jobs.title: Growth Director
jobs.description:
Privia is looking for a Sales Director to join our rapidly growing sales team. The Sales Director is responsible for achieving targets for the overall recruitment of providers into Privia Medical Group (PMG). The Sales Director is a sales professional with demonstrated experience closing complex business deals, consistently meeting and exceeding goals.

80% territory travel throughout Greater Columbus, OH and Southern Ohio area required. Individual must be located in the territory.

Primary Job Duties:

• Segment a market/region and develop a target list of independent primary care doctors and specialists
• Conduct initial sales meetings and presentations with physicians
• Follow up with interested physicians and manage opportunities to close
• Track activities, leads, and pending deals in SalesForce and participate in weekly sales calls
• Contribute new ideas and share best practices with national sales team
• Provide ongoing relationship and sales support to recruited practices
• Establish relationships with local partners and distributors
• If necessary, stand up a new market for Privia
• Perform other duties as assigned

• Bachelor's degree required; Advanced degree a plus
• 6+ years complex sales or healthcare consulting experience in a highly competitive market
• Demonstrated ability as an individual contributor in a highly competitive sales environment
• Experience exceeding sales targets with proven ability to generate in excess of $1 Million in sales
• Must provide reliable transportation
• Must comply with all HIPAA rules and regulations

Interpersonal Skills & Attributes:

• Sales orientation
• Proven ability to qualify and follow-up on leads from various sources
• Demonstrated ability to think of creative tactics to drive closure and shorten sales cycles

Physical Demands:

• Ability to constantly remain in a stationary position
• Ability to stand for 4+ hours as needed
• Ability to constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as computer and printer
• Ability to read and use close vision, including the ability to do so on a computer screen
• Ability to frequently communicate and exchange information
• Ability to frequently adjust focus
• Ability to move about the office or to other locations as needed
• Ability to occasionally position self to maintain equipment or materials including under desks or in closets
• Ability to lift, push, and/or pull up to 25 pounds, usually in the form of boxes, equipment or other small packages

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

﻿Technical Requirements (for remote workers only, not applicable for onsite/in office work):

In order to successfully work remotely, supporting our patients and providers, we require a minimum of 5 MBPS for Download Speed and 3 MBPS for the Upload Speed. This should be acquired prior to the start of your employment. The best measure of your internet speed is to use online speed tests like https://www.speedtest.net/. This gives you an update as to how fast data transfer is with your internet connection and if it meets the minimum speed requirements. Work with your internet provider if you have questions about your connection. Employees who regularly work from home offices are eligible for expense reimbursement to offset this cost.

jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer (3-5 years)
jobs.description:
Coffman Engineers is seeking a Fire Protection Engineer with three to five years of working experience, who wants to be a part of our office growth and culture. The successful candidate will have a desire to work, grow, and have fun with a multi-discipline engineering team. They are passionate about their craft and looking for an environment that promotes professional growth, diverse experience, and professional excellence.

The successful individual will have a passion for protecting lives from fire risks in the built environment. The ideal candidate will have a fire protection engineering degree, however, an engineering degree in other fields (mechanical, architectural, civil, etc.) with working experience in fire protection will also be considered.

This position will support the team in providing our clients with: fire and life safety code analysis; egress analysis; fire resistant rated construction analysis; automatic suppression system design and analysis; fire detection, alarm and communication system design and analysis; smoke control system design and special inspections; site inspections and witness of life safety system testing; fire hazard analysis; performance-based design; as well as general fire protection and life safety concepts.

The Denver Fire Protection Engineering department collectively has 50+ years of experience in Fire Protection Engineering across our department of six, all of whom will provide you with training, mentorship, and support to help you grow your career. We enjoy working together collaboratively in the office and supporting each other to deliver good engineering work that makes the world a safer place.

Requirements Include:

• Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) from accredited college or university in Fire Protection Engineering or Fire Sciences. B.S. in other engineering field combined with fire protection work experience also considered.
• 3-5 years of relevant experience.
• EIT or having passed the FE exam with the ability to obtain EIT within one year.
• Professional Engineer (PE) licensure (preferred).
• Intermediate level computer skills necessary for daily activities, including email, word processing, spreadsheets, and simple graphics.
• Managing day-to-day contacts with internal and external clients utilizing experience and technology to meet expectations.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including oral presentation skills.
• Ability to work on a highly-motivated team, think outside the box, and be proud of the work you do while having a passion for expanding your knowledge and skills.
• Working in-person in our Westminster, CO office, full-time, Monday through Friday.

Desired Skills and Duties:

• Technical writing skills.
• Project management skills for managing internal projects as well as external client needs.
• Attend and participate in local and national professional organizations, such as SFPE and NFPA.
• Perform building and fire code analysis and code interpretations.
• Prepare life safety plans.
• Perform analysis of existing fire protection systems, as well as designing new fire protection systems including suppression systems, fire detection, alarm and mass notification systems
• Perform research and documentation for internal and external distribution.
• Utilization of AutoCAD, Revit to prepare fire protection system designs.
• Utilization of FDS, Pyrosim, CONTAM programs to execute performance-based design efforts.

This position is not eligible for current or future sponsorship.

The expected annual salary range for this position is $90,000 - $115,000. No relocation assistance is provided.

jobs.title: REMOTE – USA | Hiring PHP Lead Developer / Architect (LAMP) | PHP, Laravel & AWS
jobs.description:
Role: PHP Lead Developer / Architect (LAMP)

Duration: Long Term

Location: USA- Need someone who can work in the UK time zone- Remote

Experience: 10-15 Years

Job Description:

We are hiring a hands-on technical leader to own the architecture, security posture and delivery quality of our business-critical ERP applications. You will write and review production code, set architectural direction. You will also work with infrastructure and security teams to keep our applications scalable, secure and resilient.

Technical Skills

• Core: PHP 5.x–8.x (deep OOP, SOLID, DRY, design patterns), Core PHP, Laravel 10.x–13.x, REST API design
• Data: MySQL (schema design, indexing, query optimization, replication/backup strategies)
• Platform: Linux (Ubuntu), Docker, web server tuning (Nginx/Apache)
• Cloud: AWS EC2, S3, Secrets Manager (plus IAM, VPC, security groups)
• CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Actions
• Testing: Phpunit, unit/integration/API testing, debugging and profiling tools
• Template Engines: Working experience with templating engines like Blade, Smarty, Twig
• Frontend: JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3

Core Responsibilities/Capabilities:

• Design, evaluate and recommend technical architectures for ERP modules, integrations and platform evolution.
• Stay hands-on: develop critical components, debug complex production issues and lead performance profiling and tuning.
• Own production deployments, environment setup and release readiness across dev, staging and production.
• Establish engineering standards: SOLID, DRY, design patterns, Phpunit test coverage and code quality gates.
• An eye for security vulnerabilities, SQL Injection, DDOS, XSS
• Partner with infrastructure/DevOps on CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), containerization and AWS hosting.
• Implement and operationalize SAST and DAST in CI/CD pipelines, and triage and close findings.
• Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediate issues in live production systems.
• Run security-first code reviews and threat modelling for new features and integrations.
• Compliance exposure to SOC 2 and GDPR
• Secrets handling, CI/CD design, containerization and deployment safety.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: CNA - Certified Nursing Assistant
jobs.description:
Are you friendly, passionate about serving others, and want a job where you can make a difference each day? If this sounds like you, then becoming a Certified Nurses Aide (CNA) at Miller’s Health Systems might be right the right step for you!

Additionally, the Executive Chef develops, maintains, and implements policies and procedures in line with local, State and Federal guidelines.  Responsible for the preparation and serving of meals, sanitation of food service areas, accurate record keeping, receiving, rotating and inventory of products and regulatory compliance.

jobs.title: Clinical Shift Coordinator RN-Medical Pediatrics Full Time Days
jobs.description:
The  Clinical Shift Coordinator reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the hospitalized patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation. Effectively interacts with patient, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice. This nurse functions in a leadership, overseeing daily unit operations, staff, and care delivery, utilizing a staff focused leadership model.

Responsibilities:

• Presents a friendly, approachable, professional demeanor and appearance.
• Provides accurate information and timely updates to patients and customers. Addresses questions and concerns promptly, or identifies appropriate person and resources to do so. Provides directions or help to patients and customers with finding their way.
• Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
• Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments. Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
• Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
• Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
• Contributes to opportunities and processes for continuous improvement.
• Participates in efforts to reduce costs, streamline work processes, improve and grow services we provide.
• Demonstrates proficiency as a staff nurse and serves as a role model and resource to staff.
• Maintains awareness of unstable, complex or high-risk patient conditions throughout the shift.
• Ensures appropriate assignment of care based on staff competency and patient acuity.
• Coordinates and monitors patient care to ensure patient safety.
• Collects, analyzes and organizes patient care data for the unit.
• Oversees that staff are in compliance with regulatory standards.
• Ensures adaptation of services as needed to reflect age, culture, gender, race, nationality, religion, etc.
• Oversees documentation of key critical elements for patient care and national patient safety goals (restraints, verbal orders, abbreviations, etc.)
• Ensures initial admit orders are received by end of shift.

• variances are anticipated.
• Oversees accurate completion of daily charges to ensure unit receives all appropriate revenue.
• Contributes to cost reduction and supports interventions that promote unit cost effectiveness (LOS, HPPD, OT, flexible staffing, and use of alternative skill mixes.)
• Oversees staff scheduling per unit and PCS guidelines.
• Documents appropriate staffing information and justifications in Optilink each shift.
• Checks staff timekeeping on shifts worked and oversees compliance with time and attendance policies.
• Oversees documentation of occurrences on shift and reports to Nursing leadership and risk management as appropriate.
• Ensures compliance with patient life safety standards including fire safety, handwashing, crash cart checks, etc.
• Oversees accurate accounting of unit equipment.
• Demonstrates effective oral, written, and listening skills with staff, physicians, patients and families.
• Keeps all appropriate parties informed a timely manner and understands "chain of command" accountability.
• Completes leader rounding on assigned staff routinely and consistently.
• Provides input to and may assist with organization of staff meetings. Conducts staff huddles on shift.
• Collaborates with educator and manager to ensure appropriate and complete orientation of new staff. Identifies appropriate preceptor and assigns schedule to new staff.
• Participates in unit and PCS based teams, work groups and/or committees or shared governance councils. Demonstrates willingness to give 100% and voluntarily assists others.
• Keeps staff on shift informed of unit initiatives and incorporates outcomes of the team/committees work into practice.
• Ensures all RN's, PC's perform as a team in order to complete work on time and take uninterrupted meal breaks.
• Coordinates patient placement with Clinical Placement Nurse in a timely manner and with a positive and flexible attitude.
• Displays and is responsible for "welcoming spirit" for unit by integrating students and resource team.
• Develops open, functional working relationships with other units/physicians by understanding complexities of different stakeholders; has a house wide perspective.
• Promotes an atmosphere of collective accountability for the Unit/Department.
• Performs weekend leadership rounding on all patients and assists Clinical Manager during week as needed.
• Contributes to annual employee performance evaluation and is present when evaluation is given.
• Conducts formal staff rounding with assigned group of staff on a consistent basis at frequency identified by Manager. Follow up with all new employees on shift as identified by Manager.
• Contributes to completion of minor disciplinary action; may cover this independently with staff member under the approval of Clinical Manager. Provides feedback to Manager for development plans that are needed for staff they lead.
• Demonstrates ability to coach staff effectively using leadership skills.
• Participates in interview process for candidates seeking position on his/her shift.
• Uses retention strategies to recognize and reward staff on shift.
• Serves as Qualified Observer to ensure completion of annual competencies of staff on his/her shift.
• Participates in quality improvement initiatives for unit and as appropriate for PCS. Displays knowledge of PI process.
• Supports staff to incorporate EBP/research findings into practice at the bedside.
• Oversees environment of care and regulatory readiness with all regulatory bodies.
• Is a shift leader and is accountable for hardwiring evidence based and unit specific tactics for patient satisfaction (Hourly Rounding, bedside shift report, discharge calls, and AIDET.)
• Monitors for improvement of chart audit findings at employee level and provides follow-up.
• Other duties and responsibilities as assigned

Required

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
• 3 Years RN experience

jobs.title: Technical Customer Sales Engineer - Manufacturing Diagnostics
jobs.description:
The Technical Customer Sales Engineer (CSE) will be responsible for driving business growth for ETAS Manufacturing Diagnostics by identifying new market opportunities, partnering with customers and sales teams, and aligning customer needs with innovative diagnostic solutions. The role serves as a key technical and strategic interface between customers, sales, and product management, supporting pre-sales activities, solution development, and product roadmap evolution. The CSE will also contribute to the successful deployment and delivery of manufacturing diagnostic solutions through customer engagement, technical consulting, and on-site implementation support.  Key responsibilities:

Identify opportunities and lead business acquisition

• Identify, evaluate, and drive new business opportunities, markets, and customer segments to ensure sustainable growth of the Manufacturing Diagnostics business.
• Act as the strategic interface between Sales, Customers, and the Product Field to ensure alignment of market needs with product capabilities.
• Constantly survey customer segments, value propositions, and competitor activities; bring market needs and insights to Product Management to influence the product vision and roadmap.

Assist Sales in Product and Solution Pitching

• Collaborate closely with the sales team, participating in pre-sales activities to demonstrate products (e.g., VCATS system) and customized solutions to customers as a technical expert.
• Assist in creating pre-sales materials, customer documentation, and training materials, clearly conveying product vision, features, and business value to customers.
• Experience utilizing cost-benefit analyses and analyzing market trends or business data to provide technical support to sales teams during commercial negotiations.
• Collect real customer feedback from the field and channel it back to the product management team to drive the evolution of the product roadmap.

Clarify Customer Requirements and Specify Solutions

• Ability to engage with internal and external customers (e.g., OEMs) to clarify and analyze their manufacturing diagnostics and testing needs.
• Prepare and define user requirement documentation, translating business needs into executable technical solutions and the team backlog.
• Draft and define clear acceptance criteria, elaborating and breaking down technical solutions and program features while maintaining conceptual and technical integrity.

Technical Delivery and Quality Assurance

• Authoring Manufacturing Diagnostics Tests and Sequences executed at the Production Line of the Vehicle Manufacturer.
• Responsible for the on-site deployment, configuration, and testing of hardware and software solutions (e.g., diagnostic test sequences, runtime environments, server setups, and plant-specific networks).
• Lead on-site verification and troubleshooting, capable of resolving complex technical issues during project execution independently or with minimal assistance.
• Create/update validation test documentation, participating in QA and Production release reviews.

Education:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Electrical or other relevant discipline.
• Minimum 5-years experience within the automotive industry and technology.

Technical Skills:

• Knowledge and understanding of vehicle diagnostics (at least one automotive diagnostic protocol such as ISO14229, ISO15765, KWP2000, J1939, ISO14230, or ISO13400).
• IT system and network foundation (Windows XP/7/10 environments, VMware/Virtual Box virtualization, Windows background services, TCP/IP, DHCP).
• Experience with databases (Microsoft SQL Server) and data formats (XML, ODX, OTX).
• Proficiency using packet capture and analysis tools (Wireshark, CAN/DoIP logs); ability to read electrical drawings and schematics.
• Experience with programming languages, eg C++,JavaScripts
• Experience fault-finding, debugging, and troubleshooting capabilities.

Core Competencies:

• Ability to influence through communication, capable of communicating visions and technical solutions to diverse stakeholders (customers, sales, R&D).
• Managing projects with defined business outcomes, a result-oriented approach, ability to identify and execute new business opportunities
• Experience applying agile and lean methodologies, such as SAFe, Scrum, Kanban, or OKR frameworks.
• Experience using JIRA for task and backlog management

Travel:

• Up to 50% travel may be required

The Director of Finance is responsible for the strategic leadership and day-to-day financial operations of the Limelight Aspen and Limelight Snowmass hotel properties while providing oversight and support for all financial and accounting functions across the hotels. The Director of Finance supervises and directs all aspects of financial operations, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), credit and collections, payroll, cash management, internal controls, auditing, general ledger, financial reporting, tax compliance, budgeting, and forecasting. The Director of Finance partners closely with the Senior Director of Finance and the Hotel General Managers to ensure sound financial management, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and the achievement of the hotels' financial objectives. This position reports to the Senior Director of Finance.

jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs Business Development

The Director, Regulatory Business Development ensures business needs are met by anticipating, identifying, prioritizing and communicating regulatory risks, as well as developing R&D scenarios to address and mitigate the risks associated with candidates undergoing evaluation. This role supports regulatory activities associated with business transactions including in-licensing and out-licensing, co-development/collaborations, acquisitions of new chemical or molecular entities including advanced, tissue, and cell-based therapies, platform technologies, marketed products, and company acquisitions to further the company’s overall strategic business development objectives.

jobs.title: CNC Programmer - 1st Shift
jobs.description:
The CNC Programmer will program Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machines (Milling, Waterjet, Cutter), perform setup and machining first runs of new machined parts, conduct operator training, and setup of production and maintenance support items using CNC Mills, Standard Mills, Standard Lathes, Waterjet and Textile Cutters and other related equipment.

First Shift Schedule:  Monday - Friday, 8:00 am - 5:00 pm

What You'll Do

• Program for Precision: Develop, modify, and prove out CNC programs for mills, routers, waterjets, and textile cutters, supporting both new product development and ongoing production needs.
• Bring Designs to Life: Interpret engineering drawings, customer specifications, machining parameters, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) requirements to plan effective machining processes.
• Set Up & Optimize: Perform machine setups, configure tooling and offsets, establish reference points, and verify program accuracy through first-run machining and inspection.
• Leverage Advanced Software: Use Mastercam, AutoCAD, and 3D modeling tools to develop machining programs for simple and complex parts. Program waterjet and textile cutting equipment using applicable software.
• Solve Technical Challenges: Troubleshoot machining issues, adjust programs and controls, replace worn tooling, and maintain quality standards throughout the manufacturing process.
• Design Custom Solutions: Develop fixtures, tooling, experimental parts, and working sketches to support specialized production and engineering requirements. Coordinate with vendors to fabricate custom tooling when needed.
• Support Production Excellence: Create and maintain accurate machining work instructions, manage CNC tooling inventory, and help improve work center efficiency.
• Share Your Expertise: Train production employees in the safe and effective operation of CNC equipment, promoting consistent processes and quality results.
• Collaborate Across Teams: Partner with engineering, production, and other departments to resolve problems, meet customer requirements, and support continuous improvement.
• Work Safely: Follow established safety practices, company policies, and applicable quality and environmental management requirements.

What You'll Bring

Education & Experience

• Associate degree in Applied Science in Computer-Integrated Machining or a related discipline from a two-year college or technical school, or an equivalent combination of education, certifications, and experience.
• Previous experience as a CNC programmer or machinist in a manufacturing or product development environment is preferred.

Technical Expertise

• Proficiency in G-code programming and CNC machining processes.
• Experience with Mastercam 2024 or newer and AutoCAD 2024 or newer.
• Experience with Autodesk Inventor 3D and/or SolidWorks.
• Knowledge of CNC routers and mills, conventional mills and lathes, machine controls, tooling, offsets, and setup procedures.
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, customer specifications, and GD&T requirements.
• Ability to machine both fibrous materials and metals.
• Strong mathematical skills, including basic calculations, geometry, and trigonometry.
• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and other relevant computer-based systems.

Experience with the following equipment and systems is a plus:

• 3-axis CNC routers and mills, particularly MultiCam.
• 5-axis CNC routers and mills, particularly C.R. Onsrud machines with MachMotion or FANUC controllers.
• Aggregates and angle heads.
• FLOW waterjet systems and Flow Cut/Flow Path software.
• Eastman textile cutters and Eastman Cut Pro software.
• Standard machining equipment, including conventional mills and lathes.

The Qualities That Will Set You Apart

• Analytical problem-solver: You can break down complex machining challenges, troubleshoot issues, and develop practical solutions.
• Detail-oriented: You understand that precision, accuracy, and careful verification are essential to producing quality parts.
• Independent and resourceful: You take initiative, exercise sound judgment, and know how to find answers when challenges arise.
• Collaborative communicator: You work effectively with people across departments and organizational levels, sharing technical information clearly and respectfully.
• Continuous improver: You look for opportunities to improve machining processes, work instructions, tooling, and overall work center performance.
• Committed to safety and quality: You take pride in following established procedures and helping others work safely and effectively.

Working Environment & Physical Requirements

This position works in both office and manufacturing environments, with exposure to loud noise, moving mechanical equipment, and fumes or airborne particles. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) includes approved footwear, safety glasses or goggles, and respirators when applicable.

The role requires the ability to sit and stand for extended periods, bend, reach, use stairs, and lift up to 50 pounds, with occasional team lifting of up to 100 pounds. Effective communication and the ability to use computers and related equipment are also required. Reasonable accommodations will be considered where feasible.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Aftermarket (Outside Sales)
jobs.description:
The Sales Manager, Aftermarket is a results-driven, outside sales "hunter" responsible for proactively identifying, pursuing, and closing new aftermarket parts and services business across an assigned territory and customer base. The Sales Manager spends the majority of time in the field and traveling to customer sites, industry events, and railroad facilities to build relationships, uncover opportunities, and win business. • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the assigned territory (typically 50% or more), including overnight travel, to visit customers and prospects in person.

• Hunter mentality and drive for new business

• Negotiation and deal-closing

• Customer focus and relationship building

• Integrity and trust

• Self-direction and independent territory management

• Adaptability and flexibility

• Accountability and drive for results

• Strategic planning and pipeline management

• Critical thinking and learning agility

Key Responsibilities

• Own new business development for aftermarket parts and services within an assigned territory, with a primary focus on hunting and closing new revenue rather than managing existing accounts.

• Monitor competitive activity, market trends, pricing dynamics, and customer capital/maintenance plans to identify new sales opportunities.

• Represent Harsco Rail at industry trade shows, conferences, and customer events to generate leads and strengthen brand presence.

• Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline reviews, and territory performance updates to the Director, Aftermarket Sales.

• Champion continuous improvement of the aftermarket sales process and share market intelligence and customer feedback with product, marketing, and operations teams.

This researcher will contribute to the identification and validation of novel therapeutics for inflammatory skin diseases. The Dermatology Discovery team applies human disease transcriptomic and multi-omics data sets in combination with wet-bench science to perform mechanistic in vitro studies with the overarching goal to elucidate disease-driving mechanisms that will advance innovative therapeutic strategies. The successful candidate will play a key role in the preclinical research team by conducting in vitro models focusing on human translation to HS and PsO.

• Sterile cell culture (cell lines and primary human and murine cells)

• Process and analyze ex-vivo human tissues for disease-relevant endpoints
• Perform analyses using the following techniques:

• Flow cytometry
• Quantitative PCR
• Protein analyses – ELISA, MSD and multiplex assays
• Western blotting
• Microscopy

• Develop and implement assays that monitor cellular processes

• Analyze data using appropriate statistical methods and communicate findings through presentations and scientific discussions
• Maintain detailed experimental records and ensure compliance with electronic laboratory notebook
• Prior hands-on experience with keratinocytes, fibroblasts, and immune cells (Th17 T cell differentiation, macrophage polarization) is a plus
• Candidates with prior experience in complex human in vitro model will receive extra consideration

• Bachelor’s degree in molecular biology, immunology or other biological sciences (BS/BA) with 5 years of experience
• Master’s degree with 2 years of experience is desired

• Builds strong relationships with peers and cross functionally with partners outside of the team to enable high performance

jobs.title: Customer Experience Specialist
jobs.description:
The Customer Experience Specialist (CXS) serves as an internal liaison between the Customer, the Customer Experience Account Manager (CXAM), Service Operations and Billing. The role is directly responsible for order accuracy and progression.

Primary Responsibilities:

•    Order creation – Understand and fulfill all requirements for a “complete” order every time, following established Standard Work.  This includes pricing in place, profiles that are active and will remain active until receipt at facility, supplies requested, labor required, transportation needs, and waste inventory.

•    Order scheduling – Coordinate directly with operations to schedule required work, using systems in place (Preview, CORE, etc.), while understanding that direct communication is sometimes needed to make sure service is provided that meets or exceeds customer expectations.

•    Order follow up – Follow order progression through service, receipt at end of service location, and monitor all pieces required to fully invoice every order once service is completed.  Be prepared to engage with operational team members in transportation, service centers or plants to help push orders to completion when needed.

•    Order invoicing – Finalize orders before invoicing, fulfilling non-disposal order lines, while cross-referencing service details that are provided by operations.

•    Order management – Engage with order metrics, actively follow open orders that are not progressing as expected, and be able to speak to order status for your customer groups.

•    Internal customer experience – Understand the relationships between CX, operations and sales, and provide what each group needs to service the customer right the first time, every time.  Provide information to CXAM and/or directly to customer when needed, helping to facilitate profiling, pricing, and order clarification.  Be the communication bridge between customer/sales and operations/service providers.

•    Improvement opportunity management – Escalate service issues appropriately.  Use customer complaint tools and follow opportunities for improvement through to completion, using customer satisfaction feedback as the closing factor.

•    Metrics – Understand, provide, and track metrics per Standard Work practices, actionable reports, and financial goals.  Metrics will include order accuracy, delays in billing, communication timeframes and standards, attendance and participation in cross-functional meetings as required, and internal/external customer feedback.

•    Leadership - Mentor team members, lead team meetings, participate in feedback sessions, bring ideas for better customer experience to management, with a focus on team building and growth.  Understand the needs of both the smaller team and the larger teams and be a fully engaged member of both.

Basic Required Qualifications:

•  High School Diploma or GED

•    Preferred 2 years in customer service (order management) or other industry roles (5 years minimum with high school diploma).

•    Strong communication, analytical, and organizational skills.

•    Proficiency in CRM Microsoft Office Suite.

•    Willingness to travel up to 10%.

Preferred Qualifications:

•    Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as RCRA, DOT, DEA, and OSHA

•    Experience with ERP/company order processing systems (CORE, Preview, SPAK, Steriwise)

Benefits: Comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, commencing no later than January 1, 2027, benefits package will include participation in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement. Pay and benefits for employees represented by a union are outlined in their collective bargaining agreement. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. jobs.title: VP Sales
jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Vice President, Sales to lead strategic growth initiatives, drive market expansion, and achieve revenue targets across exhibitions, events & media in the Fashion portfolio. This role combines leadership in business development, account management, and sales strategy, with overall accountability for the business unit's revenue performance. The ideal candidate will have a proven ability to build high-performing teams, foster strategic partnerships, and maintain deep industry relationships, while ensuring the delivery of the agreed sales and financial revenue plan.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Business Development

• Develop and execute business development strategies aligned with company objectives and long-term growth ambitions
• Identify and launch new market opportunities domestically and internationally to drive sustainable revenue growth
• Leverage customer insights and market intelligence to refine strategies targeting key demographics, verticals, and emerging segments
• Collaborate with Marketing to design and execute integrated campaigns for customer acquisition, retention, and engagement

Revenue Accountability

• Take full ownership of revenue performance, ensuring delivery of the agreed sales and financial revenue plan
• Monitor and manage revenue streams to maximize profitability
• Prepare detailed revenue reports, forecasts, and performance analyses, providing actionable insights to senior leadership
• Identify revenue risks and opportunities early, implementing corrective actions to maintain trajectory

Team Leadership & Development

• Lead, mentor, and manage Heads of Sales, Sales Directors, Managers, and Representatives through transparent, data-driven leadership
• Foster a culture of open communication where wins are celebrated publicly and challenges are addressed directly with empathy and solutions-focused dialogue
• Conduct regular 1:1 meetings that combine performance data with coaching conversations, creating clarity on expectations and pathways to success
• Use metrics and insights to identify performance gaps early, working collaboratively with team members to develop actionable improvement plans
• Make decisive talent decisions including hiring, promotion, and performance management, always grounded in objective data and delivered with respect
• Recognize and reward excellence visibly, while addressing underperformance promptly through honest, constructive feedback supported by clear evidence

Market Expansion & Relationship Building

• Build and maintain deep relationships with key stakeholders, industry partners, and C-level decision-makers
• Represent the company at industry events, partnership meetings, and networking opportunities
• Organize quarterly high-level meetings with key customers to understand evolving needs and create tailored solutions
• Stay ahead of industry trends and competitive dynamics to proactively adjust sales strategies

Sales Operations & Performance Management

• Oversee sales pipeline management, budgets, forecasting accuracy, and CRM data integrity (Salesforce preferred)
• Develop and execute sales strategies across diverse product categories, market segments, and customer types
• Lead sales campaign execution, including targeting, pipeline development, deal closing, and performance reporting
• Define individual quotas, develop competitive compensation plans, and ensure accurate reporting of sales performance metrics

Customer Focus & Account Growth

• Meet regularly with key customers to assess needs, strengthen relationships, and identify expansion opportunities
• Drive retention and growth through strategic cross-selling, upselling, and rebooking strategies
• Focus on acquiring large key accounts and expanding customer reach through proactive new business development
• Champion customer success by ensuring seamless delivery and exceptional service across all touchpoints

Sales Culture & Internal Collaboration

• Build an effective sales culture across the business, fostering collaboration with other functions
• Maintain open communication with internal stakeholders to share customer insights and market dynamics
• Drive innovation in sales approaches, tools, and methodologies to maintain competitive advantage

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or equivalent professional experience
• 10+ years in events, media, or related industries leading high-performing sales teams with a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets of 50M+
• Expertise in building and scaling sales organizations across multiple product lines and markets
• Advanced proficiency in CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and data-driven performance management
• Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to inspire teams through transparent, empathetic, and results-oriented approaches
• Strong strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and ability to develop relationships at senior executive levels
• Demonstrated success in managing complex B2B sales cycles, key account growth, and cross-functional collaboration
• Resilient and adaptable in fast-paced, complex environments
• Lead with empathy, understanding diverse perspectives and motivations while maintaining high standards
• Create psychological safety where team members can be vulnerable about challenges while remaining accountable for results
• Manage and develop diverse teams, creating inclusive and positive team dynamics
• Navigate complex interpersonal situations with sensitivity, honesty, and professionalism
• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (up to 40%)

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Web
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Product Manager, Web to join our global Web Product team and help shape the digital experiences that connect customers, partners, and engineers with Renesas products, solutions, technical resources, and services.

This role will support renesas.com and its connected web and digital properties, managing a portfolio of customer-facing experiences and platform capabilities across the Renesas web ecosystem. You will define product direction, translate business and customer needs into actionable roadmaps, and work closely with engineering, design, content, technical documentation, marketing, and our product group teams to deliver measurable improvements.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management fundamentals with the technical curiosity required to work in a complex semiconductor and digital-product environment. Experience within the semiconductor industry, an electrical engineering background, or experience building products for engineers and other highly technical audiences is strongly preferred.

Reporting to the Head of Product, Web & Digital, this position offers the opportunity to influence the digital experience of a global semiconductor company while working across a broad portfolio of high-impact initiatives.

Responsibilities:

• Own and advance product roadmaps for assigned areas of renesas.com and related digital properties, aligning priorities with customer needs, business goals, platform strategy, and available team capacity.

• Develop a deep understanding of Renesas customers, including engineers, developers, buyers, partners, and other technical audiences, and use those insights to identify opportunities, address friction, and improve the end-to-end digital experience.

• Lead product discovery activities, including stakeholder interviews, customer research, analytics reviews, journey analysis, competitive research, problem definition, solution evaluation, and concept validation.

• Translate product strategy and business requirements into clearly defined initiatives, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, prototypes, and measurable success criteria.

• Maintain and prioritize a healthy product backlog, balancing roadmap commitments, operational needs, technical improvements, customer-impacting issues, dependencies, and emerging opportunities.

• Partner closely with engineering and architecture teams throughout estimation, planning, development, testing, launch, and post-launch optimization.

• Collaborate with UX and visual design teams to define intuitive, accessible, and scalable experiences across desktop and mobile channels.

• Coordinate with content, technical documentation, product marketing, product-line, sales, support, and regional stakeholders to ensure solutions are accurate, useful, launch-ready, and supported by the necessary content and business processes.

• Define and monitor product metrics using quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate adoption, customer behavior, usability, operational performance, and business impact.

• Partner with the AI Product Enablement Lead and other team members to identify responsible opportunities to improve customer experiences and product-management workflows through AI, automation, semantic search, and emerging digital capabilities.

• Help improve product-management standards, reusable processes, documentation, and operating practices across the Web Product team.

• Communicate product direction, delivery status, decisions, risks, and results clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related discipline.

• Five or more years of experience in digital product management, software product management, web product management, or a closely related role.

• Experience managing global, multilingual, enterprise-scale websites or digital platforms.

• Demonstrated experience owning complex digital products or platforms from discovery and strategy through delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization.

• Strong understanding of modern product management practices, including customer discovery, roadmap development, prioritization, backlog management, requirements definition, agile delivery, experimentation, and product analytics.

• Experience working closely with software engineering, UX design, content, analytics, and business teams in a highly cross-functional environment.

• Experience managing multiple initiatives with competing priorities, dependencies, stakeholders, and delivery timelines.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data, research, and customer feedback to make sound product decisions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly and influence stakeholders at multiple levels of an organization.

• Ability to operate effectively within a global, matrixed organization and collaborate across business functions, regions, cultures, and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience working within the semiconductor, electronics, embedded systems, or broader technology industry.

• Professional or academic experience in electrical engineering, computer engineering, embedded systems, or a related technical field.

• A minimum of a basic familiarity with how engineers research, evaluate, select, design with, and obtain support for semiconductor products.

• Experience working with technical product information such as parametric data, datasheets, application notes, reference designs, software and development tools, evaluation boards, technical models, quality documentation, or product lifecycle data.

• Familiarity with content management systems, search platforms, APIs, structured data, analytics tools, experimentation platforms, personalization, cloud infrastructure, content delivery networks, and identity or customer-portal technologies.

• Experience incorporating AI, semantic search, automation, or agent-based capabilities into digital products or product-management workflows.

• Experience managing vendor-supported products, platform usage, licensing considerations, or technology budgets.

• Master’s degree or MBA.

Palm Bay, Florida and San Jose, California are other areas of consideration for this role.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. Identify opportunities for process optimization and efficiency gains, leveraging data analytics to develop long-term continuous improvement programs that achieve strategic objectives.

•Drive the end-to-end procurement process from sourcing strategy to contract negotiation and execution, leading negotiations with key category suppliers and strengthening decisions with strong analytical insight and strategic perspective.

•Lead & coach a team of Managers, setting ambitious performance targets, providing tailored coaching, and evaluating team performance. Assist in planning to address skillsets, workforce requirements, capability needs, and long-term organizational staffing goals.

.

•Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Mgmt or related field. Master’s degree is preferred.

•Minimum of 7- 10 years of experience in capital projects procurement, supply chain, or related business or operations function.

•Previous experience leading category teams, partnering with major suppliers, and reporting to senior leaders.

•Strong proficiency in developing high-impact executive-level deliverables.

•Knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry is strongly preferred.

•Comprehensive expertise in category management, including market analysis, cost and financial assessment, ensuring strategic and informed procurement decisions. Fluency in negotiation and bidding, adept in overseeing complex projects with a focus on effective change management.

•Strong capabilities in internal stakeholder management and influence, aligning procurement strategies with business needs and fostering collaborative supplier relationships.

•Strategic thinking and accountability, anticipating future trends, and taking responsibility for impactful procurement outcomes that challenge the status quo.

•Innovative problem-solving skills combined with a significant executive presence, enabling creative solutions and influential communication at all organizational levels. High cross-functional leadership abilities, conflict resolution skills, effectively navigating & harmonizing diverse team dynamics.

•Exceptional interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence, facilitating empathetic interactions, effective communication, and robust relationship-building across a matrixed organization. High resilience under pressure and autonomous work ethic, maintaining performance in challenging situations and making independent decisions.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Planning & Forecasting (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Sr. Director, Planning & Forecasting to lead the Planning function within Lakeshore’s Supply Chain business unit and guide our integrated business planning. In this role, you’ll own the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process end to end, driving alignment across demand, supply, inventory and revenue plans, and you’ll be a key voice in executive decisions on inventory investment, capacity commitments and business performance.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone who can turn market demand signals into a disciplined, data-driven operating plan for our multi-DC distribution network and retail stores. You’ll set the strategic direction for the Planning team while owning the department’s KPIs, leading six direct reports and a broader team of 20+ planning professionals responsible for item-level forecasting, PO creation, DC inventory positioning and safety stock strategy.

Reporting to the SVP, Planning, you’ll continue advancing our planning capabilities in SAP S/4HANA, evaluating and implementing automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools and advanced analytics that make planning decisions faster and sharper. We’re looking for a leader who is equally strong at analyzing scenarios, developing planning talent and presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership. It’s meaningful work: when the plan is right, classrooms and families get what they need, when they need it.

A day on the job looks like this:

• Leading the monthly S&OP process, from item-level demand forecast through the executive S&OP meeting, and driving alignment between the forecast, inventory targets and revenue plan
• Coaching and developing six direct reports and a team of 20+ while staying hands-on in daily operations, building the skills and bench strength the team needs to grow
• Overseeing all import and domestic inventory buys within Open-to-Buy (OTB) limits, and leading the domestic expediting team to deliver every buy on time and in full
• Managing item-level inventory availability across two distribution centers and all retail store locations to meet inventory and customer fulfillment goals, and recommending inventory investment strategy to senior leadership
• Defining and governing the inventory segmentation framework, including ABC classification, growth velocity tiering and lifecycle-based safety stock policy
• Driving cross-functional process improvement projects that move department and company KPIs
• Evolving planning capabilities in SAP S/4HANA by evaluating and implementing automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools and advanced analytics

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:

Required:

• 10+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics or operations management
• 7+ years in a management role leading planning, inventory or buying teams
• Expertise in import and domestic buying of consumer packaged goods or finished goods
• Experience managing inventory across a multi-tier distribution network and global supply chain, including multi-channel fulfillment and retail allocation
• Advanced working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA
• Proven success leading continuous improvement projects

Preferred:

• Experience applying automation, AI-enabled forecasting tools or advanced analytics to demand and supply planning
• Experience building inventory segmentation and safety stock policies (ABC, velocity tiering, lifecycle-based)

jobs.title: Transportation Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Transportation Specialist supports the Import/Export Coordinator with managing the day-to-day transportation of Aftermarket kits, rail maintenance machines, components, and other finished goods. This position is responsible for arranging transportation, preparing and reviewing shipping documentation, supporting import/export compliance, and coordinating shipments from order release through delivery. The Transportation Specialist will work closely with Aftermarket, Materials, Planning, Production, Sales, suppliers, carriers, freight forwarders, and customers to make sure shipments move safely, accurately, and on time. The right person needs to be comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment where priorities can change quickly. This is a hands-on position that requires strong follow-up, attention to detail, and the ability to resolve transportation issues before they impact the customer.

Primary Responsibilities

Will include the following, but other duties may be assigned:

• Arrange and coordinate LTL, FTL, expedited, flatbed, specialized, and other transportation services based on shipment requirements.

• Obtain freight quotes and compare transportation options based on cost, transit time, service requirements, and customer commitments.

• Schedule pickups and deliveries with carriers, freight forwarders, customers, and internal departments.

• Track shipments from pickup through delivery and communicate delays or issues to the appropriate team.

• Maintain visibility of open shipments and proactively follow up on past-due or at-risk deliveries.

• Coordinate transportation for large rail maintenance machines, oversized equipment, aftermarket kits, and miscellaneous components.

• Help establish the most cost-effective and reliable transportation method for each shipment.

• Work with carriers to resolve missed pickups, damaged freight, delivery issues, and other transportation problems.

• Maintain accurate transportation records and carrier information.

• Support the Import/Export Specialist with day-to-day import and export activities.

• Assist with determining and maintaining appropriate HTS (Harmonized Tariff Schedule) codes for products and components.

• Prepare and review export documentation to ensure shipments have the required paperwork before departure.

• Support preparation of commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates, export documentation, and other required shipping records.

• Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, and internal personnel to resolve documentation or customs issues.

• Help ensure shipments comply with applicable company procedures and import/export regulations.

• Maintain organized records for import/export transactions and supporting documentation.

• Escalate potential compliance issues to the Import/Export Manager before shipments are released.

• Prepare and verify Bills of Lading (BOLs) for domestic and international shipments.

• Prepare and verify packing lists against the actual shipment.

• Ensure shipping documents accurately reflect part numbers, quantities, weights, dimensions, and customer requirements.

• Verify shipment requirements before loading, including special handling, customer routing instructions, and carrier requirements.

• Coordinate required documentation for oversized or specialized equipment shipments.

• Maintain documentation in accordance with company record-retention requirements.

• Support the overall shipment process for Aftermarket kits and rail maintenance machines.

• Work closely with the Aftermarket team to understand customer-required ship dates and transportation requirements.

• Coordinate with Production, Materials, Kitting, and Shipping to ensure product is ready before scheduling transportation.

• Identify shipment risks early and communicate them to the appropriate supervisor or manager.

• Help prioritize transportation based on customer commitments, past-due orders, machine availability, and business needs.

• Support shipment planning for large kits and machine-related components where multiple shipments may be required.

• Coordinate with Sales and Customer Service when transportation requirements or customer delivery commitments change.

• Maintain accurate transportation information in the company's ERP and/or transportation systems.

• Enter and maintain freight, carrier, tracking, shipment, and documentation information as required.

• Monitor transportation costs and identify opportunities to reduce freight expense.

• Assist with freight invoice review and resolution of billing discrepancies.

• Track transportation performance, including freight cost, on-time pickup, on-time delivery, and carrier performance.

• Provide data and reporting to the Import/Export Manager and Supply Chain leadership as needed.

I. Basic Qualifications (Required)

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• 2+ years of experience in transportation, logistics, shipping, supply chain, or a manufacturing environment preferred.

• Working knowledge of LTL and FTL transportation.

• Experience preparing or working with BOLs, packing lists, freight documentation, and shipping records.

• Basic understanding of import/export documentation preferred.

• Basic understanding of HTS codes and customs requirements preferred.

• Strong computer skills and ability to learn ERP and transportation systems.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously.

• Ability to communicate effectively with carriers, suppliers, customers, and internal departments.

• Ability to work independently and make sound decisions within established procedures.

II. Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with international freight and export documentation.

• Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers.

• Experience with HTS classification.

• Experience shipping oversized equipment, machinery, or industrial products.

• Experience in a manufacturing or heavy industrial environment.

• Experience with an ERP system such as Infor LN.

• Experience with freight management or transportation management systems.

• Knowledge of Incoterms and international shipping requirements.

III. Core Competencies

• Strong understanding of production processes and manufacturing techniques.

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex schedules in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify critical paths, analyze complex data, and make informed decisions.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate and coordinate with diverse teams and stakeholders.

• Exceptional organization and time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

• Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in maintaining and updating schedules.

• Ability to work well under pressure and adapt to changing priorities and requirements.

• Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools, such as Excel, to generate reports and metrics.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

• Experience using advanced Excel techniques to parse data and provide reports.

IV. Career Progression

Harsco Rail is committed to developing employees through defined career progression opportunities. Progression is based on demonstrated performance, technical proficiency, business needs, leadership behaviors, and management approval.

Level C

• Entry-level employee who learns and performs routine assignments under close supervision while developing technical skills and knowledge of Harsco Rail processes, quality standards, and safety procedures

• Builds foundational knowledge while demonstrating safe work practices.

Level B

• Performs routine and moderately complex work independently.

• Consistently meets safety, quality, and productivity expectations.

• Continues developing technical skills.

Level A

• Performs all duties independently.

• Handles complex assignments.

• Assists with training and process improvements.

Senior

• Technical expert performing the most complex work.

• Mentors and coaches others.

• Leads troubleshooting and continuous improvement.

• Supports leadership with technical guidance.

• Supports leadership with technical guidance and problem-solving, assisting with process improvements, and serves as a role model for safety, quality, and operational excellence

Advancement Considerations

• Technical proficiency

• Quality of work

• Safety performance

• Productivity

• Attendance & dependability

• Cross-training

• Leadership & mentoring

• Performance evaluations

• Business need and management approval

V. Work Environment & Physical Requirements

• Work is performed in a manufacturing and/or warehouse environment with exposure to noise, moving equipment, and varying temperatures.

• Requires standing, walking, bending, and reaching for extended periods.

• Must be able to lift up to X lbs

• Use of required personal protective equipment (PPE) is mandatory.

VI. Schedule / Shift

• Work schedule and shift assignment may vary based on operational needs.

• Overtime, weekend, and holiday work may be required as business demands dictate.

Additional Information:

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required.

We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or genetics. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
ABOUT HUDU:

Hudu is a fast-growing SaaS platform built exclusively for IT professionals and Managed Service Providers (MSPs). We give teams a single, secure, and beautifully simple place to store, organize, and share everything that keeps modern IT environments running: passwords, network documentation, processes, assets, client knowledge, and more. By replacing scattered spreadsheets, outdated wikis, and a dozen disconnected tools with one unified, customizable solution, Hudu helps thousands of IT teams save time, reduce risk, deliver better service, and scale with confidence.



About the Role

We're seeking a high-performing Account Executive (AE) to join our team at Hudu and own the full sales cycle—from discovery through close. In this role, you will manage inbound and outbound opportunities, run product demonstrations, and guide prospects through the buying process from discovery to close.



You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and customer success to ensure prospects have a smooth buying experience. The ideal candidate is organized, curious, and energized by new technology—especially AI and how it is transforming modern sales workflows. 



We’re looking for someone early in their career who is eager to learn, enjoys experimenting with new tools, and is excited about using AI to improve prospecting, communication, and sales efficiency. If you have a background in the IT or MSP space and are looking to pivot your technical knowledge into a high-growth sales role, we want to talk to you.



The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following:

 - Pipeline Management:
   Manage inbound and self-sourced opportunities through a structured pipeline. Maintain accurate CRM records and ensure opportunities move efficiently through each stage of the sales process.

 - Discovery & Qualification:

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
CodaMetrix is revolutionizing Revenue Cycle Management with its AI-powered autonomous coding solution, a multi-specialty AI-platform that translates clinical information into accurate sets of medical codes. CodaMetrix’s  autonomous coding drives efficiency under fee-for-service and value-based care models and supports improved patient care. We are passionate about getting physicians and healthcare providers away from the keyboard and back to clinical care.


OVERVIEW

The Senior Data Engineer is a member of the Data Platform team, reporting to the Director of Machine Learning Engineering and Data. The Data Platform team is responsible for executing the data strategy for the organization, ensuring high-quality external data is ingested into the Lakehouse and realized in powerful insights for internal and external customers, while ensuring ML/AI, BI and customer success teams have the data they need to develop and train their models, build insightful dashboards and design semantic layer. 




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Technical strategy and roadmap - Contribute to the vision, architecture, and roadmap for the CodaMetrix data platform, ensuring scalability, reliability, regulatory alignment, and operational excellence. Participate in key technology decisions, disaster recovery design, architecture reviews, and data engineering standards across teams.

 - Platform Engineering at Scale - Design, build, and maintain scalable streaming and batch data platforms Databricks using PySpark, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and Structured Streaming. Own Terraform-based infrastructure across environments, including jobs, catalogs, schemas, permissions, compute policies, volumes, and external locations. Build Jenkins CI/CD workflows for automated testing, tagging, and deployments, while optimizing training pipelines, materialized views, retention policies, and production performance.

 - Data Governance & Security - Implement and evolve least-privilege access controls across Databricks using Unity Catalog grants, YAML-driven group policies, and schema-level restrictions. Ensure HIPAA and SOC 2 compliance through PHI masking, audit logging, environment-level data segmentation, user provisioning, compute policies, and cost attribution.

 - Cost Optimization & Operational Excellence - Drive platform cost reduction through compute policy tuning, serverless optimization, reserved pools, materialized view improvements, and remediation of underutilized resources. Monitor Databricks/AWS spend (using tools like CloudZero and AWS Cost Explorer), own cost attribution and budgeting, resolve production incidents, and maintain runbooks to ensure platform SLAs for uptime and performance.

 - Cross-Functional Enablement & Mentorship - Enable ML, BI, Analytics, DevOps, and customer success and implementation teams with training data pipelines, model-ready datasets, feature store architecture, optimized views, dashboards, Tableau refreshes, infrastructure changes, and tenant onboarding. Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, establish quality standards, and serve as a subject matter expert for data platform engineering across the organization.




REQUIREMENTS

Must-Haves

 - A degree in Computer Science or a related field (Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D.), or an equivalent combination of education and demonstrable professional experience

 - 3-5+ years of data engineering experience with progressive responsibility

 - 3-5+ years hands-on experience with the Databricks platform (Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Structured Streaming, Spark SQL, cluster management, platform administration)

 - Expert proficiency in PySpark and Python; working knowledge of Scala

 - Expert experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code (state management, modular structures, multi-environment deployments, YAML-driven configuration)

 - Expert experience with Apache Kafka / AWS MSK (streaming ingestion, SASL/IAM auth, topic management, cluster migrations)

 - Deep understanding of medallion/lakehouse architecture patterns (bronze/silver/gold, SCD2, materialized views, slowly changing dimensions)

 - Proven track record building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) for data platform deployments

 - Expert SQL skills — complex CTEs, window functions, performance optimization of large-scale queries across petabyte-scale datasets

 - Strong AWS experience (S3, IAM, Secrets Manager, VPC/Private Link, cross-region replication)

 - Demonstrated ability to operate in a HIPAA-regulated environment with PHI handling requirements

 - Experience with disaster recovery architecture — cross-region replication, failover procedures, read-only replicas

 - Experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Codex) and agentic workflows to augment design, development, and testing processes.

 - Huge Plus: Prior experience working with healthcare data, such as medical claims, electronic health records (EHR), or billing code systems (ICD-10, CPT). Familiarity with healthcare data standards like HL7 or FHIR is highly desirable.
   
   





What CodaMetrix can offer you:

Learn more about our full-time employee benefits and how we take care of our team.

 - Health Insurance: We cover 80% of the cost of medical and dental insurance and offer vision insurance

 - Retirement: We offer a 401(k) plan that eligible employees can contribute to one month after their first day

 - Flexibility: We have a generous Paid Time Off policy, which is managed but not limited, so you can take the time you need to relax and rejuvenate

 - Development: We provide annual performance evaluations and prioritize working with employees on what their individual growth looks like

 - Recognition: We recognize the outstanding achievements of our team through annual company awards where employees have the opportunity to nominate their peers

 - Office Location: A modern open plan workspace located in the bustling Back Bay neighborhood of Boston

All candidates will be required to complete a background check upon acceptance of a job offer.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Our company, as well as our products, are made better because we embrace diverse skills, perspectives, and ideas. CodaMetrix is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.
