• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, or a related field, with 5+ years of relevant experience.

• 2+ years of experience in ADAS development, preferably within the automotive industry.

• Experience with the hardware release process for ADAS applications, including responsibility for assigned component deliverables and issue resolution.

• Working knowledge of automotive communication protocols (CAN, GMSL, or Ethernet) and tools for development, simulation, and testing (e.g., CANoe, CANalyzer, JIRA, and Confluence).

• Working knowledge of relevant safety standards and legislative regulations (e.g., ISO 26262, SAE J3016, FMVSS 111, FMVSS 127) and the ability to apply them to assigned component development and validation activities.

• Expertise in complex problem solving and data analysis, with demonstrated ability to access and interpret information, evaluate identifiable factors, adapt existing approaches, and drive results with extended teams.

• Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities, exercise judgment within established engineering frameworks, and seek review at critical decision points.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fluency in German is a plus.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

The Project Coordinator serves as administrative and operational support for assigned data center commissioning projects for a particular client. This role supports and coordinates various aspects of complex commissioning projects to ensure on-time/budget delivery and client satisfaction. This is NOT a technical field role, success requires strong project management, financial acumen, team relationship skills.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Administrative tasks for assigned programs - Process administrative requests; maintain project records; support program coordination; ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
• Project financials and performance - Monitor, and reconcile project budgets; track costs and expenditures; identify budget variances and cost overruns; ensure accurate project profitability tracking; prepare financial reports for leadership and clients.
• Project schedules and milestones - Understand project schedules maintained by PM; monitor project progress against SoW and milestone schedule; maintain communication for project activities across technical teams and sub-consultants.
• Documentation and records - Support organization of project files and folders; ensure accurate project records; support project closeout and lessons learned documentation.
• Project status reports - Develop monthly project status reports; support development of reports for leadership and clients; track key performance indicators; identify trends and issues.
• Client meetings and program activities - Support client / team meetings and workshops - invites and minutes; prepare meeting agendas and materials; track meeting decisions and action items.
• Technical teams and sub-consultants - Work with technical Project Managers/Commissioning Managers on milestone / task assignments; communicate assignments and scheduled work.
• Change orders and contract modifications - Support change order proposals and workflow; track status of pending and approved change orders.
• Proposal development and pricing - Enter sales leads into Salesforce and support with proposal development; manage proposal process.
• Process improvement - Support standardized processes and deliverables; collaborate with other Program Managers on cross-program issues.

Education/Experience/Background:

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Project Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
• 3+ years of project coordination, operations, or business coordination experience.
• 3+ years coordinating project budgets, schedules, and financial tracking.
• 2+ years in a fast-paced, technical environment (data center, commissioning, or similar).
• Experience with change order management and contract administration.
• Experience with client program management and stakeholder communication.
• Experience with proposal development and pricing.
• Working knowledge of the commissioning process (Pre-Design, Design, Commissioning, Post-Turnover).
• Experience in AI tools such as Gemini Notebook, chat agents, and/or agent builders.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Excellent project coordination and organizational skills.
• Strong financial acumen and budget management.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proficiency with project management tools (Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar).
• Proficiency with financial tools (Excel, accounting software).
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
• Ability to work independently and take initiative.
• Attention to detail and accuracy (especially financial).
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Great PC and Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
• Ability to navigate through a variety of computer applications.
• High level of professionalism and integrity,
• Excellent typing skills.

What Sets You Apart:

• Data center operations or commissioning program management.
• Smartsheet or similar collaborative project management tools.
• Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive).
• Consulting or professional services environment.
• Background in PMO (Project Management Office) or program coordination.
• Contract administration and legal document review.

Pay Range: $70000 to $80000 Annually.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

Sick leave – 56 hours; Observed Holidays – 11 days; Vacation – 15 days

Eligible for up to 5% Annual Performance Bonus

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Disclaimer: The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

jobs.description:

Are you ready to work at a fast-growing company where you can make a difference? Boomi, the data activation company for AI, powers the agentic enterprise by bringing data to life across the business. The award-winning Boomi Enterprise Platform is the active data foundation that delivers essential agentic infrastructure enabling organizations to drive agentic transformation and harness the power of AI with secure, scalable connectivity.  Trusted by over 30,000 customers and supported by a network of 800+ partners, Boomi helps organisations of all sizes achieve agility, efficiency, and innovation at scale. At Boomi, you’ll work with world-class people and industry-leading technology. We hire trailblazers with an entrepreneurial spirit who can solve challenging problems, make a real impact, and want to be part of building something big. If this sounds like a good fit for you, check out boomi.com  or visit our Boomi Careers page to learn more.

Presales Solutions Engineer

THIS ROLE IS BASED IN MOUNTAIN, CENTRAL, OR EASTERN TIME ZONES

What You'll Do

As a Presales Solutions Engineer, you will provide pre-sales technical support to our field sales teams, helping to define the overall Boomi solution for our customers using the full range of company products and services. You will:

• Collaborate with Account Executives/Managers to help determine customer’s needs, understand the technical landscape, and identify pain points via discovery calls

• Assess and present the potential solutions of company products and services, using technical competency and creativity to design business solutions that encompass the breadth of the Boomi portfolio

• Prepare detailed product specifications and deliver impactful presentations to enable the sale of our products and solutions.

• Discuss product capabilities and applications with technical users/buyers, and business stakeholders, verifying the operability of product and service configuration within the prospect's environment via Demos or Proof of Concepts

• Coordinate internal specialists and other necessary Boomi employees to help build the “win team” for prospective customers

• Support RFI/RFP completion by answering in-scope technical questions for prospective customers

• Verify operability of sophisticated product and service configurations within the customer’s environment

• Perform advanced systems integration and provide technical expertise to design the solution

The Experience You Bring

• Excellent communication, relationship, problem-solving and leadership skills

• Ability to present to executive level and articulate the Boomi solutions

• Familiarity with LLMs and their applications in chat-based AI.

• Experience with web services, APIs, and enterprise messaging

• Hands-on experience with IPaaS technologies and integration architecture.

• Strong understanding of prompt engineering and advanced techniques to enhance LLM performance.

• Proficiency in using APIs from platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Antropic, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Gemini, and others.

jobs.title: Security PAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

Overview of Role

We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer specializing in Delinea Secret Server to lead the design, configuration, and implementation of our Account Lifecycle Management (ALM) engine.

In this role, you will be responsible for architecting and deploying automated account lifecycle workflows, integrating Delinea with our Active Directory and existing vault environments, operationalizing privileged service account governance, and any additional PAM work needed. This is an initial 6-month contract engagement with strong potential for full-time conversion based on performance and milestone achievements.

Responsibilities

• ALM Architecture & Engine Configuration: Deploy, configure, and optimize the Delinea Secret Server Account Lifecycle Management (ALM) engines according to enterprise security standards.

• Directory & Vault Integration: Connect and synchronize ALM workflows with our on-premises/hybrid Active Directory environment and ensure seamless integration with our existing secret vault architecture.

• Pilot & Production Rollout:

• Design, execute, and validate a pilot lifecycle management program for an initial cohort of 10 critical service accounts.

• Rapidly scale and onboard an additional 25 service accounts post-pilot to establish a durable, automated lifecycle management foundation.

• Lifecycle Governance & Automation: Establish end-to-end automated workflows for service account creation, credential rotation, privileged elevation, discovery, and de-provisioning.

• Documentation & Operational Handover: Develop and deliver comprehensive technical documentation, including architectural as-builts, configuration guides, operational runbooks, and Tier 2/Tier 3 support handover materials.

• Stakeholder Collaboration & Best Practices: Partner closely with internal security, IAM, and systems engineering teams to ensure compliance, privileged access auditability, and minimal disruption to business operations.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of progressive experience in Information Security with a specialized focus on Identity & Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM).

• 3+ years of hands-on technical experience deploying, configuring, and administering Delinea Secret Server.

• Proven track record implementing Delinea Account Lifecycle Management (ALM) or equivalent privileged service account governance modules.

• Deep technical proficiency with Active Directory (AD) architecture, LDAP/Kerberos protocols, group policies, and service principal/service account administration.

• Strong background integrating PAM vaults with enterprise directory services, SIEM platforms, and infrastructure endpoints.

• Experience authoring structured technical documentation, including as-built architectures, SOPs, and operational runbooks.

• Strong diagnostic, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to lead technical pilots through to enterprise-wide rollout.

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools—including LinkedIn Recruiter’s Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies—to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights.

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description:
THE WORLD’S LARGEST LAW FIRM WON’T BE A LAW FIRM. JOIN US IN BUILDING IT.

August allows law firms to compound their expertise by building an autonomous organization of AI agents that run the firm's knowledge work. We partner closely with our firms and grow alongside them through sharing revenue on our agents and equity in the firms we transform.

We believe that in five years, more than 95% of legal work will be concentrated among a select few elite law firms. The firms that get there will be the ones that rebuild how they deliver it. We're partnering with those firms and building the engine they run on to become the biggest legal service provider in the world.

We invest in partnerships, not just licenses. We sell finished legal work alongside our firms and take a share of what it earns. This enables them to scale their services and lets us grow along with it. That means we’re chasing the legal services market ($1T), which dwarfs the global legal tech market ($40b).

The problem is hard. An engine of agents sits underneath every matter we touch, connected to every step of a lawyer's workflow, in an industry where there is no margin for error. We’re challenged with building the perfectly accurate, infallibly secure, and yet all-powerful engine for legal work.

We're already live with several excellent firms and the early results are better than we expected. Lean team, in person, New York, backed by leading investors, growing fast.

Every role at August is a chance to remake an industry while the window is open.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Solutions Engineer, you will work directly with law firms to turn complex legal workflows into working AI solutions. You will embed with clients, understand their processes and technical environment, and own deployments from discovery and prototyping through integration, go-live, and adoption. This is a hands-on, client-facing role: you will run working sessions, build and test solutions, troubleshoot issues, and help people put AI to work. You should enjoy getting into the technical details as much as explaining what you’ve built to the people who will use it.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Embed with client organizations and run structured discovery across teams and practice groups, mapping workflows, systems, and data flows to identify where AI can have the greatest impact.

 - Work one-on-one with lawyers, paralegals, legal ops staff, and technical stakeholders to translate day-to-day pain points into clear requirements and practical solutions.

 - Build and test lightweight proofs-of-concept for document review, form filling, intake, drafting, redlining, and matter management, using APIs, scripts, and workflow automation tools where needed.

 - Configure AI workflows and connect them to client systems, working with technical teams on integrations, troubleshooting, and validation before rollout.

 - Run hands-on demos and training sessions that help users understand how the solutions work and adopt them in their daily practice.

 - Own the go-live from kickoff through adoption, coordinating technical resources on both sides and resolving issues as they arise.

 - Serve as a trusted technical point of contact for client stakeholders, running structured check-ins and business reviews to understand what’s working and what needs improvement.

 - Translate findings from deployments into actionable feedback for August’s engineering team, including reproducible issues, integration needs, and opportunities to improve the product.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong technical problem-solving skills: you can break down an unfamiliar workflow, understand how its systems fit together, and build a practical solution.

 - Comfort writing lightweight scripts, working with APIs and structured data, and debugging integrations. Experience with Python or JavaScript is especially useful.

 - Strong product sense: you understand what makes a workflow painful and can translate that understanding into something people actually use.

 - Business acumen and clear communication: you can earn trust with a managing partner, a legal ops analyst, and a technical stakeholder, and explain complex ideas in straightforward terms.

 - Natural curiosity and comfort with ambiguity: you ask good questions, investigate beyond the obvious answer, and take ownership when there is no established playbook.

 - 1–3 years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, software engineering, or a similarly hands-on technical role. Experience working directly with customers is valuable; a background in law or legal services is a plus.

 - Familiarity with AI tools, LLM-powered applications, or workflow automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n is helpful.

 - Excitement about working in person at our NYC office with a team that values precision, pace, and constant reinvention.


BENEFITS

 - Medical insurance coverage

 - Flexible PTO

 - Parental Leave

 - Centralized office equipment ordering for all employees

 - Equinox or Chelsea Piers gym membership

 - In-office perks: lunch, dinner, snacks, drinks, and more

 - Budget for intra-office travel

 - Team-building events

 - Relocation support to NYC (as needed)


WHY JOIN AUGUST

 - Founding Impact: Shape not just your role but the company.

 - Uncapped Upside: Competitive base + commission, early equity ownership.

 - Top-tier Team: Work alongside people who move fast, think clearly, and care deeply.

 - Category-Defining Work: Help build the first true AI agents for the legal profession.

 - Fast Growth: Scale your career as we scale the company.

 - In-person in NYC: Collaborative, talent dense and high energy environment

 - Global Reach: Our clients span 4 continents and use August in multiple languages and jurisdictions

 - Frontier of Applied AI: August has access to proprietary data inaccessible to foundation model providers. We build agents to automate all challenging knowledge work.

jobs.title: Client Strategy Lead
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Linqia is a leading independent influencer marketing agency. Leveraging our AI-powered proprietary technology platform, Resonate, we work with some of the world’s leading brands, including Albertsons, Danone, and Bayer, to develop and execute creatively compelling creator-led strategies that deliver full-funnel results.

We value intelligence, recognize talent and have instilled a culture that supports career development and growth for our employees. We thrive on innovation and accountability, with a customer first attitude that adds true value to everything we touch. Our team members are smart, hard-working, have integrity and love to have fun as we play to win. At Linqia, you’ll be working with others who are passionate about marketing in a fun, fast-paced and data-driven environment.

Client Strategy Lead

The responsibility of the Client Strategy Lead is to act as a trusted strategic advisor to Linqia’s biggest customers, helping brands grow and become more sophisticated in their influencer marketing efforts.

What You’ll Do

• Ongoing: lead strategy for 1-2 of Linqia’s biggest accounts:

• Act as a trusted advisor on all things influencer marketing, deepening Linqia’s relationship with these clients and growing these accounts

• Run client workshops, aka Linqia Lookouts, digging into past performance, bringing inspiration from across the industry, and planning for the future

• Schedule, design, prepare for, and lead in-person or virtual client strategy workshops in the tristate area or elsewhere in the US

• Give feedback to cross-functional partners (e.g. creative strategists, creative coordinators, strategic accounts managers, media and measurement strategists, talent partners) on their workshop inputs

• Finalize workshop decks, in partnership with a dedicated presentation designer

• Collect, interpret, and apply external and internal feedback on Linqia Lookout sessions

• Oversee ongoing competitive monitoring and relevant trendspotting

• Deliver monthly client newsletters, surfacing influencer campaign performance data, industry trends, and competitive activity

• As needed: contribute to new business pitches:

• Interpret briefs, RFPs, and conversations with brand marketers to accurately diagnose their influencer marketing needs

• Design brand-specific strategic approaches to annual influencer marketing plans, including allocating budgets, devising channel strategies, and creating account-level learning agendas

• Brief internal teams (e.g., creative, talent, media and measurement) on their inputs for new business proposals

• Structure proposal decks (in Canva), utilizing Linqia templates and design resources as needed

• Present new business pitches to potential clients, virtually or in-person (alongside Sales, Creative, and other cross-functional partners, as needed)

• You’ll also work to embody Linqia’s core values:

• Be human.

• Act like an owner.

• Move fast and learn from it.

• Create great experiences.

• Be a problem solver.

• Data wins.

Ideal Qualifications

• 5+ years experience in a consultant and/or strategy role at a US-based consulting firm or agency

• Stellar presentation skills (in person and virtually), with experience traveling for work

• Experience running/playing a leading role in client strategy workshops, including designing and facilitating interactive exercises

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, allowing you you to guide cross-functional teams and ensure delivery against timelines

• Ability to create presentation decks from templates (we work in Canva)

• Experience in the influencer/creator/social media space is preferred, but not required; strong interest in the industry is crucial

Location

jobs.title: Heavy Auto Body Technician - 2nd Shift - $6,000 Bonus
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Autobody Preppers with a minimum of 5 years of professional automotive bodywork experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Heavy Body Technician, you’ll be expected to train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including:

• Heavy plastic welding/stapling

• Heavy metal pulling, straightening, shrinking, and stud welding

• Roof and rocker panel repair

Large area, heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)
At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including a 401(k) with Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 690-7853, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM PT (9AM to 7PM ET).

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of prep roles available, depending on your experience - look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers:

• Entry-Level Prepper (min 1 year professional experience): perform light bodywork, including prepping, sanding, and buffing vehicles, removing and installing bumpers, single panel repair (including Bondo repair), and minor plastic welding

• Mid-Level Prepper (min 3-5 years professional experience): perform bodywork on multiple panels, including heavy plastic welding, minor metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, stud welding, and large area heavy bodywork (including Bondo repair)

• Experienced Prepper (min 5 years professional experience): train other autobody technicians and perform extensive bodywork on multiple panels, including plastic welding, metal pulling, roof and rocker panel repair, and stud welding

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available in one of our 18 locations across the country – take a look at our Careers site to apply for one of the following roles:

• Auto Body roles: Paint, Prep/Body work, Wheel Repair, Airbrush, Interior Repair, Glass Repair, and PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) roles

• Auto Technician/Mechanic roles: Lube and Oil, Inspection, Brake and Tire, Mechanical Repair / Build, and Master Technician roles

• Entry-Level roles: Detailing, Inventory Associate (Car Porters), Photo, Parts Associate, Inspection, and Coordinator/Administrator roles

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English.

jobs.title: Human Capital Consultant
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description

The Human Capital Consultant supports client training and human capital initiatives by evaluating training needs, preparing structured content inputs, supporting the development and review of training deliverables, and assisting with user acceptance testing (UAT). The role collaborates closely with instructional designers, training developers, and client stakeholders by providing subject-matter content, business context, and quality reviews. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to manage high-quality deliverables in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Key Responsibilities

Training Needs Evaluation & Content Preparation

• Conduct Training Needs Analysis to determine training focus, scope, and objectives

• Evaluate existing training materials and identify gaps relative to user and mission needs

• Develop detailed, high-quality content outlines aligned to curriculum requirements

• Identify opportunities to improve training effectiveness through enhanced content structure or updated learning approaches

Training Development Support

• Prepare content inputs, examples, data, workflows, and narrative materials used by instructional designers and training developers

• Develop standards, guidelines, templates, and checklists to support consistency across training deliverables

jobs.title: Store Planner
jobs.description:
Store Planner

Location: San Francisco, CA | Hybrid



At Rothy’s, we know there’s a better way to do business, and it starts by putting the planet and its people first. More than 225 million single-use plastic bottles and 715,000 pounds of ocean-bound marine plastic have been transformed into our signature thread, creating wardrobe staples that look just as good as they feel.



Striving for zero waste, we combine 3D knitting technology and handcrafted assembly to create machine washable styles that don’t compromise on comfort. From classic shoes to carry-everywhere bags, we create essentials for wherever you go.



At Rothy’s, building a sustainable future is at the heart of everything we do. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive environment at our HQ, retail stores and wholly-owned factory, and are growing our community every day.



About the Team:

Using data, research and expert analytical skills, our Planning & Distribution team helps ensure we have the right products in the right places at the right time. In partnership with cross-functional teams like Production, Digital Commerce, Merchandising and Retail, these wizards forecast, plan and manage our inventory—so we can continue to delight our customers with the products they love.



About the role:

We’re looking for a Store Planner to join our Planning & Distribution team and help make sure every Rothy’s store has the right product, in the right place, at the right time. As a Store Planner, you’ll bring a strong analytical lens and a collaborative spirit to store level assortment, store inventory levels, allocation and replenishment strategy, partnering closely with Retail leadership, Merchandise Planning, Merchandising, Visual Merchandising and Operations to create a great experience for customers wherever they shop with us.



What you’ll do:

 - Develop and maintain store level assortment and allocation strategies that balance customer demand, inventory flow and sales goals across all Rothy’s retail locations

 - Partner with Planning, Merchandising and Allocation to translate seasonal buys into store specific plans that reflect regional and store level nuances

 - Analyze sell through, inventory turn and in-stock rates to identify opportunities and recommend adjustments to allocation strategy

 - Build and refine store tiering model based on customer profile, store format and historical performance

 - Collaborate with the Retail team to understand store capacity, visual merchandising needs and local market trends

 - Manage replenishment strategies to help ensure the right product is in the right store at the right time

 - Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional partners in a clear, actionable way

 - Support new store openings and closures with tailored assortment and inventory strategies

 - Look for ways to improve planning processes, tools and reporting as our store fleet grows

You are:

 - A natural collaborator who builds strong relationships across Merchandising, Retail, Allocation and Visual Merchandising

 - Detail oriented, with a knack for spotting patterns in data that others might miss

 - Comfortable balancing multiple priorities and deadlines without losing sight of the big picture

 - A clear communicator who can translate complex data into simple, actionable recommendations

 - Curious and proactive, always looking for a better way to solve a planning challenge

 - Adaptable and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast growing environment



You have:

 - 4+ years of experience in retail planning, allocation or a related analytical role, ideally in footwear, apparel or another consumer product category

 - Advanced Excel skills; experience with planning or allocation systems is a plus

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

 - Experience partnering with store operations teams and a solid understanding of store-level retail dynamics

 - A bachelor’s degree in business, finance, supply chain or a related field, or equivalent experience

Our benefits:

 - Generous paid time off

 - 401k matching

 - Comprehensive health plans for you and your family

 - Supplemental mental health benefits

 - Monthly wellness reimbursement

 - Dog friendly offices

 - Employee Discount Program!

Pay range:

$82,000 - $99,000/annually

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work. This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: VP, Technology & Data Partnerships
jobs.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

VP, Tech & Data Partnerships

The Opportunity

• This is an enterprise-level leadership role responsible for defining and leading the company’s technology, data, and AI partnership strategy.

• The role reports directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer and will serve as the executive owner of the broader technology and data partnership ecosystem.

• This is not a traditional channel or alliances sales role. The focus is on partnerships that shape the product, strengthen the company’s data advantage, and extend the reach of the platform.

• The leader will help determine where the company should build, buy, partner, or potentially acquire capabilities.

What the Leader Will Own

• Set the company-wide strategy for technology, data, platform, integration, and AI partnerships.

• Identify a focused portfolio of high-impact partnership opportunities that can improve product differentiation, innovation, distribution, and growth.

• Build trusted C-suite relationships with priority technology platforms, data providers, cloud companies, and emerging AI ecosystems.

• Originate and negotiate complex, multi-year agreements covering product scope, data rights, intellectual property, economics, investment, exclusivity, and governance.

• Shape the external data strategy, including data coverage, quality, identity, signals, licensing, and differentiated data products.

• Influence product and platform strategy by bringing an external ecosystem and market perspective into company investment decisions.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering to ensure strategic agreements translate into funded roadmaps, clear ownership, successful launches, and measurable customer adoption.

• Establish portfolio governance, performance measures, and an operating model that allows the partnership capability to scale.

• Build and develop a senior, globally effective organization over time.

Why the Role Matters

• The company’s advantage depends on connecting high-quality data, identity, and signals with the platforms, data environments, and AI ecosystems where customers already work.

• These partnerships are viewed as a company-level lever for product innovation, differentiation, distribution, and growth, rather than simply a source of partner-sourced revenue.

• The successful leader will have significant influence over product direction, ecosystem positioning, investment choices, and how the company creates long-term strategic advantage.

What Success Looks Like

• In the first 60 days, assess the existing portfolio, market landscape, strategic gaps, team capabilities, active commitments, and role boundaries.

• By 90 days, develop an executive-ready technology, data, and AI ecosystem strategy with a concentrated set of priority bets, investment choices, executive sponsors, and Product and R&D commitments.

• Within six months, demonstrate visible progress on consequential partnerships, including signed or late-stage agreements with funded productization paths and clear measures of impact.

• Within 12 months, establish a focused portfolio producing measurable adoption, distribution, differentiation, and commercial impact, supported by trusted C-suite relationships and a scalable team and operating model.

The Profile That Will Be Successful

• An executive who has built or materially scaled a technology, platform, product, or data partnership capability.

• Someone who combines ecosystem strategy with enough technical fluency to engage credibly on architecture, APIs, data rights, identity, security, privacy, and AI.

• A sophisticated negotiator who understands partnership structures, economics, data licensing, commercialization, and joint product delivery.

• A strong cross-functional leader who can align senior Product, Engineering, commercial, legal, finance, and executive stakeholders around difficult investment and roadmap choices.

• Someone with a practical understanding of how AI, agents, and MCP are changing enterprise software ecosystems.

• A builder who can create the strategy, operating model, governance, metrics, and leadership team required for the capability to scale.

The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. jobs.description:
About Wealth.com http://Wealth.com

Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is the industry's leading AI-powered estate and tax planning platform, empowering thousands of wealth management firms to modernize how planning guidance is delivered to clients. Purpose-built for financial institutions, Wealth.com http://Wealth.com is the only tech-led, end-to-end platform that enables firms to scale estate and tax planning with efficiency, consistency and measurable client impact.

Trusted by some of the largest names in finance, Wealth.com http://Wealth.com combines proprietary AI, enterprise-grade security and deep legal and tax expertise to support the full spectrum of client needs, from foundational estate plans to advanced estate and tax analysis and reporting. With Wealth.com http://Wealth.com Tax Planning, firms can deliver more integrated, proactive planning through a single platform.

Wealth.com http://Wealth.com has been widely recognized for innovation and leadership, earning Top Estate Planning Technology and Top Estate Planning Implementation at the 2025 WealthManagement.com http://WealthManagement.com Industry Awards, as well as the #1 estate planning market share in the 2025 Kitces AdvisorTech Study.



Role Overview

We're hiring a Head of Customer Success to own the post-sale experience — Support and Onboarding — for Wealth.com http://Wealth.com's advisors and their end clients. As leader of Customer Success, you will  have the unique opportunity to unify and build out a single, scalable customer experience function and build the infrastructure to carry it through our next 18–24 months of growth.

This is primarily a process, people, and systems leadership role — not a hands-on delivery seat. You'll spend most of your time designing the operating model, coaching the team, and building the technology and workflow backbone that lets a lean team support a fast-growing advisor base. That said, we're still a company where everyone gets their hands dirty when it counts, and you should be comfortable stepping into a ticket, a call, or an onboarding session when the moment calls for it.



What You'll Do

 - Strategic Leadership
   
   - Define the vision and multi-year roadmap for Customer Success, including Support, Onboarding, and Enablement, as our customer base scales in volume and complexity
   
   - Build a high-performing team with clear structure, ownership, and accountability — hiring, developing, and retaining talent who are genuinely committed to serving customers well
   
   - Champion AI and automation as a lever for scaling the function
   
   - Set and own the KPIs that define success for the function and report on them to leadership

 - Operational Excellence
   
   - Build and continuously refine scalable onboarding frameworks, support models, and workflows that hold up as customer segments and product complexity grow
   
   - Establish the SOPs, tooling, and escalation paths that let the team operate consistently at scale
   
   - Own the operating cadence for the function — regular reviews of volume, themes, and friction points — so issues surface early and get resourced before they become churn risk
   
   - Ensure every process decision is evidence-based and defensible: instrument the funnel so claims about what's working (or not) can be shown, not asserted

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration
   
   - Partner with Sales and Account Management to build a seamless, connected customer lifecycle — from handoff at close, through onboarding, to renewal and expansion conversations
   
   - Partner with Product and Design to ensure the customer experience evolves in lockstep with the product, translating what customers actually need into clear input for the roadmap
   
   - Represent the voice of the customer in cross-functional planning, ensuring CS isn't just executing decisions made elsewhere but shaping them



What You'll Bring

 - A track record of owning outcomes, not just inheriting them — you can speak to specific changes you drove (an incentive redesign, a new lifecycle program, a support model overhaul) and the data behind why they worked.

 - Demonstrated people leadership — real examples of getting a team aligned and moving in the same direction, not just "I managed a team of X."

 - Comfort operating with ambiguity and speed. A blend of institutional rigor and startup adaptability — in either order — is ideal.

 - Executive presence: polished communication and the ability to present data and recommendations directly to leadership.

 - Genuine empathy for the financial advisor's experience — understanding that a bad moment for their end client reflects directly back on them, and that timing (a task due before a client meeting in the next hour) can matter as much as the task itself.

 - Experience leading Support and/or Onboarding through Series A/B through the next stage of growth, and ability to translate that playbook into Wealth.com http://Wealth.com; or experience from a more established Customer Success/Experience function where you can see 18–24 months ahead and are ready to apply that experience proactively rather than reactively.



Nice to Have

 - Experience in fintech or another regulated, relationship-driven vertical.

 - Experience standing up or scaling an AI-assisted support model (e.g., Intercom/Fin or similar).

 - Experience building both enterprise/institutional and SMB-style onboarding motions in parallel.



Benefits & Perks

 - Hybrid work arrangement in New York City (3x a week)

 - Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options, with low-cost premium structures that demonstrate our commitment to offering great value to our employees.

 - 100% company-paid basic life insurance, short-term and long-term disability insurance.

 - 100% paid parental leave upon eligibility.

 - Company equity managed through Carta.

 - 401k with match and 100% vesting upon hire.

 - Flexible PTO in an environment where taking time off to relax or recharge is supported and encouraged.

 - Take time off for holidays—and yes, your birthday counts too. Celebrate, relax, and recharge without thinking twice.

 - Free estate planning for life!

About Think Academy

We are looking for a User Conversion & Operations Specialist who can develop a deep understanding of the needs of U.S. K–12 families and drive business growth through parent engagement, course conversion, and user operations.

This role will initially focus on frontline parent communication and course conversion. You will work directly with parents, understand their needs and decision-making process, and take ownership of conversion results. As you build a deeper understanding of our users and products, you will gradually take on broader user operations initiatives, including cross-subject enrollment among existing families, referral programs, parent communities, and user engagement activities.

We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an established process. We want someone who understands users, takes ownership of goals, and proactively finds ways to get results.

What You’ll Do

• Parent Communication & Course Conversion Communicate directly with parents to understand students’ learning needs, current performance, and key factors influencing family decisions. Recommend appropriate courses based on user needs and drive trial class bookings and course enrollment. Consistently follow up with prospective families and address common concerns related to learning outcomes, course difficulty, scheduling, pricing, and other considerations. Take ownership of key conversion outcomes, including trial class bookings, attendance, and long-term course enrollment. Identify recurring user needs, objections, and reasons for drop-off, and continuously improve communication strategies and conversion SOPs.

• Community Operations & User Growth Develop a deep understanding of existing families and identify cross-subject enrollment opportunities across Math, ELA, and other programs. Participate in referral initiatives by designing user outreach, incentives, and conversion pathways. Segment users by grade level, subject, and learning stage and develop targeted engagement strategies. Identify growth opportunities through user feedback and data, and turn insights into actionable initiatives.

• Community & User Engagement Programs Support the day-to-day operation of parent communities and maintain ongoing communication with families to increase engagement. Track data related to user communication, conversion, cross-subject enrollment, referrals, and engagement programs. Plan and execute programs such as learning challenges, educational resource campaigns, trial classes, assessments, and parent workshops. Develop parent-facing content and activities around topics relevant to U.S. K–12 families, including learning pathways and school or admissions-related policies. Design user journeys that move families from initial participation toward further engagement and course conversion, with timely follow-up for high-potential users. Track key metrics such as registration, participation, and conversion, and continuously optimize programs based on results.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or above.

• Native or near-native Chinese communication skills and professional working proficiency in English.

• Strong user communication skills, with the willingness to proactively reach out, follow up consistently, and move users toward the next step.

• Strong goal orientation and results ownership, with the ability to take responsibility for clear conversion and operational targets.

• Strong learning ability and execution skills; able to proactively identify solutions and move projects forward in ambiguous situations.

• Basic data literacy and the ability to use data and user feedback to evaluate and improve performance.

• Ability to work on-site in Silicon Valley on a long-term basis.

• Mandarin proficiency is required for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in education, user operations, community operations, admissions, enrollment, or conversion-focused roles.

• Familiarity with U.S. K–12 education or the educational needs of Chinese families in the U.S.

• Experience managing parent communities, user engagement programs, or in-person events.

• Ability to demonstrate past business impact with specific examples and measurable results.

• Clear Growth Path: Opportunities to grow into project management, academic operations, education product, or people management roles.

jobs.title: 4th/5th Grade ELA Teacher
jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified 4th/5th Grade ELA Teacher at Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy (CASSA)! Serving the Buckeye-Shaker community and surrounding neighborhoods, Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences is a public charter school offering a hands-on college prep curriculum that emphasizes the arts and humanities. CASSA provides small group learning, educational technology, and a wide range of specialty classes. The close-knit K-8 school features a positive school culture with many campus events and activities. Cleveland Arts & Social Sciences Academy is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

jobs.title: Director, Automation & Controls Engineering
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

As Director, Automation & Controls Engineering, you will lead the team building the automation backbone of Divergent’s next generation of machines and factories. You will define and deliver the controls, robotics, electrical, safety, and factory automation systems that turn complex manufacturing technology into reliable, scalable, and increasingly autonomous production.

This role owns both the technical direction and organizational capability required to push industrial automation forward—from first-of-kind machine development through fleet deployment and factory scale. You will build the architectures, standards, teams, and engineering systems that enable Divergent to move faster, automate more, reduce operator dependency, and create manufacturing systems capable of scaling far beyond traditional factories.

The Role

Development & Execution

• Lead delivery of electrical, PLC, HMI, SCADA, motion control, robotics, and machine-safety systems from requirements through validated production release.

• Lead engineering execution to deliver systems on schedule and to technical, quality, and production-readiness requirements.

• Ensure systems meet reliability, maintainability, functional safety, and regulatory compliance requirements through rigorous engineering and validation practices.

Architecture & Foundation

• Set technical direction for controls architecture, technology platforms, engineering standards, and integration across Divergent machines and factories.

• Build scalable capabilities through modular architectures, reusable libraries, standardization, and disciplined configuration management.

• Establish technical governance and engineering rigor to improve consistency, reliability, maintainability, and development efficiency.

• Drive systemic reliability improvements by incorporating operational failures, corrective actions, and production learnings into future designs.

Robotics & Advanced Automation

• Define and execute the technology roadmap for industrial robotics, autonomous machine operation, and advanced factory automation.

• Drive initiatives that reduce manual labor, operator dependency, manufacturing complexity, and cost while improving productivity.

• Develop the technical capabilities, partnerships, and scalable automation platforms required for increasingly autonomous machines and factories.

Organizational & Strategic Leadership

• Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization through hiring, coaching, delegation, performance management, and development of technical leaders.

• Establish an effective operating rhythm with clear ownership, priorities, accountability, resource management, and measurable outcomes.

• Translate business objectives into engineering strategy, roadmaps, and investment priorities, balancing production support, reliability, technical debt, and future development.

• Lead cross-functional alignment and execution across Machine Development, R&D, Supply Chain, Production, Service, and other operational teams.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience in industrial automation, controls, robotics, or complex automated equipment development.

• Proven experience leading engineering organizations and delivering complex, cross-functional machine or factory automation programs.

• Strong technical foundation in PLCs, electrical systems, industrial networking, motion control, robotics, and machine safety.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing complex capital equipment, advanced manufacturing, semiconductor, additive manufacturing, or robotics systems.

• Expertise in Beckhoff TwinCAT, IEC 61131-3 Structured Text, industrial networking, and motion control.

• Experience with industrial robotics, simulation, offline programming, and virtual commissioning.

• Knowledge of NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, functional safety, and machine risk assessment.

• Experience scaling controls architectures, engineering standards, and teams across machine fleets or factories.

Pay Range

$221,130—$305,430 USD

What We Offer:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

• Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Equal Employment Opportunity
Divergent is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected characteristic. Divergent provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with Disabilities and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

From time to time you may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected.

jobs.title: Maintenance Supervisor
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

At Copperstate Farms and Sol Flower, we’re creating a better kind of cannabis company. Where we know happy plants begin with happy people. We aspire to high standards, take pride in our work, and drive for better results every day. At the greenhouse, our roots are growing flower, but we’ve branched out to offer an extensive range of cannabis products like edibles, topicals, and concentrates for retail dispensary locations. From farm to market, we are committed to the quality of our products and are always testing for patient and customer safety. By bringing together best practices from big agriculture, consumer packaged goods, and pharmaceutical and retail industries, Copperstate is becoming one of the top cannabis companies to work for.

What We’re Growing:

As one of the largest greenhouse cannabis producers in North America, Copperstate Farms ranges over 1.7 million square feet of canopy and 40 acres under glass. It’s here where we have been growing a house of cannabis brands that our patients and customers can trust, each addressing a different needs state and demographic. From the greenhouse to corporate to multiple Sol Flower dispensaries, we’re an inclusive cannabis community empowering wellness for all. Most of all, we strive for a culture where our employees view us as one of the best places to work.

Job Description:

The Greenhouse Maintenance Supervisor is responsible to implement, monitor, evaluate, and supervise the operations, staff, and activities of greenhouse maintenance.

Core Responsibilities:

Duties of this job include, but are not limited to:

• Develop, maintain, monitor, evaluate, and supervise the operations of greenhouse maintenance

• Oversee, train, assign / direct, schedule, monitor / supervise staff

• Evaluate employee performance and initiate disciplinary action as needed

• Inspect greenhouses periodically to determine problems and necessary maintenance

• Prepare weekly maintenance schedules and allocate work

• Monitor material and equipment inventory

• Contribute to the development of maintenance budget

• Co-operate with and oversee contracted vendors

• Respond to emergency calls for maintenance and repairs

• Diagnose and troubleshoot issues

• Participate in the coordination of projects (e.g., retrofit and renovations)

• Other duties as assigned

Commitment & Dependability:

• Willingness to be an integral member of a successful team

• Dedication to provide the highest levels of service

• Excellent attendance and reliability

• Adherence to company policies and procedures

• Expectation to work weekends and holidays as required

• Properly handle confidential customer information and other non-public company proprietary information

Qualifications & Education:

• High School diploma or equivalent preferred

• Must be at least 21 years of age

• Must be able to pass a fingerprint background check to get a facility agent card

• 5+ years of relevant job experience in a high-tech greenhouse setting

• Strong technical knowledge of greenhouse, HVAC, plumbing, carpentry, and mechanical systems

• Ability to read and interpret safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and other manuals and documents

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Excellent planning and leadership abilities

• Ability to work in a team and follow instructions from supervisors

Physical Requirements:

• Requires prolonged sitting, standing, walking, bending, lifting, and use of hands with repetitive motions

• Frequently requires physical exertion to manually move, lift, carry, pull, or push heavy objects or materials

• Frequently stooping, bending, and reaching

• Must work indoors and outdoors year-round

• Must work in noisy and crowded environments

• Observe, see, hear, and respond to directions given with effective outcome

• Lift 25-50 pounds from the floor to a waist-high table when necessary

• Crouch & bend often throughout

• Stand for short / long periods of time

• Sit for short / long periods of time

• Walk for short / long periods of time

• Occasionally sit on the floor or at floor level

• Frequent use of hands doing all sorts of repetitious motions

• Handle the responsibilities and routine stress often associated with this position

• Must be able to use all PPE equipment for each department

• Must be able to do physical labor in all types of environments such as the airconditioned rooms within the facility as well as the heat of the greenhouse which can be over 100 degrees with high humidity

Certifications or Training Requirements:

• Complete New Hire Orientation & Safety Training

• Additional trainings as assigned by management

jobs.title: CDD Risk Analyst, Reviews
jobs.description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

CDD Risk Analyst

Adyen is looking for a hands-on CDD Risk Analyst with experience in the payments and/or finance industry to contribute to the growth and scaling of our customer base in North America. In this role, you will perform necessary enhanced due diligence, including reviewing KYC documentation and assessing potential anti-money laundering risks, to protect Adyen and our customers. We call this a CDD Review (Customer-Due-Diligence). You will be working with a wide range of teams within Adyen, including commercial, compliance, and product to ensure that our customers and understanding of them remain up-to-date and compliant. You are expected to be very detail-oriented, take a risk-based approach, and have the ability to think critically with scalability always in mind, all while maintaining a high caliber work product.

What you will do

• Execute upon Know-Your-Customer (KYC) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) procedures.

• Collect and analyze customer information on a monthly basis whilst documenting material changes to their organizational structures, legal entity(ies) and policies.

• Perform KYC checks on our merchants, collect and verify relevant documentation and iterate on the process flow.

• Guide our merchants and be the first point of contact for every CDD Review related matter.

• Be an internal product advocate, drive process improvements and feedback on automation within our workflows.

• Be an internal advisor for CDD Review related questions in the local office and our North America team.

• Align with your peers based in Chicago and global teams to ensure consistency throughout our global risk reviews.

Who you are

• 4+ years experience in Customer Due Diligence/Enhanced Due Diligence/KYC.

• Knowledgeable of AML/CTF, CDD, EDD, and payments risk concepts.

• You have a great sense of responsibility, integrity in your work, and you prioritize tasks based on business needs.

• You have a natural tendency to be curious and think outside of the box.

• You are comfortable navigating ambiguity in an unstructured work environment and enjoy working with people from different cultures and backgrounds.

• You are a clear communicator with a strong team spirit, not afraid to step out of your comfort zone, and feel confident tailoring your message to your audience.

• You have an analytical and critical mindset that helps inform your risk-based approach.

• You get a sense of achievement from solving operational problems and helping others.

• You are operationally oriented with an eagerness to pick up and drive projects with cross-functional teams.

• You are willing to travel 10% of the time throughout the year.

Total rewards & compensation

The annual base salary range for this role in Chicago is $85,000–$110,000. Compensation is based on factors including qualifications, experience, and location. Total compensation package includes equity (RSUs), 401(k), health, dental, vision, and more.

In-office expectations

jobs.title: Benefits Manager
jobs.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As Via’s Benefits Manager, you will be supporting the strategy, administration and execution of our US and global health, welfare, retirement and wellness programs. This position is focused on optimizing the employee experience across the lifecycle, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting the scale of our benefits offerings to support our growing, dynamic team.

This is a hands-on role— we’re a one-team culture, and you’ll be rolling up your sleeves to support across the board, whether it’s executing annual open enrollments, managing complex leave requests, auditing carrier billing, or delivering clear employee communications. Collaborating closely with Via’s broader People Operations team, global payroll, and external partners, you’ll act as a subject matter expert and trusted resource, helping shape a competitive and exceptional benefits experience that aligns with Via’s mission.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the end to end benefits experience for employees, managing new hire enrollments, offboarding workflows, COBRA, life event changes and qualifying status updates.

• Serve as a thought support lead for day-to-day employee benefit inquiries, while creating clear, engaging employee communications, benefit booklets, policy guides, and education sessions.

• Lead monthly carrier billing reconciliation and audits across all plans, partnering with payroll and finance to ensure deduction and invoice accuracy.

• Support compliance with federal, state and local regulations (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, COBRA, FMLA, SF HCSO, etc) managing required non-discrimination testing, ACA reporting and required annual notice distributions.

• Maintain all plan documents (SPDs, SBC, plan summaries, etc) and lead the project management and execution of annual Open Enrollment, including HRIS system set up, broker liaison, and employee Q & A sessions.

• Assist with the administration of leave of absence workflows (FMLA, state paid family leave, STD/LTD, parental leave, and ADA accommodations) in close coordination with other members of the People and Payroll team.

• Manage benefit administration workflows and data integrity within our HRIS (Workday), auditing carrier integrations (EDI feeds).

• Act as a point of contact for benefits brokers, carriers, 401(k) recordkeepers, pension fund contacts, and wellness vendors, resolving claim escalations.

• Analyze program utilization, claims trends, employee feedback, and market benchmarking to partner with Director of People Operations on continuous plan optimization and cost-containment initiatives.

Who You Are:

• Minimum of 4-6+ years of dedicated experience in US benefits administration (preferably with self-insured plans), plan design, and leave management in a fast-paced environment.

• Deep, practical knowledge of employment and benefit laws (ERISA, ACA, HIPAA, FMLA, COBRA, FLSA) and experience executing non-discrimination testing.

• Experience working with unionized employee populations and understanding of collective bargaining agreements.

• Highly organized with exceptional financial and auditing skills; meticulous when reconciling monthly carrier bills, payroll deductions, and employee census data.

• Proven proficiency with enterprise HRIS platforms (experience with Workday Benefits Administration and carrier EDI feeds is a strong plus).

• Ability to breakdown complex medical, financial and regulatory concepts into easy to understand, supportive communications for employees.

• Comfortable with ambiguity, flexible in adapting to changing needs, and proactive in driving process improvements alongside leadership.

• High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential material including medical records, sensitive employee situations, and compliance audits.

Compensation and Benefits:

• Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

• Salary Range: $80,000-$90,000 per year

• Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans

• A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting

• Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options

• Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

• 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.
