jobs.title: Senior Product Security Engineer, Assessments
jobs.location: New York City; Seattle; United States
jobs.description:
Who You Are

You are a seasoned security professional with a deep passion for uncovering vulnerabilities and improving product security through technical assessments and hands-on penetration testing. You pride yourself on being able to execute sophisticated security tests, identify issues, and implement pragmatic solutions, all while keeping the customer experience central. You enjoy working collaboratively across teams and have the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear, approachable manner.

Who We Are

The MongoDB Product Security organization is a diverse collection of individuals working together to scale MongoDB’s security, both security of the products themselves and the security features we offer to customers. The team is responsible for assessing the security of our products including MongoDB Atlas Cloud, Ops Manager, Kubernetes Operator, and the MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise editions). Our team provides assurance that new MongoDB products and features are built to meet our customers’ high security needs through rigorous threat modeling, code analysis, and penetration testing.

The MongoDB Product Security organization works with software engineers to design, implement, and operate systems in a manner that protects our customers and their data. It is a multidisciplinary team that covers product, software, cloud, infrastructure, and operational security concerns.

The Product Security team:

• Conducts rigorous penetration testing and security assessments of MongoDB products

• Develops and deploys advanced AI tooling and modern automation to enhance assessment efficiency and workflows

• Works closely with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for security best practices and remediate vulnerabilities

• Builds a developer-driven security program where there is tight integration between engineering artifacts, process, and tooling

• Uses software architecture and coding patterns to reduce the impact of security issues

Role Responsibilities

As a Product Security Engineer specializing in security assessments, your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the evolution of our internal security and assessment processes by leveraging AI-based analysis to enhance threat modeling, penetration testing workflows, and assessment efficiency

• Conducting deep-dive penetration tests and hands-on security assessments of MongoDB products, including architecture reviews, threat modeling, static/dynamic code analysis, and vulnerability exploit verification

• Researching, prototyping, and executing new attack vectors and techniques to strengthen our defensive measures

• Collaborating closely with engineering teams to advocate security best practices and to remediate identified vulnerabilities

• Recommending secure coding patterns, container security measures, and secrets management strategies to strengthen our products

• Partnering with product development teams to ensure secure delivery across cloud environments, applications, and systems

• Coordinating closely with the red team and detection functions and processes to address potential security incidents or implement new defensive or monitoring capabilities

Requirements

• 7+ years of experience in application security, product security or penetration testing roles, including manual and automated approaches

• Proven expertise in product security assessment techniques such as threat modeling, penetration testing, red teaming, and secure code reviews

• Some programming and scripting skills, with familiarity in one or more languages such as Python or Golang

• Hands-on experience with one or more major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure)

• Experience leading threat modeling workshops and discussing security issues with engineers

• Comfortable explaining and communicating technical concepts and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Demonstrated ownership of security initiatives, with the ability to deliver results autonomously or collaboratively

• Working knowledge of large-scale distributed systems and container technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)

• Knowledge of security tools and frameworks for cloud and application security

Success in This Role Looks Like

• Driving improvements in MongoDB’s product security through end-to-end ownership of security assessments

• Guiding and mentoring the team through the technological evolution of our security assessment processes using modern AI capabilities

• Proactively uncovering vulnerabilities and presenting actionable recommendations to engineering teams

• Building trust and establishing yourself as a key security partner within the organization

• Growing MongoDB’s security capabilities and contributing to innovative solutions that enhance customer trust and product robustness

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.title: Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor – Construction Management
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is seeking a Cost Manager / Quantity Surveyor to join our Denver-area team. We support some of the region's most significant investments in mission-critical data centers, corporate real estate, and infrastructure, providing cost management, project controls, and commercial consultancy services throughout the project lifecycle.

Working with public and private sector clients, you'll help deliver complex programs through strategic cost planning, commercial management, and project controls. The ideal candidate is driven, client-focused, and committed to Turner & Townsend's purpose and values.

Responsibilities:

• Advise clients on procurement and commercial strategies, including vendor prequalification, assessment of proposals, bid leveling, contract recommendations, bid interviews, and appointment processes.
• Lead estimating services across all project phases by developing project estimates for construction, fees, direct work, and other project costs.
• Review estimates prepared by junior team members and present cost plans, value engineering recommendations, and risk assessments to clients.
• Meet with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to review, validate, and challenge costs while leveraging benchmark data from comparable projects.
• Manage cost reporting by establishing reporting schedules, preparing and presenting cost reports and forecasts, reviewing project budgets and spend forecasts, and maintaining commercial risk registers.
• Facilitate regular meetings with clients, project teams, consultants, and vendors to monitor cost performance.
• Manage cost control processes, including payment application reviews, contractor entitlement assessments, change order evaluations, and contractual dispute resolution.
• Monitor and manage project invoicing processes.
• Benchmark project performance against similar successful commissions and industry standards.
• Lead all aspects of final account negotiations, post-contract audits, and account closeout activities.
• Conduct lessons-learned reviews with clients and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and training materials.
• Develop procedures governing project handover and closeout.
• Utilize Bid Analysis Sheets, Change Control Forms, Cost Estimating Software, Take-off Software, and other commercial management tools to support project delivery.
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role and must be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related construction field.
• Minimum 3-5 years of experience in a cost management, quantity surveying, or commercial management role within the construction industry.
• Experience supporting medium to large-scale construction projects, preferably in mission-critical, data center, industrial, healthcare, and/or commercial real estate
• Construction consultancy experience is strongly preferred.
• RICS accreditation, or active pursuit of accreditation, is highly desirable.
• Strong understanding of construction industry technical matters, including procurement strategies, value management, value engineering, and commercial risk management.
• Experience preparing estimates, managing change control processes, cost forecasting, and final account settlements.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
• Ability to work collaboratively with public-sector agencies, corporate occupiers, technology clients, project managers, designers, contractors, and other project stakeholders.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.

The base salary range for this role is $110,000-$130,000 USD. This range reflects the company's good faith estimate of the base salary for this position at the time of the posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, employees may be eligible for bonuses and a comprehensive benefits package.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

jobs.title: Member Support Specialist (Float)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Member Support Specialist (Administrative Assistant) you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $24.00 per hour based on a full time schedule, with a 1.25 differential for eligible extended hours.

This is a full-time role based in-person with our team and patients at offices in Strawberry Village, Mill Valley, CA. There is an expectation to float to our San Rafael office on an as needed basis. This is a full time position with 8 hour shifts (40 hours a week) landing between Monday and Saturday 7:30 AM - 6:00 PM.

Physical Demands:  Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Career and Technical Education
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Background:

Bloomberg Philanthropies works to create catalytic change across five areas of focus: arts and culture, education, the environment, government innovation, and public health. Our mission is to ensure better, longer lives for the greatest number of people. Our approach is rooted in Mike Bloomberg's unique experience and success across business, government, and philanthropy.

Our Program:

Bloomberg Philanthropies' Career and Technical Education (CTE) Program seeks to expand high-quality career programs and pathways for students who may not pursue a traditional four-year college pathway immediately after high school, helping more young people access high-demand careers, family-sustaining wages, and greater economic mobility.

As the CTE portfolio grows, Bloomberg Philanthropies is focused not only on supporting individual communities, but also on understanding what works, identifying emerging lessons and best practices, and sharing that knowledge so successful approaches can be adapted and replicated by other communities, policymakers, funders, and education and workforce leaders.

The Position:

Bloomberg Philanthropies is seeking a Program Manager to help lead the work of the CTE portfolio including research, evaluation, and program management. The role will work across the portfolio to support program needs and help assess progress, identify emerging lessons, and translate findings into insights and resources that can strengthen programs and inform the broader field.

The Program Manager will also support national and regional convenings that bring together grantees and leaders across education, workforce, government, philanthropy, research, and industry to share lessons, address common challenges, and advance effective CTE and education-to-career pathways.

The role is based in New York City and will require regular domestic travel.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

Program Management & Strategy

• Monitor program implementation, grant progress, and evaluation activities across the portfolio, reviewing and synthesizing grantee reports and other program materials.

• Identify strategic opportunities and emerging challenges across the portfolio and provide regular updates and recommendations to leadership, highlighting progress, emerging lessons, and stories of impact.

• Ensure coordination and learning across the CTE portfolio and with the broader Education team.

• Help lead Bloomberg Philanthropies' calendar of national and regional convenings, learning sessions, and site visits, developing the agendas, content, and speakers that facilitate peer learning among grantees and advance the field.

Research, Evaluation & Learning

• Lead research and evaluation activities across Bloomberg Philanthropies' CTE portfolio, working with external research partners, grantees, and internal teams.

• Develop research questions, learning agendas, evaluation approaches, and metrics to assess program implementation, outcomes, and impact.

• Collect, analyze, and synthesize quantitative and qualitative information from across the portfolio to identify trends, lessons, challenges, and opportunities.

• Work with grantees to strengthen data collection, reporting, and use of data to inform program improvement.

• Translate research and evaluation findings into clear, actionable insights for leadership, grantees, and external audiences.

Knowledge Development & Replication

• Identify and document promising practices, successful models, and lessons learned across Bloomberg Philanthropies' CTE initiatives.

• Lead the development of reports, case studies, briefs, toolkits, and other products that communicate lessons from the portfolio and inform the broader field.

• Help identify which elements of successful programs may be transferable or adaptable to other communities and contexts.

• Develop strategies for disseminating lessons and best practices to education and workforce leaders, policymakers, funders, employers, and other external partners.

• Build relationships with grantees, researchers, government leaders, employers, funders, and other thought partners, and represent Bloomberg Philanthropies in national funder collaboratives, working groups, conferences, and other external forums

• Stay current on emerging research, policy, and practice in CTE, education-to-workforce pathways, apprenticeships, employer engagement, and youth career development.

Qualifications:

• 8+ years of relevant experience, including significant work in education, workforce development, CTE, research/evaluation, or a closely related field.

• Outstanding interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues, grantees, government officials, researchers, employers, funders, and other external partners.

• Demonstrated experience leading or managing research, evaluation, learning, or knowledge-development projects, ideally involving multiple partners.

• Ability to synthesize complex research and data into clear insights and high-quality reports, briefs, case studies, and presentations.

• Strong experience planning and executing convenings, meetings, and other external engagements, with the ability to create productive environments for peer learning and collaboration.

• Creative and strategic problem-solving skills, paired with the ability to influence, collaborate, and inspire others to achieve shared objectives.

• Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex initiatives from concept through execution.

• Highest standards of ethics, integrity, discretion, and confidentiality.

• Willingness to engage in both strategic and administrative work, with a collaborative and hands-on working style.

• Bachelor's degree required.

Accommodation

Bloomberg Philanthropies provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please let us know if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email careers@bloomberg.org.

Equal Opportunity

Bloomberg Philanthropies is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg Philanthropies' policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Organization is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy or maternity/parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (each, a “Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg Philanthropies prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics.

We’re proud to provide all full-time employees with comprehensive healthcare coverage, as well as programs and services to help them and their families manage their health and well-being. In addition to health, dental, and vision coverage, we offer disability and life insurance, a retirement savings plan (complete with a generous company match), and an array of wellness programs. We also have perks including fitness and gym reimbursement, commuter savings programs, and discounts on products and services.

The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

Annual Salary Range

$145,000—$160,000 USD

jobs.title: Chief Expert Robotics
jobs.description:
At Bosch Research, we pioneer cutting-edge AI algorithms for high-impact industrial applications, from automated driving to intelligent agentic systems. Our innovations are the foundation for high-performance, robust, and safe AI solutions across the Bosch Group. Join us as a Chief Expert in Robotics and shape the future of autonomous systems.

• Drive End-to-End Robotics Deployment: As a Chief Expert Robotics, you will lead the technical implementation and architecture of advanced robotic systems by translating complex algorithms into reliable, production-ready hardware and software solutions.
• You will take physical robots from the concept and laboratory stage directly into real-world operating environments, whether in manufacturing, logistics, or field applications.
• Strategic Technology Leadership: Furthermore, you will define and drive the long-term robotics research roadmap by identifying emerging technologies in perception, manipulation, motion planning, and AI/ML.
• As a technical expert, you will make key decisions regarding system architecture, hardware-software co-design, and make-or-buy strategies.
• Foster Agile & Pragmatic Engineering Culture: Within interdisciplinary teams, you will foster a fast-paced, startup-like prototyping culture focused on rapid iteration, fail-fast principles, and continuous testing on physical hardware.
• You will mentor and coach researchers across multiple disciplines, including mechanical engineering, electronics, software engineering, and artificial intelligence.
• Stakeholder & Ecosystem Collaboration: You will work closely with business units, product managers, and external partners to ensure that our robotics innovations solve real customer needs and deliver a clear ROI.
• Last but not least, you will scout and collaborate with leading robotics startups, venture partners, and academic institutions to integrate state-of-the-art technologies.

• Education: Completed Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent professional experience (minimum 8+ years in robotics/autonomous systems development)
• Required Experience and Knowledge:Minimum 8+ years of professional experience in robotics and autonomous systems, with demonstrated success in building or deploying advanced physical AI/robotic systems in production environmentsProven background in robotics organizations, including startups, scale-ups, or innovation-focused teamsDeep technical expertise in core robotics technology stacks (e.g., ROS/ROS 2, modern C++, Python, Linux/RTOS)Hands-on experience with GPU-accelerated simulation tools (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo) and teleoperation/data collection pipelinesPractical experience with modern robotic learning methodologies (Imitation Learning, Diffusion Policy, ACT, Reinforcement Learning, or Foundation Models including VLMs/VLAs)Demonstrated knowledge of perception and state estimation techniques (sensor fusion, SLAM, 3D vision, LiDAR/camera calibration)Expertise in manipulation and grasping systems (end-effectors, tactile sensing, teleoperation)Professional experience with Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, safety protocols, and design for reliabilityDemonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical challenges across full-stack systems, from electrical and CAN bus issues on physical robots to software race conditions and edge casesProven ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to executive leadership, customers, and cross-functional teamsTrack record of implementing iterative prototyping methodologies that enable rapid development cycles
• Languages: Fluent written and spoken English

This position is open to Pittsburgh, PA, Sunnyvale, CA and Renningen, Germany. If you are interested in the position in:

• Germany please APPLY HERE

jobs.title: BestDrive Commercial Sales Associate
jobs.description:
Build Relationships. Grow Business. Drive Results.

BestDrive is seeking a motivated, results-driven Sales Representative to grow our commercial tire and fleet solutions business. This is an outside sales role focused on developing new customer relationships, expanding existing accounts, and helping commercial fleets improve performance through innovative tire and service solutions.

If you thrive on building relationships, enjoy being in the field, and have the determination to overcome rejection and win new business, this is an opportunity to make a significant impact while building a rewarding career.

This is not a desk job. Successful candidates will spend the majority of their time meeting customers face-to-face, prospecting for new business, managing customer relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand BestDrive's products and services within their territory.

Position Summary

The Sales Representative is responsible for developing new business, growing existing customer relationships, and delivering commercial tire and fleet solutions within an assigned territory. This field-based role requires daily customer engagement, business development activities, and account management to achieve sales and profitability goals.

The position reports directly to the Area Manager and maintains a strong collaborative relationship with the National Sales Manager to support strategic sales initiatives, account growth, territory development, and overall commercial performance.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development

• Prospect and develop new commercial fleet and business customers through daily in-person visits.
• Generate leads through cold calling, referrals, networking, and territory development activities.
• Build relationships with fleet managers, business owners, maintenance managers, and purchasing decision-makers.
• Maintain consistent sales activity and follow-up efforts to drive revenue growth.
• Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities.

Account Management

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers.
• Identify opportunities to expand products and services within current accounts.
• Conduct regular customer visits to assess needs and strengthen partnerships.
• Provide solutions that help customers improve operational efficiency and reduce costs.
• Ensure exceptional customer service and responsiveness.

Sales & Solution Selling

• Assess customer needs and recommend commercial tires, retread solutions, and fleet service programs.
• Prepare quotes, proposals, and pricing recommendations.
• Negotiate within company guidelines to secure profitable business.
• Collaborate with store operations and service teams to ensure customer expectations are met.
• Promote the full range of BestDrive products and services.

Territory Management

• Develop and execute territory growth plans.
• Maintain an active pipeline of opportunities and target accounts.
• Utilize Salesforce CRM to document customer interactions, opportunities, and sales activities.
• Accurately forecast sales activity and business opportunities.
• Achieve established sales, gross profit, customer acquisition, and retention goals.

Required

• High School Diploma or GED.
• Minimum of two years of outside sales, B2B sales, account management, or territory sales experience.
• Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
• Excellent organizational and time management skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and CRM systems.
• Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record.
• Ability to travel throughout an assigned territory daily.

Preferred

• Commercial tire industry experience.
• Fleet, transportation, automotive, industrial, or related sales experience.
• Knowledge of commercial trucking or fleet operations.
• Experience using Salesforce CRM.
• Existing relationships within the transportation, fleet, or commercial services industry.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

The ideal candidate is resilient, competitive, and highly motivated to grow business. They are comfortable with daily prospecting, frequent customer visits, and overcoming rejection while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.

This role requires the stamina and discipline to be in the field five days a week, actively engaging customers, creating opportunities, and building long-term partnerships that drive results.

Why Join BestDrive?

• Competitive compensation and incentive opportunities
• Established brand and industry-leading products
• Strong support from operations and sales leadership
• Career advancement opportunities
• Comprehensive benefits package
• Company technology and sales tools
• Opportunity to make a direct impact on business growth
• Collaborative and team-oriented culture

Work Environment

This position requires regular travel throughout an assigned territory and frequent visits to customer locations, fleet operations, maintenance facilities, and BestDrive locations. Candidates must be comfortable working in industrial and outdoor environments and interacting with a wide variety of customers and decision-makers.

Join the BestDrive Team

If you are a driven sales professional who enjoys building relationships, creating opportunities, and delivering value to customers, we encourage you to apply today.

Join BestDrive and help drive growth, strengthen customer partnerships, and deliver industry-leading fleet and tire solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner | Executive Search
jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to lead executive searches across the company. You will own Director-level and above hiring for every part of the business: Go-to-Market (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success), Corporate Functions (Finance, Legal, HR, IT, Operations) and Product & Technology.

This is a full-cycle, high-visibility role. You will partner directly with senior leaders and the executive team, run searches from intake to signed offer, and represent Kaseya to the senior talent market. You will also help build and refine how Kaseya runs executive search, so every leadership hire follows a consistent, well-documented process.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead full-cycle executive searches for Director, Senior Director, VP and C-suite roles across GTM, Corporate Functions and P&T, managing a concurrent portfolio of senior searches.

• Run thorough intake sessions with hiring executives to define the role, success profile, leadership competencies, compensation range and target talent pools.

• Build search strategies and market maps, including target companies, competitor org intelligence and passive-candidate pipelines.

• Source and engage senior passive talent directly through networks, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals and targeted outreach.

• Assess candidates for leadership capability, functional depth, scale experience and culture fit, and present well-calibrated shortlists with clear written candidate summaries.

• Design and coordinate structured executive interview processes, including panel planning, case presentations and interviewer prep.

• Manage offers end to end: compensation benchmarking, offer strategy, negotiation, references and closing, in partnership with Total Rewards and HR Business Partners.

• Keep all executive searches in Greenhouse as the system of record, including resumes, interviews, feedback and offers.

• Select, manage and hold accountable external retained search firms when used, including contract terms, fee management and performance against timelines.

• Report search status, pipeline health and market insights to hiring executives and TA leadership on a regular cadence.

• Deliver an exceptional, confidential candidate experience that strengthens Kaseya's employer brand with senior talent.

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

jobs.title: People Systems and Solutions Manager
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

About The Role

The People Systems & Solutions team designs the technology workflows, processes, and data that power Apollo’s People organization. Our ecosystem spans the full employee and talent lifecycle, including recruiting, onboarding, organizational structure, compensation, performance, compliance, reporting, and analytics.

We believe AI will fundamentally change how People teams operate. Getting there requires trusted data, simple processes, thoughtfully designed workflows, and an integrated technology ecosystem. This role will help build and evolve that foundation.

The People Systems and Solutions Manager will partner with the Head of People Systems & Solutions, People leadership, and IT to shape and drive Apollo’s People Systems roadmap. You will translate People and business needs into clear requirements, lead multi-quarter systems and process initiatives, configure and improve platforms and workflows, and manage our People technology vendors.

This is an individual contributor role today. You will lead through deep expertise, sound judgment, clear operating mechanisms, and influence rather than direct management authority. As the function evolves, the role may grow to include people management.

What You’ll Do:

• People Systems Strategy & Roadmap: Partner with People leadership and IT to shape a multi-quarter People Systems roadmap, recommend priorities and tradeoffs, and own delivery of agreed-upon initiatives.

• Process & Workflow Design: Translate complex business needs into simple, scalable processes, requirements, and system configurations across the employee and talent lifecycle.

• Technology Vendor Management: Lead the evaluation, implementation, and ongoing management of People technology vendors, ensuring our platforms deliver measurable value and work together effectively.

• Data, Reporting & AI: Improve People data governance, reporting, and analytics while identifying practical AI and automation opportunities that make work simpler and support better decisions.

• Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner across People, IT, Data, Payroll, Finance, and Legal teams on cross-functional initiatives. Align stakeholders, drive decisions without direct authority, and measure the impact of systems investments.

What You Bring:

• 7+ years of experience in People Systems, People Operations, HR technology, business systems, or a related field.

• Experience shaping and delivering multi-quarter technology or process roadmaps across multiple platforms and business areas.

• Strong business analysis and process design skills, including requirements gathering, system configuration, testing, implementation, and change management.

• Experience evaluating and managing technology vendors and partnering with IT, data, security, and integration teams.

• Strong understanding of People data, reporting, governance, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.

• Thrives in fast paced environments, turning complex challenges into practical, scalable solutions while working effectively across a global organization.

• Experience mentoring or raising the capabilities of others. Prior direct people management experience is helpful but not required.

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$188,400—$235,400 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$163,800—$204,700 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

jobs.title: Head of Procurement
jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.






ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is looking for a Head of Procurement to lead how we buy. You'll be a senior individual contributor reporting to the Chief Accounting Officer with broad influence across and responsibility for our third-party spend in cloud infrastructure, enterprise SaaS, and professional services, and over our travel and expense program.

Our procurement function has earned real trust across the business. Teams don't just invite procurement into their deals for compliance, but because it makes their deals better. You'll protect and build on that trust. You'll be a partner to the business: someone who understands what each team is trying to achieve, looks objectively through a broader company-wide lens, finds the best overall value for Benchling, and makes buying easier while improving how it's controlled.

You'll lead negotiations of our largest and most strategic contracts, build coverage to address the tail, and be our expert on what a well-designed procure-to-pay process looks like, guiding our systems and accounting partners toward it.  You'll work closely with Engineering, IT, Security, Marketing, Legal, Strategic Finance, Corporate Development, and Accounting, running a regular rhythm that gets to decisions. You'll adjust how involved you are to what each team needs, from running a deal end to end to coaching an experienced owner.

 


RESPONSIBILITIES

Sourcing and negotiation, together with strategic initiatives, make up roughly 65–70% of your time. Process excellence makes up the remaining 30–35%.

Sourcing, negotiation, and spend management

 - Lead vendor negotiation and renewals for our largest and most strategic agreements, including our cloud infrastructure and enterprise SaaS providers.

 - Structure deals that hold up over time, including usage-based and committed-spend pricing, multi-year terms, price protections, and exit and data portability rights.

 - Enhance our renewal management process, building a renewal strategy with business owners and Strategic Finance, so renewal pricing never comes as a surprise.

 - Develop category strategies for our major spend areas, and use them to consolidate vendors, inform renewal strategies and stop redundant software spend, working with business partners on usage monitoring and build-versus-buy decisions.

 - Design and implement an appropriately sized third-party vendor risk program that aligns and partners with security and other stakeholders.  Improve vendor risk visibility and build mitigation plans with business partners.

 - Build leverage by giving business owners what they need to negotiate on their own.

 - Advise on categories outside procurement today, such as benefits, large events, real estate, and our contingent workforce vendors.

Process excellence

 - Leverage your experience in leading edge, best-in-class process and set the direction.  Partner with stakeholder teams to evolve existing processes.

 - Own our procurement and T&E policies, set clear rules for when procurement gets involved, and assess whether our tools are still the right ones.

 - Simplify and apply AI and automation from intake through reporting, including procurement metrics teams can use on their own.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years in procurement, strategic sourcing, or vendor management, with most of that experience at technology or SaaS companies

 - A track record of delivering substantial, measurable savings by leading the most complex, high-stakes negotiations in the company, including large cloud infrastructure commitments and multi-year enterprise SaaS agreements, and by driving cross-functional vendor and tool consolidation

 - A reputation as a trusted business partner who balances commercial results with stakeholder needs and long-term vendor relationships

 - Leading-practice procurement process design: demonstrated results from process redesign and simplification, leveraging AI and automation, with good judgment about where they help and where they don't

 - Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills at an executive level.  You can make a clear case for value with data-driven analysis based on usage, benchmark, and total-cost data, and influence decisions without authority.

 - Experience designing third-party risk processes with Security, Legal, and Compliance partners

 - Familiarity with Zip, Navan, NetSuite, or similar platforms

 - Comfort working on your own, handling both strategy and execution



Differentiating: procurement certification (CPSM, CIPS, or similar)

Nice to have: experience in life sciences or biotech

 

 


HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Mechanical Assembler
jobs.description:
At IEM, we’re not just building innovative electrical distribution systems, we’re shaping the future. IEM is dedicated to delivering world-class solutions for complex power needs. After 75 years, we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Whether you’re an experienced professional or just starting out, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, grow, and make a lasting impact on industries that power the world’s most dynamic markets.

IEM is currently seeking experienced Mechanical Assemblers to join our team in San Antonio, TX and will report into the Operations Manager.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Accounting Manager – Revenue Accounting

Location: Sandy, UT (Hybrid; 2 days in office / week)

So, what's the role all about?

As an Accounting Manager – Revenue Accounting at NiCE, you'll play a key leadership role in managing revenue accounting operations for a global, publicly traded SaaS company.

You'll lead and develop a team of Senior Accountants supporting the CXone line of business, oversee monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, and ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and ASC 606.

This is an opportunity for an experienced revenue accounting professional who enjoys combining technical accounting expertise with team leadership, operational ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with Finance, accounting leadership, external auditors, and cross-functional business partners to navigate complex revenue arrangements, strengthen accounting processes, and support key financial reporting requirements.

You'll also play an important role in the implementation of a new revenue recognition system, helping modernize processes, improve controls, and introduce greater automation into a growing and evolving accounting function.

Whether you're an experienced Accounting Manager or a Senior Revenue Accountant ready to take the next step in your leadership career, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a complex, global SaaS environment.

How will you make an impact?

• Lead and develop your team. Manage, mentor, and support a team of Senior Accountants, providing technical guidance, coaching, and oversight of day-to-day revenue accounting activities.

• Own the revenue close process. Lead monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, including reviewing journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition schedules, and financial reporting deliverables to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

• Oversee CXone revenue accounting. Take ownership of revenue accounting activities for the CXone line of business, working closely with accounting leadership to maintain consistent processes, strong financial controls, and reliable reporting.

• Apply technical accounting expertise. Provide guidance on complex revenue arrangements, contract reviews, and revenue recognition matters in accordance with ASC 606 and US GAAP.

• Research and document accounting conclusions. Evaluate technical accounting questions, prepare and review accounting memoranda, and support well-reasoned, clearly documented accounting conclusions.

• Support external audits and compliance. Coordinate audit requests, prepare supporting documentation, participate in walkthroughs, and work with external auditors to resolve revenue accounting questions and ensure compliance with public-company reporting requirements.

• Partner across the business. Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve revenue-related questions, address accounting challenges, and support accurate financial reporting.

• Help modernize revenue accounting systems. Support the implementation of a new revenue recognition system, working with key stakeholders to improve processes, strengthen controls, reduce manual activities, and introduce automation where appropriate.

• Drive operational improvements. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, documentation, reporting accuracy, and overall team effectiveness while supporting scalable and sustainable practices.

• Deliver against critical deadlines. Monitor close timelines, anticipate potential challenges, communicate risks proactively, and ensure accounting deliverables meet established deadlines in a fast-paced, publicly traded company environment.

Have you got what it takes?

• 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for revenue recognition within a SaaS, subscription software, or similarly complex recurring-revenue environment.

• Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, US GAAP, and the accounting principles governing subscription-based and complex software revenue arrangements.

• Experience working within a publicly traded company or similarly complex accounting and financial reporting environment.

• Previous people management experience or demonstrated leadership of accounting teams, processes, or significant accounting workstreams. We welcome candidates who have successfully led others and are ready to take the next step into formal people management.

• Demonstrated experience leading or managing monthly and quarterly accounting close processes, including reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, and revenue accounting schedules.

• Experience researching technical accounting matters, preparing accounting memoranda, documenting conclusions, and supporting accounting positions during external audits.

• Experience collaborating with Finance, Accounting, external auditors, and business stakeholders to resolve accounting questions and meet financial reporting objectives.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Additional experience that will help you stand out:

• CPA certification.

• Public accounting experience, particularly with a Big 4 accounting firm.

• Previous experience as a Revenue Accounting Manager, Accounting Supervisor, or Senior Revenue Accountant with demonstrated leadership responsibilities.

• Experience supporting ERP implementations, revenue recognition systems, accounting automation, or financial systems transformation initiatives.

• Experience navigating complex revenue arrangements, contract modifications, or multiple-element software and subscription agreements.

Skills and Tools

• Leadership and team development: Ability to coach, mentor, and develop accounting professionals while creating accountability, encouraging collaboration, and maintaining high standards of performance.

• SaaS revenue accounting: Strong technical understanding of ASC 606, subscription and software revenue arrangements, accounting close processes, and financial reporting requirements.

• Technical accounting and judgment: Ability to research complex accounting questions, evaluate alternatives, document conclusions, and communicate accounting guidance clearly.

• Financial systems and analytical skills: Advanced Excel proficiency and experience working with ERP and revenue recognition systems, including reviewing complex accounting schedules and reconciling financial data.

• Process improvement and automation: Comfortable operating in an evolving systems environment, with the ability to improve manual processes through automation, stronger controls, and scalable accounting practices.

• Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting matters clearly and work effectively with Finance, external auditors, accounting leadership, and cross-functional business partners.

• Organization and execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to balance competing priorities, anticipate challenges, and consistently meet demanding reporting deadlines.

• Problem-solving and ownership: A proactive approach to identifying accounting issues, investigating discrepancies, recommending solutions, and taking responsibility for accurate, timely results.

About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

jobs.title: Industrial Technician - South Boston, VA
jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer - Minorities/Women/Protected Veterans/Disabled/Other Protected Category.

Any resumes sent without a Service Agreement and Agency Portal submission with Konecranes, Inc. are void of any fees and free for internal use. At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of complex SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) solutions, ensuring they are resilient and aligned with Zero Trust principles.

• Provide SailPoint guidance within an Agile project management framework, fostering technical excellence, professional growth, and a culture of quality.
