jobs.title: Talent Programs Coordinator
jobs.description:
At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing-in-ground-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo - connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before.

Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production - and building the team to make it happen.


ROLE OVERVIEW

REGENT is looking for a Talent Programs Coordinator to help us build and run the programs that bring great people into the company.

This role sits at the intersection of recruiting operations, candidate experience, and early-career talent programs. You'll keep interviews moving across a fast-growing organization, help create an exceptional experience for candidates coming to REGENT, and take increasing ownership of our year-round campus recruiting program — from university relationships and career fairs to intern recruiting and early-career pipelines.

You'll also own many of the logistics that make joining REGENT easier, including candidate travel and relocation support, and help coordinate the recruiting events where we meet future REGENT teammates.

This is a great role for someone who loves making complicated things run smoothly but doesn't want to only manage calendars. You'll have plenty to coordinate, but you'll also have the opportunity to build programs, improve how we work, and take on more ownership as REGENT grows.




🔧 WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Keep Our Interview Process Moving: Own interview scheduling and coordination across teams, keeping candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview teams aligned even when calendars and priorities change quickly.

 - Create a Great Candidate Experience: Help make every interaction with REGENT feel thoughtful and organized. Coordinate candidate communications, travel, onsite logistics, and interview-day details so candidates know what to expect and have what they need.

 - Help Build Our Year-Round Campus Program: Partner with the People team to build and run a campus recruiting program that extends well beyond intern season. Maintain our campus calendar, coordinate relationships with universities, career centers, faculty, and student organizations, and help REGENT build strong early-career talent pipelines.

 - Coordinate Intern & Early-Career Recruiting: Keep the recruiting side of our intern and early-career programs moving — including applications, interview coordination, candidate communications, pipeline tracking, offers, and other program logistics.

 - Run Recruiting Events: Coordinate the details behind career fairs, campus visits, conferences, hiring events, and other opportunities for REGENT to meet prospective talent. Make sure we show up prepared — and that we follow through afterward.

 - Support Relocation From Offer to Arrival: Serve as a consistent point of contact for new hires relocating to join REGENT. Coordinate relocation logistics, resources, vendors, and communications so people aren't left figuring out a major move on their own.

 - Build Better Ways of Working: Look for opportunities to make our recruiting and talent programs simpler, faster, and easier to navigate. Help improve workflows, templates, documentation, automations, and the systems we use to keep everything moving.

 - Use Data to Improve Our Programs: Keep our systems and trackers accurate and help us understand what's working — from campus partnerships and event engagement to interview operations and candidate experience.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Strong Coordination & Organization: You know how to manage a lot of moving pieces, stakeholders, deadlines, and details without losing track of what matters.

 - Experience Supporting Recruiting or Talent Programs: You've worked in recruiting coordination, university recruiting, People/HR, program coordination, or another environment where you've had to keep complex, people-centered processes moving.

 - A Candidate-First Mindset: You understand that the details matter. A clear email, well-run onsite, smooth travel experience, or quick answer to a question can shape how someone feels about joining a company.

 - Program-Building Instincts: You're excited by the opportunity to do more than execute a checklist. You notice what's missing, think about how something could work better, and are comfortable helping turn an idea into a repeatable program.

 - Strong Communication: You're comfortable communicating with candidates, hiring managers, university partners, vendors, and teammates, and you know how to adjust your approach depending on who you're working with.

 - Comfort With Change: Plans shift. Interviews move. Hiring priorities change. Events don't always go according to plan. You're able to reprioritize quickly and keep moving without needing everything to be perfectly defined first.

 - Follow-Through You Can Count On: You take ownership of the details and close loops. When you say you'll handle something, people can trust that it's going to get done.

 - Comfort With Systems & Data: You're comfortable learning new tools and using systems to keep work organized. Experience with an ATS like Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever is a plus.

 - Curiosity About the Mission: You don't need to come in knowing everything about Seagliders, aerospace, maritime, or defense — but you should be excited to learn. You'll be one of the people helping candidates and campus partners understand why REGENT is such an interesting place to build a career.


🔍 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Collaborative People Partner: You know a great candidate and talent experience takes coordination across a lot of people. You build strong relationships with candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, university partners, and teammates, communicate clearly, and make it easy for people to work together.

 - Comfortable in Ambiguity: You’re energized by a fast-moving environment where schedules, priorities, and plans can change quickly. You can figure out what matters most, adjust on the fly, and keep things moving without needing every detail mapped out first.

 - Detail-Oriented Operator: You’re great at keeping a lot of moving pieces organized and take pride in following through. Whether it’s an interview, campus event, candidate trip, or relocation, you anticipate what’s needed, catch the details, and close the loop.

 - Builder Mindset: You don’t just run the process that exists today. You look for ways to make the work better — improving workflows, tools, candidate experiences, and programs in ways that help the People team operate more effectively as REGENT grows.


🌟 WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive compensation including a robust equity incentive plan.

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance — we cover 100% of your premiums.

 - 401(k) with company matching, so you can plan for the future.

 - Generous flexible time off, paid parental leave, and company-wide holiday breaks.

 - Daily, free catered lunches.

 - Learning and professional development opportunities.

If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! We value diverse skillsets and experiences and believe in the potential of passionate individuals to make a big impact.

Equal Opportunity Employer

REGENT is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: 6th-8th Grade Science Teacher
jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified 6th-8th Grade Science Teacher at Broadway Academy at Mount Pleasant in Cleveland, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at Broadway Academy at Mount Pleasant! Celebrating over 10 years of service to the community, Broadway Academy at Mount Pleasant is an award-winning public charter school for EK-8th grade students. The top-performing school in the area, Broadway Academy is known for its academic excellence, nurturing teachers and staff, and well-rounded education featuring Career Technical Education. Strong student attendance and a passionate administration committed to student and teacher success creates a positive school culture. Broadway Academy at Mount Pleasant is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $41,000 - 50,500.  Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

• Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary short-term disability insurance

• Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

• Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

Are you passionate about building the next generation of infrastructure for the future 100 million developers? Are you excited to define the products that AI-native companies will use to build, scale, and operate agents in production?DigitalOcean is entering a pivotal moment as we build infrastructure for the agentic future. Agents will change how software is built, deployed, operated, and scaled. Developers will need infrastructure that lets them move from local development to cloud execution, from short-running tasks to long-horizon workflows, and from experimental prototypes to reliable production systems.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager for Agentic AI Infrastructure to define and own the product strategy for a new generation of managed agent infrastructure products. This role will shape one or more products like Action Gateway, Inference Router, and related services that make it simple for developers to run, scale, and operate agents in the cloud.This is a rare opportunity to help define a new product category at DigitalOcean and build the infrastructure layer that agent-native companies will depend on.

What You’ll Do

• Define the Agentic AI infrastructure product strategy: Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution plan for DigitalOcean’s managed agent infrastructure products.

• Build foundational agent infrastructure products: Lead product definition for services such as Action Gateway, Inference Router, and related developer experiences.

• Work backwards from agent-native customers: Partner directly with companies building coding agents, productivity agents, workflow agents, and custom AI systems to understand the infrastructure they need to move from prototype to production.

• Create simple abstractions for complex workloads: Define product experiences that make it easy for developers to run long-lived agents, fork sessions, resume work, attach tools, manage credentials, execute code safely, and observe agent behavior.

• Shape the developer experience: Build intuitive APIs, CLIs, docs, examples, and workflows that let developers bring their existing harnesses and agent frameworks to DigitalOcean with minimal friction.

• Partner with engineering on architecture and tradeoffs: Work closely with engineering leaders to translate customer needs into product requirements across MicroVMs, sandboxing, tool execution, identity, state management, observability, security, and scale.

• Launch new products and SKUs: Partner with GTM, finance, and engineering to define packaging, pricing, beta programs, launch plans, and adoption motions for agentic infrastructure services.

• Drive operational and business outcomes: Establish product metrics around adoption, retention, usage, reliability, workload scale, gross margin, developer satisfaction, and revenue growth.

• Evangelize the category: Help DigitalOcean explain why agents need a new infrastructure layer and how our products help developers build, test, deploy, and operate agents with confidence.

What You’ll Bring:

• Strong product leadership in infrastructure or developer platforms: Experience building cloud infrastructure, developer tools, ML platforms, runtime systems, workflow engines, security products, or API-first platforms.

• Fluency in agentic AI systems: Understanding of how agents use tools, execute code, manage context, call APIs, operate across long-running sessions, and interact with external systems.

• Technical depth in cloud primitives: Familiarity with areas such as containers, MicroVMs, sandboxing, identity and access management, stateful workloads, distributed systems, observability, and secure execution environments.

• Customer-backed product instincts: Ability to work with early, demanding customers and turn ambiguous feedback into clear product direction, roadmap priorities, and launchable capabilities.

• Strong systems thinking: You can reason across user experience, platform architecture, security, reliability, pricing, and operational complexity.

• Developer empathy: You understand what developers need to adopt a platform quickly: simple APIs, clear mental models, fast onboarding, trustworthy docs, and products that work without unnecessary ceremony.

• Business judgment: You can connect product investments to revenue, adoption, margin, differentiation, and long-term platform strategy.

• Executive communication and influence: You can align engineering, design, GTM, finance, legal, security, and executive stakeholders around a clear product strategy.

• Category-building mindset: You are excited to operate in an emerging market where the primitives are still being defined and where product leadership requires both conviction and customer-driven iteration.

Compensation Range:

• $218,400.00 - $273,000.00

*This is a hybrid role

JR: 2026-8298

#LI-Hybrid

Why You’ll Like Working for DigitalOcean

• We innovate with purpose. You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.

• We prioritize career development. At DO, you’ll do the best work of your career. You will work with some of the smartest and most interesting people in the industry. We are a high-performance organization that will always challenge you to think big. Our organizational development team will provide you with resources to ensure you keep growing. We provide employees with reimbursement for relevant conferences, training, and education. All employees have access to LinkedIn Learning's 10,000+ courses to support their continued growth and development.

• We care about your well-being. Regardless of your location, we will provide you with a competitive array of benefits to support you from our Employee Assistance Program to Local Employee Meetups to flexible time off policy, to name a few. While the philosophy around our benefits is the same worldwide, specific benefits may vary based on local regulations and preferences.

• We reward our employees. The salary range for this position is based on market data, relevant years of experience, and skills. You may qualify for a bonus in addition to base salary; bonus amounts are determined based on company and individual performance. We also provide equity compensation to eligible employees, including equity grants upon hire and the option to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Program.

• DigitalOcean is an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Application Limit: You may apply to a maximum of 3 positions within any 180-day period. This policy promotes better role-candidate matching and encourages thoughtful applications where your qualifications align most strongly.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Job Description

4D Tech Solutions, an AFS company, is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer experience in engineering disciplines to support a multidisciplinary product development team focused on advanced sensor technologies. The role involves designing, developing, and commercializing embedded systems for unmanned vehicles and handheld, body‑worn, or mounted platforms, requiring strong skills in embedded software, GUI development, and DevSecOps practices. Candidates will design and develop embedded applications, streamlined user interfaces, and remote-control solutions for sensor systems while also performing calibration and testing in lab and field environments. The ideal engineer thrives in dynamic settings, adapts to shifting project objectives, and contributes to mission success through effective collaboration. This position offers the opportunity to work across diverse technologies and play a key role in delivering next‑generation sensing solutions.

Required Qualifications

• B.S. or higher in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, electrical engineering or a similar degree

• 5+ years’ experience in design and development of embedded software for sensors and devices

• 5+ years’ experience in C, C++ and/or Python programming language

• 5+ years’ experience applying modern GUI design principles to develop user interfaces for sensor and data intensive applications

Candidates that do not meet the required qualifications will not be considered

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with embedded Linux development (PetaLinux/Raspberry Pi, etc.)

• Familiarity with optics, lasers, LiDAR, and camera systems

• Experience with Xilinx Zynq architecture

• Experience with FPGA development and VHDL language

• Familiarity with Qt or another cross-platform user-interface toolkit

• Experience developing graphical user interfaces for unmanned systems

• Experience working with government customers (demonstrations/test events)

• Familiarity with NIST 800-171 security controls

• Familiarity with or certified to operate unmanned aerial systems (FAA Part 107 certification)

Security Clearance:

• US citizenship required

jobs.title: H&M Sales Advisor Georgetown, Washington DC
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Sales Advisor, you'll be responsible for providing excellent customer service, welcoming & guiding customers through your store to actively sell our products and providing customers with support & guidance. You'll use your fashion and product knowledge to provide our customers with all the relevant information they need for the best experience. You'll also work on garment refill & care, presentation and contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house, working closely with the rest of your store team to deliver an excellent customer experience.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Provide excellent customer service: welcoming & guiding customers through the store & OMNI experience where available, supporting them with direct customer service
• Willingness to engage and have conversations with customers to provide excellent service
• Guide customers through our fashion trends, stories & products in all areas of the store
• Ability to effectively promote and sell our products to customers
• Actively promote our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Support with commercial or operational actions to reach sales targets with store management team

General Information

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc.
• Use your product & fashion knowledge to share relevant information to customers

Team & Development

• Retain and share your service, fashion and store operations knowledge and skills with colleagues
• Follow all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store
• Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding, introduction processes & trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Complete full garment cycle from unpacking and refill to steaming and ensure good garment care
• Operate fitting room and checkout areas according to best practice & processes
• Contribute to a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house (including stockrooms)
• Support with garment presentation, execution and maintain attractive merchandise displays, clear trends & stories according to visual & commercial guidelines
• Ensure good stock levels with replenishment routines on sales floor
• Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
• Support with opening and closing of the store
• Following all H&S guidelines and legal requirements applicable to role and responsibilities

Who You Are

• As a Sales Advisor, you'll be passionate about fashion and everything we create in-store.
• Motivated by giving customers a great experience.
• You should also be communicative, creative and curious, motivated, flexible, decisive, and action-oriented.
• You should also enjoy working in a collaborative and dynamic environment.
• You have sales experience working in a dynamic and collaborative environment that you can apply to your role
• Experience working with customer service in fashion, retail or other service-related industries

Why You'll Love Working at H&M

• We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
• We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
• You'll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
• We are an inclusive company where you're encouraged to be yourself at work
• You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
• We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
• You'll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Job Status: Hourly, Non-Exempt

EEOC Code: SLS

Compensation: Sales Associates Pay Rate $19 per hour**

*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company's discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Data Research Fellowship
jobs.description:
A Career with Point72's Market Intelligence Team

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our investment professionals and Compliance team to work with alternative data to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our sector data analysts, data scientists, data managers, and engineers work together to build compliant research products that are incorporated into the research process of our investment professionals. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

What you'll do

This 6-month intensive fellowship offers hands-on experience in data-driven research, business analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and the discretionary investment process within a fast-paced, compliance-focused environment. Data Research Fellows will be considered for permanent placement on the team following completion of the program.

During the 6-month program based in our New York office, you will:

• Analyze alternative data from multiple sources to identify trends, themes, and business insights across companies and industries

• Develop sector expertise by studying key performance indicators, competitive dynamics, and operating drivers within an assigned coverage area

• Produce research for internal investment professionals through written analysis, verbal updates, and clear data visualization

• Partner with data analysts, data scientists, and engineers to transform datasets into research products that support investment decision-making

• Interact with investment professionals to learn the discretionary investment process and contribute to informed research discussions

• Collaborate with Data Sourcing, Data Science, Data Engineering, and Compliance to ensure research is rigorous, useful, and compliant

• Translate complex analytical findings into practical insights for technical and nontechnical partners

• Apply alternative data within a broader fundamental research process while building skills for potential permanent placement

What's required

• Undergraduate degree conferred in 2025 or 2026

• Strong analytical skills and demonstrated academic success

• Basic proficiency with coding or programming, including exposure to SQL or Python

• Comfort analyzing data and explaining concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a demanding workload

• Understanding of how companies, industries, or sectors operate, with a strong interest in continued learning

• Intellectual curiosity, creative thinking, maturity, and a strong work ethic

• Ability to collaborate productively and build relationships across teams

jobs.title: Enrollment Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
Join the dynamic journey at Vynca, where we're passionate about transforming care for individuals with complex needs.

We’re more than just a team; we're a close-knit community. Our shared commitment to caring for each other and those we serve is what sets us apart. Guided by our unwavering core values: Excellence, Compassion, Curiosity, and Integrity, we forge paths of success together. Join us in this transformative movement where you can contribute to making a profound difference every day.

At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.



About the job

The Enrollment MA is a compassionate, self-motivated clinical professional who serves as the primary point of contact for identifying and enrolling patients into Vynca's palliative care program. In this role, you will conduct targeted outreach calls to patients, families, and healthcare organizations — educating them on palliative care and VyncaCare's services, completing structured eligibility screenings to identify patients with chronic illness and functional decline, and scheduling those who qualify for an initial visit with a nurse practitioner. Success in this position requires a strong foundation in motivational interviewing and health literacy-aware communication, as you will often be the first voice guiding patients and caregivers through an unfamiliar but life-changing program. You will build and maintain collaborative relationships with health plans, physician offices, discharge planners, and community partners to drive census growth and expand program reach. Alongside your direct outreach, you will be expected to contribute qualitative and quantitative feedback on outreach trends and barriers, working closely with the market and business development team to inform strategy.



What you’ll do 

 - Conduct targeted telephonic outreach to patients on provided lists, following Vynca's standard messaging while delivering the highest standard of customer service and patient-centered communication

 - Confirm service area eligibility and complete structured screening forms capturing demographic information, chronic disease history, and indicators of functional decline to determine program eligibility

 - Educate patients and families on palliative care, Vynca 's services, and what to expect from the program — translating complex clinical concepts into accessible, reassuring language

 - Schedule eligible patients for an initial visit with a nurse practitioner and coordinate logistics to ensure a smooth handoff from enrollment to care

 - Act as a liaison between patients and the broader care team, directing calls, texts, and emails to the appropriate individuals or departments and responding to patient questions and concerns in a timely, supportive manner.

 - Maintain confidentiality and accuracy in all patient documentation and communications in accordance with HIPAA and organizational standards

 - Coordinate enrollment efforts across targeted regions, tracking outreach activity systematically to encourage referrals and support census growth

 - Identify outreach trends, surface barriers to enrollment, and share qualitative and quantitative feedback and creative ideas with the market and business development team to continuously improve program reach

 - Maintain a strong, collaborative working relationship with your designated market team and practice leadership, contributing to shared goals around program expansion and patient access
   

Your experience and qualifications 

 - Current CMA or CCMA certificate issued by a recognized credentialing body

 - 2 years of healthcare experience required; 8 months of previous clinical experience preferred

 - 1 year of telephonic or call center customer service experience; call center experience highly preferred

 - Experience working in a medical practice or healthcare setting, including familiarity with EHR platforms for documenting patient interactions and scheduling appointments

 - Experience and training in motivational interviewing and patient education. Comfort discussing serious illness, chronic disease, and end-of-life adjacent topics with patients and families

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to work independently and manage a high-volume outreach workload

 - Proficient with Microsoft and Google applications; must have access to a reliable internet connection

 -  Strong written and verbal communication skills

 -  Exceptional interpersonal skills including conflict resolution and de-escalation techniques

 - Willing and able to work Monday through Friday, 8:30am–5pm Eastern/Central/Mountain/or Pacific Standard Time, with the possibility of overtime

Preferred Qualifications

 - Bilingual (English/Spanish)

 - Medical terminology certification

 - Familiarity with palliative care, home-based care models, or chronic disease management

California, Georgia, Texas, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Illinois, Nevada, North Carolina, Oregon, Utah and Washington.

About Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.

Iovance Biotherapeutics, Inc.  is the global leader in innovating, developing, and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) cell therapies for patients with solid tumors. Amtagvi® (lifileucel) is the first FDA-approved, one-time treatment for previously treated advanced melanoma, now approved in three global markets and available at more than 95 authorized treatment centers. Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Tax team's mission is to proactively manage our global tax footprint while supporting Robinhood’s mission to democratize finance for all! We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams to navigate complex tax regulations and enable business growth. Our team values deep collaboration, technical excellence, and proactive problem-solving. We maintain a high-performing, supportive culture where every team member is encouraged to challenge the status quo.

As the Manager, Global Indirect Tax, you will lead our global indirect tax compliance, controversy, transaction advisory, and operations initiatives.
You will manage end-to-end global indirect tax operations, including compliance, audits, system improvements, and technical research and advisory. You will play a critical role in shaping our overall indirect tax strategy and compliance framework for innovative products and business models. This is a unique opportunity to build scalable tax processes in a fast-growing financial services environment, spearheading the next generation of tax operations through automation and AI-enabled solutions.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

• Oversee global indirect tax operations, including VAT, GST, sales and use tax, and other non-income transactional tax compliance, registrations, return filings, and payment processes across relevant jurisdictions

• Manage indirect tax audits and notices, acting as the primary point of contact for tax authorities to resolve assessments and disputes

• Provide clear technical tax advice regarding indirect tax implications for new products, acquisitions, contracts, cross-border transactions, and business reorganizations

• Partner cross-functionally to support taxability determinations, invoicing requirements, exemption documentation, and implementation of indirect tax requirements or process improvements in systems and operational processes

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments affecting global indirect tax and translate those developments into practical guidance, risk mitigation, and process updates

What you bring

• A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

jobs.title: SOC Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

What you'll do:

Build and lead the SOC

• Define the operating model: coverage hours, on-call rotation, escalation tiers, and the split between in-house staff and managed service partners.

• Hire, train and retain analysts and detection engineers. Set clear career paths and hold a high technical bar.

• Write and maintain the playbooks, runbooks and standard operating procedures the team works from.

• Own the SOC budget, tooling roadmap and vendor relationships.

Detect

• Own log source coverage and detection content across enterprise IT, the CUI enclave, cloud tenants, engineering labs, and production and test networks.

• Run detection engineering as a discipline: map coverage to MITRE ATT&CK, tune out noise, test detections, and retire what does not work.

• Lead proactive threat hunts driven by intelligence on actors that target the defense industrial base.

• Consume and act on government and industry threat sharing, including DC3/DCISE and NSA Cybersecurity Collaboration Center reporting.

Respond

• Serve as incident commander for security incidents, from triage through containment, eradication, recovery and lessons learned.

• Meet DFARS 252.204-7012 obligations: 72-hour reporting to DoD, media preservation, and malware submission.

• Coordinate with Legal, Export Compliance, the Facility Security Officer and HR when an incident touches CUI, ITAR or EAR technical data, classified programs or personnel.

• Run tabletop exercises and purple-team engagements at least [quarterly], and close the gaps they expose.

Protect sensitive data

• Operate data loss monitoring for CUI and export-controlled technical data across endpoints, email, cloud storage and code repositories.

• Support the insider threat program with monitoring, investigation and evidence handling that holds up to legal and regulatory review.

• Monitor sanctioned and unsanctioned use of AI and SaaS tools against data that must stay inside the compliance boundary.

Prove it

• Produce the evidence that CMMC Level 2 and NIST SP 800-171 assessments require for the Audit and Accountability, Incident Response, Risk Assessment, and System and Information Integrity families.

• Report SOC performance to leadership with metrics that mean something: time to detect, time to contain, coverage gaps and trend lines.

• Partner with the vulnerability management, IT and engineering teams to turn findings into fixes with owners and dates.

• Use automation and AI-assisted triage, inside the compliance boundary, to keep analyst time on work that needs judgment.

What you bring

• 8+ years in security operations, incident response or threat hunting, including 4-5+ years leading a SOC or IR team.

• Experience in a regulated defense, aerospace or federal environment that handles CUI or export-controlled data.

• A record of leading significant incidents end to end, including executive communication and external reporting.

• Working knowledge of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC Level 2, DFARS 252.204-7012 and NIST SP 800-61 incident handling.

• Hands-on depth with SIEM, EDR and SOAR platforms: you can write a detection, read a packet capture and pull a forensic timeline.

• Experience operating security tooling in a government community cloud or similarly restricted tenant.

• Experience managing an MSSP or MDR provider against measurable service levels.

• Scripting ability in Python, PowerShell or a comparable language, and fluency in at least one SIEM query language.

• Clear writing. Your incident reports will be read by executives, counsel, assessors and government customers.

• Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience. We weigh experience heavily.

Preferred

• Experience building a SOC from an early stage at a fast-growing hardware or defense technology company.

• Experience supporting a C3PAO assessment or DIBCAC review as the owner of incident response and audit evidence.

• Insider threat program experience, including work with counterintelligence or DCSA.

• Familiarity with NISPOM (32 CFR Part 117) and the boundary between unclassified security operations and classified system monitoring.

• Experience monitoring lab, manufacturing or embedded environments alongside enterprise IT.

• Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, GCDA, GNFA or CISSP.

• Prior military, intelligence community or DoD cyber operations experience.

Eligibility and clearance

• This role requires access to export-controlled information and a U.S. government security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required.

• Preferred Active Secret clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one.

• On-site presence at Los Angeles or Washington DC. Incident response may require work outside business hours and participation in an on-call rotation.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

Salary Range: $180,000 - $240,000

The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Legend Biotech is seeking Sr. Cell Therapy Clinical Educator (Illinois) as part of the Commercial team based Remotely.

Role Overview

The Cell Therapy Clinical Educator are field based commercial personnel responsible for providing information, education and resources on Legend cell therapy products to advanced practice providers (APPs) and nurses involved in delivering care for patients treated with cell therapy. jobs.title: Solutions Architect - West
jobs.description:
About Us

AI coding is the largest use case of enterprise AI adoption today, as is evident from the success of Anthropic on Claude Code, Cursor’s $60B exit to SpaceX, and Cognition’s $48B valuation.

The bottleneck now has moved from code generation to security and safety - AI agents write code faster than any team can review it, and over 65% of the lines of code produced by them are insecure. Vulnerabilities are piling up 16x faster than companies can fix them, and adversaries are able to exploit these new vulnerabilities within hours.

AURI by Endor Labs closes that gap. It runs inside the harness where coding agents work, through hooks, skills and MCP, so the controls sit outside the model and every agent action is visible. Underneath is our patented code context graph, which maps code, open source, containers and infrastructure. It shows which vulnerabilities can actually be reached and exploited, then delivers fixes that won’t break the application. Security teams get evidence instead of noise, and developers get fixes instead of tickets.

The companies building AI trust us to secure it - our customers include OpenAI, SpaceX, DoorDash, Dropbox, Atlassian, MongoDB, Snowflake, Robinhood and Peloton to name a few.

Endor Labs is the third company from Founder & CEO Varun Badhwar, who built Prisma Cloud, the platform that helped define cloud security, from $0 to $300M ARR at Palo Alto Networks. We’ve raised $163M from Lightspeed, Coatue, DFJ Growth, Salesforce Ventures and Dell Technologies Capital.

Software runs everything around our lives today - banking, hospitals, airports and power grids. AI now writes more of it every day, and our mission is to make sure the world can trust that software. Come build that future with us.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Solutions Architect at Endor Labs, you're at the heart of connecting our innovative team with our diverse and dynamic customers. Every day presents a new set of exciting challenges and opportunities to make a significant impact:

• Educate with Enthusiasm: Elevate awareness about Application Security and Software Supply Chain Security. It's about making security engaging and accessible to developers everywhere.

• Master Our Tech: Deep dive into our supply chain security product suite and emerge as the go-to expert and evangelist.

• Deliver Tailored Demos: Showcase our solutions in a way that speaks directly to the needs and challenges of our customers. Be the architect of captivating, solution-oriented presentations.

• Shape Customer Outcomes: Collaborate with our engineering and product teams to design solutions that genuinely address customer challenges. Your insights from the field will directly influence our product development, ensuring we always meet our customers' evolving needs.

• Facilitate Customer Success: Guide customers through onboarding, ensuring a smooth transition and adoption of the Endor Labs solution. Your goal is to empower customers to leverage our technology fully and ensure they achieve their security and development objectives.

What You Bring to the Table

We're on the hunt for someone who is not just looking for a job but likes a bit of adventure, too! You'll fit right in if you have:

• Rich Experience: You have experience in pre-sales or a similar customer-facing, technical role. You're no stranger to technical deep dives, product demonstrations, and leading evaluations.

• Strong Technical Foundation: A solid understanding of modern software development practices, including backend or full-stack development experience, CI/CD pipelines, Git-based development workflows, and DevOps tooling. You’re comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams and understanding how modern applications are built and deployed.

• Application Security Awareness: Familiarity with application security concepts, software supply chain security, and/or identity & access management principles. You understand the importance of securing developer workflows and modern cloud-native environments.

• Tech Savvy: A robust understanding of the Developer, DevOps, Application Security, and open-source ecosystems. Hopefully, you can meet developers where they are and flex some programming skills.

• Customer & Sales Skills: You've successfully engaged with technical customers at an Enterprise level and know how to articulate complex solutions and operate in a sales cycle.

• Curious and Eager to Learn: Always on the lookout for new technologies and understanding the intricacies of how things work.

• Collaborative Spirit: You thrive in a team setting and value diversity and inclusion in every interaction.

• Action-oriented: You prefer actively solving customer problems and asking for help as needed.

What Makes Us... Us

• Go to extraordinary lengths to distinguish ourselves through world-class work.

• Prioritize quality over speed, and speed over scope.

• Desire to work with deeply kind, mission-driven people.

• Strive to make the complex simple.

• Use first principles to debate ideas, test assumptions, and make decisions.

• Seek the truth by putting data above opinions.

• Assume good intent and give tactical feedback to help each other get better.

• Hold no ego—when our customers win, we all win.

What We Offer You

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including Health, Dental, Vision and Mental Health plans.

• 401(k) plan to support your longterm financial goals.

• Flexible PTO to maintain a healthy work-life balance (we want you here for the long-haul!)

• Opportunities for co-working and team meetups to foster collaboration.

• A dog-friendly office environment for those who love to bring their fur babies along.

Endor Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if you don't fit every requirement above, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and experiences, so we encourage all talented individuals to apply—there's no one-size-fits-all here.

Compensation: For candidates who receive an offer for this position, the compensation range is expected to be between $190,000 - $250,000. This may include additional incentives such as commission targets, restricted stock units, and/or bonuses, depending on the role.

jobs.title: Senior Recruiter
jobs.description:
IN BRIEF

We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives. You'll own full-cycle recruiting across the company, with a primary focus on engineering, data science, and AI/ML, and help us build a recruiting operation that finds and signs top-tier talent efficiently.




WHO WE ARE

Bayesian Health's mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point of care. We're a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, AI experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.

We're funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association's venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Recent recognitions include Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, and BioTech AI Company of the Year. Read more about our peer-reviewed research in Nature Medicine associating our products with improved patient outcomes.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a 6-month fixed-term role with the option to convert to full-time. Technical hiring is the primary focus, and you'll also own hiring across the rest of the company, including sales, client success, and clinical roles. When a search needs a recruiter, you take it, whatever the function.

This role is built on proactive sourcing and market mapping. The best candidates for our roles don't always apply on their own, so you'll spend real time finding them, reaching out, and earning their interest. You'll also protect the integrity of our hiring process, building identity and work history verification into how we screen.

You'll be our dedicated recruiter, so you'll set the baselines for time to fill, candidate response time, and offer acceptance, and then own improving them. Candidates judge us by how we treat them. No one waits for an answer, and when something inside our own process is slowing a candidate down, you'll find it and fix it. We would rather give someone a clear no quickly than leave them guessing.

You'll also help shape how we recruit. If the role converts to full-time, you'll help build and scale the recruiting function as we grow.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Full-Cycle Recruiting Across the Company

Own searches from intake to signed offer, with a primary focus on engineering, data science, and AI/ML. Take on sales, client success, clinical, and other searches as the business needs them. Map the market, build target lists, and run proactive outbound sourcing so your pipelines don't depend on inbound applicants. Build and run talent-community and brand-awareness initiatives, creating recruiting content, job promotion, and outreach assets that raise awareness of our roles. Design and execute proactive sourcing campaigns tailored to specific audiences, using timely market insights to reach talent when they’re open to new opportunities.Build http://opportunities.Build verification into your process so we can spot fraudulent or misrepresented candidates early.

Hiring Manager Partnership

Run intake meetings that pin down qualifications and competencies. Hold a regular pipeline review with each hiring manager, and partner on feedback, calibration, offer negotiation, and closing.

Candidate Progression and Speed

Keep every candidate moving and every search on pace. Respond to candidates and hiring managers quickly, manage scheduling, and spot stalled pipelines early. Own time to fill for your searches, and keep candidates engaged from first contact through their start date.

Recruiting Operations and Process Design

Manage our ATS end-to-end, including stage design, automation, sequencing, templates, tags, and reporting, and keep it current so no step depends on someone's memory. Keep improving our workflows, structured interviews, and scorecards, tying them back to defined competencies. Train and onboard hiring managers on ATS best practices, sourcing and compliance. Expand interviewer training and calibration so we have an adequate number of interviews to scale with our pipeline. Partner with the People team on offer development and on selling candidates on the opportunity.

Analytics

Publish recruiting analytics that show funnel health and guide improvements.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Deep sourcing expertise, with a track record of filling technical roles through proactive outbound and market mapping, not inbound applicants

 - High follow-through: running many searches at once, responding fast, keeping your commitments, and reducing time to fill, with specific examples you can describe

 - A willingness to do whatever it takes to close a search, including the administrative work

 - A candidate-first approach, with clear communication at every stage and no one left waiting for an update

 - Comfort recruiting across technical and non-technical roles, and taking on searches outside your usual lane

 - Experience spotting and screening out fraudulent or misrepresented candidates, such as verifying identity and work history

 - 6+ years of recruiting experience, including technical recruiting across engineering, ML/AI, and data roles, from entry-level through staff

 - 3+ years recruiting in an early-stage or high-growth startup environment

 - Experience designing recruiting operations, including workflows, structured interviews, scorecards, and rubrics tied to competencies

 - Evidence that you improve processes rather than work around them, something you found broken, changed, and measured

 - Working knowledge of a modern ATS (Ashby preferred), including automation, reporting, and pipeline hygiene

 - A track record of inclusive recruiting practices and building diverse talent pipelines
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Hands-on use of AI tools for sourcing and communication, with sound judgment about where automation is worth using

 - Experience recruiting in health tech or other regulated domains

 - Experience hiring for AI/ML specializations, such as MLOps, model development, deployment, and validation

 - Experience recruiting for sales, client success, or clinical roles

 - Experience with Ashby recruiting software

Life at Bayesian

We're a small, mission-driven team building AI tools that help clinicians catch life-threatening conditions earlier. We work remotely but stay closely connected in real time. We believe that closer collaboration helps us move faster for the hospitals and patients who depend on us.

Our values guide how we work every day:

 - Patients at the center. We hold ourselves to a high bar for excellence and impact.

 - Hard problems, real breakthroughs. We pursue new ideas even when it's uncomfortable.

 - No surprises, clear signals. We communicate clearly and honestly, so teams and customers can trust us.

 - Whole people, shared respect. We treat teammates with respect and make space to grow.

 - Truth seekers, stronger together. We debate openly and align around shared goals.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Medical, Dental & Vision: Benefits-eligible from day one. Coverage through Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, including an HSA-eligible option, plus dental and vision through Guardian/VSP. Bayesian covers the majority of your premium and a meaningful share of your dependents' coverage. Enrolled members also get access to One Medical for same-day and 24/7 virtual primary care.

 - Life & Disability: Life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability, fully company-paid.

 - 401(k): A company retirement plan with your choice of investment approach.

 - Wellbeing: Free mental health support through Spring Health, plus additional wellness resources including pet care benefits and more.

 - Time Off: Generous PTO that grows with tenure, paid sick time, paid holidays, and occasional company-wide self-care days.

 - Equity: Equity is part of the picture when you convert to full-time, so you share directly in what we build together.

 - Team Retreats: A fully paid annual company retreat to connect with the team in person.

 - Equipment: A MacBook and ongoing reimbursement for internet and phone costs from day one. A one-time home office stipend begins when you convert to full-time.



Team: People

Reports to: Head of People

Level: Senior Individual Contributor

Employment Classification: Fixed-Term with Benefits (6 months, with the option to convert to full-time)

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: Remote - US Only

Salary: $155,249 - $176,055 total cash (base plus target bonus)

Candidates based in certain high-cost cities may be eligible for a geographic premium.

Equity: Eligible upon conversion to full-time

Synchronous Hours: 11a-5p ET (8a-2p PT)

jobs.title: Principal Automation and Controls Engineer
jobs.description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Team

You will be joining Valar Atomics' Automation and Controls team within the Instrumentation, Control & Electrical (IC&E) organization. Automation and Controls Engineers own the logic and data layer , PLC and DCS application code, ISA-88 batch sequences, SCADA and HMI applications, historian infrastructure, and enterprise integration — across the reactor program and fuel manufacturing operations. You will work alongside I&C Hardware, electrical, process, and nuclear safety engineers in an environment that blends traditional control systems with modern software and data integration practice. As the principal engineer, you will be the discipline's most senior technical voice: the architect of its systems, the final checker of its highest-consequence work, and a standard-setter for the engineers who will build their careers here. The team values operator-focused design, data integrity, disciplined documentation, and a safety-first culture.

The Role

Valar Atomics is seeking Principal Automation and Controls Engineers to own the technical direction of the controls software discipline across our reactor and nuclear fuel manufacturing facilities. The role spans the full controls software domain: PLC and DCS applications, SCADA and HMI, batch control, alarm management, safety logic, historians and plant data, and enterprise integration, but at the level of architecture, strategy, and design authority rather than routine application development. This is a principal position: you will define the control system and plant data architecture and technology roadmap for a first-of-a-kind nuclear program, hold final technical approval authority within the discipline, direct the resolution of the highest-consequence and most novel control problems, represent the discipline in licensing, cybersecurity, and strategic vendor engagements, and build the engineering capability of the organization around you. Where a Staff engineer owns the discipline's standards and quality, the Principal engineer owns where the discipline is going.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Technical Strategy

• Define and own the control system architecture and technology roadmap across the reactor program and fuel manufacturing facilities, including PLC/DCS, SCADA, SIS, and HMI platform strategy, controller and server segregation architecture, and the plant data architecture from historian through enterprise integration.

• Author and own the discipline's philosophy and basis documents — control system architecture basis, alarm philosophy, HMI philosophy, batch architecture basis, software validation and testing philosophy, and configuration management and change control philosophy that constrain and guide all downstream application development.

• Direct control strategy development for first-of-a-kind plant control problems where no established solution exists, sponsoring control approach trade studies, platform capability evaluations, prototyping campaigns, and validation strategies with long-term consequences.

• Own the discipline's standards program: set the framework and priorities for coding standards, template libraries, display and alarm standards, and testing practice; delegate authorship to staff and senior engineers and approve standards for release; drive convergence across projects and sites.

• Evaluate emerging controls and data technology — virtualization and containerization, advanced regulatory and model-based control, analytics and anomaly detection, and evolving SCADA and historian platforms — and decide what enters the toolkit, what is piloted, and what is excluded, balancing innovation against nuclear quality and long-term supportability.

Design Authority and Technical Governance

• Serve as the discipline design authority: hold final technical approval within controls software for architecture decisions, safety-significant applications, deviations from standards, and concessions; adjudicate technical disputes within the discipline and represent its position in cross-discipline conflicts at program level.

• Own the technical integrity of safety application software across the fleet under IEC 61511: the safety software development and validation regime, independence and review requirements, and approval of safety-significant software changes.

• Own software quality governance for the discipline: the assurance model for in-house, contractor, and integrator code; audit and surveillance approach; and the criteria by which applications are accepted into operation.

• Lead the discipline's engagement in the highest-consequence program reviews: preliminary and critical design reviews, safety case and licensing reviews, cyber assessments, and software readiness reviews for major commissioning and startup milestones.

• Direct root cause investigations for the most significant software-related events — spurious trips, sequence failures, data loss, cyber incidents and approve corrective action strategy, ensuring findings are institutionalized in architecture, standards, and training.

• Personally execute or lead engineering on the small set of problems where the consequence of error or the degree of novelty warrants the discipline's most senior engineer, and know which problems those are.

External Representation and Licensing

• Support the nuclear licensing effort as the senior controls software voice: contribute to and defend the digital I&C and software content of the safety case, including software qualification, development process, and cybersecurity arguments; support regulatory interactions and audits.

• Represent Valar Atomics to strategic controls platform vendors and system integrators at a senior technical level; own long-term platform relationships, roadmap influence, qualification expectations, and escalation of systemic vendor quality issues.

• Represent the company in industry and standards forums as appropriate (ISA, IEEE, IEC, advanced reactor industry groups); bring emerging digital I&C, cybersecurity, and standards developments back into company strategy before they become constraints.

Organizational Capability

• Build the discipline's engineering capability: define the technical competencies the controls software organization needs, shape role definitions and the technical career ladder with the Director, set the hiring bar, and lead technical interviews for senior positions.

• Mentor staff and senior engineers toward independent technical authority; sponsor their development through delegation of ownership with oversight rather than retention of scope.

• Advise IC&E leadership on technical risk, resourcing, and sequencing for the program; provide independent technical judgment on schedule and cost pressure where it intersects software quality and safety.

• Maintain disciplined engineering records consistent with nuclear quality requirements, ensuring traceability of design decisions, software changes, and test results, and setting the example for the discipline's

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronic, Computer, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

• 10+ years of controls software, PLC/DCS, or SCADA engineering experience in process industries.

• Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of controls software scope across multiple major capital projects, including at least one taken from functional specification through commissioning, startup, and initial operations.

• Track record of architecture-level technical leadership: defining control system architecture, platform strategy, or software standards and practices that were adopted across an organization or program, not just a single project.

• Recognized technical authority in at least one deep area of the discipline (for example: batch architecture, SCADA and data architecture, safety application software, alarm and HMI engineering, or OT cybersecurity), evidenced by design authority roles, published work, standards participation, or a verifiable internal reputation as the final technical reference.

• Deep, hands-on command of the full controls software domain: PLC/DCS application architecture across IEC 61131-3 languages, SCADA and HMI systems, ISA-88 batch, ISA-18.2 alarm management, historians and data modelling, enterprise integration, and software configuration management.

• Substantial safety application software experience under IEC 61511, including formal validation regimes and approval or independent-review authority over safety logic.

• Working command of OT cybersecurity architecture under IEC 62443 or NIST SP 800-82, sufficient to own the control system security strategy and defend it to assessors.

• Experience directing and developing other engineers, including senior-level engineers, and reviewing and approving their work as a formal checker or design authority.

• Experience representing an engineering discipline to external parties regulators, assessors, certification bodies, major platform vendors, or client design authorities.

Preferred Skills and Experience

.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• ISA Certified Automation Professional (CAP), platform certifications, or equivalent credentials.

• Nuclear digital I&C experience, including software qualification under NQA-1 or 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, digital I&C safety case content, or familiarity with IEC 61513 / IEC 60880 / IEEE 7-4.3.2.

• Experience defining control system architecture for first-of-a-kind or prototype plants where no established precedent existed.

• Experience leading or defending cybersecurity assessments of industrial control systems.

• Experience with virtualised or containerised control system infrastructure at an architecture and lifecycle-strategy level.

• Participation in industry standards committees or working groups (ISA, IEEE, IEC, or equivalent).

• Experience with GAMP 5 or 21 CFR Part 11 regulated software validation environments.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary

• Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company

• Comprehensive medical benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite

• Generous PPE stipend

• High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy

• Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement

• Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders

• The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary

$196,000—$240,000 USD
