jobs.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS Industries seeks an experienced Information System Security Engineer (ISSE) to serve as the primary security engineer for classified Information systems across one or more Program Security Authorization boundaries. The ISSE will take full ownership of the security engineering effort for our next generation classified processing environment – from initial system security architecture through Assessment and Authorization (A&A) and into sustained continuous monitoring once the system reaches Authority to Operate (ATO).

Responsibilities:

Security Engineering & Architecture:

• Design and document system security architecture for classified and unclassified Information Systems, ensuring alignment with RMF (NIST 800-37), ICD 503, and applicable DoD/IC overlays.

• Conduct and review security assessments, maintain system patches, risk analysis, and vulnerability scans (Nessus, ACAS, SCAP) to identify and remediate risks.

• Evaluate proposed changes to hardware, software, and firmware for security impact; approve or reject changes in accordance with the Configuration Management (CM) process.

• Oversee implementation and validation of STIG/SRG hardening requirements across Windows, Linux, and network infrastructure.

Vulnerability Management and Continuous Monitoring:

• Run and interpret vulnerability scans (ACAS, SCAP or equivalent tools), triage findings, and drive remediation with the responsible engineering teams.

• Maintain the system’s continuous monitoring strategy post- ATO, including tracking control effectiveness overtime and flagging drift.

• Support incident response for accredited systems, including root-cause security analysis and reporting.

Assessment & Authorization (A&A):

• Architect, design, implement, support, and evaluate, security-focused tools, and services.

• Develop and interpret security policies and procedures.

• Experience with cloud security platforms in a production environment, as well as development, quality-assurance and staging environments.

• Ensure compliance with DCSA, DSS, and applicable IC community security policies across all assigned programs.

Minimum Requirements:

• Minimum Bachelor’s degree plus 7 years of Information Assurance / Information System Security experience.

• Master’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience.

• Possess a DoD 8140 Cyber Workforce IAT Level 2 or IAM level 1 certification

• Strong knowledge of RMF, STIGs, system hardening, network security, secure architecture, and vulnerability management processes.

• Experience working across hardware, software, networking, and mission system integration environments.

• Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience supporting military aircraft, mission systems, CUAS, or tactical communication platforms.

• Background supporting cybersecurity test events, airworthiness, or platform accreditation activities.

• Strong knowledge in major cloud environments.

Why CHAOS?

• Health Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company

• Additional benefits: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more

• Our Perks: Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code

• Compensation Components: Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses

• Team Growth: 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

$150,000 - $190,000

jobs.title: Environmental Construction Manager
jobs.description:
What The Role Is

Reporting to the Director, Environmental, the Manager, Environmental Construction is responsible for overseeing day-to-day construction management activities for Clearway’s solar, wind, and storage projects while ensuring that environmental compliance requirements - including SPCC plans, SWPPP implementation, biological clearance protocols, permit conditions, land use, dust and erosion control, and revegetation - are properly implemented in the field throughout the construction process. This role serves as the primary link between Clearway’s construction site teams, EPC contractors, and the Environmental department, ensuring that projects are built on schedule, on budget, and in full compliance with all applicable environmental, permit, and regulatory requirements.

This is a remote role that requires the ability and willingness to travel as required, up to 70%.

What You'll Be Doing

• Manage day-to-day construction activities across assigned solar, wind, and/or storage projects to ensure adherence to project schedule, budget, and quality standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact between field construction teams and the Environmental department, ensuring environmental permit conditions and compliance plans — including SWPPP and biological clearance requirements — are understood and properly implemented on site.

• Oversee EPC contractors and subcontractors, including performance monitoring, schedule coordination, and quality control inspections.

• Lead pre-construction planning reviews, including environmental permit conditions, SWPPP requirements, and biological clearance surveys/protocols, and communicate requirements to field crews and contractors.

• Coordinate the resolution of construction-related environmental issues (e.g., stormwater management, spill response, habitat/wetland and species protection) in partnership with the Environmental team.

• Conduct regular field inspections to monitor construction progress and environmental compliance, including SWPPP and biological clearance conditions; provide corrective action recommendations as needed.

• Manage external consultants and contractors, including budget tracking, deliverables, and quality control review of reports and submissions prior to distribution.

• Track and report construction progress, budget variances, and environmental compliance status to Construction and Environmental management.

• Administer and enforce corporate construction and environmental policies, standards, and regulatory requirements as they apply to Clearway projects.

What You'll Bring

• Minimum of 5 years' experience in environmental construction and/or construction management in the wind and/or solar energy industry, including SWPPP and biological clearance oversight.

• Minimum of 2 years' experience managing environmental compliance scope or programs, including vendor/contractor coordination.

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.

• Working knowledge of construction practices for renewable energy projects (solar, wind, and/or storage) is required, along with knowledge of SWPPP implementation and biological clearance requirements.

• Working knowledge of applicable environmental regulations (e.g., Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, SPCC) as related to the construction of renewable energy projects is desirable.

• Working knowledge of hazardous and non-hazardous materials handling, storage, and disposal requirements as they relate to construction activities is required.

• Highly resourceful and strategic thinker; able to summarize complex issues, identify opportunities or next steps with limited guidance, and add value through creative input.

• Motivated team player who is action-oriented and interested in continually learning and taking on additional and more complex responsibilities.

• Proven ability to work in a team environment and perform effectively in a fast-paced, unstructured field environment without close supervision.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Able to maintain composure and diplomacy in all situations.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Excellent technical and organizational skills, including scheduling and budget management.

• Ability and willingness to travel as required, up to 70%.

• Outstanding customer service background.

• Ability to use discretion concerning confidential and sensitive company information.

No visa sponsorship or any kind of sponsorship for employment authorization is available for this role, now or in the future.

#LI-Hybrid

This is a full-time, 40 hours per week, phlebotomy position located at a client site in Hinsdale.

Must be able to work Monday through Friday 8:30am - 5pm.

The Phlebotomist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Phlebotomist provides expert phlebotomy services and must demonstrate excellent customer service and communication skills. The phlebotomist must have the ability to function as part of a highly effective team that consistently puts “Patients First”.

The Phlebotomist is responsible for venipuncture collection and specimen processing. Other responsibilities include but are not limited to order entry in multiple systems, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval and lab reception/clerical duties and functions

Responsibilities:

· Performs phlebotomy and other lab specimen collections per age related standards and in accordance with departmental policies, protocols and procedures.

· Demonstrates AIDET model and optimizes patient safety to reduce the likelihood of medical/health care errors.

· Receives and reviews physician orders; ensures that all necessary information is included for appropriate lab services. Enters accurate orders for lab tests in accordance with department policies, protocols and procedures.

· Patient communication model and provides appropriate post-phlebotomy patient care.

· Processes specimens in a timely manner to ensure stability and integrity of samples including labeling, centrifuging, aliquoting, freezing and packaging specimens for transport in accordance with established protocols and policies.

· Reviews/Records refrigerator temperature(s) and QC/QA records. Areas of concern are recorded through the Corrective Action Log and reported to maintenance for repair. Findings are reported to supervisor or manager.

· Understands the operation and maintenance of equipment pertinent to the job. Follows up with all outstanding orders on manifest log, and communicates all timed, completed or uncompleted draws/charges/results as appropriate

· Communicates and notifies Laboratory and/or Physician of problems with specimen procurement for optimal care

· Maintains a safe work environment, holds self-accountable for safe work practices; including adhering to biohazard waste procedures and ensuring proper storage and timely pickup of biohazardous waste.

· Performs lab-related clerical duties include but not limited to order entry, verification of test result receipt, patient information retrieval as well as utilization of email, medical record systems, handheld and desktop devices, ordering and maintaining supply inventory, filing and sanitizing equipment as necessary

· Uses department’s resources efficiently; participates in efforts to reduce costs and streamline work processes.

· Adheres to continuing education expectations; completes and signs-off on competency assessments

· Demonstrates the value of teamwork on a consistent basis; interacts with and assists others in a professional manner

· Applies critical thinking, sound decision making and judgment to investigate and resolve challenging situations

· Complies with all organizational policies regarding ethical business practices.

· Performs other duties as assigned

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• High School diploma or equivalent.

Certification:

• ·Phlebotomy certification through a nationally recognized organization or training from a phlebotomy school or medical institution or one or more years of phlebotomy experience in a healthcare setting or CMA certification.

Preferred:

· Experience performing phlebotomy on a broad range of patient’s types.

· Experience with processing lab specimens, transferring specimens, and handling a centrifuge.

· Familiar with medical EMR systems.

· Knowledge of medical terminology.

Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. From strategy to technology and everywhere in between, our experts use their unique skills to advance the important missions of education, nonprofit, healthcare, and state and local government clients.

Attain Partners is seeking an experienced MuleSoft Architect & Developer to join our Data Services & Analytics practice. This individual will be responsible for architecting, designing, developing, and deploying enterprise integrations using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform for our clients, with a strong emphasis on Higher Education and Salesforce ecosystems. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical professional who combines MuleSoft architecture and development expertise with extensive Salesforce integration experience. This role requires someone who can independently design and build integrations, troubleshoot complex technical challenges, and work directly within Salesforce configuration environments to support end-to-end integration delivery. Active MuleSoft certification is mandatory, and previous experience supporting Higher Education institutions is strongly preferred. Important: Candidates must possess at least one active MuleSoft certification and demonstrate strong hands-on MuleSoft development and Salesforce integration/configuration experience.

Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying integrations using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.

• Expertise with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave, API Manager, CloudHub, and MuleSoft connectors.

• Proven experience developing REST APIs, SOAP APIs, batch integrations, and real-time integrations.

• Hands-on Salesforce integration and configuration experience, including the ability to navigate Salesforce Setup, objects, fields, relationships, connected apps, permissions, and API configurations.

• Experience integrating Salesforce using MuleSoft Salesforce Connector, REST API, SOAP API, and Bulk API.

• Strong understanding of API-led connectivity, integration architecture, authentication, OAuth 2.0, and error-handling frameworks.

• Ability to independently architect, build, test, troubleshoot, and deploy MuleSoft integrations.

• Experience developing technical specifications, integration mappings, API documentation, and solution architecture diagrams.

• Strong client-facing communication and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work collaboratively with Salesforce administrators, developers, and business stakeholders.

Desired Skills

• Higher Education experience is strongly preferred, particularly working with universities, Advancement organizations, and Student Information Systems.

• Experience integrating Salesforce Education Cloud, Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud, or Salesforce Advancement solutions.

• Familiarity with Higher Education platforms such as PeopleSoft Campus Solutions, Ellucian Banner, Workday, Slate, Anthology, and other campus systems.

• Experience with MuleSoft API-led architecture and reusable integration frameworks.

• Knowledge of data migration, source-to-target mapping, data quality, and enterprise data architecture.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated testing, and deployment automation.

• Experience with event-driven architecture, message queues, and asynchronous processing.

• Prior consulting or professional services experience supporting multiple enterprise clients.

• Ability to lead technical discovery sessions, architectural design discussions, and integration troubleshooting activities.

Years of Experience

• 7+ years of overall enterprise application integration, software development, or solution architecture experience.

• 4+ years of hands-on MuleSoft development and integration implementation experience.

• 3+ years of Salesforce integration experience, including direct exposure to Salesforce administration and configuration.

Certifications

Active MuleSoft certification, such as Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer or Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Integration Architect.

Additional Requirements

• Demonstrated ability to build trusted advisor relationships with clients

• Experience supporting sales and business development

• Position requires flexibility to travel periodically based on business and client needs

Attain Partners values your mental, emotional, and physical health and wellbeing. Our comprehensive benefits package starts on your first day of employment and includes benefits such as:

• Competitive health, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA accounts, life and disability insurance, fertility and family planning benefits, and employee assistance and discount programs

• 11 paid federal holidays and flexible unlimited time off (UTO)

• Generous 401(k) matching with immediate vesting

jobs.title: Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!

Vaxcyte is a clinical-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

WHAT we do is every bit as important as HOW we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

*RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.

*AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.

*LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.

*MODEL EXCELLENCE:  The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Summary:

Vaxcyte is seeking a Systems Engineer to design, deploy, and maintain the systems and infrastructure that support the organization. Working within the Systems Engineering team, the Systems Engineer administers core cloud, SaaS, and network technologies, contributes to technical projects, and provides escalated support — deepening their expertise with guidance from senior engineers. This role is a strong fit for a hands-on engineer who takes ownership of their work and wants to develop and grow their skills across a modern, cloud-first environment.

Essential Functions:

• Install, configure, and maintain cloud servers, workstations, lab infrastructure and networks.

• Administer and support core SaaS and infrastructure technologies, including Okta, M365, Microsoft Intune, Proofpoint, Zoom, Meraki, and virtualization technologies including vSphere, and Proxmox.

• Implement, manage, and troubleshoot security measures and cybersecurity initiatives that protect company data and systems.

• Contribute to IT projects and initiatives, executing assigned workstreams and collaborating with senior engineers on more complex efforts.

• Monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot office infrastructure, SaaS applications, and network services (e.g., DNS, DHCP, NTP).

• Contribute to the automation of manual and recurring tasks to improve efficiency.

• Perform new system deployments, migrations, and application lifecycle activities.

• Provide Tier 2 / Tier 3 support and serve as a technical resource for the IT Operations team, escalating complex issues to senior engineers as needed.

• Participate in cross-functional technical projects with other teams — for example, supporting enterprise application implementations or internal business tools.

• Create and maintain clear documentation of IT procedures, configurations, and policies.

• Participate in pre-scheduled, after-hours support for special projects or events.

• Assist in administering the organization’s enterprise AI platforms (e.g., Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT / Claude Enterprise) — including user provisioning, access, and configuration.

• Help configure and maintain integrations between AI platforms and internal systems, such as SSO / identity (Okta) and data connectors.

• Follow and help implement AI security and governance practices, including data-handling, access control, and acceptable-use requirements.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience with a minimum of 5+ years of relevant IT / systems engineering experience. Biotech experience is a plus. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered.

• Working knowledge of foundational IT applications such as Okta, M365, Zoom, and Microsoft Intune / MEM.

• Experience administering cloud servers, workstations, and networks, including familiarity with Layer 2 / Layer 3 networking and services such as DNS, DHCP, and NTP.

• Experience with server administration, network administration, and security administration.

• Some experience with scripting (ex. Power Shell, python) and/or automating manual workstreams.

• Exposure to administering or supporting enterprise AI tools is a plus.

• A systematic problem-solving approach, strong communication skills, and a sense of ownership and drive.

• Ability to create clear documentation, adapt and learn new skills, and stay current with developments in the field.

• Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

Reports to: Senior Director, IT Operations & Infrastructure

Location: San Carlos, CA

Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy): Onsite (minimum of 4 days per week onsite)

Compensation: The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component.

Salary Range: $148,000 – $172,500

Equal Opportunity

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.title: Instrumentation & Electrical Technician
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The Instrumentation & Electrical Technician will support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of a reciprocating engine-based power generation facility consisting of multiple engine-generator units and associated balance-of-plant systems.

This position will be responsible for troubleshooting, maintaining, calibrating, repairing, and improving electrical, instrumentation, controls, and automation systems associated with engine-generator packages, plant auxiliaries, emissions control systems, switchgear, motor controls, PLCs, SCADA/HMI systems, and plant protective devices.

The I&E Technician will work closely with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, OEM representatives, and contractors to support commissioning, startup, routine maintenance, forced outage response, and long-term reliability of the facility.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Perform troubleshooting, maintenance, testing, calibration, and repair of plant instrumentation, electrical systems, and control systems associated with engine-generator units and balance-of-plant equipment.
• Maintain and troubleshoot instrumentation including pressure, temperature, level, flow, vibration, speed, gas detection, emissions monitoring, and other process measurement devices.
• Support maintenance and troubleshooting of engine control systems, generator control systems, PLCs, remote I/O, HMIs, SCADA systems, communication networks, and associated control panels.
• Troubleshoot and repair electrical circuits, control wiring, motor controls, solenoids, actuators, relays, switches, transmitters, sensors, and field devices.
• Support electrical maintenance on low, medium, & high voltage equipment, which may include switchgear, motor control centers, breakers, transformers, protective relays, generators, exciters, battery systems, UPS systems, and DC control systems.
• Perform inspection, testing, calibration, and functional checks on control valves, actuators, dampers, sensors, transmitters, and safety interlock devices.
• Participate in root cause analysis, corrective action development, reliability improvements, and preventive/predictive maintenance planning.
• Perform work in accordance with company safety policies, electrical safety requirements, lockout/tagout procedures, environmental requirements, and plant operating procedures.
• Coordinate with Operations, Maintenance, contractors, OEM technicians, and engineering support personnel as required.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area and properly document maintenance activities in the CMMS.

Work Environment:

• Ability to work around operating engines, rotating equipment, energized electrical equipment, elevated noise levels, heat, cold, and other industrial plant conditions while following all required safety procedures.
• Ability to work in industrial environments including engine halls, electrical rooms, control rooms, outdoor equipment areas, and construction or commissioning areas.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.
• Technical school, trade school, military training, apprenticeship, or equivalent experience in instrumentation, electrical, controls, automation, or power generation preferred.
• 4 years of progressive experience as as an I&E technician, electrical technician, controls technician, or similar role in power generation, industrial manufacturing, data center power systems, utilities, oil and gas, chemical processing, or other heavy industrial environments.
• Experience with electrical systems up to 34,500 Volts
• Experience with engine-generator systems, reciprocating engines, turbines, power generation equipment, or large industrial electrical systems preferred.
• Experience with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, motor controls, instrumentation loops, and industrial control systems required.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Strong understanding of electrical safety, lockout/tagout, energized work controls, arc flash hazards, and safe troubleshooting practices.
• Demonstrated experience and knowledge at reading process flow diagrams and control and instrumentation diagrams and interpreting manufacturer's manuals and drawings
• Ability to troubleshoot electrical, instrumentation, and control system problems using drawings, meters, loop calibrators, diagnostic software, OEM tools, and plant operating data.
• Ability to read and interpret P&IDs, single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, loop sheets, wiring diagrams, ladder logic, control narratives, and OEM technical manuals.
• Working knowledge of transmitters, RTDs, thermocouples, pressure switches, flow meters, level devices, vibration sensors, gas detection, actuators, control valves, relays, solenoids, and motor controls.
• Working knowledge of PLCs, distributed I/O, industrial communication networks, HMIs, SCADA systems, and control system troubleshooting.
• Understanding of generators, switchgear, synchronization, load sharing, protective relays, excitation systems, transformers, MCCs, UPS systems, batteries, and DC control systems preferred.
• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining strong communication with Operations and Maintenance leadership.
• Ability to support a high-availability facility where equipment reliability, response time, and documentation accuracy are critical.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to perform precision work on electrical, instrumentation, and control systems.
• Ability to prioritize work, respond to changing plant conditions, and support troubleshooting during forced outages or abnormal events.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Must hold a valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record to maintain minimum company required insurance coverage.
• OSHA, NFPA 70E, electrical safety, arc flash, lockout/tagout, first aid/CPR, and site-specific safety training preferred or required after hire.

Physical Requirements:

• The job can be physically demanding involving movement of heavy equipment and carrying materials up and down stairs.
• Candidates should be able to lift a 50-lb load.
• Ability to climb stairs, ladders, and access platforms.
• Ability to wear required PPE including hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves, safety shoes, arc-rated clothing, and respiratory protection where required.

Benefits: Our employees are covered by comprehensive benefits packages including paid time off policies; health, dental, vision, and life insurance; retirement plans, savings accounts; tuition reimbursement; paid volunteering and more.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer, Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer, Identity & Access Management to own the identity layer that protects our Controlled Unclassified Information and export-controlled technical data. This role’s primary goal is to make our IdP, IAM, PAM, PIM, and Secrets Management platforms work as one coherent system that meets CMMC Level 2, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 252.204-7012, and ITAR, and that people can actually use.

You'll work alongside security operations, IT, HR, and compliance as the person who turns policy into working access controls, from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role with real influence over where our identity architecture goes next.

Responsibilities:

• Design, build, and maintain identity architecture and role-based access control (RBAC) across cloud and on-premises directory services.

• Own and automate the IAM portion of the joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) process across identity, directory, cloud, and secrets platforms, so that access is provisioned at hire, adjusted when roles change, and revoked promptly at departure. You coordinate with human resources and IT, who own the employee record and device steps.

• Design and tune authentication policies, conditional access, phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication (MFA), and device compliance requirements.

• Build identity-focused detections and threat hunts in the company's SIEM, EDR, and SOAR tools, and support the security operations center (SOC) during identity-related investigations.

• Operate and mature a tiered administrative model, including privileged access workstations (PAWs) and dedicated administrator accounts.

• Administer privileged identity management for just-in-time role activation and privileged access reviews.

• Administer the enterprise password and secrets management platform, including role-based enforcement policies, vault structure, SSO integration, and vaulting of privileged and shared credentials.

• Manage cloud infrastructure IAM, including role assignments, service identities, and workload identity federation.

• Integrate software as a service (SaaS) and internal applications with single sign-on (SSO) through SAML and OpenID Connect, and with SCIM for automated provisioning.

• Maintain Active Directory security, including account lifecycle hygiene, service accounts and group Managed Service Accounts (gMSAs), and ongoing attack path analysis.

• Run periodic access reviews and produce assessment evidence for the NIST SP 800-171 Access Control (AC) and Identification and Authentication (IA) families.

• Write and maintain IAM policies, standards, and procedures.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, cybersecurity, information security, Information Technology, Information Assurance, or a related field with 5+ years of progressively responsible cybersecurity engineering experience, or a Masters degree with 3+ years of relevant experience.

• At least two years of experience focused on IAM.

• Hands-on experience administering IdP in a production environment.

• Hands-on experience administering Entra ID or Active Directory.

• Experience running the provisioning, access change, and deprovisioning steps of a JML process.

• Experience designing authentication policies and deploying phishing-resistant MFA across an organization.

• Working knowledge of Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.

• Scripting experience in PowerShell, Python, or a comparable language, including work with identity provider APIs.

jobs.description:
Title: Finance and Business Operations Manager                                               Reporting to:  COO

ABOUT ANELLO

ANELLO is innovative hardware company serving both defense and commercial customers with advanced navigation technology based on silicon photonics technology based by over 50 patents. These highly technical products are manufactured through a combination of internal activities, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. The company also performs work under multiple government contracts. ANELLO is at series B stage, has strong growing revenue and operating as a profitable company.

ANELLO is seeking a experienced and hands-on Finance & Business Operations Manager to lead the company's accounting and finance function and serve as a strategic partner to the leadership team.

This is an individual contributor role with broad responsibility across accounting, financial operations, financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with external accounting firm to own the integrity and timeliness of the company's financial information. Through the creation of a wide variety of financial models, the successful candidate will help leadership understand the financial implications of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability, cash utilization, and operational efficiency.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Operations and External Vendor Oversight

• Act as the primary corporate point-of-contact to manage an external CPA firm, driving accountability and ensuring highly accurate, timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end close process.

• Supervise and audit the external firm's execution of core transaction processing, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable cycles, payroll administration, bank reconciliations, and accruals.

• Partner with external tax advisors to coordinate all federal, state, and local compliance requirements, including sales/use tax tracking, annual corporate filings, R&D tax credits, and specialized corporate valuations (e.g., 409A).

• Continually refine internal data pipelines, financial procedures, and documentation to ensure seamless transfer of financial records between internal teams and the external accounting provider.

Financial Modeling, Forecasting & Strategic Advisory

• Revenue & Sales Forecasting: Develop dynamic, scenario-based forecasting models across the broader business to project sales pipelines, diverse revenue streams, product pricing sensitivities, and long-term growth velocity.

• Build, maintain, and continually optimize financial models analyzing manufacturing costs, bill of materials (BOM), supply chain logistics, inventory turnover, and cost of goods sold (COGS) to maximize margins.

• Translate intricate modeling data, variance analyses, and financial anomalies into executive summaries, presentations, and KPIs that directly assist leadership's decision-making.

• Run detailed sensitivity analyses and capital allocation models to forecast corporate cash runway, evaluate major operational expenditures (CapEx), and support strategic runway planning.

Government Contracting & Compliance

• Monitor and track contract costs, expenditures, and invoicing requirements associated with SBIR and other government contracts.

• Work closely with technical teams to monitor performance against government budgets and support external compliance reviews.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's or advanced degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field.

• 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, or experience in an Assistant Controller, Finance Manager, or similar FinOps role.

• Demonstrated experience owning monthly close and financial reporting.

• Experience in financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.

• Advanced spreadsheet skills and ability to build financial models from underlying business assumptions.

• Ability to effectively engage with external accounting firms, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.

• Solid understanding of cash flow, working capital, budgeting, and financial planning.

• Ability to analyze complex business issues and communicate financial implications

• Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.

• Ability to operate independently and effectively in a small, fast-moving organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in a technology, hardware, engineering, manufacturing, or startup environment.

• Experience with contract manufacturers, suppliers, inventory, and product costing.

• Experience developing pricing, profitability, cost-benefit, and capital allocation analyses.

• Experience supporting fundraising, company valuation, due diligence, M&A, or other strategic transactions.

• CPA, MBA, CFA, or other relevant professional qualifications.

• Experience scaling finance processes in a growing company.

Additional:

• Due to US Gov contracts in place, successful candidates will be US Citizens or US Perm Residents.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Assets & Issuance
jobs.description:
Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com http://paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.


ABOUT THE TEAM

Engineering at Paxos builds and operates the systems that move real money: stablecoin issuance, custody, trading, settlement and the ledgers that underpin them. Our engineers work on distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure where reliability, security and correctness are non-negotiable, and they work in close partnership with Product, Security and Compliance.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Director of Engineering, you will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for Assets & Issuance, shaping the architecture, growing the team and setting the direction as we scale. As our Director of Engineering, you will lead teams of engineers, directly and through engineering managers, responsible for Assets & Issuance. This is a leadership role for someone who has built money-moving infrastructure in the past and can shape how systems get designed and built. You won't be writing production code day to day, but you will go deep on architecture, reliability and hard technical decisions alongside your teams. You'll tackle hard problems in issuing and moving assets across blockchains, customers and jurisdictions, working with strong engineers and limited existing structure. You'll be expected to set technical direction, build the team and deliver.

Success looks like a team that ships quickly without compromising correctness, systems that are resilient and well understood, a strong bench of engineering managers and senior ICs, and a trusted partnership with Security, Compliance and Product that accelerates delivery rather than slowing it down.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the technical strategy, roadmap and delivery for Assets & Issuance, balancing speed to market with the reliability and controls our regulated, institutional customers expect.

 - Stay close to the code and the architecture: review designs, pressure-test tradeoffs, and lead by example in hard technical decisions.

 - Build and grow the team as needed: hire senior engineers and managers, develop emerging leaders, and shape an engineering culture centered on ownership, craft and bias to action.

 - Lead through incidents: set the standard for on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through, and drive down operational risk over time.

 - Partner with Product, Security, Compliance and other control functions to design systems that are secure and auditable by construction, with controls built into the software rather than layered on afterward.

 - Make progress with incomplete information. Break ambiguous problems into shippable pieces, set direction, and adjust as you learn.

 - Drive the architecture of systems such as wallets and key management, ledgers, settlement and blockchain integrations, depending on team charter.

 - Build an engineering organization that uses AI and modern tools to fundamentally improve how software is built, tested and operated, with just enough process to scale without slowing down.

 - Represent engineering to executive leadership, translating technical complexity into clear priorities, tradeoffs and commitments.

 - Immerse yourself in blockchain technology, digital assets, our regulation-first approach, and more!


ABOUT YOU

 - 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 8+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers. We care more about the career pattern than the exact numbers.

 - You've been an early engineer or engineering leader at a fast-growing company, built systems from scratch and scaled both the technology and the engineering organization.

 - A track record of building teams, not just inheriting them, with experience leading a sizable engineering organization, including managers, and growing it as the business scaled.

 - Built and operated complex distributed systems where correctness, reliability and security are critical. Experience with money-moving infrastructure is strongly preferred, but exceptional builders from other high-stakes systems are equally compelling..

 - Meaningful depth in several areas: distributed systems, blockchain infrastructure, MPC or key management, high-availability systems, security-sensitive financial software.

 - Strong technical credibility with senior engineers. You can go deep on architecture, reliability and hard technical decisions, and you earn the respect of the engineers you lead.

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and moving quickly without highly defined requirements.

 - Experience working effectively with Product, Security and Compliance, applying the right amount of process to keep teams aligned and controls intact without slowing down delivery.

 - A builder's instinct. When faced with a messy technical or organizational problem, your first move is to dig in and find a way through it.

 - Nice to have: experience at both startup and scaled-company environments, prior experience in a regulated environment (e.g., a trust company, broker-dealer or exchange), and direct experience with blockchain protocols or smart contracts.

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

 - Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers http://paxos.com/careers

 - We only use @paxos.com http://paxos.com email addresses

 - We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

 - For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

jobs.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

This position is open for the Southwest Region, TX, CO, AZ, NM, WY, UT*Must live in one of these States

At Heartflow, our Field Reimbursement Managers are strategic partners to our commercial team, bringing reimbursement expertise as a solution to access barriers, not a gatekeeper. If you are energized by solving novel access challenges in real time, comfortable influencing without authority, and frustrated by slow, process-heavy environments, this role was built for you.

This is a fast-paced, field-embedded commercial role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, earns trust with sales teams quickly, and pivots between complex customer problems daily. Every coverage barrier you remove means a patient gets a fast, noninvasive answer about their coronary artery disease instead of a delay or an unnecessary invasive procedure. You bring deep reimbursement expertise and deploy it with judgment: anticipating access barriers before they stall an account and building plans with your sales partners.

This is a high-impact, highly visible position. Your expertise translates directly into patient access and commercial momentum. Join Heartflow and make a difference.

Who Thrives Here

You will thrive here if you:

• Think in terms of territory strategy, not just the next call — prioritizing cross functional partnerships and troubleshooting as a path for patient access

• Spot patterns across accounts, such as a denial trend or a prior authorization bottleneck, and act before they become escalations

• See your sales partners' success and patient access as the same goal, and earn their trust by solving problems with them

• Own issues from start to finish, from pre-service authorization through appeal outcome, and close the loop every time

• Present confidently to hospital CFOs, health system administrators, and clinical leadership alike

• See ambiguity as interesting, not threatening

• Can translate a complex payer policy into plain language on a live customer call without preparation time

• Have operated successfully alongside a quota-carrying field sales team — not as a compliance resource, but as a trusted commercial partner

• Understand supporting a team is a valued partnership

What You Will Own

Strategic Field Partnership

• Operate as the embedded reimbursement expert within the commercial field team — a trusted partner who enables sales success, not an oversight function

• Attend strategic customer calls to address complex coding, billing, and access concerns, positioning Heartflow as a consultative resource

• Proactively partner with the Field Sales Team to identify facilities needing reimbursement support and develop strategies to address barriers

• Educate the commercial team on coding updates, billing trends, and payer developments, ensuring the entire field organization is aligned and informed

Customer Access & Billing Optimization

• Partner with field team members and customers to serve as the primary reimbursement support for providers and hospital billing and administrative leadership

• Conduct onsite visits and remote consultations to educate customers on appropriate billing scenarios, documentation requirements, and payment components

• Support customers across the full reimbursement cycle: from pre-service authorization through post-service claims and appeals

• Partner with customers to optimize prior authorization workflows and claims appeals processes, maximizing reimbursement success and reducing administrative burden

• Proactively partner with health system revenue cycle and finance teams to review and optimize chargemaster setup, ensuring the services included on the cCTA pathway are accurately reflected for appropriate charge capture and reimbursement

• Conduct claim reviews to identify patterns, provide recommendations to resolve issues, and ensure appropriate materials aligned for reimbursement outcomes

• Address and support customers in resolving patient coverage, access, and reimbursement questions in coordination with patient services and internal stakeholders

Market Intelligence & Education

• Proactively identify gaps in customer-facing and internal educational resources, communicating those needs internally to support timely content development

• Monitor and communicate payer policy changes, CMS coverage determinations, and market access trends to keep Heartflow's reimbursement guidance current and competitive

• Identify, anticipate, and surface systemic reimbursement opportunities and barriers — bringing market intelligence back to the organization to inform strategy and response

• Maintain deep fluency in payer medical policies, prior authorization trends, and claims adjudication patterns across the Northeast, including NGS (Jurisdiction K), major regional commercial plans, and radiology benefit managers

Skills Needed

Commercial Partnership Orientation (Priority)

• Strategic Thinking: Ability to see the territory, prioritize where reimbursement support will have the greatest impact, and plan rather than react.

• Field Collaboration: Demonstrated success working alongside a quota-carrying field sales team as a trusted partner who removes access barriers and improves patient access.

• Executive Presence & Polish: Credibility to represent Heartflow at the C-suite and health system leadership level. Ability to present confidently, handle objections on the spot, and command a room with both clinical and administrative audiences.

• Operational Agility: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent, time-sensitive priorities in a high-velocity environment. Comfort with daily reprioritization and ambiguity is essential.

Technical Reimbursement Expertise

jobs.title: Lead Nuclear Materials Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

Lead Nuclear Materials Engineer

Radiant is seeking a highly motivated Lead Nuclear Materials Engineer to lead Radiant’s nuclear materials team in the development, testing, and qualification of materials and related manufacturing processes used in the Kaleidos 1MWe nuclear microreactor. The ideal candidate is excited to grow an in-house nuclear materials team, is proficient in materials selection, testing, and analysis, takes great ownership of their work end-to-end, and thrives in a highly cross-functional, fast-paced environment. Your team’s ownership spans fuel, moderators, shielding, neutron poisons, and irradiation testing. You will be a key contributor to building the world's first mass-produced, rapidly-deployable nuclear reactor. 

Responsibilities & Duties

 - Set the technical direction for the nuclear materials team, including the definition of project scopes, the guidance of day-to-day engineering and support activities, and the development of a nuclear materials roadmap to support future reactor designs and builds

 - Deliver materials solutions for fuel, moderator, shielding, and neutron poison designs for Kaleidos

 - Accountable for nuclear materials engineering team’s technical output

 - Lead and mentor team members technically and professionally

 - Communicate project status, issues, and schedules to teammates and executives

 - Present to external stakeholders and regulatory bodies (DOE, NRC)

 - Review test plans, purchase orders, and analysis

 - Provide surge materials engineering support as-needed

 - Manage irradiation testing from design of experiment through irradiation to post irradiation examination (PIE)

Required Qualifications & Skills

 - Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Materials Science and Engineering, or in Mechanical, Aeronautical, Nuclear, or Chemical Engineering with a materials science and engineering focus.

 - 5+ years of experience working in the development, testing, and/or analysis of nuclear materials for demanding load cases and environments

 - Hands-on experimental or testing experience in laboratory or production environments

Desired Qualifications & Skills

 - Master’s or PhD degree from an accredited institution in Materials Science and Engineering, or in Mechanical, Aeronautical, Nuclear, or Chemical Engineering with a materials science and engineering focus.

 - 2+ years of engineering leadership and management experience at a company building and/or testing hardware for nuclear, aerospace, or other extreme environments

 - Expert-level competency in at least one area of nuclear materials such as fuel, neutron poisons, shielding, or moderators

 - Experience with development and qualification of material systems for use in high temperature and irradiation environments.

 - Knowledge of standard test methods for materials and experience with development of design allowables.

 - Self-motivated with strong organizational, written, and oral communication skills.

 - Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with design and operations teams to deliver high-value results.

 - Experience with using text-based software development tools (Python or similar).

Additional Requirements:

 - Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as necessary to accomplish our mission.

 - Must work 100% onsite at El Segundo HQ.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Stock: Substantial incentive stock plan for all full-time employees.

 - Medical: 100% up to base silver level plan for employee + 50% dependents, offers up to Platinum plans.

 - One Medical: Sponsored memberships for employees and their dependents.

 - Vision: 100% top tier plan coverage + 50% for dependents.

 - Dental: 100% top tier plan coverage, orthodontia extra, 50% for dependents.

 - Voluntary life, accident, hospital, critical illness, commuter and FSA/HSA are offered as employee contributed benefits.

 - 8-weeks of paid parental leave for all parents. Additional paid pregnancy leave for CA employees.

 - Daily catered lunch. Free snacks and drinks.

 - Flexible PTO policy. Remote workday allocation.

 - Company and team-bonding events, happy hours and in-person camaraderie.

 - Beautiful El Segundo headquarters close to the Pacific Ocean.



Total Compensation and Benefits
Radiant compensates people for impact and invests in those who continue to raise the bar. Radiant’s new hire compensation package includes base salary, substantial equity grants, and comprehensive health benefits. Total compensation and level are determined through a rigorous evaluation of interview performance, experience, education, and qualifications, and are designed to support continued growth as scope, responsibility, and impact expand at Radiant.

This role is based in our San Francisco headquarters with an expectation of 3 days per week in the office.

• Monitor changes in applicable regulations and industry practices and incorporate updates into contracting processes and templates

• Drive continuous improvement of clinical contracting processes, templates, and negotiation playbooks to enhance efficiency, consistency, and scalability across Vir's global clinical portfolio

• JD and 10+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry, with significant experience negotiating clinical trial agreements and related development contracts

• Deep expertise independently drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing a high volume of clinical trial and vendor agreements

• Demonstrated experience supporting global clinical development programs across multiple countries and regions

• Ability to balance legal risk with business and operational priorities while providing practical, solution-oriented guidance

• Experience collaborating with Clinical Operations, Development, Legal, Procurement, and Finance stakeholders in a fast-paced environment

jobs.description:
Attain Partners is an innovative consulting firm dedicated to disrupting the status quo to change the world and improve the lives of those we touch. Attain Partners is seeking an experienced Technical Delivery Manager – Data Integration & Migration Solutions to lead the technical delivery of enterprise data integration and migration initiatives for our clients, with a strong emphasis on Higher Education, Nonprofit, and Salesforce ecosystems. This individual will be responsible for managing end-to-end technical delivery, including solution architecture, technical discovery, data mapping, development oversight, testing, deployment, and production readiness. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in enterprise integration and data migration technologies with proven experience managing technical teams, client relationships, project deliverables, and delivery quality. The Technical Delivery Manager will serve as the primary technical delivery lead, working closely with solution architects, developers, data migration specialists, project managers, and client stakeholders. This role requires the ability to understand complex technical solutions, make architectural decisions, remove delivery obstacles, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, requiring the ability to guide development teams, review technical designs, troubleshoot complex integration and migration challenges, and directly contribute to solution delivery when needed. Critical Hiring Requirement: This is not a traditional project manager position. Candidates must have a strong technical background in enterprise integrations and data migrations, with the ability to lead technical architecture discussions, challenge solution designs, troubleshoot complex delivery issues, and hold engineering teams accountable for successful implementation.

Required Skills

• Strong experience leading technical delivery of enterprise data integration and data migration projects.

• Proven ability to manage technical teams consisting of integration architects, developers, data engineers, migration specialists, and QA resources.

• Experience with enterprise integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Informatica, or similar iPaaS technologies.

• Strong understanding of API-led connectivity, REST/SOAP APIs, batch processing, event-driven integrations, and enterprise integration architecture.

• Experience leading data migrations into Salesforce, including source system analysis, data mapping, transformation, cleansing coordination, loading, reconciliation, and validation.

• Strong understanding of Salesforce data architecture, standard and custom objects, relationships, APIs, and integration patterns. Experience reviewing technical architecture, integration designs, source-to-target mappings, migration strategies, and development deliverables.

• Ability to lead technical discovery workshops, gather requirements, identify dependencies, and translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Experience managing technical delivery schedules, resource assignments, milestones, dependencies, risks, and issue resolution.

• Strong understanding of system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), migration mock loads, cutover planning, and production deployment.

• Ability to troubleshoot complex data integration and migration issues while providing technical direction to delivery teams.

• Experience managing client expectations, communicating technical status, and escalating delivery risks.

• Ability to support project financial management, including resource utilization, delivery budgets, estimated hours, and project profitability.

• Strong client-facing communication, stakeholder management, and technical leadership skills.

• Ability to manage multiple concurrent client engagements and geographically distributed delivery teams.

Desired Skills

• Higher Education consulting experience, particularly with Advancement, Student Information Systems, CRM modernization, and enterprise data initiatives.

• Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Advancement-focused CRM implementations.

• Familiarity with Higher Education applications such as PeopleSoft Campus Solutions, Ellucian Banner, Workday, Slate, Anthology, Advance, and other institutional systems.

• Hands-on technical experience with MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), or Azure Data Factory.

• Experience delivering large-scale Salesforce CRM migrations involving complex data models, historical data, and multiple source systems.

• Experience with relational databases, SQL, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and cloud data platforms.

• Familiarity with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Databricks, and other enterprise data platforms.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence, all diversity dimensions are considered in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

H&M is a fashion brand that offers the latest styles and inspiration, from fashion pieces and unique designer collaborations to affordable wardrobe essentials. Our business idea is fashion & quality at the best price in a sustainable way. Learn more about H&M here.

H&M Fashion USA, Inc. – Maki Assessment Tool:

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Rather, it is a tool that uses an AI-created avatar to present to you a set of multiple-choice questions. These questions are prepared by the H&M hiring team to assess candidates’ ability to perform the duties of the position for which they are applying. The assessment calculates your total score based on predefined point values provided by our H&M team. The hiring team will review your whole application, including your assessment score, to decide whether to advance each candidate to the next stage. Doing the assessment is optional. If you choose to complete the assessment, your score will be one factor that the hiring team considers.

If you have any difficulties or concerns with the online assessment method, you can request an alternative method of assessment by contacting recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager of CX Enablement
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com http://Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank. 

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.



About You

You've owned CX quality at a contact center scale of 200+ agents (in-house or BPO), built a QA framework from rubric through calibration, and shipped training programs that measurably moved agent performance. You're equally comfortable in a Looker dashboard and a Zendesk Guide CMS. You've worked alongside or implemented an AI deflection product (Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought) and can speak credibly about what makes AI-mediated support actually work.

Role Summary

As Senior Manager of CX Enablement, you will own the quality, training, and knowledge management systems that power Imprint's customer experience. This is a strategic leadership role combining QA framework design, AI-powered deflection enablement, knowledge base ownership, and agent training excellence.

You will drive the architecture that connects quality inputs to AI systems (Sierra), knowledge management, and training outputs—ensuring content quality compounds rather than degrades as Imprint scales. You'll partner closely with engineering, ops, product, and vendor teams to transform customer support from reactive to proactive through automation, rigorous quality frameworks, and data-driven training strategies.

This role reports directly to the Director of Customer Operations and manages a small team of 2–3 associates focused on execution and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

 - Completed a comprehensive knowledge base audit with defined ownership model between CS, engineering, and ops, including refresh SLAs in Zendesk

 - Designed and shipped a new QA framework that moves from manual contact center approaches to fully automated quality scoring with clear expectations

 - Established Sierra AI deflection enablement system with daily feedback loops, gap detection, and content optimization for AI ingestion and delivery

 - Built a scalable partner launch QA and training strategy and applied it to an active launch with measurable quality improvements over prior launches

 - Created a structured training rehaul plan in collaboration with our outsourcing partner, focusing on strategic oversight and outcome monitoring

 - Established trusted partnerships with key cross-functional stakeholders including vendor ops, AI product team, partner success, compliance, and legal

Responsibilities

 - Own the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of quality management frameworks that drive consistent agent performance across omnichannel support

 - Lead knowledge base strategy and operations in Zendesk, including content audits, ownership models, refresh cadence, and optimization for both human agents and AI consumption

 - Drive Sierra AI deflection strategy by analyzing feedback data, identifying content gaps, optimizing knowledge for LLM ingestion, and improving customer-facing AI delivery

 - Partner with Imprints BPO training teams to design and monitor training programs that address systemic quality issues, leverage AI automation, and scale effectively with new partner launches

 - Build and maintain the technical architecture that connects quality inputs (QA automation, CSAT, sentiment analysis) to training outputs and knowledge base improvements

 - Use data from QM platforms, Sierra AI, and CSAT to diagnose root causes of quality issues—differentiating agent behavior from systemic or content gaps

 - Lead partner launch readiness by designing QA strategies, training plans, and content requirements that prevent launch failures and training debt

 - Establish cross-functional collaboration rhythms with vendor ops, engineering, product, fraud ops, partner success, compliance, and legal teams

 - Manage and develop a team of 2–3 associates responsible for execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement of quality and training operations

Qualifications

Required

 - 7+ years in customer experience, with 4+ years in quality management, training, enablement, or knowledge management roles

 - Experience owning CX quality, training, and enablement at scale (100+ agents, in-house or outsourced), ideally omnichannel

 - Hands-on experience implementing AI-powered deflection projects using tools like Sierra, Ada, Decagon, Forethought, or comparable LLM-based platforms

 - Strong technical fluency with CX platforms such as Salesforce, Zendesk Guide and Support, or comparable knowledge base and support systems (not homegrown tools)

 - Experience with QM platforms such as Maestro QA, Klaus, Playbox, Stella Connect, Tether AI, or similar quality automation tools

 - Exceptional writing skills with the ability to produce compliance-ready content that requires minimal iteration with legal or regulatory teams

 - Data fluency: able to analyze QA trends, CSAT drivers, sentiment data, and agent performance metrics to identify systemic issues vs. behavior gaps

 - Bias toward action and shipping—comfortable building frameworks that get adopted, not just designed

 - Genuine curiosity about how AI is transforming customer service, with a demonstrated commitment to staying at the forefront of CX automation

Nice to Have

 - Experience in fintech, payments, regulated environments, or industries with complex compliance requirements

 - Familiarity with training LMS tools and designing scalable learning programs

 - Background in customer education, support operations, or contact center quality leadership

 - Experience working with outsourced BPO partners and driving adoption of new quality or training standards

 - Track record of redesigning legacy QA or training systems into modern, automated frameworks




PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Leading configured work computers of your choice

 - Flexible paid time off

 - Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage

 - Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the  option to enroll in an FSA

 - 20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents

 - Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

jobs.description:

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners, specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We’re backed by top investors, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity—in backgrounds and experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory.
