We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building, seeking teammates who are not only strong in their own aptitudes, but who also care deeply about supporting each other’s growth.

As an early-stage startup employee, you’ll have the opportunity to help build the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by consolidating up to 50% of their work and improving work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you’ll find a home at Fieldguide.



 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Staff Product Designer to join the Fieldguide team. You’ll own complex, ambiguous problem spaces end-to-end, partner deeply with Product and Engineering, and help shape the design direction of a core Fieldguide product.

We move incredibly fast at Fieldguide, and we’re looking for designers who can operate at that cadence. This team ships frequently, iterates in tight loops, and makes progress amid ambiguity. You should be comfortable balancing speed with craft, incorporating AI into your daily design practice, and designing AI-assisted workflows directly into the product. This is a high-impact role for someone excited to own unclear problems, drive momentum, and help modernize audit workflows that customers depend on every day.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Lead end-to-end design for complex, ambiguous audit workflows, from problem definition through shipped solutions

 - Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape strategy, influence roadmaps, and deliver high-quality, scalable implementations

 - Drive design execution with minimal direction, operating effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment

 - Translate customer needs, research insights, and business goals into clear user journeys, interaction models, and polished UI

 - Balance speed and iteration with usability, consistency, and long-term product quality

 - Advocate for users while accounting for technical, regulatory, and business constraints

 - Own a significant product area or customer journey, anticipating downstream impacts across workflows and personas

 - Set a high bar for craft and influence by contributing to the design system, mentoring peers, and serving as a trusted design voice.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE:

 - 10+ year of experience in a Product Design role, ideally focused on complex, B2B SaaS products

 - You operate as a strategic IC — you don't just solve problems, you decide which problems matter

 - You think several steps ahead, anticipating how decisions in one area ripple across others

 - You're comfortable influencing senior PM and Engineering leaders, not just your immediate collaborators

 - Experience shaping how AI-assisted workflows get designed at a systemic level, not just within a single flow

 - You've coached or mentored other designers and can articulate why, not just what

 - You set a bar for craft and consistency that others look to as the standard

 - You can hold a long-term point of view while still shipping incrementally
   
   


BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience designing for audit, accounting, compliance, or other regulated domains

 - Track record of shaping design strategy across multiple teams, not just a single product area

 - Experience building or scaling design systems, standards, or team-wide processes

 - Background in workflow-heavy, document-centric, or B2B SaaS products

 - Experience coaching or managing designers, formally or informally

 - Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design practices at scale
   
   


MORE ABOUT FIELDGUIDE:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

jobs.title: Manager II, Technical Program Management
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

Role Summary

As a Senior Manager of Technical Program Management Engineering team, you will lead the end-to-end execution of product sustaining in various complex Semiconductor product lines, driving alignment across hardware engineering, product marketing, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, field Services, and external partners. You will serve as the central leader responsible for translating sustaining strategy into execution, ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget, and at the highest standards of quality, performance, and customer value.

In this role, you will establish program governance/measurement, oversee requirements and change management processes, manage resource allocation, and drive cross-functional decision-making throughout the product lifecycle. You will act as the primary point of contact for sales/service team, and business partners, facilitating technical trade-offs, resolving complex issues, mitigating risks, and ensuring alignment of priorities and execution plans.

Additionally, you will lead and develop high-performing Technical Program Management Engineering (TPME) teams, build scalable operating mechanisms, and implement best practices that improve organizational effectiveness and accelerate product delivery. By combining strategic leadership with strong technical and operational expertise, you will create clarity in ambiguous environments, drive accountability across organizations, and ensure successful execution of both individual programs and broader product lines.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and mentor high-performing TPME teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

• Lead the TPME organization for HVM/Sustaining and EOL programs across the KPUs

• Lead complex cross-functional programs involving hardware, software, systems integration, and operations

• Establish and govern program execution strategies, development plans, requirements management, and change-control processes

• Drive alignment across design engineering teams, product management, supply chains, sales/service team and external partners

• Manage schedules, budgets, resources, dependencies, risks, and critical milestones throughout the product lifecycle

• Lead technical reviews, decision-making forums, escalation processes, and executive communications

• Develop scalable governance frameworks, measurement processes, and operational mechanisms that enable organizational growth and excellence

• Drive product change management, customer qualifications, and implementation of product changes across various KPU and installed product bases

• Balance business objectives, customer needs/qualifications, technical complexity, cost, quality, and schedule considerations to achieve successful outcomes

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, or equivalent industry experience. Advanced degree in technical management is desired.

• 15+ years in technical program management or engineering leadership delivering complex HVM products that combine hardware and software.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills across internal teams and external partners, including experience owning requirements governance and change-request/escalation processes as a primary technical point of contact between organizations

• Track record delivering integration, validation, and parts release cycles through a full product development lifecycle (concept to production) for complex HVM products.

• Demonstrated experience managing engineering change processes, obsolescence programs, lifecycle management, and supplier-driven changes.

• Proven ability to drive alignment and decisions in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder governance structures without direct authority.

• Experience in executing the same product change implementation for different customers.

• Drive adoption of best practices in technical communication across the TPME team.

• Experience with PLM systems (e.g., Teamcenter) and ERP systems (SAP S4 Hana).

• Familiarity with Design for Six Sigma methodologies

• Strong exposure to Configuration Management (CMII) practices

• Experience supporting Copy Exact methodology and global manufacturing operations

• Knowledge of inventory management and CPIM practices

Ideal Leadership Profile

A highly accomplished technical leader with extensive experience delivering complex products. Strong business and people leadership acumen, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority. Demonstrates excellence in strategic planning, execution management, product change management, systems thinking, and executive-level communication while consistently driving results in fast-paced, highly matrixed environments.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

ASM is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, nationality, social or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identify or expression, marital status, pregnancy, political affiliation, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Web Marketing Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location: Remote (US) — core hours estimated 9:00 AM–2:00 PM PT Mon–Thu, 9:00 AM–12:00 PM PT Fri Duration: September 1 – March 30 (~7 months) Commitment: 20–25 hours/week Type: Direct contract

About the Role

Our web marketing team runs several parallel workstreams: SEO/AEO, CRO, and quarterly web launches — supported by specialists and cross-functional partners. During a planned leave of absence, execution of each workstream is covered by existing team members. What this role owns is the connective tissue: the meeting rhythm, the follow-ups, and the cross-team communication that keep web marketing coordinated and moving.

This is a process-and-communication role managing high velocity workstreams across teams and aligning resourcing and helping leadership make decisions to keep the roadmap on schedule and on scope. You'll keep the moving pieces together so the team can stay focused on the work itself.

What You'll Own

Run the operating rhythm. Facilitate the weekly SEO/AEO/CRO meeting and keep web team standup mechanics tight: agendas, notes, and action tracking. Attend internal engineering, AEO/SEO, and web meetings and capture the requests and decisions landing on the web team. Sit on agency calls and assist with roadmap and follow ups and action items.

Keep the roadmap visible. Assemble the written web updates broadcast to cross-functional stakeholders (reviewed by the web team lead before distribution) and help prioritize incoming work with input from workstream owners.

Groom the backlogs. Keep the AEO/SEO and CRO backlogs current: mark items done, capture new requests for triage, and flag when runway is getting thin.

Track and chase. Follow up on action items across workstreams so nothing silently stalls.

Escalate with judgment. Spot blockers and route them to the right owner: execution questions to the web team lead, program decisions to the program owner. Deliver a weekly one-page status report to leadership so they have visibility without extra meetings. Act as the connective issue across a variety of marketing calls actively identifying which items are related for the web team and will need resourcing or prioritization.

Support launch coordination. Keep the quarterly web launch checklist moving (owners, dates, dependencies) and partner with BizOps on timeline and strategy alignment, including occasional support materials such as slides.

Who You Are

• 4+ years of experience as a marketing program manager or similar, with exposure to web or digital marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.

• Web and demand generation experience a plus.

• Strong meeting facilitator who runs tight, productive sessions and leaves a clear paper trail

• Excellent written communicator, especially in status updates and stakeholder summaries

• Fluent with backlog and project tracking tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)

• Comfortable working across functions and driving follow-through without formal authority

• Organized, proactive, and reliable, you notice when something is about to stall and act before it does

Reporting Structure

You'll report day-to-day to the Sr director of digital with the web experience manager and SEO/CRO managers as your first point of contact for execution questions.

For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $30,000-$40,000 over your 6-month tenure. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. (edited)

Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

As a Toddler Assistant Teacher, you'll support a nurturing toddler classroom where curiosity, exploration, and play-based learning are encouraged every day. You'll work closely with the Lead Teacher to develop and implement engaging curriculum, support each child's cognitive, social-emotional, physical, and language development, collaborate with classroom team members, and ensure your classroom maintains the highest standards of safety, quality, and compliance with New York State Office of Children and Family Services (OCFS) regulations and center quality standards.

jobs.title: Copy Supervisor (Pharma Ad Agency Experience Required)
jobs.description:

We are seeking a talented and experienced Copy Supervisor to join our creative team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in copywriting, exceptional leadership skills, and a passion for storytelling. As a Copy Supervisor, you will oversee the copywriting team and ensure the delivery of high-quality, engaging content that aligns with brand voice and marketing objectives.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams.  These results are achieved by:

• Curious. You must have an unquenchable thirst for knowledge — of the problem, the solutions and our target — in order to sculpt the big ideas that drive action.

• Empathetic. Compassion leads to passion and, ultimately, work that makes a difference for our clients and their targets (many of whom suffer). You’ll feel good about what you do here.

• Persuasive. You’ve come up with the perfect solution; now you have to pitch it that way.

• A team player. You will work with a dozen different departments to make your message come to life across a multitude of digital channels. Collaboration and laughter are key.

• A go-getter. No time? No problem!

• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent education plus professional experience) required

• A book featuring conceptual work and very smart digital executions, social experiences, out-of-home extensions and even banners

• Know-how for writing in a digital landscape — from strategy development to banners to sites to SEO

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Certified Medical Assistant
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Certified Medical Assistant (internally known as Lab Services Specialist/Member Support Specialist) in our Jersey City office,  you’ll provide an exceptional experience for our patients and help them accomplish an important part of their care journey by providing venipuncture as well as other clinical support services. You will be an ambassador for patients, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for our patients, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You combine excellent specimen collection technique with tactful interpersonal skills during every interaction with your patients, at both the front desk and in the lab. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you’ll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions, both clinical and administrative, and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• Provide best in class venipuncture services on a population ranging from pediatrics to geriatrics, depending on the office location

• Perform and assist with extended scope duties such as, but not limited to non-blood specimen collection, EKGs/ECGs, vitals, ear lavages, vaccines, PPD tests, and swabs

• Maintain high standards of in-office care through proper specimen labeling, handling and processing, inventory upkeep, and tool sterilization

• Continue to care for our members beyond the lab room by answering patient messages, following up on lab cases and assisting our providers and virtual medical team with clerical duties such as, but not limited to biometric screening forms, medical record and consult review, billing inquiries, and DOH reporting

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

• Master our technology suite including, but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, Circulation, RingCentral, and our Electronic Medical Record System, in order to interact with team members and complete daily work

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• An active Medical Assistant certification from the National Healthcareer Association (NHA), the American Association of Medical Assistants (AAMA), the National Center for Competency Testing (NCCT), the American Medical Certification Association (AMCA), the National Association for Health Professionals (NAHP), the National Certification Medical Association (NCMA), or registration from the American Medical Technologists (AMT), or any other recognized certifying body approved by the Board

• Graduated from a postsecondary Medical Assistant program accredited by either the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP), the Accrediting Bureau of Health Education Schools (ABHES), another accrediting organization recognized by the United States Department of Education

• At least 6 months of relevant experience as a Medical Assistant or Phlebotomist outside of a training/externship environment

• Strong customer service skills, including ability to establish and maintain effective customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• A High School Diploma or equivalent

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse, multi-disciplinary teams (additional experience with remote teams a plus)

• A proven ability to display confidence and instill trust during the collection process while delivering individualized, human-centered, customer-focused care

• A proven track record of persisting through change, consistently stepping up to take action on challenges, and learning quickly and effectively when faced with new situations or tasks

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices

The range for this role is $24.00 to $26.00 per hour based on a standard full-time schedule. Total compensation packages may be based on factors unique to particular candidates, such as skill sets, depth of experience, and work location. The total compensation package for this position may also include benefits. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

This is a full time role (40 hours/week) with 8 hour shifts generally taking place Monday - Friday between 7:30am-6:00pm based in our Jersey City, NJ office.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Manager of Club Revenue Analytics & Data Science to join our Data & Analytics team at the NFL. Based in the League’s New York office, this role partners with internal stakeholders and all 32 clubs to turn business questions and fan data into actionable recommendations, scalable analytics products, and measurable growth across ticketing, premium seating, sponsorship, and fan engagement. The role also works with Data Engineering and Business Intelligence to ensure solutions are accurate, governed, and scalable.

The ideal candidate combines business acumen, data science and advanced analytics experience, executive communication skills, and a consultative mindset to turn insights into action.

Responsibilities

• Manage and collaborate with stakeholders from Club Business Development and the 32 clubs to understand their analytics needs and deliver actionable insights.

• Oversee the development and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive analytics platforms to support ticketing, premium seating and sponsorship analytics and insights.

• Lead advanced analytics to evaluate ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship behavior, including KPI monitoring, segmentation, customer profiling, and predictive modeling.

• Effectively communicate analytical findings to stakeholders, translating complex data analysis into clear and concise insights.

• Collaborate with BI and technology teams to ensure ticketing, premium seating, and sponsorship platforms receive accurate, reliable data through regular quality audits and validation.

• Perform data extraction, transformation and analysis using SQL and Python.

• Develop and implement attribution models to measure the impact of different League-provided data products.

• Work with the BI COE to create dashboards to provide insights and recommendations based on analytics findings.

• Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in club analytics and data quality management.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Club Business Development, Marketing and the 32 clubs to align analytics initiatives and drive data-driven decision-making.

• Collaborate with analytics consulting vendors.

• Foster a collaborative and agile work environment, leveraging tools like Jira for project management and task tracking.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative discipline.

• At least 7 years of relevant experience in revenue analytics, pricing, customer analytics, ticketing, consulting, ecommerce, hospitality, sports, media, or another commercially oriented industry or other relevant industry experience.

• Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous business problems, direct analytical work, and translate findings into clear commercial recommendations.

• Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with practical experience working with large customer, transactional, or behavioral datasets.

• Experience with predictive modeling, customer segmentation, forecasting, experimentation or campaign measurement, and analytical storytelling.

• Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical workstreams and coaching analysts

• Proven ability to communicate with senior business and technical stakeholders and present complex analysis in a clear, concise, and influential manner.

• Experience partnering with data engineering, BI, product, or technology teams to deliver scalable analytical solutions with strong data quality and governance.

• 3 years of management experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

• Sports, clubs, ticketing, live events, venue, hospitality, airline, subscription, or revenue management experience.

• Experience with Ticketmaster, SeatGeek, or comparable ticketing and live-event datasets.

• Experience developing club-facing, client-facing, or executive-facing recommendations in a consulting or analytics advisory environment.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings to stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

• Strong collaborator who communicates transparently, supports shared goals, and welcomes constructive challenges.

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Project Coordinator, Construction Operations

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Success
jobs.description:
The database market is massive (IDC estimates it to be $121B+ by 2025!) and MongoDB is at the head of its disruption. At MongoDB we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing apps that people use every day. We are the leading modern data platform and the first database provider to IPO in over 20 years. Join our team and be at the forefront of innovation and creativity.

MongoDB is looking for an experienced and results-oriented people leader to help grow our Customer Success program. You will play a key role in the growth and success of MongoDB, our customers and CS team members. Your team will be working directly with our customers, and you’ll help develop an outstanding program in one of its most exciting phases.

You will recruit and provide the coaching, mentoring and development that will enable both our high-touch and tech-touch Customer Success teams to positively impact customers, develop skills, and grow their careers over time. In addition to recruiting, retaining, and developing talent, you will also be responsible for crafting and executing initiatives to increase our customer retention and happiness, identify expansion opportunities, and promote customer adoption of MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City for our hybrid working model.

We’re looking for someone with

• Passion for and experience in hiring, developing and managing a team of individual contributors; Your team and their success are your top priority

• A proven track record and experience with fast-growing teams, using data to drive initiatives and guide your decision making processes

• A mind for technology; We’ll teach you all about MongoDB and databases, but our users and products are inherently technical; You should be too

• Experience or aptitude for learning enterprise infrastructure technologies; exposure to MongoDB or NoSQL databases is a plus, but not required

• High organization in your workflows; To lead and execute efficiently, you’ll need to be a specialist in prioritization and time management

• You know how to deal with ambiguity and be able to navigate through it with perseverance, a positive mentality and a point of view; We’re still growing and learning and will look to you to help us establish and evolve processes

• A strong desire to embrace partnership and collaboration; You’ll be working with multiple teams on a regular basis (Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, etc.) and helping to build the Customer Success “brand” across our entire organization and the market

• You have experience in working and collaborating with internal and external partners with diverse cultural and professional backgrounds

• An adaptive mentality; You love an ever-changing environment where you are constantly improving yourself, the team and your processes

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present to a diverse audience both internally and externally

• A Bachelor's degree combined with 3-4 years of management experience, preferably in a customer success or account management capacity

Role Overview & Key Responsibilities

• People leadership: Recruit, mentor and develop individuals on the CSM team

• Execution: Define and lead to a set of analytical metrics to guide the direction of the team; deliver against quarterly and long-term targets

• Build programs: Craft and execute initiatives sought to grow customer retention, expansion, satisfaction, and product adoption

• Executive presence and communication: Build and maintain relationships across MongoDB teams, organizations and offices

Success Measures

The Manager, Customer Success will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

• In the first 3 months you’ll have ramped on our key CS processes and program, effectively completed our weeklong training bootcamp and started interviewing for new team members

• In 6 months, have hired your team to at least 90% capacity (as per hiring plan outlined to you). You’re actively mentoring and guiding the team through quarterly and monthly team goals and initiatives

• In 12 months you’ll have accomplished and are 100% on track for your team’s hiring plan, coach your individual contributors on the team efficiently, and are on achieving and exceeding your team goals for retention, expansion and customer satisfaction

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Mandalay Bay
jobs.description:
Position: Assistant Manager

Hours: 40 Weekly

Interview Plan

Ever wondered what it’s like behind the bubbles?  #lushcareers

Lush North America has been creating fresh and handmade cosmetics for the past 20 years- keeping our customers’ bathtubs and showers a little more magical through our retail shops across Canada and the US. We are dedicated to the practices of fair trade sourcing and supporting sustainable communities as well as giving back to organizations that can make a difference.

We Offer:

• A fun and funky store atmosphere where individualism is encouraged

• A 50% discount off all our products to keep you smelling and feeling fresh

• An unconventional retail structure to support your entrepreneurial spirit

• The opportunity for growth as Lush loves to promote from within

Assistant Manager

As Assistant Manager, you bring Lush’s Leadership Practices into all elements of your business interactions with customers, fellow staff and operations: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose.

The ASM supports the Shop Manager as needed in all business areas and as delegated by their Retailer; as second-in-command, the ASM will pick up Manager duties as required to support a strong customer experience, staff experience, shop operational excellence, and exceeding sales goals.

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Customer Service: collaborate with your team on plans to exceed daily sales goals and ensure a unique and inclusive customer experience that makes every visitor feel welcome, meets their needs and makes their day.

• Building the Brand: educate our customers and staff on our brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed and product recommendations for every need

• Driving Sales: demonstrate strong business acumen and understanding of your metrics, budgets and reports and how to impact them through behaviors on the floor to deliver profitable results.

Team Leadership:

• Lead Fearlessly: Be present to support your team on the sales floor, answer questions, remove obstacles, problem solve, and motivate them to meet their sales goals

• Grow Talent: by owning your own development, assessing your performance, seeking feedback and resources and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities; and supporting the growth of your team through coaching and leading by example.

• Be Real: with your needs and feedback for your team and leaders and adaptable to the needs of the business as required

• Live with Purpose: engage your team at every level of your business to ensure they are inspired, motivated and building strong peer and customer relationships and are connected to the brand values

• Recruitment and Selection: Support the staffing of your shop with top-performing staff by working actively within your markets to network, recruit, hire and succession plan.

• Staff Development: collaborate with your Manager on creating and executing plans that improve staff engagement, retention, performance, and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging practices.

Operational Excellence:

• Policies and Procedures: Support your manager to keep your shop complaint and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, health and safety and daily communication. · Stock and Inventory: Support the training of your inventory team to abide by fresh standards and rotation rules and manage ordering to ensure the right products, in the right amounts are in the store at the right times within your allocated budget.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Identify and support the development of your team to take pride in a clean and beautiful work environment and follow the merchandising and design standards to provide a consistent customer experience and drive sales.

• Scheduling, Time and Attendance: ensure the right number of staff with the right skill levels are scheduled at peak times and that breaks and meals are allocated and recorded appropriately to ensure staff wellbeing and payroll accuracy.

Qualifications:

Required:

• 1-3 years managing or supervising in a retail environment

• Excellent listening and communication skills

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.

jobs.title: Technology Product Owner, Commercial Analytics & Data - Contract - Local ORANGE COUNTY, CA REQUIRED
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Technology Product Owner (TPO) to lead the Commercial Analytics & Data Technology Product Portfolio within the Commercial Technology organization.

The Technology Product Owner is responsible for the strategy, roadmap, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of analytics products that enable Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Sales Enablement, Finance, Marketing, and the Field Sales Organization across the company.

This role serves as the primary technology partner connecting business questions and decisions to data, analytics, engineering, and user experiences. The successful candidate will help establish end-to-end product ownership from business priority and use case through data sourcing, integration, modeling, visualization, insights, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

The portfolio includes capabilities spanning Power BI, Qlik, commercial dashboards, forecasting and planning analytics, physician and customer intelligence, third-party data, automated reporting and distribution, AI-assisted analytics, and the underlying data and integration ecosystem. The role requires strong product leadership combined with working knowledge of analytics architecture, data models, source-to-consumption data flows, integrations, data quality, governance, and enterprise data platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

• Own the product vision, roadmap, and value realization strategy for the Commercial Analytics portfolio.
• Translate commercial priorities, business questions, user needs, and field feedback into an actionable analytics roadmap and prioritized product backlog.
• Partner with Commercial Operations, Sales Leadership, Finance, Marketing, Sales Enablement, and other stakeholders to define analytics use cases that improve commercial decision-making.
• Establish clear product outcomes and KPIs across areas such as analytics adoption, decision effectiveness, forecast visibility, field effectiveness, data quality, and user experience.
• Prioritize investments across run, enhancement, modernization, and innovation work based on business value, technical feasibility, dependencies, and organizational readiness.

Commercial Analytics Product Delivery

• Lead end-to-end delivery of analytics capabilities from discovery and requirements through data enablement, visualization, release, adoption, and continuous improvement.
• Manage the product backlog, feature prioritization, user stories, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, release planning, and product governance.
• Partner with Power BI and analytics developers, data engineers, architects, platform teams, analysts, data scientists, and delivery partners to execute the roadmap.
• Ensure analytics products are designed around business decisions and user workflows rather than individual reports or isolated technology requests.
• Drive adoption through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, feedback loops, usage measurement, and iterative product improvement.

BI Platforms & Analytics Experience

• Serve as product leader across commercial BI and visualization capabilities, including Power BI and Qlik.
• Guide the evolution and rationalization of the analytics experience, including enhancement of existing dashboards, Power BI adoption, and appropriate migration or decommissioning of legacy analytics where applicable.
• Promote reusable analytics patterns, common semantic definitions, consistent user experiences, and scalable dashboard design.
• Partner with analytics teams to improve performance, usability, accessibility, maintainability, and adoption of commercial analytics products.
• Evaluate opportunities for AI-assisted analytics, conversational interfaces, automated insight generation, and more effective distribution of analytics to users.

Data Models, Integration & Analytics Architecture

• Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end commercial data landscape, including source systems, integrations, transformation logic, data models, semantic models, and consumption layers.
• Partner with data engineering and architecture teams to document and continuously improve source-to-consumption data flows and integration dependencies.
• Understand dimensional and relational data modeling concepts sufficiently to evaluate analytics requirements, identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and guide scalable solution design.
• Ensure business definitions, calculations, hierarchies, relationships, and key metrics are consistently represented across analytics products.
• Coordinate integration of internal and third-party data sources into commercial analytics products, with clear ownership of interfaces, refresh cadence, dependencies, and failure handling.
• Partner with enterprise data and platform teams to align solutions with approved data platforms, architecture patterns, integration standards, and source-of-truth principles.

Data Quality, Governance & Trust

• Establish clear ownership and governance for critical commercial data, metrics, and business definitions.
• Drive visibility into data lineage, refresh cadence, source-of-truth rules, data gaps, and quality issues that impact business decisions.
• Work with business owners, data owners, and engineering teams to define quality expectations, reconciliation processes, issue triage, and remediation priorities.
• Ensure analytics products comply with enterprise security, privacy, governance, and regulatory requirements.
• Build user trust by making data definitions, limitations, dependencies, and quality transparent and actionable.

Commercial Decision Support & Business Partnership

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand the decisions analytics must enable, including commercial performance, forecasting, field effectiveness, account and opportunity prioritization, physician/customer intelligence, and planning.
• Lead discovery, process mapping, decision mapping, journey mapping, and analytics capability assessments.
• Translate complex analytical and technical concepts into clear business language and communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and roadmap decisions effectively.
• Influence cross-functional alignment without direct authority and build trusted partnerships across business, data, analytics, and technology organizations.

AI, Advanced Analytics & Innovation

• Identify opportunities to leverage Generative AI, predictive analytics, automation, data science, and conversational analytics to improve commercial decisions and user productivity.
• Partner with data science, engineering, and platform teams to move valuable analytical concepts from experimentation into governed, scalable products.
• Ensure AI and advanced analytics use cases are grounded in trusted data, clear business outcomes, measurable value, and appropriate governance.
• Evaluate emerging analytics technologies and platform capabilities to inform the long-term Commercial Analytics roadmap.

Agile Product Operating Model

• Serve as a champion of the company Product Operating Model.
• Co-own value realization with the Business Product Owner and align a stable cross-functional squad around shared outcomes.
• Foster a culture of user-centricity, experimentation, transparency, continuous learning, and outcome-based delivery.
• Lead Agile product ceremonies and governance activities, including backlog refinement, prioritization, planning, demos, and retrospectives.
• Promote data-driven prioritization, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement of team effectiveness.

Leadership Skills & Behaviors

• Strong product management and business transformation leadership.
• Business-first mindset with the ability to connect analytics to decisions and measurable outcomes.
• Strong analytical thinking and ability to understand complex data ecosystems without needing to be the primary developer or data engineer.
• Ability to communicate effectively across business leaders, analysts, data engineers, architects, developers, and field users.
• Strong problem-solving, facilitation, prioritization, and decision-making capabilities.
• Ability to simplify complex data and technology topics and create alignment across cross-functional teams.
• Lead through influence, collaboration, accountability, and servant leadership.
• Promote an inclusive, high-performing, and continuously learning team environment.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Analytics, or related field.
• 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Technology, Analytics, Data, Commercial Operations, or related disciplines.
• 5+ years of experience delivering analytics, data, or technology solutions supporting commercial, sales, finance, or customer-facing organizations.
• Experience managing complex product roadmaps and cross-functional delivery.
• Experience working in Agile product delivery environments.
• Strong understanding of business intelligence and visualization platforms such as Power BI and/or Qlik.
• Working knowledge of data modeling, semantic models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, APIs/integrations, and source-to-consumption data flows.
• Ability to understand data lineage, source-of-truth concepts, refresh dependencies, data quality, and integration architecture.
• Strong understanding of the analytics product lifecycle, from business question and data sourcing through insights, adoption, and value realization.
• Exceptional stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
• Proven ability to translate business strategy and analytical needs into scalable technology products and measurable outcomes.

Preferred

• Hands-on or product leadership experience with Power BI, including semantic models, dashboard/report design, and enterprise deployment patterns.
• Qlik experience and/or experience leading BI platform rationalization or migration initiatives.
• Experience with SQL, cloud data platforms, data warehouses/lakes, Databricks, Microsoft Azure, or similar technologies.
• Experience integrating CRM, ERP, sales, territory, forecasting, physician/customer, third-party, or other commercial data sources.
• Experience with commercial analytics, forecasting, field effectiveness, territory planning, physician intelligence, opportunity analytics, or sales performance solutions.
• Experience defining common metrics, business rules, dimensional models, semantic layers, and data quality controls.
• Experience supporting highly regulated industries.
• Experience leveraging AI, Generative AI, automation, predictive analytics, or data science to improve commercial outcomes.
• Product Management certifications (SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Scrum Product Owner, Pragmatic Institute, or equivalent).
• MBA or advanced degree preferred

Preferred Attributes

• Passion for advancing healthcare through data, analytics, technology, and innovation.
• Strong customer-first and business-outcome mindset.
• Curious about how data is created, integrated, modeled, governed, and ultimately used to make decisions.
• Comfortable operating at both strategic and technical levels while maintaining clear product ownership.
• Demonstrated ability to simplify complex analytical and business challenges.
• Highly collaborative and relationship-oriented.
• Strategic thinker with a bias for action and execution.
• Data-driven decision-maker with strong commercial acumen.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Additional Information

OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS

Patient Minded - I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight - I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action - I am empowered and hold myself accountable.

Grow Talent - I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together - I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters - I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful, and timely dialogue.

Embrace Diversity - I create an environment of awareness and respect.

jobs.description:
The Versant Internship Program offers students the opportunity to build foundational skills, contribute to meaningful projects, and gain exposure to how a modern media organization operates. Interns are curious, motivated, and eager to learn in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

All internships are paid. Summer interns are also eligible for:

• Time off to support overall health, well-being, and academics.

• Structured onboarding and professional development opportunities

• Mentorship and networking with teams across the company & intern community

• Hands-on experience that supports long-term career growth

As part of Versant’s internship program, interns will help shape an experience designed to invest in emerging talent and support early career development.

Summer 2027 Internship Program:

• Applications Open: October 7

• Applications Close: November 16. Tip: Apply early! Positions may be filled on a rolling basis and applications may close once capacity is reached.

• Program Dates: June 7, 2027 to August 13, 2027

• Time Commitment: 40 hours per week. Exact schedule to be determined based on business need.

• Format: Opportunities listed will require an intern to work on-site at the Los Angeles, CA office.

How to Apply:

• Submit a one-page resume detailing your relevant experience, skills, accomplishments, and expected graduation month and year.

• Submit an optional letter to the hiring team expressing your interest in Versant, the internship locations you are open to (listed below), and your primary areas of interest (opportunities listed below).

• Must be able to provide a current transcript (unofficial transcripts accepted) to confirm enrollment in a degree-granting program during the recruitment process.

Job Description:

This division brings together a mix of entertainment and sports-focused businesses, including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow, TeeOff, GolfPass, Golf Channel, Full Swing, and other digital platforms. On the entertainment side, interns may support teams focused on moviegoing, streaming, consumer marketing, partnerships, sales, and audience engagement. On the sports and golf side, interns may contribute to teams focused on golf technology, fan engagement, marketing, sales, and digital experiences.

Across both areas, interns gain hands-on experience supporting campaigns, ad sales, product development, programming, and customer experiences that help audiences discover, engage with, and enjoy entertainment across film, TV, and sports. Whether enhancing the digital moviegoing experience or helping modernize how fans connect with the game of golf, interns play a role in building platforms, partnerships, and content that make entertainment more accessible, engaging, and enjoyable.

Areas of placement include but are not limited to:

• Marketing Partnerships & Branding
• Creative & Production
• Ad Sales

Basic Requirements:

• Must be actively enrolled in a degree-granting program at an accredited institution during the entire duration of the program OR have a graduation date in Spring 2027. Applicants who graduated in 2026 or earlier are not eligible for our internship program.

• Current class standing of sophomore or above (30 credits).

• Must be available to work 40 hours per week from June 7, 2027 to August 13, 2027.

• Must be willing to work on-site at the Los Angeles, CA office.

• Must be presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and must not require work visa sponsorship from VERSANT now or in the future to retain authorization to work in the United States.

• For further clarification, candidates currently on any student or exchange visa (e.g. F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, J-1, M-1) are not eligible to apply unless they will be able to change or adjust to another status that grants work authorization without sponsorship from VERSANT. VERSANT is an E-Verify company, requiring all employees to have an active Social Security number. Any candidate receiving an internship offer must complete I-9 form with Social Security number within 3 days of hire.

Desired Characteristics:

• Students with class standing of junior or above preferred

• Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above

• Strong interest in the media industry

• Previous internship experience and on-campus involvement

The hourly rate for student interns is $19.00.

jobs.title: Automotive Master Technician | Up to $170K* & Air Conditioning | Buckeye
jobs.description:
Job Title:

Master Automotive Technician / Mechanic

Location:

23385 W. Yuma Road, Buckeye, AZ 85326

Job Overview:

A Master Technician is responsible for accurately diagnosing and efficiently completing complex mechanical and electrical repairs to resolve vehicle issues. Utilizing advanced diagnostic equipment, scan tools, wiring diagrams, and technical resources, this production-focused role delivers high-quality craftsmanship to ensure guest safety and vehicle reliability. We are looking for an energetic, upbeat technician with a passion for technical excellence and doing what’s right for our guests.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Perform high-quality automotive diagnosis, service, and repair on all vehicle makes and models.
• Efficiently utilize scan tools, wiring diagrams, technical support resources, and diagnostic procedures to identify root causes.
• Consistently meet or exceed shop productivity standards and flagged hour targets.
• Perform thorough vehicle inspections and clearly document technical findings for Service Advisors.
• Assist peer technicians with complex diagnostic challenges when needed.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized personal workspace and care for shop equipment.
• Follow all shop safety guidelines and regulations.
• Continuously update technical skills and participate in ongoing training.

Qualifications:

• Positive attitude and a strong desire to serve guests with integrity and excellence.
• 7+ years of experience as an automotive technician/mechanic.
• Advanced automotive diagnostic and mechanical repair skills.
• Strong personal investment in professional tools suitable for a Master-level role.
• Ability to flag 40+ hours per week based on shop workload.
• ASE A1–A8 Certifications required (Master L1 preferred).
• Diesel repair and diagnostic experience preferred.
• Capability to diagnose and repair all makes and models of vehicles.
• Professional appearance and strong communication skills.
• A desire for continuous learning and long-term career growth.

Physical Requirements:

• Occasionally lift and/or move over 100 pounds.
• Work with hand and power tools on vehicles lifted above head height.
• Work comfortably in tight spaces as dictated by vehicle design and repair needs.
• Possess the manual dexterity required to efficiently use hand tools.
• Walk and stand for the majority of the workday.
• Drive manual transmission vehicles.
• Efficiently navigate computer software and electronic diagnostic tools.

Christian Brothers Automotive (CBA) began in 1982 with the simple premise of providing precision auto repair with transparency, integrity and a philosophy of people first. All 300+ CBA locations offer a modern facility equipped with manufacture-level diagnostic equipment and the latest factory scan tools. CBA shops also offer their technicians a consistent workload, free training, full-time live technician support and access to our private Technician Assistance Center.

jobs.description:
Calyxo, Inc. is a medical device company headquartered in Pleasanton, California, USA. The company was founded in 2016 to address the profound need for improved kidney stone treatment. jobs.title: Sr. Account Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
Most companies claim to have the best people. We say to them, "Keep dreaming." Our people are second to none. They set us apart with their entrepreneurial spirit and ambition. They come to us from the likes of Amazon, Microsoft, Nordstrom, Starbucks and the sports world, bringing energy, bold ideas and a willingness to dive into the unfamiliar. It's our people that make BDA the top global Merchandise Agency to work for.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Account Manager is responsible for leading a portfolio of complex, high-value client accounts while delivering exceptional client service, profitable growth, and consistent program performance. This role serves as the senior day-to-day owner of assigned accounts and is accountable for translating client objectives into actionable account strategies, overseeing complex programs, and ensuring financial and operational commitments are achieved.

Working closely with Sales, Creative, Sourcing, Operations, Logistics, eCommerce, Finance, and supplier partners, the Senior Account Manager leads cross-functional teams to deliver innovative branded merchandise solutions that advance client business objectives. This role builds trusted relationships across multiple levels of the client organization, anticipates emerging needs, navigates complex challenges, and provides strategic recommendations that strengthen the partnership.

As a senior commercial contributor, the Senior Account Manager is expected to drive revenue growth, protect and improve gross margin, strengthen client retention, and identify opportunities to expand programs and services. This role also provides leadership and coaching to junior Account Management team members, contributes to account planning and process improvement, and demonstrates readiness for broader portfolio and strategic account leadership.

LOCATION:

• This role is based in the Bryant Park area of Manhatten in New York City and offers a flexible onsite schedule of onsite 4 days per week, with 1 day remote.

• To be considered, you must live within commuting distance, as regular in-person collaboration is a key part of the role.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management & Execution (20%)

• Lead complex, high-value, and multi-workstream client programs from initial strategy and brief through final delivery and ongoing operation.

• Establish clear project plans, governance structures, timelines, milestones, approval processes, and measures of success.

• Direct cross-functional execution across Production, Creative, Sourcing, Logistics, eCommerce, Finance, and supplier partners.

• Anticipate execution risks, resolve escalations, and develop mitigation plans that protect client commitments, financial performance, and program continuity.

• Oversee major program launches, transitions, inventory initiatives, eCommerce implementations, and other business-critical projects.

• Ensure client programs are delivered accurately, on time, within budget, and in accordance with agreed service standards.

• Maintain visibility across concurrent projects while appropriately delegating responsibilities and holding internal partners accountable for deliverables.

Operations & Internal Coordination (10%)

• Lead internal kickoff meetings, recurring account reviews, and cross-functional working sessions.

• Establish clear ownership, communication protocols, and escalation paths across internal teams.

• Maintain accurate account, opportunity, forecast, and project information within Salesforce and other internal systems.

• Drive adherence to operating procedures, documentation requirements, service standards, and financial controls.

• Identify and implement improvements that increase workflow efficiency, execution quality, and program scalability.

• Lead post-project reviews and corrective-action planning when service, financial, or operational performance does not meet expectations.

Client Service & Relationship Management (25%)

• Serve as the senior day-to-day relationship owner for assigned clients and build trusted partnerships across multiple stakeholder levels.

• Develop and maintain account strategies based on a deep understanding of each client’s business, brand, priorities, budget, and long-term objectives.

• Lead client meetings, business reviews, program planning sessions, and presentations of strategic recommendations.

• Anticipate client needs and proactively introduce relevant products, services, trends, and program improvements.

• Translate client objectives into actionable recommendations that balance creativity, operational feasibility, financial performance, and speed to market.

• Navigate difficult conversations and resolve escalated issues with sound judgment while protecting the long-term client relationship.

• Monitor client satisfaction, service performance, and relationship health, addressing risks before they affect retention or growth.

• Build relationships beyond the primary day-to-day contact to strengthen account continuity and expand organizational reach.

Budget & Financial Performance (25%)

• Own revenue, gross margin, and profitability performance across assigned client accounts.

• Develop pricing strategies and commercial recommendations that balance client value, competitive positioning, and company financial objectives.

• Review and approve quotes within established authority levels, ensuring pricing accuracy, appropriate margin, and complete cost assumptions.

• Maintain accurate revenue forecasts, pipeline projections, and financial reporting for assigned accounts.

• Monitor project and program profitability, identify margin leakage, and implement corrective actions when performance falls below expectations.

• Manage client budgets, inventory exposure, program spend, freight, duties, and other costs that affect account profitability.

• Partner with Finance to support timely invoicing, reconciliation, collections, and resolution of financial discrepancies.

• Use account and financial data to identify trends, improve decision-making, and recommend actions that increase revenue, margin, and client value.

• Support renewal planning and commercial discussions by evaluating program performance, service requirements, and account economics.

Growth & Leadership (20%)

• Develop and execute account growth plans with defined revenue, margin, retention, and relationship objectives.

• Identify and advance opportunities to expand existing client programs, introduce additional capabilities, and increase share of client spend.

• Partner with Sales and other internal leaders on renewals, pitches, proposals, cross-sell opportunities, and strategic business development initiatives.

• Mentor Account Managers, Associate Account Managers, and Account Coordinators through coaching, feedback, and day-to-day guidance.

• Delegate work effectively while maintaining accountability for quality, timing, and client outcomes.

• Share best practices and contribute to the development of Account Management tools, processes, service standards, and training.

• Support portfolio planning, workload prioritization, and resource recommendations across the Account Management team.

• Model strong commercial judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership across the organization.

• Demonstrate readiness to advance into National Account Manager responsibilities through sustained portfolio performance and strategic client leadership.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

• 5–7 years of progressive experience in account management, client services, agency services, promotional products, or a related environment.

• Demonstrated success managing complex, high-value client accounts and multiple concurrent programs.

• Strong financial acumen, including experience with pricing, budgeting, revenue forecasting, gross margin management, and project profitability.

• Proven ability to identify and advance account growth, cross-sell, and program expansion opportunities.

• Strong executive presence with the ability to lead client meetings, business reviews, strategic discussions, and difficult conversations.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence outcomes without direct authority.

• Strong project management, organizational, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to balance strategic account leadership with detailed execution and financial accountability.

• Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms preferred.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, client-focused environment while managing competing priorities and deadlines.

Success in this Role

Successful Senior Account Managers consistently deliver strong client retention, revenue growth, gross margin performance, forecast accuracy, and program execution across a complex portfolio. They operate as trusted client advisors, convert business objectives into commercially sound solutions, anticipate and resolve risks, and create measurable value for both the client and the company. They elevate the performance of the broader Account Management team through coaching and leadership while demonstrating the strategic judgment and sustained commercial results required to advance into National Account Manager responsibilities.

We are pleased to share the base salary range for this position is $83,000 to $98,000. If you are hired at BDA, your compensation will be determined based on factors that may include geographic location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any offer. In the spirit of pay transparency, the range listed is the full base salary range for the role and hiring at the top of the range would not be typical, in order to allow for future salary growth. jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s Growth Engineer, you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

The web platform

• Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.

• Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today.

• Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.

• Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.

• Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure

• Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.

• Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

• Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.

• Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.

• Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

What We’re Looking For

• 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

• Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar.

• Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.

• A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.

• High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.

• Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

• Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.

• Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

Nice To Have

• Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement.

• Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory.

• Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family

• Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it

• Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child

• Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future

• Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office

• Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced

• In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K  + Equity

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.
