jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells https://blog.roboflow.com/cancer-research-computer-vision/ to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety https://blog.roboflow.com/preventing-accidents-on-construction-sites-with-computer-vision/, digitizing floor plans https://blog.roboflow.com/floor-plan-analysis-computer-vision/, preserving coral reef populations https://blog.roboflow.com/reefos-supercharging-coral-reef-restoration-with-ai/, guiding drone flight https://blog.roboflow.com/georeferencing-drone-videos/, and much more https://roboflow.com/templates.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers love building great things with passionate teammates. We value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action—whether it's a big initiative or a small fix. You’re naturally curious, hands-on with new tech (maybe even played with ChatGPT or AI products early on), and prefer to show your work over talking about it. Many of us have founder mindsets and thrive in Roboflow’s high-autonomy environment—some even started as side hustlers in school.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Primarily, you like to make great things with passionate colleagues. You are someone that likes to own outcomes, not only inputs. You’re motivated by having responsibility and accountability. You’re eager to ‘do the work,’ big and small.

You’re curious and learning about new technologies, perhaps an early tinkerer with MLOps products. You show more than you tell.

You’re motivated by the question, “How can I improve this?” and have a track record of doing so, even in ways adjacent to your role. Much of our current team is made up of former founders and thrive in the level of autonomy at Roboflow. Maybe you had a side hustle in high school or college.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of ouropen source projects https://roboflow.com/open-source.Likewise we highly value users with meaningful contributions to successful open source devtool and security projects.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a member of our infrastructure team, you'll be at the heart of a fast-paced startup environment. Your primary focus will be on striking the right balance between rapid delivery, high reliability, and robust security. This isn't a traditional, siloed role; you'll need to wear many hats—acting as an infrastructure engineer one moment, and a developer, or even a security analyst.

You will be securing, scaling, and maintaining the core infrastructure that powers our product. This includes our cloud architecture, databases, file storage, search clusters, microservices, and machine learning pipelines. You'll work closely with our product team and collaborate across the company on product, operations, and customer-facing projects, constantly context-switching to solve the next critical challenge.




SKILLSET

We're looking for a versatile engineer excited by high-impact challenges. At Roboflow, we are AI-native: we expect our team to use AI to accelerate everything from writing code and fixing bugs to analyzing security, cost, and performance. Experience in some or all of the following areas will be crucial:

 - Production experience with Kubernetes: Building and managing containerized applications at scale.

 - Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Using Terraform, Helm charts, bash scripting, and Python to automate everything.

 - Scale & Site Reliability: Operating, monitoring, and scaling large-scale applications (especially in ML/AI) in AWS and/or GCP.

 - Development Skills: Proficiency in Node.js and Python, with the ability to collaborate with full-stack developers on designing and operating SaaS applications.

 - ML/Big Data Ops: Hands-on experience with the infrastructure required for machine learning at scale (GPUs, Docker, Kubernetes) and familiarity with libraries like PyTorch or Tensorflow.

 - CI/CD Automation: Experience with tools like GitHub Actions or Spacelift to build and deploy code efficiently.

 - Pragmatic Security: Awareness of security best practices for cloud operations and how they can be applied to startup environments.

 - AI-Native Engineering: Leveraging LLMs and AI tools to accelerate the development lifecycle—from writing and refactoring code to identifying security vulnerabilities and optimizing infrastructure costs.

 


A GLIMPSE OF YOUR WORK

No two days will be the same. Your tasks will be a blend of strategic projects and hands-on implementation. Examples include:

 - Running and optimizing a high-availability machine learning inference service.

 - Collaborating with customer security teams to ensure secure integration.

 - Developing creative IaC solutions to scale our platform cost-effectively.

 - Working with the engineering team to define SLOs/SLAs and participating in incident response.

 - Improving the Observability and Alerting stack and the processes built around it.

 - Diving deep into our stack to identify and act on cost-optimization opportunities.

 - Contributing code (Python, JavaScript, etc.) as part of a team designing and deploying new product features.

 - Fixing security vulnerabilities and bugs

 - Hardening our systems and processes to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR requirements, making us audit-ready.

 - Participating in an on-call rotation to ensure platform reliability.



📅 Within one week, you will…

 - Learn all about computer vision, our product, company, customers, and vision.

 - Ship something substantial to an end user

 - Start learning our infrastructure and security practices.

📅 Within one month, you will…

 - Onboard in person with your manager

 - Build your first computer vision project with Roboflow (if you haven't already)

 - Start contributing to infra-as-code

 - Start working with customers to help with their security questions and onboarding

 - Understand the architecture of Roboflow

📅 Within six months, you will…

 - Attend your first all company onsite https://blog.roboflow.com/remote-company-onsite-ideas/

 - Be ramped up on other relevant parts of the Roboflow product.


WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH

Our team of ~100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

You will directly be working with our Engineering Lead and a team of product, infrastructure and security engineers.




WHERE YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team on-sites in different cities) and resources https://blog.roboflow.com/how-we-work-together-at-roboflow/ (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!




WHEN YOU'LL WORK

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.



What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

💰 The target compensation for this role is USD $180,000 base - $230,000 base.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

 - $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

 - $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

 - Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

 - Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision


INTERVIEW PROCESS (~5 HOURS)

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. You will be speaking directly with our team about what it's like to work and thrive at Roboflow. 

Before the Interview:

 - We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

 - The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects https://roboflow.com/open-source, or highlight your contributions to devtools/infrastructure/security engineering open-source projects.

 - We may send you a technical screen if applicable.

Introduction Phase:

 - [45m] Meet with hiring manager for introduction, Sachin Agarwal, to assess overall mindset and skillset. This first interview is a time to get to know more about the role, allow us to get to know you better, and ensure it's a good fit for both parties to continue moving forward in the process

Team Interview Phase:

 - [45m] Meet with our CTO, Brad Dwyer

 - [90m] Meet with hiring manager and team for a technical infrastructure hands-on interview

Ask questions!

Final Interview Stage:

 - [45m] Meet with Kate Wagner, Head of Operations for a culture discussion

 - [60m] Meet with Joseph Nelson, CEO

 - We check references and conduct a background check

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.





LEARN MORE ABOUT US

We are building a diverse Distributed team https://blog.roboflow.com/how-we-work-together-at-roboflow/ that is distributed across the globe. Roboflow is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds, communities, and experiences.

We provide competitive compensation and stellar benefits to accelerate your personal and work life. Learn more about what it is like to work at Roboflow by reading these blog posts. https://blog.roboflow.com/tag/working-at-roboflow/

See our careers page https://roboflow.com/careers for all open listings.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Engineer, Named - Portland, OR
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Portland, OR

About the Role

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. As the architectural complexity of enterprise solutions scales, we are evolving how we partner with our customers. The Customer Engineer (CE) represents the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted advisor who owns the technical relationship from the initial discovery phase through to long-term adoption and ongoing account expansion.
Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to the Regional Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, utilizing AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities

• Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, build bespoke architectures, and deliver compelling product demonstrations and Proof of Concepts (PoCs) across Cloudflare’s portfolio (Security, Networking and Developer Platforms).

• Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Lead and/or provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. You will partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. You will proactively monitor dynamic customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value and resolve integration bottlenecks.

• Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. You will be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.

• Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion.

• AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Act as an "AI-Augmented" engineer. Leverage AI agents and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, and basic telemetry monitoring, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.

Minimum Qualifications

• Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

• Technical Acumen: Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.

• Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.

• Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

• Cloudflare AI Stack Experience: Hands-on experience building, deploying, or architecting solutions using Cloudflare's developer platform and AI ecosystem, specifically Workers AI, AI Gateway, and Vectorize.

• Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with prompt engineering, Large Language Model (LLM) orchestration, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures.

• Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Dock Sortation Specialist

Operations · On-Site (Saltbox Location)

Who We Are

Saltbox is on a mission to simplify the hardest parts of running an eCommerce business. Our purpose-built spaces serve as modern headquarters for small to medium-sized businesses in industries like Fashion & Apparel, Health & Beauty, Electronics, and Household Goods. We offer a powerful combination of flexible warehouse suites, offices, and on-site logistics support that empower entrepreneurs to scale with confidence.

What You’ll Do

We’re launching something new at Saltbox—and we need the right people to run it.

As a Dock Sortation Specialist, you’re the execution engine of our new Dock Sorting function. You’re on the floor every shift—scanning packages, sorting them accurately, staging them for drivers, and making sure every package gets where it needs to go, on time. This is a fast-paced, physical, detail-oriented role where accuracy and reliability aren’t just nice to have—they’re everything.

You’ll work alongside a small, tight-knit crew processing hundreds of packages per shift using handheld scanning technology. When the day is done, you may also pitch in to support other parts of the Saltbox operation—from member logistics to building upkeep—as part of our Elastic Workforce (e-Force). You’ll report to the Dock Sortation Lead at your location, with support from the Saltbox Operational Excellence team.

Responsibilities

Package Scanning & Sortation

• Scan every inbound package using the Sort App on a handheld device—each package gets two scans: presort and bin assignment.

• Maintain a target scan rate of 225 scans per hour (approximately 112 packages processed per hour).

• Sort packages into the correct shelving unit or bin based on batch and market assignment. Accuracy is critical—missorts delay drivers and risk SLA breaches.

Staging & Dispatch

• Move sorted batches to the driver handoff zone before the dispatch window opens.

• Assist with dispatch scanning as drivers pick up their loads.

• Help ensure 99.5% of packages are dispatched by 11:00am.

Driver Handoff & End-of-Shift Reconciliation

• Assist the Lead with driver coordination—staging packages for pickup, completing departure scans, and keeping the handoff zone organized.

• Help count on-hand packages at shift end and immediately flag any discrepancies to the Lead.

Workspace Stewardship

• Keep the sortation area clean, organized, and safe throughout your shift.

• Return equipment to proper positions and maintain the Saltbox standard for Members and partners.

Who You Are

You’re reliable, detail-oriented, and take real pride in doing physical work well. You don’t need to be managed closely—you show up, you execute, and you hold yourself to a high standard. You’ll thrive here if you move with purpose, pay attention to the small details that matter, and bring a consistent, team-first attitude every shift.

Key Qualities

• Dependable—your team can count on you being there, every shift.

• Focused and purposeful in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

• Detail-oriented—right package, right bin, right scan, every time.

• Comfortable with technology and quick to learn new tools and apps.

• Works well on a team without needing constant direction.

• Takes physical work seriously and can stay on your feet for a full shift.

Requirements

• Ability to stand for 6+ hours and lift/move packages up to 50 lbs (reasonable accommodation provided).

• Available for early morning shifts (typically 3 am - 11 am) on a rotating 7-day schedule with two consecutive days off. Shifts as early as 2:00am may be available as operations grow, with advance notice.

• Reliable transportation to your Saltbox location.

• Comfortable using handheld scanning devices and mobile apps.

• Prior experience in warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, or retail is a plus—but if you’ve got hustle, we’ll train you on everything else.

What We Offer

We care deeply about our team and are proud to offer:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance (100% covered for some plans, low premium for PPO)

• 401K plan with options

• Company-paid long and short-term disability insurance and life insurance

• Paid holidays, vacation time, sick leave, and paid parental leave

• Learning and development opportunities, including job training and a dedicated learning budget

Location & Schedule

This role is on-site at the Duarte Saltbox location. Shifts are early morning (typically 3:00am–11:00 am) on a rotating 7-day schedule, with two consecutive days off per week. As operations scale, shifts as early as 2:00am may be available. Only New Year’s Day and Christmas Day are closed.

Are you ready to join a team that values your skills and experience? Saltbox is excited to offer this full-time position with a base pay range of $20.00–$21.00 per hour, depending on your location. We understand that the cost of living varies across different geographic markets, and we want to ensure that our compensation reflects that.

If you’re looking for a role where showing up well and doing the work with care truly matters, we want to hear from you. Apply today and become a part of the Saltbox team!

If you’re interested in learning more about Saltbox, check out our website: www.saltbox.com

jobs.title: Principal Alliance Manager
jobs.description:
We’re seeking a senior level strategic, results oriented and relationship-driven Principal Alliance Manager to join our team. In this senior external role, you will translate the channel strategy established by leadership into actionable plans for the assigned VAR portfolio, owning partner recruitment, enablement, activation, and growth.

You will then be fully accountable to  contract, enable, and activate a specific set of VAR partnerships within the Microsoft, Sage, Netsuite and Acumatica ecosystems. You’ll serve as the primary point of contact for these tier 1 partners, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, sharing partner insight, and ensuring a seamless experience for joint customers. Success is achieved by developing opportunities, growing a solid pipeline that meets or exceeds our annual targets, and jointly closing deals with VAR partners.  This is a highly collaborative role that will span partnerships, sales, product management, finance, legal, and marketing.

The ideal candidate brings significant experience in SaaS solutions, embedded solutions, a proven senior and impactful network in the ERP ecosystem, and a proven track record of developing high-impact partner relationships that generate significant revenue for the lifetime of the customer.   This is a role that requires extensive senor level communications both internally and externally.

What You’ll Do

• Continually refine the VAR Strategy for AVID by working senior leaders to continually enhance the VAR engagement and commercial models to be an industry standard.

• Develop and implement repeatable partner practices that improve the VAR model, resolve complex partnership challenges, and drive measurable improvements in partner performance.

• Lead complex cross-functional partner initiatives and provide guidance, coaching, and training to teammates on VAR partnership practices.

• Actively working with the Sr. Director of Partnerships and the VP of Channel Sales , own and refine a specific VAR strategy within the assigned ecosystem.

• Within the assigned ecosystem, own partner-sourced pipeline targets and partner with Sales to convert opportunities into closed revenue, with clear accountability for the VAR portfolio’s contribution to revenue goals.

• Help develop and build an end to end VAR ecosystem model from recruit to enablement to closing deals and driving scale through the ecosystem.

• Develop, execute, and evolve Go-to-Market plans with partners, focusing on sales, marketing, solutions consulting, and leadership.

• Own the all up relationship with the partners complete with revenue/customer targets, executive engagements, business rhythm, and overall impact of the business

• Be accountable for sales pipeline and net new revenue generated through your VAR partnerships

• Own and lead regular communication with partner sales organizations, including sales meetings, pipeline reviews, and operational updates.

• Monitor and analyze partner performance using both qualitative and quantitative metrics, including referral activity, leads, win-loss data, marketing program effectiveness, and engagement.

• Serve as the “voice of the partner” internally, collaborating with product, marketing, sales, and post-sales teams to improve processes and customer experience.

• Identify partner key performance objectives and align them with AvidXchange’s business goals.

What We’re Looking For

• Senior level partner development leader that has a proven set of established VAR relationships at the senior (C suite level).

• Proven success in developing and managing strategic partnerships with a strong track record of meeting and exceeding revenue targets.

• Strong network of established senior contacts within the Microsoft, Netsuite, Sage and Acumatica ecosystems, including VARs and key people in the Microsoft Channel partner ISV program.

• Experience contributing to and executing demand generation and marketing programs.

• Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally on process improvement, issue resolution, and workflow optimization.

• Knowledge of finance operations for middle-market companies; Accounts Payable knowledge is a plus.

• Ability to manage multiple projects and tasks simultaneously while maintaining high attention to detail.

• Proven presentation skills for both in-person and virtual settings (Teams, WebEx, GoToMeeting).

• Curious, creative, and self-motivated with a bias toward action.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Balance and Ledger - Core
jobs.description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

Overview

Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG) is on a mission to create the best online sportsbook in the industry. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to lead the team that builds the Balance and Ledger platform: the shared ledger and customer-level balance that holds customer funds across Fanatics. This leader will own systems where accuracy matters most, guiding the team through complex and ambiguous problems while ensuring operational excellence, consistent delivery, and long-term impact. The team sits within the Customer, Accounts & Transactions (CAT) domain and works closely with the Payments team.

The Engineering Manager plays a central role in shaping the architecture, processes, and engineering culture of the balance platform. You will lead backend engineers (Java, Spring Boot, AWS) who are responsible for the ledger, the rules that decide where each portion of a balance can be used, and the migration of existing wallets onto a shared platform.

At FBG, we're revolutionizing sports betting with cutting-edge technology, a customer-first mindset, and a world-class engineering team. You'll have the opportunity to work on complex, high-scale challenges in an exciting and rapidly growing industry, as part of a team that values innovation, integrity, and excellence.

Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Ownership

• Lead an engineering team that owns the ledger and balance services for customer funds, where correctness, auditability, and availability are key.

• Drive operational excellence by setting high standards for security, reliability, observability, and on-call practices.

• Lead the phased migration of existing business wallets onto the shared ledger, including reconciliation, cutover, and rollback planning that avoids customer-visible downtime.

• Partner with Finance, Legal, and Compliance on fund attribution between businesses, settlement, chargebacks, and audit requirements.

• Identify and resolve technical and operational risks before they affect the business.

Team Performance & Delivery

• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team through hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development.

• Define and execute a roadmap that balances new capabilities, migration work, technical health, and operational load. Plan team capacity honestly, make tradeoffs visible, and hold the team to the commitments it makes.

• Deliver maintainable, scalable software that handles high transaction volume without losing or double-counting a transaction.

• Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, take part in architectural decisions, and unblock engineers.

Communication, Stakeholder Management & Product Partnership

• Communicate clearly with engineers, Product, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and executive stakeholders.

• Build partnerships with the Payments team and with the teams in other Fanatics businesses that depend on the balance, and agree on ownership boundaries.

• Write and present clear documentation, including roadmaps, vision documents, design reviews, and incident reviews.

• Represent the balance platform's technical perspective in broader company planning.

Navigating Complexity & Ambiguity

• Lead the team through open questions that span engineering, finance, and regulation, using structured and data-informed approaches.

• Bring Product, Legal, Finance, and Engineering viewpoints together to make decisions that hold up over time.

• Provide clarity as requirements change, new businesses onboard, and regulatory expectations evolve.

Travel

• Must be open to occasional travel to Fanatics Betting & Gaming offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team building activities.

Qualifications

We value aptitude and integrity over years of experience, but here are key skills that will make you successful in this role:

• 3-5+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of delivering secure, scalable systems in regulated or high-stakes environments.

• Background leading teams or contributing in a Java and AWS ecosystem preferred.

• Experience with ledgers, wallets, balance services, payments, or other financial systems of record is highly desirable.

• Understanding of transactional consistency, idempotency, and data modeling in systems where accuracy cannot be compromised.

• Experience with event-driven architectures and message streaming platforms such as Kafka.

• Experience leading migrations of live, high-traffic systems with minimal customer impact.

• Ability to balance strategic direction with technical depth.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to influence across Engineering, Product, Finance, Legal, and Compliance.

• Experience working through complex, cross-functional, and regulatory challenges.

• Commitment to operational excellence and to building systems that people can trust.

• Passion for mentoring and developing engineers, and for fostering a culture of accountability, empathy, and innovation.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Ranges will change based on country and state of residence, which are reflected in Geographical Zones defined by Fanatics Betting and Gaming. The range incorporates all of our Geographical Compensation Zones and is subject to change as the Zone associated with the actual offer is confirmed. In addition to the base and bonus, full-time employment, and more. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

Salary Range

$190,000—$237,500 USD

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it here.

jobs.title: Sr. Speaker Programs Manager
jobs.description:
Sr. Speaker Programs Manager

Reports To: Senior Manager, Speaker Programs

Department: Corporate Marketing

Location: Remote

Position Summary

Natera is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Sr. Speaker Programs Manager to support day to day operations within the Speakers Program Office.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Speaker Programs, the Sr. Speaker Programs Manager will serve as a primary operational resource for field representatives, speaker faculty, and cross-functional partners. This role will support  speaker program operations:including nomination, contracting, compliance, honorarium and expense processing, and payment.

The ideal candidate brings prior experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or commercial operations supporting diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device organizations, and thrives in a high-volume, detail-driven environment.

Operations & Compliance

• Manage speaker programs operations for assigned business unit(s), ensuring consistency, compliance, and operational rigor at every stage.

• Maintain accurate program records, documentation, and audit-ready files in accordance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements.

• Proactively identify gaps or risks in program workflows and escalate issues to the Associate Director in a timely manner.

• Support audit readiness by ensuring all speaker program files are complete, accurate, and organized per compliance and Legal requirements.

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for field representatives (AMMs and sales teams) and physician speakers on questions related to program requirements, timelines, status, and compliance obligations.

• Respond to inquiries promptly and accurately, applying a thorough understanding of program policies, SOPs, and applicable healthcare regulations.

• Contribute to onboarding and training materials to help new field personnel and speakers understand program requirements and workflows.

Honorarium & Expense Management

• Manage honorarium and expense reimbursement lifecycle: collect, review, and submit required documentation for payment processing.

• Submit approved payment requests to Accounts Payable in accordance with established deadlines and contracted payment timelines.

• Track payment status for each speaker engagement and proactively escalate any delays or discrepancies to Finance and the Associate Director.

Speaker Nomination & Contracting Process

• Oversee speaker nomination and contracting process, coordinating across commercial and medical stakeholders to move nominees through vetting, onboarding, and credentialing steps efficiently.

• Manage contracting workflows in partnership with Legal and Compliance, ensuring fair market value (FMV) compliance, proper documentation, and timely execution of all speaker agreements.

• Serve as the operational coordinator for speaker onboarding and annual recertification processes, ensuring all requirements are met on time.

Reporting & Operational Support

• Maintain and update program tracking tools, dashboards, and databases to support accurate and timely reporting on speaker utilization, payment status, and program activity.

• Contribute to regular program status reports and business reviews prepared by the Associate Director for senior leadership.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying administrative inefficiencies and recommending process enhancements.

• Assist in the coordination of speaker training events, program logistics, and other operational activities as needed.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree required.

• 5-7 years of experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or commercial operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of healthcare compliance requirements, including HCP contracting, fair market value (FMV), and industry codes of conduct (PhRMA, AdvaMed).

• Experience managing high-volume administrative workflows with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with physician speakers, field sales representatives, and cross-functional partners.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

• Experience working directly with Compliance and Legal teams on HCP contracting and payment-related processes.

• Familiarity with honorarium and expense reimbursement workflows and Accounts Payable coordination.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce.com (SFDC) or similar CRM platforms for program tracking and reporting.

• Experience supporting multiple therapeutic areas, product lines, or business units simultaneously.

• Knowledge of speaker bureau management platforms and event management tools.

• Experience in a remote-first, cross-functional work environment.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$99,700—$124,600 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
As a member of the ShipBob Team, you will...

• Grow with an Ownership Mindset: We champion continuous learning and innovation. You'll take on real problems, create tangible solutions, and drive results that move the needle for ShipBob, our merchants, and for your own professional growth. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career, this is the place.

• Collaborate with Peers and Leaders Alike: At ShipBob, leaders are accessible; feedback flows in both directions, and everyone, regardless of their seniority or role, steps up to help when needed. We hold each other to high standards because we trust each other to meet them. That combination of transparency and mutual respect is what makes the work here feel worth doing.

• Experience a High-Performance Culture and Clear Purpose: We are results-driven and clear about what that means: our goals are specific, accountability is shared, and every team member can see how their work connects to our mission. When we hit milestones, we celebrate them together. When we fall short, we learn and move forward.

Start Date: 1/25/2027

Compensation: $55,000 base + Sales Incentive Compensation

Location: Hybrid – Mondays & Fridays (Remote) and Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday (Onsite) at ShipBob Headquarters (120 N Racine Ave #100, Chicago, IL 60607)

*Ability to graduate to fully remote after 12-months if in good standing.

Role Description:

Our Business Development Representatives (BDRs) identify and evaluate growing, small to mid-sized ecommerce brands, exploring tech-driven supply chain solutions using the full suite of ShipBob's services. A BDR’s main goal is to set qualified meetings with our Account Executives and achieve a monthly quota by meeting or exceeding expected metrics for outbound outreach and demos set and converted.

The BDR role is a great fit for candidates looking to develop their skills and grow within their sales career. You’ll start your first month at ShipBob with a comprehensive onboarding program designed to set you up for success. You’ll learn the ins and outs of the role through industry, product, and sales training, practicing your skills, and shadowing experienced BDRs. Along the way, you'll get hands-on experience with tools like Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, and 6sense, and build skills in data analysis for sales insights, prospecting strategies, negotiation, and consultative selling. Together, these will give you a strong foundation for long-term success in sales.

Start as a BDR and unlock opportunities to grow your career across the organization, with promotion eligibility beginning at 9–18 months. This role will report to a Manager, Business Development.

What you’ll do:

• Drive Growth: Source new business by identifying, researching, and qualifying new leads weekly, resulting in 10+ prospects added to your book of business per day.

• Proactive Outreach: Engage a prospect pipeline via high volume multi-channel outreach (outbound cold calls, emails and social selling) leading to 40+ dials, 6+ connected calls, and 25+ minutes of talk time daily.

• Engage Decision-Makers: Connect with key stakeholders at target companies to understand their current operations and determine alignment with our solutions.

• Advocate & Advise: Flag non-ICP merchant opportunities to leadership for book of business refinement.

• Collaborate for Success: Schedule qualified demos for Account Executives and help drive deals forward through strategic partnership.

• Own the Metrics: Meet and exceed daily activity benchmarks and contribute consistently to monthly and annual revenue goals.

• 1:1 Coaching: Connect weekly on 1:1’s with your manager, a dedicated mentor and with the Account Executive team to keep a pulse on industry trends, competitive movements, and evolving market needs to inform outreach strategy and messaging.

• Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary.

What you’ll bring to the table:

• 1-2 years of outbound BDR or SDR experience preferred; however, strong candidates with demonstrated coursework or internship experience in sales encouraged to apply.

• Experience cold calling and smart selling to various types of businesses or merchants.

• A coachable mindset: you seek feedback, apply it quickly, and consistently improve.

• A high degree of diligence and accountability.

• Comfortable in a competitive environment, with evidence of personal ambition.

• Relentless persistence in the face of daily rejection and delays from potential merchants.

• An aptitude for research and understanding data.

• A plus: Exposure to account-based prospecting, including building relationships with multiple contacts within a company.

Perks & Benefits:

• Medical, Dental, Vision & Basic Life Insurance

• Paid Maternity/Parental Leave Program

• Paid Holidays & Flexible Time Off Program

• Paid Sick Leave

• Wellness Days (1 day/quarter)

• 401K Match

• Comprehensive Benefits Package >>> https://www.shipbob.com/careers/

• See Our High-Performing Culture >>> Check us out on Instagram (@lifeatshipbob)

#LI-JN1

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence; therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions.

About You:

Building the world’s leading full-stack fulfillment platform is challenging work. The problems we solve are complex, the pace is fast, and the bar is high. That means ShipBob’s environment isn’t the right fit for everyone, and that’s okay. If you are ready to take ownership, push boundaries, and grow alongside a team that genuinely supports each other, we would love to hear from you.

Learn more about our core values and how we perform at a high level in our day-to-day work on our Culture page (https://www.shipbob.com/careers/culture/).

About Us:

ShipBob is a leading global supply chain and fulfillment technology platform designed for SMB and Mid-Market ecommerce merchants to provide them access to best-in-class capabilities and to deliver a delightful shopper experience. Merchants can outsource their entire fulfillment operations, utilize ShipBob’s proprietary warehouse management system for in-house fulfillment, or take advantage of a hybrid solution across ShipBob’s dozens of fulfillment center network in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. ShipBob is backed by leading investors like Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, Hyde Park Venture Partners, and SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and is one of the fastest-growing tech companies headquartered in Chicago.

At ShipBob, every full-time employee gets access to our best-in-class AI and productivity tools from Day 1 at no cost. This isn't a pilot or a perk for select teams. It's standard for everyone. We believe innovation isn't owned by one department. Whether you're in Talent, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or Customer Success, we expect you to ask: how can this be done better, faster, or smarter? These tools are our investment in your ability to find those answers.

Use of AI-Assisted Tools During Recruitment

We may use AI-assisted tools during the recruitment process to support administrative functions such as transcribing interviews, generating summaries or notes, organizing interview feedback, facilitating candidate communications, and helping recruiters identify candidates whose qualifications may align with job requirements. These tools are designed to assist our recruiting team and are not used to make final hiring decisions. Hiring decisions are made by trained human reviewers who consider the candidate's application, interview performance, qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors. AI-assisted tools do not independently determine whether a candidate advances in the hiring process or receives an offer of employment. Where required by applicable law, candidates will be provided with notice regarding our use of AI-assisted technologies and, where available, information about any applicable rights relating to such processing, including the ability to request additional information or opt out of certain AI-assisted processing activities. Candidates who exercise available opt-out rights may be reviewed through alternative processes consistent with applicable law.

ShipBob provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

There is no deadline to apply for this position, as ShipBob accepts applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Help Desk Supervisor
jobs.description:
Information Technology | The Problem Solvers

We are a 1,000-piece puzzle. Each of us is essential, interconnected, and intentionally designed. Together, we create something powerful: media that matters, growth that lasts, and a culture we are proud to build.

As part of our Information Technology team, you're one of The Problem Solvers, helping make sure our people have the tools, systems, and support they need to do their best work. From resolving everyday technology challenges to keeping our teams connected across offices, our IT team brings the expertise, responsiveness, and thoughtful solutions that keep the agency moving. We believe great technology should make work easier, not more complicated, and that the support we provide behind the scenes has a direct impact on the work we bring to life.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As our Help Desk Supervisor, you'll report directly to the IT Infrastructure Manager and lead the frontline support team responsible for keeping Attention Arc's people productive, connected, and supported. You'll oversee daily help desk operations, guide and develop our IT Help Desk Technicians, and ensure technology issues are resolved with the right balance of speed, accuracy, and care.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has built a strong foundation in technical support and understands how to translate that expertise into a reliable, people-first service experience. You'll bring structure to help desk operations, confidence to complex technical challenges, and a proactive approach to identifying issues before they disrupt our teams.

You'll also be a trusted partner across the agency, supporting everything from everyday technology needs to high-priority client presentations, agency events, and system rollouts. You'll help connect frontline support with our broader IT infrastructure priorities, ensuring our technology experience keeps pace with the needs of a growing, performance-driven media agency.

Key Responsibilities

Help Desk Operations & Service Delivery

• Lead day-to-day IT help desk operations, ensuring support requests are properly triaged, prioritized, assigned, and resolved within established service-level agreements (SLAs).

• Manage the IT ticketing system, including ticket workflows, escalation procedures, service categories, and reporting, to maintain a consistent and responsive support experience.

• Monitor incoming requests, ticket backlogs, resolution times, and recurring issues, proactively addressing service gaps and opportunities for improvement.

• Serve as the escalation point for complex hardware, software, connectivity, and user-access issues, partnering with the IT Infrastructure Manager or external vendors when additional expertise is needed.

• Establish clear support processes and service expectations that help employees receive timely, accurate, and thoughtful assistance.

• Develop and maintain internal documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and self-service resources to improve support consistency and efficiency.

Team Leadership & Development

• Directly supervise, schedule, coach, and support Tier 1 and Tier 2 IT Help Desk Technicians, ensuring appropriate coverage and clear accountability across the team.

• Provide technical guidance and escalation support, helping technicians build troubleshooting skills, confidence, and sound judgment.

• Set performance expectations, provide ongoing feedback, and conduct performance evaluations that support individual development and team effectiveness.

• Identify training needs and create opportunities for technicians to expand their technical knowledge, customer service capabilities, and problem-solving skills.

• Foster a collaborative, service-oriented team environment where people feel supported, take ownership, and work together to solve challenges.

• Partner with the IT Infrastructure Manager to align help desk staffing, priorities, and development needs with broader IT objectives.

Technical Support & Agency Technology

• Provide advanced troubleshooting and support across Windows and macOS environments, including desktops, laptops, peripherals, operating systems, and standard business applications.

• Support collaboration and productivity platforms, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Teams, and other agency technology tools.

• Assist employees using creative and production applications, including Adobe Creative Cloud and video editing software, escalating specialized issues when needed.

• Troubleshoot common network connectivity, VPN, wireless access, cloud storage, and file-sharing issues, including workflows involving large media and creative assets.

• Coordinate technology support for time-sensitive agency activities, including client pitches, presentations, production schedules, town halls, and other high-priority events.

• Work with infrastructure and external technology partners to resolve recurring technical issues and improve the reliability of employee-facing systems.

Employee Technology Lifecycle & Security

• Oversee IT onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring timely account provisioning, access changes, equipment preparation, device recovery, and appropriate documentation.

• Maintain accurate IT asset inventories, including laptops, desktops, peripherals, assigned equipment, and software licenses.

• Support software license tracking and compliance, helping ensure technology resources are appropriately allocated and maintained.

• Reinforce endpoint security practices, including device encryption, patch management, antivirus protection, and mobile device management (MDM) enrollment.

• Support device management through platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, following established agency security policies and procedures.

• Partner with the IT Infrastructure Manager to identify endpoint risks, maintain consistent device standards, and support secure technology access across the agency.

• Coordinate technology access and equipment needs for hybrid employees, remote workers, and approved freelance or contractor resources.

IT Collaboration, Reporting & Process Improvement

• Track and report help desk performance metrics, including ticket volume, response and resolution times, SLA adherence, recurring issues, and employee satisfaction.

• Translate service trends and technical challenges into actionable recommendations for the IT Infrastructure Manager.

• Identify opportunities to streamline support workflows, improve documentation, strengthen self-service resources, and reduce repeat incidents.

• Partner with the IT Infrastructure Manager on technology upgrades, system rollouts, office moves, and other infrastructure initiatives, providing frontline insight and execution support.

• Build strong relationships across departments to understand technology needs, anticipate support challenges, and improve the employee experience.

• Help develop scalable help desk processes that support the agency's continued growth without compromising responsiveness, security, or service quality.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Experience & Technical Expertise

• 5+ years of progressive IT support experience, including at least 1 to 2 years in a team lead, supervisory, or people management capacity.

• Demonstrated experience managing or coordinating Tier 1 and Tier 2 help desk operations, including ticket prioritization, escalations, service-level expectations, and technical troubleshooting.

• Strong hands-on proficiency supporting both Windows and macOS operating systems, devices, applications, and peripherals.

• Experience administering or supporting IT service management and ticketing platforms such as Freshservice, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, or comparable systems.

• Strong understanding of IT asset management, equipment provisioning, software licensing, and employee onboarding and offboarding processes.

• Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi connectivity, and common network troubleshooting practices.

• Experience supporting cloud-based productivity and collaboration tools, including Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, and Microsoft Teams.

• Familiarity with endpoint management and security practices, including device encryption, patching, antivirus tools, and mobile device management.

• Experience using Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or comparable device management platforms.

• Experience supporting creative or production software, including Adobe Creative Cloud and video editing applications, is strongly preferred.

• Understanding of cloud storage, shared drives, permissions, and file-transfer workflows, particularly those involving large creative or media assets.

• Experience managing help desk performance metrics, creating service reports, and improving technical support processes.

• Experience providing technical support for hybrid, remote, and freelance or contractor employees.

• Prior experience within a media agency, advertising agency, production company, or creative services environment is highly preferred.

• IT certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, Microsoft certifications, or Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) are a plus.

• Familiarity with firewall and network security solutions such as WatchGuard, Cisco Meraki, or Check Point SASE is a plus.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud is a plus.

Capabilities

• Technical Problem-Solving: You bring strong troubleshooting skills and a practical approach to diagnosing issues, identifying root causes, and delivering solutions that keep people productive.

• Service-Oriented Leadership: You understand that IT support is ultimately about people. You balance technical expertise with responsiveness, patience, and a commitment to creating a positive employee experience.

• Operational Ownership: You're comfortable managing competing priorities, maintaining service standards, and ensuring critical issues receive the right attention.

• Team Development: You take pride in helping technicians strengthen their skills, build confidence, and grow into greater responsibility.

• Process Improvement: You look for opportunities to make support operations more consistent, efficient, and scalable through better workflows, documentation, and technology.

• Clear Communication: You can explain technical issues in straightforward language, helping employees understand what is happening, what to expect, and how to move forward.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: You build productive relationships across departments and understand how technology needs connect to client work, agency operations, and business performance.

• Adaptability & Composure: You stay organized and solutions-focused when priorities shift, deadlines are tight, or unexpected technology challenges arise.

• Security Awareness: You understand the importance of protecting agency systems, employee information, and client data while maintaining a practical and supportive technology experience.

WHO YOU ARE

At Attention Arc, how you work is just as important as what you deliver. Our core competencies define the skills and behaviors that drive strong performance and meaningful impact:

• Credibility: You bring strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and a commitment to reliable service. You understand the systems and tools our people depend on, and you use your knowledge to solve problems, strengthen processes, and build confidence in the IT support team.

• Clarity: You make technical information understandable and actionable. Whether you're explaining a system issue, setting expectations during an outage, or guiding your team through a complex escalation, you communicate with transparency, patience, and purpose.

• Connection: You recognize that great IT support depends on strong relationships. You collaborate across departments, listen to employees' needs, and create an environment where people feel comfortable asking questions, raising concerns, and working together toward solutions.

• Care: You approach every support request with empathy, accountability, and attention to detail. You understand that a technology issue can affect someone's ability to do their job, and you take responsibility for helping them get back to what matters.

• Culture & Character: You lead by example, take ownership, and hold yourself and your team to high standards. You bring curiosity to challenges, support your colleagues' development, and contribute to a team environment where people feel respected, trusted, and empowered to do their best work.

Together, these behaviors define what it means to do great work here, building trust, driving impact, and creating a culture where people and ideas thrive.

WHO WE ARE

We're a media agency built for brands that value intention. At Attention Arc, we combine deliberate media craft with technology designed to amplify it. We build trusted partnerships so every decision stays aligned with what matters most.

Media doesn't fail because of technology. It fails when intention is missing.

That's why we exist.

To restore intention to media.

At 160 people across four offices in Phoenix, Durham, Irvington, and New York City, we occupy a deliberate sweet spot: big enough to handle major brands and complex business, nimble enough to actually move, make decisions, and drive impact. No unnecessary layers. No slow-moving bureaucracy. Just sharp thinking, fast execution, and tech-enabled expertise.

Our culture is shaped by our values:

• All In: We show up with intensity and ownership.

• No Sidelines: We collaborate without ego or boundaries.

• Move With Curiosity: We ask why, explore boldly, and learn fast.

• Truth With Heart: We communicate with honesty and empathy.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Attention Arc, we believe people do their best work when they feel they belong. Inclusion isn't just about representation, it's about creating an environment where people feel seen, supported, and comfortable showing up as themselves.

We value different lived experiences and perspectives, and actively create space for those voices to shape our work. We're committed to building an agency where everyone has a genuine seat at the table and is trusted to step in and contribute, fostering collaboration, encouraging curiosity, and creating opportunities for people to take ownership and make an impact.

Because when people feel heard, respected, and confident to step forward, we all move forward together.

WHAT WE OFFER

Compensation: The estimated salary range for this role is $90,000 to $115,000. Compensation packages are based on the skill level and experience each candidate brings to the role.

We're committed to rewarding our people fairly and supporting their growth with intention. Our salaries are competitive, thoughtfully benchmarked, and designed to ensure equity across roles, experience, and impact. Growth at Attention Arc isn't tied to a calendar, it's driven by performance, progress, and potential.

We continuously invest in our people through ongoing feedback, development, and opportunities to take on more, so you can keep building your career in meaningful ways.

We know that great work starts with people who feel genuinely supported, inside the office and out. Our benefits are designed with your whole self in mind: your health, your family, your financial future, and your wellbeing day to day.

Here's what you can expect:

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans

• Competitive Parental Leave that gives you time to bond with your family

• Hybrid work model with in-office collaboration

• Mental health support

• Annual agency contribution to 401(k)

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Healthcare FSA

• Commuter benefits and corporate discounts

• Carrot Fertility and family-building support

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Casual work environment, team building, and other social events

LOCATION

We operate on a hybrid, in-office model designed to foster collaboration, mentorship, and hands-on learning. Employees are expected to work from the office three days per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday) to fully experience the energy of our teams and build meaningful connections.

Candidates must reside in and be able to commute to the following office location three days a week:

• 2 Bridge Street Irvington, NY 10533

RIGHT TO WORK IN THE US

You must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer. At this time, we are not sponsoring or providing assistance with obtaining work authorization.

jobs.title: Manager Digital Marketing
jobs.location: IL-Bloomington; MN-Lakeville; WI-Sun Prairie; Open to any Compeer location
jobs.description:
Empowered to live. Inspired to work.
Compeer Financial is a member-owned cooperative located in Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin. We bring together team members with a variety of backgrounds and experiences to help provide financial services to support agriculture and rural communities. Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

How we support you:

• Hybrid model – up to 50% work from home

• Flexible schedules including ample flexibility in the summer months

• Up to 9% towards 401k (3% fixed Compeer contribution plus up to 6% match)

• Benefits: medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, life & AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability, wellness program & EAP

• Vacation, sick leave, holidays/floating holidays, parental leave, and volunteer paid time off

• Learning and development programs

• Mentorship programs

• Cross-functional committee opportunities (i.e. Inclusion Council, emerging professional groups, etc.)

• Professional membership/certification reimbursement and more!

Casual/seasonal & intern team members are not eligible for benefits except for state-mandated programs.

To learn more about Compeer Financial visit www.compeer.com/careers.

Where you will work: This position offers a hybrid work option up to 50% remote and is based out of the Bloomington, IL; Lakeville, MN; or Sun Prairie, WI office locations.

The contributions you will make:  This position provides leadership for digital marketing activities that strengthen client engagement and support organizational and business objectives. The incumbent implements digital marketing strategies and oversees digital experiences, content, performance and roadmap execution across public-facing digital channels. Through people leadership, cross-functional collaboration and data-informed decision making, this position improves digital marketing effectiveness and client experience.

A typical day:

• Leads and develops digital marketing professionals by establishing priorities and performance expectations, providing coaching and feedback, managing performance and building individual and team capability.

• Implements digital marketing strategies and plans that align digital experiences, content and channel priorities with broader marketing direction, business objectives and client needs.

• Directs digital experience and content execution across public-facing digital channels to ensure effective, consistent and client-focused experiences.

• Manages the digital marketing roadmap by prioritizing initiatives, coordinating resources and dependencies, and partnering across functions to deliver enhancements and marketing capabilities.

• Evaluates digital marketing and client engagement performance using relevant measures, analytics and insights to identify opportunities, optimize experiences and inform priorities.

• Partners with marketing, technology and business stakeholders to align digital priorities, resolve competing needs and support effective implementation of digital initiatives.

• Advances digital marketing practices by evaluating emerging capabilities, technologies and industry trends and recommending improvements that strengthen marketing effectiveness and client experience.

The skills and experience we prefer you have:

• Bachelor's degree in marketing, business administration, communications or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the position.

• Minimum seven years of progressively responsible experience in digital marketing, integrated marketing, digital experience or related disciplines.

• Minimum three years of progressive people leadership experience, including responsibility for team performance, coaching, development and work prioritization.

• Experience implementing digital marketing strategies and managing digital initiatives that support organizational or business objectives.

• Experience using digital analytics and performance measures to evaluate marketing effectiveness and inform decisions.

• Experience within financial services, agriculture or another regulated industry, preferred.

• Experience with digital experience platforms, content management systems, CRM platforms or marketing technology, preferred.

• Experience leading cross-functional digital initiatives involving marketing and technology partners, preferred.

• Valid driver's license and ability to travel as needed

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Advanced knowledge of digital marketing practices, digital experiences, content strategy and client engagement.

• Advanced people leadership skills to coach, develop and engage team members while establishing accountability and strengthening team capability.

• Advanced digital marketing planning and execution skills to implement strategies and priorities aligned with broader marketing and business objectives.

• Strong digital experience and content management skills to deliver consistent, client-focused experiences across digital channels.

• Strong analytical and performance measurement skills to interpret digital, client and marketing data and translate insights into improvements.

• Strong roadmap, project and resource management skills to prioritize initiatives, coordinate dependencies and manage competing demands.

• Strong communication, influence and relationship management skills to collaborate across marketing, technology and business functions.

• Solid knowledge of marketing technology, CRM, content management, digital analytics and related digital platforms.

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills to evaluate digital opportunities, resolve issues and balance client, business and technology considerations.

#IND100

How we will take care of you:

Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). The actual title and base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is eligible for variable compensation and other benefits.
