jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At Rox https://rox.com/, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.

Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.

We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.

Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.

Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.


THE TEAM

Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.

Members on our team have:

 - Founded and exited successful companies

 - Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic

 - Won IMO and IOI gold medals

 - Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.


CORE PRINCIPLES


TASTE: CRAFT BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCES.

No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.


OBSESSION: COMMIT UNREASONABLY.

In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.


ACTION: GET IT DONE.

Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.


YOUR ROLE

As Senior Commercial Counsel at Rox, you’ll be our first in-house lawyer. Our product sends email, places calls, researches companies and people across the public web, and acts inside our customers’ CRMs on their behalf, all of it driven by large language models. Our customers are Global 2000 enterprises in regulated industries, and the people our agents reach sit in the US, EU, UK, Canada and APAC. That combination produces legal questions with no settled playbook: who is the controller for enriched contact data, what an autonomous outbound agent must disclose, how responsibility splits when the product runs inside a customer’s own cloud. You’ll work them out, with outside counsel where the law is unsettled, and turn the answers into agreements, policies and product requirements that scale.

You’ll own commercial contracting end to end, run our privacy and communications-compliance programs day to day, and work closely enough with product and engineering to shape features before they ship. Outside general counsel and privacy counsel cover corporate matters and back you on novel questions. This is the first seat in a legal team that will grow with the company. If you’re energized by hard questions at the intersection of enterprise contracting, data privacy and AI, and by the pace of an early-stage company selling to the largest enterprises in the world, we’d love to talk.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own commercial contracting end to end: MSAs, order forms, SOWs, DPAs, security addenda, NDAs and pilot agreements, from first draft through negotiation with Global 2000 legal and procurement teams to signature

 - Build the templates, playbooks and fallback positions that let Sales and Growth close standard deals without a lawyer in the room, and route the exceptions that need one to you

 - Set and defend Rox’s data privacy positions across GDPR and UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA and the other US state laws, PIPEDA and APAC regimes: controller, processor and subprocessor roles across our product, our data and inference providers and customer integrations; cross-border transfers; retention; DPIAs. Run the subprocessor management program across enterprise DPAs with differing notice and consent terms

 - Own communications compliance for a product that outbounds on behalf of sellers: CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL, ePrivacy and PECR, state telemarketing and call-recording laws, do-not-call, consent and suppression. Define what the product enforces by design and what customers warrant, and put both into our agreements and our features

 - Own AI governance: EU AI Act obligations, US state AI laws, bot and automated-communication disclosure rules, FTC guidance on AI claims, and model provider terms. Work out, with outside counsel where the law is unsettled, what Rox commits to on training, data retention, output ownership and indemnification, and keep the AI Use Policy and customer-facing AI documentation current

 - Counsel product and engineering on features and integrations before launch: data flows for the Outbound Agent, Sequences and the dialer, agentic web research, call recording and transcription, CRM and communication-platform integrations and their third-party terms, and customer-hosted (in-VPC) deployments with their shared-responsibility model

 - Negotiate inbound agreements with data, inference, telephony and cloud vendors, and structure partner, reseller and cloud marketplace agreements as the partner ecosystem grows

 - Partner with Security on SOC 2, ISO 27001 and NIST alignment, security questionnaires, incident response and breach notification obligations

 - Coordinate outside counsel on corporate matters (fundraising diligence, IP and trademark, open source compliance) and train the go-to-market and forward deployed engineering teams on contracting and compliance guardrails


QUALIFICATIONS

 - JD and active membership in good standing with at least one US state bar; California preferred

 - 4 to 8 years of legal practice, including at least 2 years in-house at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company or in a technology transactions practice serving them; experience with products that handle customer data at scale or build on large language models is a strong plus

 - Has taken large, complex, heavily negotiated MSAs, DPAs and security addenda with Fortune 500 or Global 2000 legal and procurement teams from first redline to signature, and knows when to hold a position and when to trade it

 - Practical command of data privacy law in the US (CCPA/CPRA and other state statutes) and the EU and UK (GDPR, UK GDPR, ePrivacy), including cross-border transfer mechanisms and controller/processor analysis; Canada (PIPEDA, CASL) and CIPP/E or CIPP/US a plus

 - Working knowledge of marketing and communications compliance: CAN-SPAM, TCPA and state telemarketing and call-recording laws, and the operating practices (consent, suppression, do-not-call, disclosure) that keep automated outreach compliant; CASL and PECR a plus

 - Working knowledge of AI regulation and standards (EU AI Act, US state AI laws, NIST AI RMF) and a solid understanding of how the technology works: inference, context windows, retrieval, agents and tool use, and what each means for where data goes and who is responsible for it

 - Comfortable reading architecture diagrams, data flow maps and API documentation, and able to turn them into accurate contractual commitments and privacy disclosures

 - Has built or materially improved contract templates, playbooks or CLM tooling; experience as a first or early legal hire a plus

 - Familiarity with SOC 2 and enterprise security questionnaires; ISO 27001, regulated industries, public sector or customer-hosted deployments a plus

 - Clear writer and direct communicator who gives answers, takes positions, and is comfortable making calls with incomplete information

 - Be located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco


BENEFITS

 - Competitive pay with considerable equity upside

 - Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents

 - Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability

 - 401(k) with automatic enrollment

 - Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement

 - Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster)

 - Wellness stipend: $375/quarter

 - Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year

 - Internet & cell phone stipend: $25/month

 - Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation

 - Fertility & family-building support, plus backup care membership

 - Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit & parking)

 - SF HQ: daily catered breakfast & lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting to the office


APPLY

To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

jobs.title: Finance Assistant
jobs.description:
At Montu UK, we are transforming access to healthcare, and behind our continued growth is a team of people helping to build a business that makes a genuine difference to patients' lives.

As our business continues to grow, we are looking for a Finance Assistant to join our Finance team. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, has a keen eye for detail and wants to develop their career within a fast-growing and evolving organisation.

We are looking for someone who is organised, proactive and enjoys being part of a team. Whether you have already gained experience in a finance environment or are at the beginning of your career, we want someone who is curious, willing to learn and takes pride in getting the details right.




WHAT IS THE JOB?

As a Finance Assistant, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of Montu UK, helping to ensure our financial records are accurate, payments are processed efficiently and the Finance team has the information it needs to support the wider business.

This is a varied, hands-on role where you will be involved in everything from processing invoices and managing supplier payments to reconciling accounts, reviewing expenses and supporting financial reporting.

You will work closely with colleagues across the Finance team and wider business, helping to maintain accurate financial processes while identifying and resolving discrepancies.

As Montu continues to grow, there will also be opportunities to get involved in additional projects, develop your knowledge and take on greater responsibility.




WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

 - Processing supplier invoices accurately and efficiently, ensuring they are completed in line with agreed procedures and resolving any discrepancies

 - Supporting the administration of weekly supplier payment runs, ensuring all information is collated accurately and deadlines are met

 - Preparing and processing payment run files, submitting completed information for senior management authorisation

 - Creating supplier payments and remittance advice in line with approved payment runs

 - Reconciling bank accounts, supplier statements and financial ledgers, investigating and resolving any differences

 - Reviewing and processing employee expense claims in accordance with company policy, ensuring VAT is recorded accurately

 - Supporting the preparation of financial reports and providing information to team leads and management

 - Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the smooth running of day-to-day finance processes

 - Working collaboratively with colleagues across the business and supporting additional finance projects as required
   
   


WHAT DO YOU NEED?

 - Around 1 to 2 years of experience in a finance, accounts or similar administrative role, although recent graduates are also encouraged to apply

 - Part-qualified AAT, ACCA, CIMA or ACA, or a relevant degree. We will also consider candidates who are qualified by experience or looking to begin their professional studies

 - Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to working with financial information

 - Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines

 - Good communication skills and the confidence to work with colleagues across different teams

 - A proactive attitude, willingness to learn and confidence to ask questions when needed

 - The ability to adapt to changing priorities in a growing and fast-paced business

 - Working knowledge of Xero would be advantageous but is not essential

Above all, we are looking for someone who is reliable, enjoys working as part of a team and is motivated to develop their skills and experience within finance.




WHY JOIN MONTU UK?

 - Generous annual leave: 25 days holiday, increasing to 27 days after one year of service and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

 - Pension scheme: Employer pension contributions of up to 5%

 - Private healthcare: Access to private healthcare benefits

 - Enhanced family leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity benefits

 - Career development: Opportunities to learn, develop and progress within a growing organisation

 - Meaningful work: Be part of a business that is improving patient access to treatment and making a genuine difference to people's lives

 - Collaborative environment: Work alongside a team of people who are passionate about what they do and committed to supporting the continued growth of Montu UK


ABOUT MONTU UK

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPM), dedicated to improving patient access to safe and effective treatments.

Our mission is to transform lives by combining innovative technology with high-quality clinical care, ensuring patients receive the support they need throughout their treatment journey.

As a fast-growing organisation, we offer a collaborative and supportive environment where talented people can develop their careers while contributing to meaningful change in healthcare.

At Montu UK, every team plays an important role in our success, and our Finance team is no exception. By supporting the financial operations of the business, you will be contributing to an organisation that is helping to shape the future of healthcare.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINDAR

Quindar builds modern software for satellite operations, helping teams operate spacecraft with greater speed, clarity, and reliability. We work at the intersection of aerospace, software, and operations, supporting customers who need dependable tools for complex, real-world missions.

About the Role

Quindar is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to develop ground satellite operations software using Python, AWS, and modern web technologies. In this role, you will support mission-unique software development for U.S. government programs, working across backend and frontend systems while also contributing to Quindar’s core product.

You do not need to be a satellite expert to succeed here. We are looking for a strong software engineer who is excited to build reliable, scalable systems in a mission-driven environment.

This is a hybrid role based in Arvada, CO.

 
What You’ll Do

 - Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and cloud-native applications for satellite operations workflows.

 - Develop mission-specific software for U.S. government customers while contributing to Quindar’s core product platform.

 - Design, integrate, and troubleshoot services using AWS technologies such as EC2, S3, RDS, Fargate, EKS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Work across backend and frontend systems, including integration with React, TypeScript, GraphQL, and modern application frameworks.

 - Improve the scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and performance of software used in satellite operations.

 - Build and support containerized and serverless architectures using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Collaborate with satellite operators, customers, product managers, frontend engineers, backend engineers, and other cross-functional partners to understand requirements and deliver new capabilities.

 - Troubleshoot production issues, analyze system behavior, and improve maintainability, resilience, and observability over time.

 - Automate development, deployment, and operational workflows to help teams move quickly and reliably.

What We’re Looking For

 - 4+ years of professional experience in backend development, full-stack engineering, DevOps, or a related software engineering role.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Strong proficiency with Python and experience building production backend services.

 - Experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting APIs, distributed systems, relational and NoSQL databases, caching systems, event-driven systems, and multi-tier architectures.

 - Experience with AWS services and cloud-native development patterns.

 - Hands-on experience with Docker, containerized applications, and Kubernetes systems.

 - Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform or similar.

 - Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript, with experience either developing full-stack or frontend software or closely integrating with frontend engineers.

 - Experience with version control systems such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or similar tools.

 - Strong technical analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting skills.

 - Ability to work independently, manage projects with minimal guidance, and deliver high-quality work on time.

 - High standards for software maintainability, quality, resilience, security, and performance.

 - Strong communication skills across engineering, product, customer, and operations stakeholders.

Nice to Have

 - Experience building React components in TypeScript.

 - Experience with frameworks such as Next.js, Refine, or Vite.

 - Experience with Kubernetes and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, CloudWatch, S3, EFS/EBS, EC2, and RDS.

 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines, especially with GitHub Actions.

 - Experience working on satellite operations, aerospace, defense, or government software systems.

 - Demonstrated self-starting technical ownership, including building or deeply improving a product outside of a traditional professional role.

Why You’ll Love Working at Quindar

 - We work in a cutting edge industry and you will get the opportunity to be part of a small team with a large direct impact on the success of our customers’ space missions!

 - We take work life balance very seriously. We require employees to take 15 days off but provide unlimited PTO and follow most US federal government holidays.

 - Mental health is just as important as physical so we provide quarterly health & wellness benefits.

 - Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family with 100% coverage for employees.

 - We encourage employees to save for retirement and provide 4% 401(k) matching.

 - Each year we have a 4-day company offsite. Previous locations include San Francisco, Nashville, Denver, Santa Fe, New Orleans, San Diego, Bozeman, and New York City.

 - Our culture and company is evolving. You will be key in creating the next major or minor version!

jobs.title: Head of Business Risk & Controls
jobs.description:
About MoonPay
MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.
This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.
AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.
You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.
The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.
 
About the Opportunity
MoonPay is strengthening its control environment as part of its long-term strategy to build a robust, scalable, and compliant platform at the intersection of financial services and digital assets. We are hiring a Head of Business Risk & Controls to build and lead a strong first-line risk and control framework across relevant areas of our business.
This is an opportunity for an experienced financial services controls leader to build and scale a control environment in a fast-evolving industry. You will be responsible for ensuring that risks are effectively identified, appropriate controls are designed and implemented, and their effectiveness is continuously monitored as MoonPay grows.
The role will have a particular focus on fiduciary, custody, and regulated financial services activities, requiring significant experience operating within the US banking environment and a strong working knowledge of applicable regulatory and supervisory expectations.
You will work closely with business leaders and with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and other control functions to establish clear accountability, strengthen first-line ownership, and build a control environment capable of supporting an increasingly complex financial services business.
What You Will Do
Build and own the first-line risk and control framework across relevant MoonPay activities, including risk and control assessments, control standards, documentation, governance, issue management, and ongoing monitoring of control effectiveness.
Embed effective controls into business processes, translating regulatory requirements, policies, identified risks, and supervisory expectations into practical and sustainable controls with clear ownership and accountability.
Establish a robust control monitoring and testing program, identifying control weaknesses, assessing their impact, driving remediation, and providing clear reporting on the effectiveness of the control environment.
Develop the control framework supporting fiduciary, custody, and other regulated financial services activities, ensuring appropriate governance, processes, controls, and monitoring are embedded throughout the relevant business activities.
Partner effectively across the three lines of defence, working with business leaders and independent Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Internal Audit teams to establish clear roles, effective challenge, timely remediation, and strong first-line ownership.
Build for scale and increasing complexity, establishing the procedures, governance, reporting, systems, and operating cadence required to maintain a robust control environment as MoonPay evolves.
About You
You bring 10+ years of relevant experience within US banking or regulated financial services, including significant leadership experience in first-line risk, business controls, operational risk, or a comparable control function.
You have a proven track record as a builder and operator, with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and improving first-line control frameworks spanning risk assessments, control design, monitoring and testing, issue management, remediation, and governance.
You have deep working knowledge of US banking regulation and supervisory expectations, with meaningful experience supporting fiduciary, trust, custody, transaction services, or closely related banking activities.
You have a strong understanding of the three lines of defence model and experience establishing effective first-line ownership while partnering closely with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and senior business stakeholders.
You are comfortable operating in a high-ambiguity, fast-scaling environment, combining strong technical judgement with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and personally drive the development of robust control infrastructure from the ground up.

Salary: 180,000 - 200,000 USD
Salary is based on experience and location in the US

jobs.title: Production Control II
jobs.description:
Summary

The Production Control II role is responsible for ensuring efficient management of production schedules, addressing material shortages, supporting interdepartmental collaboration, and overseeing external service processes. This position requires strong organizational skills, the ability to manage production-related issues, and continuous communication with various departments to ensure that production flows smoothly and that any challenges are resolved in a timely and effective manner. This role is key in maintaining the efficiency and accuracy of operations, driving improvements, and supporting the overall success of production projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Production Problem Resolution

• Confer with production personnel to identify and resolve production challenges.

• Act as a liaison between departments to quickly resolve issues that impact project timelines or production goals.

• Identify any production or project issues that require immediate attention and report them to the Production Control Supervisor.

• Provide regular updates on project status and any concerns that could impact overall production timelines.

Manage Part Shortages o Monitor and track material shortages that may impact production schedules. Report material shortages to the Production Control Supervisor and key stakeholders

• Work closely with SCM to ensure materials are available on time and inventory is managed appropriately.

• Develop contingency plans to resolve issues quickly and minimize schedule disruption.

ERP Schedule Coordination o        Collaborate with the planning department to ensure the ERP system generates an accurate production schedule.

• Monitor schedules and resolve discrepancies or systemic issues.

• Ensure project timelines are maintained and communicate schedule risks proactively.

MIR Operations Accuracy o           Work with planning and quality departments to ensure MIR operations are accurate and compliant with standards.

• Ensure that data is correctly captured and communicated across the appropriate channels.

• Report any discrepancies in MIR processes to the Production Control Supervisor and suggest corrective actions.

Lean Product Flow Improvement:

• Identify and implement opportunities for lean product flow improvement across the production process.

• Work with team members to streamline processes, reduce waste, and improve efficiency.

• Report any obstacles to the Production Control Supervisor and suggest improvements to optimize production workflows.

Manage OSP Requests and Improvements: o           Oversee and track OSP (Outsourced Processes) requests, ensuring timely execution and documentation.

• Evaluate and suggest improvements to OSP processes to enhance overall efficiency and quality.

Engineering Collaboration for Design and Drawing Releases: o Collaborate with engineering to ensure timely drawing releases and the integration of design improvements.

• Ensure that any design changes are properly communicated to the production team.

• Help identify and resolve issues caused by design or drawing discrepancies.

Cross Departmental Communication: o       Maintain open lines of communication with logistics, quality, program management, and other departments to keep all stakeholders informed of project details, progress, and potential issues.

• Ensure that information is communicated in a timely and accurate manner, ensuring smooth operations and collaboration across departments.

Other Duties as Assigned: o          Perform any other duties as assigned by the Production Control Supervisor, in alignment with departmental goals

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies:

• Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications - Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability - Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative - Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence, and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

High School diploma or equivalent required.  Minimum of two years’ relevant experience in an aerospace production environment.  Vocational and technical schooling preferred.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes. required.  Minimum of five years’ relevant experience in an aerospace production environment.  Vocational and technical schooling preferred.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Ability to communicate well with others, both verbally and in written format.

• Mathematical knowledge and ability to apply towards problem solving.

• Ability to prioritize, multi-task effectively, and work under pressure.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Works under minimal supervision.

• Ability to travel.

• Ability to work outside of core business hours, as required.

Physical Requirements.

• Able to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds without assistance and ability to occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds with assistance.

• Able to reach overhead.

Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

Endpoint risk is growing faster than IT and security teams can hire. Automox is the autonomous endpoint management platform built for that reality. About Re:Build Manufacturing

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

Executive Leverage & Strategic Leadership

• Serve as a trusted thought partner and extension of the Chief Digital and Product Officer.

• Take ownership of high-priority initiatives requiring senior-level attention and drive them from definition through execution.

• Translate broad strategic direction into clear priorities, decisions, actions, owners, and milestones.

• Provide independent analysis and perspective to strengthen executive decision-making.

• Evaluate technology trends and determine their practical applicability across Re:Build.

• Pressure-test assumptions and challenge conventional thinking when evaluating opportunities.

• Remain engaged through implementation to ensure recommendations translate into measurable outcomes.

Cross-Functional Execution & Organizational Effectiveness

• Convene stakeholders, establish alignment, clarify decision rights, and resolve obstacles.

• Influence senior leaders and build coalitions without relying solely on formal authority.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Network & Supply Engineer - FTC (6 months)
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract.

About the role

Cloudflare is scaling one of the largest global networks on the Internet, and capacity planning is what keeps that growth ahead of demand. As an Infrastructure Network & Supply Planner on our Infrastructure Capacity Planning team you'll build the products, tools, and AI agents that turn growth and demand forecasts into scalable, execution-ready infrastructure expansions, ensuring the right capacity is in the right place, at the right time and cost, in the shortest time possible.

You'll design and ship internal products — forecasting models, planning systems, dashboards, and automated workflows — that make end-to-end infrastructure readiness faster, cheaper, and more reliable at global scale

You'll refine and create new AI agents to model demand into supply, network, and capacity scenarios and surface risks early, producing force multipliers that let planners see the whole system and act quickly — shifting time from reactive task-processing to proactive strategy, and scaling impact. You'll partner across planning, operations, procurement, logistics, engineering, and finance to keep Cloudflare's global deployments moving smoothly.

What you'll do

Infrastructure Capacity & Expansion Planning

• Translate demand forecasts into infrastructure capacity plans that support business growth, aligning hardware deployments with performance, cost, and timeline targets.

• Ensure infrastructure readiness across space, power, connectivity, and hardware availability, identifying capacity constraints early and coordinating mitigation.

Deployment Planning & Execution Coordination

• Build quarterly and weekly deployment plans that are realistic, balanced, and optimized for execution efficiency across operations, logistics, integration partners, and engineering teams.

• Track progress, resolve blockers, and maintain deployment momentum across the global fleet.

Supply, Inventory & Lifecycle Readiness

• Partner with Procurement and Data Center teams to ensure hardware and resources are available at the right time and locations, and manage inventory to balance availability, cost efficiency, and operational risk.

• Support hardware refresh and asset lifecycle planning, and align infrastructure investments with budget and growth plans alongside Finance.

AI-First Products, Automation & Continuous Improvement

• Design, build, and ship internal products — forecasting models, dashboards, planning systems, and automated workflows — using AI/agentic tooling to structure messy data, run scenario analyses, and improve planning accuracy.

• Identify high-leverage opportunities to automate repetitive work, introduce new tools and methodologies, and continuously improve how planning and deployment operate at scale.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as a central layer across planning, operations, engineering, logistics, procurement, and finance to keep Cloudflare's global deployments moving smoothly.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

• Experience in capacity planning, infrastructure planning, production/operations planning, supply planning, or a related technical planning role.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience across complex operational systems and managing multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.

• Hands-on experience building tools, automation, or internal products

• Fluency with AI tools in daily work, and a genuine appetite to use and create AI/agentic tooling to scale decision-making and eliminate manual toil.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €36,000-50,000.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.description:

Job Summary:

A master scheduler is responsible for coordinating, planning, scheduling, and supervising products throughout their production process or cycle.

A master scheduler performs various functions in ensuring that work being done within a company is performed in a particular order so as to attain efficiency and avoid waste.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review inventory levels versus sales daily

• Establish production schedules based on demand forecast and inventory levels.

• Manage the flow of bulk raw materials, including quantity to be received, versus capacity based on estimated production flow and projected consumption

• Understand systems constraints/limitations to avoid potential scheduling conflicts/waste.

• Monitor and report on Shop Order completions

• Work closely with Plant Management, Materials planners, and Global Supply Chain Planning to develop and execute optimal production schedules and inventory control.

• Monitor and ensure appropriate master data setup and continuous monitoring to align with production processes.

• Ensure continuous feedback with manufacturing to ensure scheduling information is kept up to date, including but not limited to; demonstrated run rates, start times, ends times, resources, BOM’s, scrap rates, CIP times and materials sequence.

• Clearly understand all requirements and constraints at the plant level for a production plan (consideration of min/max batch sizes, resource assignment, materials sequencing on resources, changeover/startup allowances and materials availability.

• Establish raw materials at the sub assembly level to meet production needs while avoiding potential expiry, product returns or waste.

• Create and/or organize a production schedule on a daily basis and update as required based on production results.

• Understand restrictions/capabilities of production lines

• Ensure production that meets customer demand while maximizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.

• Manage interdependent demand flows for incoming raw materials to avoid conflict and/or waste

• Work hand-in-hand with other employees to make sure that all issues that are related to scheduling are properly handled and resolved

• Work closely with Purchasing Team so as to make sure that the company’s supply needs are adequately met in a timely manner and changes to schedule are communicated

• Make sure schedules are given to employees in a timely fashion and that any distortions in the company’s schedule are accounted for always

• Maintain different reporting systems to make sure that all forms of documentation are accurate and also timely.

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor degree in business or equivalent experience

• Minimum 3 years in master scheduling role.

• A minimum of 3 years working experience in a similar position

• Experience working with MRP systems mandatory

• Experience in SAP desired

Skills and Competencies:

• Must have excellent communication skills so as to be able to pass the necessary information to both customers and employees

• Must be able to work in a team environment cordially and effectively, as well as having the ability to lead a team if required to

• Must have excellent interpersonal skills and be able to relate respectfully, cordially, and freely with people (customers, employees, and vendors inclusive)

• Must exhibit a high level of flexibility and an ability to multi-task at all times

• Must be able to work with little or no supervision

• Must possess good reasoning and problem-solving abilities

• Must possess at least a basic knowledge of supply chain activities

• Must have good time management ability so as to be able to meet up with orders and schedules

• Must be able to make use of different data base programs especially Microsoft Excel

jobs.title: Director of Business Operations - North America
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Director of Business Operations (NorthAm) to join us and do things differently.

This is a critical leadership position designed for a strategic and hands-on leader who will shape the future of our operations across North America. You will not only lead business operations for the region but also proactively identify opportunities for improvement and guide a team of BizOps managers to execute these initiatives.

This is a high-visibility leadership role with significant regional scope. For the right candidate, this position offers a clear succession pathway to senior executive entity leadership in North America. You will serve as the primary operational representative to our regulators and the regional Board of Directors.

What you’ll do.

You will lead the North American operational strategy, directing a matrixed footprint of over 1,000 support and servicing team members located in our European hubs (Budapest and Tallinn), while building out our local teams in Austin and São Paulo.

• Strategic Leadership: Lead the business operations organization in the region, identifying and capitalizing on opportunities to enhance efficiency and performance. You will work closely with global heads to shape the future of the region, including location strategy and capacity planning.
• Team Leadership: Lead and develop a small team of high-performing BizOps managers, guiding them to execute on key operational improvements.
• Regulatory & Board Representation: Represent our operations confidently and credibly in front of regulators and our board of directors.
• Expansion and Growth: Collaborate with the North American leadership team on strategic expansion into new markets and regions.
• Talent Development: Grow and mentor local operational leaders, hire new talent, and establish effective local ways of working, including hybrid models and career growth opportunities.
• Execution in a Flat Structure: Embrace our flat organizational structure by being a leader who can both strategize and execute, getting your hands dirty to solve problems and drive projects forward.

Accountability & Success Metrics.

Your success will be measured by your ability to scale our regional operations efficiently and sustainably.

While you will ultimately hold accountability for regional servicing metrics (including SLAs, efficiency targets and resolution quality), your primary focus will be on driving structural improvements. You will work in lockstep with our product teams to build forward-looking infrastructure that upgrades our operations.

• Operational Excellence: Proactively identify systemic operational vulnerabilities, lead high-impact automation projects, and drive contact deflection strategies to scale our volume without linearly scaling headcount.
• Strategic Planning: Translate product requirements into a sustainable servicing model and formulate both long-term strategies and actionable 6-month plans.
• Data-Driven Decisions: Build, track and execute against robust KPIs, using data to uncover operational insights and eliminate customer friction points.
• Location and Talent Strategy: Act as a "local office leader", owning decisions on location changes, and contributing to our hybrid work strategy. You will also provide key input into forecasting and hiring decisions.

We are looking for a seasoned leader with a proven ability to operate at a senior level in a dynamic, product-driven environment.

Essential:

• Experience: A minimum of 7+ years of experience in senior operational leadership roles within FinTech or at US banks.
• Leadership in Scale-Up Environments: A highly successful track record in senior operational leadership, with a sophisticated approach to managing people, processes, and fast-moving organizational change. You must have a demonstrated ability to execute and scale within complex, tech-driven operations or product-led servicing environments.
• Regulatory and Board Experience: Proven experience representing operations to regulators and a board of directors.
• Product Partnership: A track record of working in true partnership with product teams to build effective solutions for support challenges.
• Analytical & Data-Driven: You must be able to build and execute against KPIs and use data to solve complex problems and find insights.
• Local Market Knowledge: A strong understanding of the laws, culture, and regulations within the US market.

Leading at Wise

Our 4D leadership framework, defined by four key attributes, captures what it means to be an impactful leader at Wise. Our unique culture gives teams and individuals the autonomy to make impactful decisions for our customers. Leaders empowr their teams to deliver this impact and champion our culture.

• Design: Our leaders design the strategic direction, empowering their teams to operate autonomously and make data-driven decisions that directly benefit our customers.
• Drive: They drive a high-performing culture by acting as a coach, nurturing an environment of continuous development and growth.
• Develop: Leaders actively develop resilience and emotional intelligence to lead authentically and by example.
• Disrupt: They disrupt the status quo by championing change and innovation, constantly seeking new ways to achieve our mission.

For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders  — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.

Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

jobs.title: Credentialing Specialist
jobs.description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.

As a Credentialing Specialist at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a Credentialing Specialist who will be responsible for first line management of the credentialing associate team. They will train the team on the tasks that the associates are responsible for completing day to day. As new processes and systems are adopted by the organization, they will be responsible for researching how the team will interact with them then implement those processes and systems. They will also document all knowledge of the BetterHelp Insurance Credentialing workflows then use that documentation to train the team and then improve those processes.

This person will work with the Credentialing Team Lead to monitor the performance of the associate team and provide feedback to the team and our contracting partner, TekSystems. They will also help with answering questions from other BH teams and internal credentialing team members and the Credentialing Team Lead will assign additional projects to this person as the need arises.

What will you do?

• Supervision of the credentialing associate team

• Training of the credentialing associate team

• Documentation of all BetterHelp Insurance Credentialing processes Analyze and update processes to improve as needed

• Provide day-to-day guidance, training, and support to credentialing associates and internal BetterHelp team

• Identify and problem solve inefficiencies in credentialing and recredentialing processes

• Develop and maintain the credentialing team’s relationship with other BetterHelp Teams

• Track application statuses, credentialing deadlines, and recredentialing timelines to ensure timely completion. Analyze and update processes to improve timelines

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date provider information in internal databases and Verifiable.

• Liaise with CVO to resolve any issues or delays in the credentialing process.

• Provide regular updates to leadership on key metrics and process improvements.

What will you NOT do?

• You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.

• You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.

• You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.

• You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.

• You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.

Can I work remotely?

Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.

• Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.

Benefits

jobs.title: Driller Assistant (Helper)
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

The Driller Assistant works alongside the Driller to support  drilling for mineral exploration and resource definition at our open-pit copper mine. The role focuses on safe rig operations, careful core handling and recovery, equipment care, and following health, safety and environmental standards. Experience with reverse circulation (RC), air rotary or water-well drilling carries over well. It's a strong entry point for anyone looking to build a career toward Driller. Help us build the world's first fully autonomous mine.

Responsibilities

 - Help the Driller safely set up, move and tear down the drill rig and drill pad

 - Handle rods, core barrels, casing and tooling while tripping in and out of the hole

 - Pull, clean, measure, label and box core accurately, with good contamination control

 - Mix and manage drilling fluids, and maintain water lines, pumps and supply systems

 - Do pre-start inspections, greasing, lubrication and basic maintenance on the rig, compressors, pumps and support equipment

 - Help keep drill logs, footage drilled, consumables used and daily reports

 - Keep an inventory of bits and supplies, and let the Driller know when stock is low

 - Recognize changes in ground conditions and flag them to the Driller and geologist

 - Keep the drill pad and equipment area clean and organized

 - Handle equipment breakdowns and emergencies with a calm, safety-first approach

Qualifications

 - Experience as a driller's helper, offsider or rig hand, or comparable hands-on field, construction or mechanical work

 - Diamond core, reverse circulation (RC) or water-well drilling experience is a plus

 - Strong mechanical aptitude and willingness to learn drilling techniques and equipment

 - Real commitment to safety and following procedures

 - Valid driver's license; CDL is a plus

Schedule

 - 7 days on / 7 days off, 12-hour day shifts

Working Environment & Physical Requirements

 - Work 12-hour shifts outdoors on drill pads and rugged terrain, in all weather and extreme temperatures

 - Lift at least 50 lbs, with exposure to dust, noise, vibration and diesel

 - Wear all required PPE (hard hat, steel toes, safety glasses, hi-vis, hearing protection, and a respirator when required)


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

Standing

Walking

Sitting

Lifting

Requires

jobs.title: Speaker Programs Manager
jobs.description:
Speaker Programs Manager

Reports To: Associate Director, Speaker Programs

Department: Corporate Marketing

Location: Remote

Position Summary

Natera is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Speaker Programs Manager to support day to day operations within the Speakers Program Office.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Speaker Programs, the Speaker Programs Manager  will serve as an operational resource for field representatives, speaker faculty, and cross-functional partners. This role will support  speaker program operations: including nomination, contracting, compliance, honorarium and expense processing, and payment.

The ideal candidate brings prior experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or customer success supporting diagnostics, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical device organizations, and thrives in a high-volume, detail-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

Operations & Compliance

• Manage speaker programs operations for assigned business unit(s), ensuring consistency, compliance, and operational rigor at every stage.

• Maintain accurate program records, documentation, and audit-ready files in accordance with company SOPs and regulatory requirements.

• Proactively identify gaps or risks in program workflows and escalate issues to the Associate Director in a timely manner.

• Serve as the go-to operational resource for all speaker program activity, providing real-time status visibility to internal stakeholders.

• Act as the primary liaison between Area Marketing Managers (AMMs) and the Compliance team, managing escalation communications on program-related issues.

• Track open compliance issues and escalations through to resolution, maintaining complete documentation of all communications and outcomes.

• Support audit readiness by ensuring all speaker program files are complete, accurate, and organized per compliance and Legal requirements.

Stakeholder Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for field representatives (AMMs and sales teams) and physician speakers on questions related to program requirements, timelines, status, and compliance obligations.

• Respond to inquiries promptly and accurately, applying a thorough understanding of program policies, SOPs, and applicable healthcare regulations.

• Contribute to onboarding and training materials to help new field personnel and speakers understand program requirements and workflows.

Honorarium & Expense Management

• Manage honorarium and expense reimbursement lifecycle: collect, review, and submit required documentation for payment processing.

• Submit approved payment requests to Accounts Payable in accordance with established deadlines and contracted payment timelines.

• Track payment status for each speaker engagement and proactively escalate any delays or discrepancies to Finance and the Associate Director.

Speaker Nomination & Contracting Process

• Oversee speaker nomination and contracting process, coordinating across commercial and medical stakeholders to move nominees through vetting, onboarding, and credentialing steps efficiently.

• Manage contracting workflows in partnership with Legal and Compliance, ensuring fair market value (FMV) compliance, proper documentation, and timely execution of all speaker agreements.

• Serve as the operational coordinator for speaker onboarding and annual recertification processes, ensuring all requirements are met on time.

Reporting & Operational Support

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree required.

• 3–5 years of experience in speaker bureau execution, HCP engagement, or customer success.

• Knowledge around healthcare compliance requirements, including HCP contracting, fair market value (FMV), and industry codes of conduct (PhRMA, AdvaMed).

• Experience supporting high-volume administrative workflows with strong attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple priorities simultaneously.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with physician speakers, field sales representatives, and cross-functional partners.

• Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

• Familiarity with honorarium and expense reimbursement workflows and Accounts Payable coordination.

• Hands-on experience with Salesforce.com (SFDC) or similar CRM platforms for program tracking and reporting.

• Knowledge of speaker bureau management platforms and event management tools.

• Experience in a remote-first, cross-functional work environment.

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.

Remote USA

$85,000—$110,000 USD

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. jobs.title: Architectural Engineer, Structural Systems
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

In this role, you’ll translate the structural needs of our production equipment into real, permitted, built facilities. A large part of your work will be designing the foundations – concrete slab, equipment foundations, piles, and steel support structures – that carry our heavy and precision machinery. You’ll work directly with equipment OEMs to intake loads, anchoring, vibration, and tolerance requirements and turn them into engineered foundation drawings. You’ll be Hadrian’s primary point of contact with our external Architect and General Contractor partners and shape the early structural and foundation requirements driven by equipment selection and operational flow, inform site selection, and lead structural schematic design through to construction. 

This is a role for someone who makes forward progress through ambiguity, takes smart calculated risks, and treats schedule and budget as real design constraints. Ultimately, you’ll partner closely with engineering to intake requirements and turn them into a built reality on schedule and on budget. 




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Structural & Foundation Requirements Partnership: Intake structural requirements from engineering, geotechnical surveys, and OEM equipment vendors. Lead the development of the equipment foundations structural scope from initial concept evaluations through completion of construction drawings for permitting and on-site execution.  

Equipment Foundation Design & OEM Coordination: Design equipment foundations, concrete slabs, and steel support pedestals for heavy and precision manufacturing equipment. Work directly with equipment OEMs to capture load, anchoring, vibration, and tolerance requirements. Engineer anchor bolt and embed details that connect equipment and steel framing to concrete. 

Schedule & Problem Solving: Strategically identify critical path items relating to structural design, procurement, and construction phases including long-lead concrete, rebar, and structural steel. Manage the critical path and any blockers. Apply first-principles thinking to recover lost time and protect delivery milestones. 

Design Collaboration: Collaborate closely with manufacturing, construction, facilities, geotechnical, and cross-disciplinary teams to address end-user requirements, resolve integration challenges, and coordinate structural systems against architectural, mechanical, and electrical designs so everything stays compatible with the design intent. 




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor’s degree in Architectural Engineering, Civil or Structural Engineering, or a related field. 

 - Professional licensure (PE preferred), or clear progress toward it; SE license a plus. 

 - 5+ years of experience in structural or building-systems design. 

 - Experience designing for new manufacturing or production facilities, ideally in environments with engineering and production complexity comparable to Hadrian’s. 

 - Experience designing concrete foundations and equipment foundations – slab-on-grade, pads, pedestals, and anchorage for heavy or precision equipment. 

 - Working knowledge of structural codes and standards (e.g., IBC, ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC 360) and foundation design for industrial facilities. 

 - Proficiency with Procore or an equivalent construction management platform. 

 - Willingness to travel up to 25%. 




WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience in highly regulated or high-consequence industries (nuclear, energy, aerospace, defense, advanced manufacturing). 

 - Direct experience coordinating with equipment OEMs to design and qualify equipment installations against load, anchoring, and tolerance requirements. 

 - Familiarity with foundations for dynamic equipment (e.g., ACI 351.3R) and vibration-isolation design for rotating/reciprocating or vibration-sensitive machinery. 

 - Experience designing for crane and overhead material-handling loads (e.g., AISC Design Guide 7, CMAA). 

 - Proficiency with structural analysis and modeling software (e.g., SAP2000, ETABS, STAAD, RISA) and Revit/AutoCAD. 

 - Excellent interpersonal skills for interfacing with diverse engineering disciplines, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaborative problem-solving. 

 - Practical knowledge of field installation methods, means, and materials, including troubleshooting real-world constructability issues and adapting designs for on-site efficiency. 

 - Exposure to design-for-construction or design-for-operations efforts. 

 - Experience working on expedited timelines or in fast-paced industries. 




COMPENSATION

For this role, the target salary range is $106,000 - $181,000 (actual range may vary based on experience).

This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee's pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans for employees 
   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen or national, lawful permanent resident, protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

 


USE OF AI IN HIRING

Hadrian uses AI-assisted tools in our recruiting and hiring processes to help our team work more efficiently. This may include tools that help organize and analyze recruiting data, as well as an AI-powered notetaker that can record and transcribe interviews and help coordinate feedback. These tools support our team and are not used to make hiring decisions. All candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are performed by humans. If an interview will be recorded, you will be notified in advance and may opt out at any time with no impact on your candidacy. Candidate data processed through these tools is subject to the same protections described in our Privacy Policy https://www.hadrian.co/privacy-policy.

 


CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY

Hadrian will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws. We do not ask about criminal history on our application, and we do not consider criminal history before making a conditional offer of employment.

 


HADRIAN IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
