jobs.title: Medical Director (Sign on Bonus!)
jobs.description:
About Hopscotch Primary Care

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we believe great healthcare should be accessible to all people across all communities.  Today, almost 20% of Americans live in a rural community, yet only 11% of physicians practice in those same communities.  We are on a mission to transform healthcare in rural America.  We provide high-quality primary care tailored to meet the needs of our patients through our robust care model and comprehensive care team, delivering care in our clinics, and across settings, and wrapping resources around the patients who need them most.

Our patients and the care teams who serve them sit at the center of everything we do at Hopscotch.  Hopscotch Primary Care takes a team approach to serve patient needs and provide the best care possible.  Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.

Today, we are serving thousands of patients in our value-based care model and the number is growing every day.  If you want to bring your experience, skill and passion to make a lasting impact in healthcare, we’d like to meet you.

Join Us on Our Mission to Transform Healthcare!

Hopscotch Primary Care takes a team approach to serve patient needs and provide the best care possible.  Our goal is to provide the care each of us would want for ourselves or for our family members, in the right setting, and at the right time.  The Hopscotch Care Team is responsible for delivering high-touch, high-quality care to patients, including coordination of care across different physicians and the broader healthcare continuum. Unique benefits of this position include:

Flexible schedule options available for this role!

• Dedicated MA and Clinical Documentation Specialist so that you can focus on the patient, not the paperwork.

• Longer appointment times, with preparation and charting time built in

• Smaller patient panels to allow for more customized care

• Average 15 patients per day

• Interdisciplinary care teams on site to support each patient’s wellness needs

• AI software dictation support

• Competitive salary and bonus structure

• Generous Time Away From Work program

• Annual CME funding and dedicated days to use it

• NHSC loan repayment options

• Opportunities for advancement in a growing organization

• Organizational culture rooted in the values of: Patients first, team always; Make every moment count; Bring joy to the journey; Data, Insight, Action; and Rise to the challenge

Hopscotch also provides a generous benefits program to add to our total rewards offerings for our team members, including:

• Paid holidays + PTO

• Company sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurance for you + your family

• FREE short-term and long-term disability insurance

• FREE $100k life insurance policy

• 401k plan with 4% company match + no vesting period $720 - $1,000 added to employee Health Savings Account annually for eligible health plans

• Relocation and/or sign-on bonuses available

What You'll Do

As the Medical Director, you will provide day-to-day leadership for the clinic teams and deliver high-quality care, an exceptional patient experience and a best-in-class culture, acting as a Champion of the Hopscotch Care Model and a Culture advocate for your team and your patients. Specifically, you will:

• Provide leadership, oversight and support for the team to drive day-to-day execution against critical priorities to enable high-quality care, a great patient experience, engagement across the team and a best-in-class culture

• Set the curve for Care team and across Care Centers through clear understanding and execution to deliver care in the Hopscotch care model, a commitment to results, quality and excellence and by executing against key workflows and processes to enable the model

• Management of Providers including ensuring all Providers complete administrative tasks and utilize indirect care hours appropriately, managing their panels and completing documentation

• Partner with the Care Center Manager to outperform against target metrics and outcomes, including patient experience, STARS/HEDIS, care coordination, utilization and cost of care, through collaboration and engagement of your clinical care team

• Provide high-quality patient care in the comprehensive and interdisciplinary care model of Hopscotch health to deliver best-in-class outcomes and results for your dedicated patient panel

• Provide direct oversight of your clinical care team, including Hopscotch Advanced Practitioner, Medical Assistant, Care Manager, Community Health Worker and others

• Support the Hopscotch mission and vision through your leadership around talent and culture, clinical innovation and compliance/best practices to enable success

• Represent Hopscotch Health in the community and provides community-based education, engagement, and participation in events such as health fairs/conferences

About You

You’ll be a great fit for this position if you have 5+ years of post-Residency experience and have experience in managing teams.  You must be Board Certified in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine, have an active, non-probationary North Carolina state medical license (or willingness to obtain), and be authorized to work in the US. An ideal candidate will also have:

• Familiarity with innovative clinical models, specifically those that serve high acuity members

• Experience with the Medicare population, including in-home care as well as documentation and compliance requirements

• Experience caring for “at-risk” panel of patients

• Experience using data and insights to drive action in a clinical setting

• Experience leading, teaching, and training others, in both formal and informal ways

You also have a proven track record demonstrating:

• High EQ and a collaborative and trust-driven working style to quickly build relationships, internally and externally, to enable our work and culture.

• Comfort with dynamic and sometimes ambiguous settings, showing the skill to bring a structured, proactive approach to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Ability to learn quickly and leverage critical thinking and perseverance to take initiatives, solve problems, operate with autonomy and succeed in high-pressure situations.

• Willingness to act with courage, lean into conflict and foster the ‘tough’ conversations that need to happen to support our culture and success together

• A service orientation, demonstrating a patient centric mindset, going above and beyond for patient needs and creating a culture where your entire team does the same

From a cultural perspective, you are:

• Committed to excellence and bring a growth mindset to everything you do

• Patient- and mission-focused, with a passion for healthcare and service to the providers who deliver healthcare

• Agile, yet thoughtful and can work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Constantly seeking ways to simplify and improve how things are done, bringing a positive attitude to challenges

• Team-first and lead with humility, setting the tone for others to do the same

• Accountable, holding yourself and others to a high standard and seek to support and develop others

• Willing to roll up your sleeves, bringing a high work ethic and strong collaboration skills to work effectively with people of all backgrounds

• Concise and articulate, drive towards clarity and deliver on your commitments

At Hopscotch Primary Care, we embrace diversity, invest in a culture of inclusion and positivity and encourage all to apply to join our team.  You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Pricing & Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Kin makes life simpler, more affordable, and better for homeowners — especially in the places where climate risks, rising costs, and outdated systems make it harder. We start with smarter homeowners insurance and expand to everything homeowners need to thrive.



Using data, technology, and thoughtful human support, we’re building products that are clear, fair, and help homeowners feel confident — so homeowners aren’t left behind when they need help most.



Founded in 2016, Kin is a remote-first employer with Kinfolk across more than 35 states. We serve customers in 14 states (and counting). Our disciplined growth, strong customer satisfaction, and focus on long-term sustainability fosters outstanding growth, attracts marquee investors, and earns recognition and accolades, including:



 - Built In Chicago's Best Places to Work, Midsize Companies (2021-2026)

 - Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers (2026)

 - Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies

 - Forbes’ Fintech 50 (2023-2026)

 - Great Places to Work Certified (May 2024-May 2027)

Most importantly, we’re building Kin to be a place where people do meaningful work with real impact — for our customers, our communities, and each other. We're excited to tell you more about how you can contribute to our rapid growth, strong unit economics, profitability, and excellent customer ratings. To learn more about how we work and what we’re building, visit kin.com http://kin.com and see how we work https://www.linkedin.com/company/kin-insurance/life/kin/.




THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Pricing & Risk Analyst to help us find where Kin can grow profitably, state by state and segment by segment. As Kin grows, understanding how each state is performing, and why, is central to deciding where to grow and how to price for it. This role sits on our Pricing and Risk Management team and focuses on state growth and segmentation. You'll work alongside state managers and business partners to turn policy, quote, and claims data into practical recommendations.



This is an entry-level role built for someone curious and detail-oriented who wants to learn how analytics shape real pricing and risk decisions. AI is part of how this team works every day. You'll use Databricks Genie, Claude Code, and approved MCP connections to explore data, automate recurring work, and spend more of your time on the questions that matter. Experienced Pricing and Risk colleagues will guide you as you build knowledge of insurance metrics, pricing, segmentation, and state performance. Prior insurance expertise isn't expected, and neither is experience with every tool in our stack.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own recurring state performance reporting on quote volume, quote-to-bind conversion, new business, premium, retention, and loss experience, and investigate what's driving changes in results

 - Analyze performance across geography, risk characteristics, coverage, and distribution channels to surface growth opportunities and segments that need closer review

 - Evaluate how proposed rate changes, underwriting rules, and shifts in business mix could affect growth and profitability

 - Build and maintain competitive research that informs state comparisons and points to potential product or pricing opportunities

 - Use Databricks Genie to explore data, and Claude Code to write SQL queries, build analytical scripts, automate recurring reports, and document findings

 - Bring relevant data and business context into analytical workflows through approved MCP connections

 - Validate data, calculations, and AI-generated outputs; document sources and assumptions, and raise questions early when results look uncertain or inconsistent

 - Deliver clear charts and concise summaries for Pricing and Risk and partner teams, developing recommendations alongside experienced colleagues

 - Measure performance after pricing, underwriting, and product changes go live


SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6–12 months at Kin, success is less about checking boxes and more about the impact you create. You’ll use your skills and judgment to take ownership of meaningful work, improve how we operate, and help move Kin’s mission forward. Along the way, you’ll deliver outcomes that make a real difference for both Kinfolk and the homeowners we serve.




BY THE END OF YOUR FIRST YEAR, YOU SHOULD FEEL CONFIDENT IN YOUR ROLE, TRUSTED AS AN OWNER, AND PROUD OF THE PROGRESS YOU’VE HELPED MAKE.

 - State performance analyses arrive accurate and on time, and the team trusts your explanation of what changed and why

 - The team is acting on profitable state growth opportunities that your analysis helped bring to light

 - Recurring reports run through repeatable AI-assisted workflows instead of manual effort

 - You're independently handling analyses that once required close guidance


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 0–2 years of relevant experience; internships, coursework, and analytical projects count

 - Bachelor's degree in economics, statistics, mathematics, actuarial science, finance, business, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

 - Foundational SQL skills and proficiency with Excel or similar spreadsheet tools

 - Experience analyzing data to identify patterns, investigate questions, and explain findings

 - Hands-on experience using AI for analytical or coding tasks (academic or personal projects count), and a willingness to regularly use and build proficiency in Claude Code, Databricks Genie, and MCP-enabled workflows

 - Attention to detail and the judgment to question and verify AI-generated results before relying on them

 - Ability to explain findings in plain language, stay curious, and manage assignments with guidance



Bonus if you have

 - Familiarity with Claude Code, Databricks Genie, or MCP connections

 - Exposure to P&C insurance, pricing, underwriting, or risk analysis

 - Familiarity with Python, data visualization, or statistical analysis

 - A project showing how you used AI to analyze data, validate results, and communicate a recommendation


HOW WE HIRE

We believe a great hiring experience should be clear, respectful, and human. We’ll accept applications for this position until [insert date]. While our recruiting team uses AI tools for efficiency, resumes are still screened by Kin’s in-house recruiters, and candidate evaluations and hiring decisions are made by recruiters and hiring teams. Rest assured, real people make real decisions.



The hiring process and timeline for each role will vary, depending on the position. However, here are some things you can expect from us:

 - Prompt updates and feedback following interviews

 - Interviews with recruiters, hiring managers, and members of teams

 - Skills assessment relevant to the position, if applicable

 - Genuine, thoughtful human interaction at every step


HOW WE SUPPORT YOU

We offer a comprehensive, competitive benefits program, allowing you to choose the benefits that are best for you and your family, starting on the first day of the month following your start date.

Core Benefits

 - Competitive salary and company equity through Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), granted as part of our standard compensation package and based on role and level

 - 401(k) with company match up to 4% of eligible earnings

 - Multiple medical plan options, plus dental and vision coverage

 - Company-funded HSA contributions (based on medical plan selection)

 - Company-paid life insurance and short-term disability

Health & Wellbeing

 - A variety of supplemental benefit options, including long-term disability, critical illness, accident, legal, and pet insurance

 - Access to mental health support and confidential counseling resources

 - Flexible PTO for exempt employees (most employees take 15–20 days per year), plus 8 company-observed holidays

 - Paid parental leave, including up to 14 weeks at 100% pay for birthing parents and 8 weeks at 100% pay for non-birthing parents

Growth & Development

 - Career mobility and internal growth opportunities across the organization

 - Professional development budgets for certifications, conferences, and learning available, subject to management approval


HOW WE WORK

We don’t just hire for skills. We hire for alignment. Kinfolk bring diverse perspectives, but we’re united by a shared set of values that shape how we work and how we show up for each other and our customers.

Run through walls, together - Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. We assume the best in each other and challenge ideas, not intentions. We show up, work hard, and play to each other's strengths — because that’s how great teams win.

Raise the bar. Drop the ego - Attitudes are contagious. Every one of us is responsible for creating the culture we want to work in. High performance. Low drama. Always respectful. Like professional sports teams, we win by working in sync. We show up, work hard, and play to each other’s strengths.

Act like an owner - We are owners, fully accountable for achieving Kin’s mission. That requires positive, proactive, big-picture thinking well beyond our job descriptions. Ask questions, Take ownership. Do the right thing, even when it‘s hard. Because when Kin thrives, so do you. And so do our customers.

Operate lean. Deliver more - We build efficiency into everything we do. Each dollar we save gets reinvested to deliver more to our customers: better pricing, more products, and new innovations. We work smarter by relentlessly prioritizing and using technology, including AI, to multiply our impact. Lean is about focus, not deprivation. Lean isn't a limitation — it's our competitive advantage.

Keep asking ‘What if?’ - We value curiosity. To make insurance better for our customers, we experiment. We embrace insights. And we base decisions on data rather than assumptions. We see setbacks as opportunities for growth and are always learning and improving. Both individually and as a company.




WHERE WE WORK

We are a remote-first company with offices in Chicago, IL and St. Petersburg, FL where teams can come together for collaboration.

For Sales Agents and Customer Service Agents: These roles sit in any of the following 32 states: AL, AZ, CO, FL, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, MT, NC, NE, NM, NV, NY, OH, OK, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA, and WI.

Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in one of the states listed above.

For remote technical positions located in Canada, we are only able to hire individuals who reside in Ontario. Applicants must be able to live and work full-time in Ontario to be considered.

State locations and specifics are subject to change as our hiring requirements shift.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Tax and Grant Analyst will support ongoing tax compliance activities and provide financial and compliance oversight to donations and grants received by BAYADA Home Health Care. The position will support pre- and post grant activities, which include research, application, accounting, and analysis. This person will develop in-depth knowledge of various federal, state, local, and private programs, providing consultation and support to the various  businesses within BAYADA. The person will also support nonprofit and tax compliance activities, including the preparation of annual filings submitted to the IRS.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

• Exemplifies characteristics of The BAYADA Way: compassion, excellence and reliability.

• Four (4) year college degree in Accounting or Finance.

• Two (2) to five (5) years of public accounting or related industry experience.

• Prior nonprofit experience is a plus.

• Proficient in Windows and Microsoft Office (Excel and Word) applications and ability to learn various software applications (i.e. Workday).

• Strong understanding of US GAAP standard concepts, practices, and procedures.

• Ability to manage multiple assignments and processes.

• Ability to work independently and meet competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• High level of confidentiality and attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Demonstrate and communicate the core values of BAYADA and The BAYADA Way.

• Develop working knowledge of BAYADA’s mission, services, people, organization, policies and procedures.

• Build trust and rapport with colleagues across the organization, as well as external stakeholders.

• Support the discovery of new grant opportunities administered by Federal, State, Local, and Private Payors.

• Research the reporting requirements of grant opportunities; gauge the anticipated effort needed to maintain/produce such reports.

• Collaborate internally and, if needed, externally to determine the compliance implications of grants and donations.

jobs.title: Clinical Pharmacist Cancer Center Part time Days 0.7
jobs.description:
The position is 0.7 FTE, 28 hours a week.

The Clinical Pharmacist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The Clinical Pharmacist is responsible for identifying, preventing, and/or resolving medication related problems; for providing authoritative information to other health care professionals, patients, and the public; and for assuring that the informational, clinical, and drug distribution components of pharmacy services function as an integrated system to provide patient centered care to the patients and staff of Northwestern Medicine.

The mission of the Department of Pharmacy is to deliver the safest, highest quality, most effective and efficient patient care while developing the best people, advancing research, and integrating pharmacy services to successfully coordinate care across the Northwestern Medicine enterprise.

The vision of the Department of Pharmacy is to be a recognized as a national leader in advancing the pharmacy enterprise through excellence, innovation, education and research.

Responsibilities:

• Interprets medication orders to ensure safety and proper use of medications and is alert to compatibilities, incompatibilities, medication duplication, medication allergies, and potential medication administration errors. Coordinates the solving of medication related problems between pharmacy, nursing, and prescribers, demonstrating initiative and sound judgment.
• Monitors medication therapy for significant drug-drug, drug-diet, or drug-laboratory test interactions. Intervenes in circumstances of significant interactions, therapeutic duplications, and other occasions where pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetic expertise is warranted.
• Evaluates and documents that the medication(s) selected are appropriate for achieving the desired therapeutic outcome. Communicates potential problems and likely solutions to the prescriber.
• Acts as a consultant in the areas of pharmacokinetics and adverse reactions to physicians, nurses and other healthcare professionals. Participates in all therapeutic drug monitoring or intervention programs; adjusting therapy as indicated by patient condition and laboratory results.
• Processes all medication order information into the Electronic Health Record to ensure accuracy of records regarding past, current and future dispensing and charging.
• Maintains a comprehensive pharmacy patient profile. The profile should include age, maturation, weight, allergies, diagnosis, estimated and actual pharmacokinetic parameters, and pertinent information which may affect medication therapy decisions.
• Oversees the packaging labeling, and distribution of medications for all patients and employees according to established policies, procedures, and guidelines. Monitors the use of scheduled medications on the nursing units and maintains controlled inventories of medication in the dispensing areas.
• Compounds and dispenses pharmaceuticals including sterile products, chemotherapy and parenteral nutrition products.
• Verifies medication orders before delivery to patient care areas and ensures accuracy and completeness. Resolves discrepancies as necessary.
• Reviews all laboratory data for appropriateness of medication use and recommends changes when needed. Including microbial culture and sensitivity data, toxicology, therapeutic drug monitoring, etc.
• Develops and presents orientation, education and training programs for medical, nursing, hospital and pharmacy staff, as well as assisting in the educating of pharmacy students, residents, and fellows.
• Educates patients and their families about specific medications.
• Responds to emergency situations to assist with medication management (e.g. response to cardiac arrests)
• Provides accurate and timely medication information and or teaching to healthcare professionals or patients.
• Maintains the hospital formulary and acts to limit medication usage to formulary items when appropriate
• Documents all clinical activities and interventions performed. Collects data, maintains logs, records and other documentation as required by the department
• Communicates professional knowledge effectively in both oral and written forms to patients and other health professionals.
• Participates in quality improvement and medication use review activities of the department.
• Organizes, prioritizes, and plans workload within given time constraints. Works cooperatively with fellow pharmacists to oversee and direct the activities of the work area, to assign work to technicians, and to assure that the established department objectives are accomplished
• Reviews restocking automated dispensing cabinets (ADCs) throughout the hospital and resolves any problems.
• Ensures compliance with hazardous waste collection and disposal procedures.
• Maintains proficiency and expertise in area/s of practice through continuous professional development.
• All other job duties as assigned.

Minimum Requirements:

Education:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmacy or a Doctor of Pharmacy Degree

Licensure:

• Active Clinical Pharmacist license in the state of Illinois (IDFPR)

Preferred:

• Training and knowledge of specialty areas (neonatology, critical care, oncology, etc.)
• Completion of a pharmacy residency program or equivalent hospital pharmacy experience

jobs.title: Principal AI Platform Architect
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Principal AI Platform Architect to define and build the next generation of our AI platform and cloud-native application ecosystem. This is a senior technical leadership role responsible for designing scalable, secure, and resilient platforms that enable AI-powered products, intelligent automation, and modern software development across the organization.

The ideal candidate is hands on technologist with extensive experience designing cloud-native applications and AI-enabled platforms. They understand how modern APIs, event-driven systems, orchestration frameworks, and agentic AI capabilities come together to create enterprise-scale solutions that are secure, observable, and operationally efficient.

This role partners closely with product leadership, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders to establish architectural direction, define platform standards, and guide the implementation of next-generation AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build a scalable AI platform supporting LLMs, agentic workflows, and federated development across multiple teams
• Establish architectural standards for AI governance, security, evaluation strategies, and operational excellence
• Architect cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform supporting enterprise-scale workloads
• Define platform patterns for microservices, event-driven architectures, and API-first design
• Build CICD pipelines that deploy automatically to the cloud while interfacing with legacy systems
• Provide architecture guidance and governance across engineering teams through reviews and standards
• Balance strategic platform vision with hands-on implementation to earn respect from engineering teams
• Enable teams to add new components, agents, and functionalities within the overarching platform

Required Qualifications & Technical Experience

• 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise software platforms with proven success at scale
• Strong GCP expertise - deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform services, semantics, and AI capabilities (Vertex AI preferred)
• AI platform experience building production systems that support product use cases, including agentic frameworks, LLMs, and orchestration
• Evaluation strategy experience - particularly building eval loops in production for monitoring and tuning AI systems (highly preferred)
• Event-driven architecture and distributed systems expertise with understanding of microservices and APIs
• Platform security and governance knowledge, including responsible AI practices
• Python proficiency (primary language for AI development), plus experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native tools
• Exceptional communication skills with ability to influence technical direction across multiple engineering organizations

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will:

• Establish the architectural vision for our enterprise AI platform.
• Define reusable cloud-native platform patterns supporting AI-enabled applications.
• Enable engineering teams through standardized platform capabilities and architectural guidance.
• Improve platform scalability, security, observability, and operational efficiency.
• Accelerate the adoption of AI capabilities while ensuring strong governance, reliability, and engineering quality.

As a Store Manager, you’ll be responsible for the total holistic omni customer experience in your store, ensuring high visual and commercial curation & standards according to the store format location and global & regional strategies. You have the responsibility of leading the full store team to excel. You create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit and are responsible & aware of the store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. You’ll also be the person who analyzes and follows up on sales, creating plans to optimize results and profits.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

• Responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to your store format environment, global guidelines and regional strategies
• Represent yourself and the H&M brand positively during all customer interactions
• Establish, analyze, and follow up on sales & budget goals, and create plans to optimize results
• Ensure personal customer service is provided in all areas of the store, ensuring your team initiates customer interactions, guiding customers through fashion stories and works towards actively selling our products
• Following up that your teams are actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
• Schedule to budgeted hours plan in line with sales budget and commercial activities
• Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
• Be aware of your store strengths and opportunities, identifying commercial opportunities and acting on them. Maintain competitor awareness & knowledge
• Manage store maintenance in a cost-efficient way
• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

Fashion & Trend Awareness

• Keep up to date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc
• Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions
• Ensure good understanding of the local area of your store, customers, competition, and fashion trends

Team & Development

• Responsible for talent and performance management in your store – recruiting, onboarding, upskilling, and developing your team
• Complete performance evaluations and succession planning to support business needs & team
• Retain and share your knowledge and skills with your team
• Strong collaboration with Area team and store leadership team including VMs
• Ensure excellent communication & professionalism
• Responsible for the teams planning & scheduling
• Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily/weekly meetings, etc
• Ensure all procedures, routines, security, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed
• Participate in relevant available Onboarding & introduction processes, trainings and courses relevant for your role & future development

Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

• Ensure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house.
• Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with great garment care.
• Ensure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to relevant area or sales market colleagues
• Responsible for & supports with the daily opening & closing of store routines and processes

jobs.title: Senior Specialist, Digital Quality (Quality Systems & Compliance)
jobs.description:
Kyowa Kirin is a global specialty pharmaceutical company backed by more than 70 years of breakthrough life science innovation, dedicated to discovering and advancing treatments for diseases in which unmet need is greatest. Based in Japan with worldwide operations, we work across the continuum from drug discovery to commercialization, guided by our commitment to patients and their families.

Our research teams, located in California and around the world, are focused on developing the next generation of antibody, cell, and gene therapies, with particular emphasis on bone and mineral disorders, hemato-oncology, and rare diseases. We accelerate development through collaborations with industry, academia, patients, and healthcare providers, and since 2018 we have introduced four new therapies serving patients with progressive illnesses often in need of new therapeutic alternatives.

Our culture is grounded in our values: Commitment to Life, Integrity, Innovation, and Teamwork/Wa, and brought to life through the Kabegoe Principles, which define the behaviors and actions that guide how we work together to deliver meaningful impact for patients.

We’re proud of the progress we’ve made and mindful of the countless individuals still waiting for their own breakthroughs. A commitment to making people smile unites our efforts. Learn more at www.kkna.kyowakirin.com.

Summary:

The Senior Specialist, Digital Quality (Quality Systems & Compliance) serves as the Quality business lead and system owner for laboratory digital systems, including LabVantage LIMS, analytical instrument platforms, and related interfaces supporting GxP operations at Kyowa Kirin’s Sanford, NC manufacturing site. This role ensures laboratory computerized systems remain compliant, validated, inspection-ready, and aligned with regulatory requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA++, and data integrity standards.

Partnering with IT, QC Operations, Automation, Engineering, system vendors, and global stakeholders, the incumbent oversees system lifecycle management, validation, change control, user access, periodic reviews, enhancements, and continuous improvement. As the business administrator for LabVantage and related systems, this role translates business requirements into compliant digital solutions, supports system integrations and investigations, and ensures the reliable use of laboratory data and technology.

This position reports to the Sr. Manager, Quality Systems & Compliance and receives day-to-day Digital Quality priorities, technical direction, and workstream alignment from the Digital Quality Lead, as applicable.

Essential Functions:

Technical Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
•    Serve as Quality System Owner and Business Administrator for LabVantage LIMS and associated laboratory computerized systems, ensuring systems remain compliant, validated, fit for intended use, and aligned with business requirements.
•    Partner with Information Technology, laboratory operations, Automation, Engineering, global teams, and system vendors to manage the lifecycle of laboratory digital systems, including implementation, configuration, validation, maintenance, upgrades, integrations, and retirement.
•    Act as the primary Quality business representative for laboratory digital platforms by translating laboratory and compliance requirements into user requirements, system configurations, enhancements, and sustainable operational solutions.
•    Maintain system ownership and lifecycle documentation, including user requirements, system inventories, data flow diagrams, validation plans, risk assessments, traceability documentation, periodic reviews, and system governance records.
•    Author, review, and approve computerized system validation deliverables, including protocols, test scripts, reports, risk assessments, deviations, and technical documentation, using a risk-based approach and ensure laboratory computerized systems comply with data integrity and electronic records and electronic signatures requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA++, and applicable global, regional, and site procedures.
•    Lead and coordinate system periodic reviews, user access reviews, audit trail review governance, backup and recovery assessments, and other controls required to maintain the validated state and inspection readiness.
•    Partner with IT and vendors to manage incidents, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, change controls, enhancements, upgrades, cybersecurity activities, and service delivery affecting GxP laboratory systems.
•    Provide Quality oversight and business administration for analytical instrument software and associated interfaces to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant generation, processing, review, retention, and retrieval of laboratory data.
•    Support the implementation, validation, and integration of analytical instruments with LIMS, chromatography data systems, and other enterprise platforms while maintaining data integrity and intended-use requirements.
•    Collaborate with laboratory subject matter experts and process owners to optimize workflows, standardize master data and system use, improve data management practices, and implement technology-enabled process improvements.
•    Monitor and communicate system health, compliance risks, project status, service performance, and quality metrics to Quality leadership and relevant stakeholder and serve as a subject matter expert during regulatory inspections, client audits, and internal audits for LIMS, analytical instrument systems, computerized system lifecycle controls, and laboratory data integrity.
•    Author, review, and maintain procedures, work instructions, governance documents, system administration guides, and training materials related to digital quality systems and deliver training, coaching, and ongoing business support to system users and administrators to promote consistent, compliant, and effective use of laboratory digital systems.

Non-Technical Skills:
Demonstrates a results-oriented approach by setting clear objectives, managing priorities, and delivering measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals. Navigates ambiguity and change effectively while maintaining accountability, responsiveness, and attention to detail. Builds productive relationships through clear communication, active listening, and inclusive collaboration across diverse teams and cultures. Promotes a growth mindset through continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Applies an enterprise-wide perspective to identify opportunities, drive innovation, and deliver integrated solutions that support business success.

Requirements:

Education
•    Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related scientific or technical discipline (required). Master’s degree in related scientific or technical discipline (preferred).

Experience
•    Minimum of 5 years of experience in a GxP-regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related life sciences environment, with a focus on Quality Assurance for computerized systems, laboratory systems, or digital platforms.
•    Demonstrated experience serving as a system owner, business administrator, validation lead, or Quality representative for GxP computerized systems.
•    Experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS); hands-on experience with LabVantage is strongly preferred.
•    Experience supporting analytical instrument qualification, analytical instrument software validation, system integration, and lifecycle management.
•    Demonstrated experience in computerized system validation, including authoring or reviewing user requirements, protocols, test scripts, risk assessments, traceability documentation, and validation reports.
•    Experience partnering with Information Technology teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to implement, administer, maintain, and improve GxP systems, along with a strong understanding of data integrity requirements, electronic records and electronic signatures, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, ALCOA++, and global regulatory expectations for computerized systems.
•    Experience managing deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls, periodic reviews, user access reviews, and audit readiness activities associated with GxP systems, and experience supporting regulatory inspections or audits involving laboratory computerized systems, validation, or data integrity.
•    Experience with laboratory informatics ecosystems, including LIMS, chromatography data systems such as Empower, analytical instrument software, interfaces, and master data governance, preferred, and experience supporting facility start-up, system implementation, technical transfer, or operational readiness activities is highly desirable.
•    Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to author SOPs, training materials, governance documents, and technical reports.

Physical Demands:

Must be able to work in an office and regulated manufacturing environment, including construction/start-up phases, with appropriate PPE. Reasonable accommodation will be provided as required by law. This position is an on-site role based in Sanford, NC. Other standard company policies for flexible work arrangements do not apply to this role.

May require up to 5-10% domestic and limited international travel.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Material Planner to join our operations team in Halstead. In this role, you will be responsible for managing material flow, coordinating with production schedulers, and optimizing inventory levels to ensure seamless manufacturing operations. You will work collaboratively with production, procurement, and supply chain teams to forecast demand, plan material requirements, and maintain efficient production workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Review raw material requirements daily through the MRP system and identify upcoming material needs.
• Develop and maintain accurate material plans based on demand, inventory levels, lead times, and production requirements.
• Support material forecasting and budget preparation by analyzing historical usage, current demand, inventory requirements, and anticipated material needs.
• Monitor material availability and proactively identify potential shortages, delays, or supply constraints.
• Communicate with vendors and internal teams to confirm material availability and delivery dates.
• Partner with the Purchasing team to process purchase requests for production materials and support the Halstead team with non-production material requests.
• Coordinate closely with Production Scheduling to ensure material requirements are understood and changes in demand or supply are communicated.
• Analyze inventory levels, historical usage, and demand trends to support appropriate material requirements and minimize excess inventory.
• Utilize ERP/MRP systems to monitor material requirements, track inventory, maintain accurate records, and generate planning reports.
• Support cycle counts, annual physical inventory, and ongoing inventory accuracy initiatives.
• Investigate and help resolve material shortages, discrepancies, and supply issues that could impact production.
• Prepare and maintain reports related to inventory levels, material requirements, supplier performance, and planning accuracy.
• Identify opportunities to improve material planning processes, inventory management, and overall supply chain efficiency.
• Collaborate with Production, Purchasing, Warehouse, Quality, and other internal teams to support the timely and efficient flow of materials.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE ROLE

Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or GED.
• 2–3 years of experience in material planning, production planning, inventory management, procurement, or supply chain operations preferred.
• Proficiency with ERP systems (such as SAP, Oracle, or similar platforms) and MRP software
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting
• Solid understanding of production processes, lead times, and inventory management principles
• Experience with demand forecasting and inventory optimization techniques
• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate effectively across departments
• Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in planning and data management
• Legal authorization to work in the United States is required. . We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job posting.

Additional Ways to Stand Out

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field.
• Proficiency with SAP
• Experience in a manufacturing environment
• Familiarity with supply chain coordination and procurement processes
• Experience with forecasting tools or demand planning software

THE PERKS:

• Immediate Benefits
• Paid Time Off
• Tuition Assistance
• Employee Discounts
• Competitive Bonus Programs
• Employees 401k Match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Future Growth Opportunities, including personal and professional.
• And many more benefits that come with working for a global industry leader!

jobs.title: Recruiting Manager
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

We are hiring three Recruiting Managers to lead the next stage of growth for our recruiting team. Each Recruiting Manager will lead a team of 4-6 recruiters and sourcers, reporting to the Head of Recruiting. This is the first layer of management on our team, and you will help shape how it works!

You will partner directly with engineering, product, manufacturing, operations, and G&A leaders to turn business priorities into hiring plans, and you will coach your recruiters to act as trusted advisors to their hiring managers, not order-takers. You will be accountable for the speed, quality, and candidate experience of every search on your team, while building the playbooks, metrics, and habits that let us scale without lowering the bar.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will be close to the work, step in on critical searches and closes, and be a strong voice in how the broader recruiting organization evolves. Experience recruiting for engineering roles in defense, aerospace, or other highly regulated technical industries is a major plus.

Responsibilities:

• Monitor pipeline health, time to fill, offer acceptance, and recruiter productivity, using data to spot problems early and recommend changes

• Serve as the escalation point for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, resolving issues directly and keeping searches moving

• Coach recruiters on role scoping, intake, sourcing strategy, candidate assessment, and closing, with a focus on identifying exceptional people for hard-to-fill technical roles

• Strengthen interview quality and consistency by championing structured, inclusive interviewing, calibration, and hiring manager training

• Manage external recruiting agencies and contract recruiting partners used for niche or surge hiring, holding them to the same quality and candidate experience standards as the in-house team

• Contribute to the recruiting leadership team by building scalable playbooks, templates, and process improvements, and by sharing hiring trends and market insights

• Use AI and automation to improve efficiency in areas such as outreach, talent mapping, and reporting, while applying strong judgment and verifying outputs for accuracy and bias

• Protect candidate and company information, including the handling of sensitive and export-controlled hiring needs

• Deliver and model an outstanding, proactive candidate experience from first outreach through offer

• Work 4-5 days onsite out of our office in Los Angeles (Hawthorne), California

Minimum Requirements:

• 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience focused on technical and/or engineering roles, with a track record of closing complex or hard-to-fill positions

• 3+ years of experience managing recruiters, including coaching, performance feedback, and developing people at different experience levels

• Experience building recruiting strategies and managing execution against timelines and business goals

• Proven ability to build trusted partnerships with senior business leaders, using market data and business context to influence hiring decisions

• Strong understanding of engineering roles and technical skill sets such as software, hardware, systems, or manufacturing

• Data-driven mindset, with experience tracking recruiting metrics and translating them into clear recommendations for stakeholders

• Experience managing multiple searches, recruiters, and priorities at once in a fast-paced, changing environment

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to deliver direct feedback and handle escalations with empathy and confidence

• Working knowledge of ATS systems (Greenhouse preferred), sourcing tools, and structured interview practices

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience recruiting in the defense industry or similarly regulated technical environments such as aerospace, government, or advanced manufacturing

• Experience supporting or building recruiting teams at an early-stage or high-growth company

• Experience managing a mixed team of full-time recruiters, contractors, and agency or RPO partners

• Familiarity with the following tools: Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, Pave, Asana, Headcount365

• Experience using AI-enabled recruiting tools to improve speed and quality of work

• Experience building enablement programs, playbooks, or interview training adopted across a recruiting organization

• Ability to operate independently while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners

• A builder’s mindset, with a willingness to improve processes and contribute beyond defined responsibilities

Why CHAOS?

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary

The Senior Associate, Media Optimization is a core member of a dynamic, solutions-oriented team.  The ideal candidate will have familiarity with optimization strategies to achieve the client’s media investment goals and drive budget growth. In this role, you will partner with other Programmatic and Artificial Intelligence (AI) experts to drive results for our clients.

The Senior Associate, Media Optimization, plays a key role in transforming digital media investments into business outcomes. You will manage programmatic campaigns from beginning to end, including setup, QA, optimization, and reporting while delivering client investment goals and driving budget growth through exceptional performance.

Your extensive training will translate into deep knowledge of all the major platforms, such as Amazon and DV360, and emerging channels such as Audio, DOOH, and advanced TV, all while accessing exclusive alpha and beta products and releases built in-house and from our partners. Being a part of NMS also means exclusive knowledge and use of our proprietary planning and AI-powered platforms.

In doing all this, you will work alongside our strategic client teams, dedicated Copilot AI experts, analysts, product, partnership, and innovation teams to jointly make advertising more valuable for brands.

At NMS, we believe learning and growth are crucial to the success of our company and our employees; our goal is to help further develop your expertise within programmatic (Artificial Intelligence, Supply Management, Dynamic Creative, Data Integration).

Key Responsibilities

• Plan the structure and take ownership of the setup of programmatic campaigns (ex. TTD, Xandr, DV360, Amazon).

• Manage all aspects of campaigns including campaign and creative setup, tracking, QA, proactive performance checks, optimizations, pacing, and profitability updates to ensure goals are met within team SLAs.

• Collaborate with internal teams to troubleshoot any creative, HTML tags, pixel-related, or verification-related issues.

• Work closely with all account teams to develop tagging strategies.

• Drive test and scale programs. Seek out new optimization tactics and knowledge and share them with the wider teams.

• Provide insights into your optimization approach and work with the account service team to turn data-backed actionable insights into recommendations that enhance client strategy.

• Act as a consultant to educate account teams on best practices for campaign setup, data collection, technology, and platform use

• Complete requests in internal data management platforms

• Discrepancy investigation and resolution

• Work with your manager to meet the goals of the Media Optimization team and to fulfill the team strategy.

• Creation and implementation across the team of any new processes and procedures

• Grow your knowledge of programmatic platforms such that you attain a detailed knowledge of all programmatic media practices utilized in the company within the first year of the role.

Requirements

• 1+ years of experience working on biddable or programmatic platforms such as DV360, The Trade Desk, or Xandr (ideally including certification).

• Experience with one or more ad servers (DCM, Sizmek, AdForm).

• Knowledge of HTML, XML, and JavaScript in an advertising context.

• Good understanding of the online ad industry, ad targeting and optimization through DSPs/SSPs, an understanding of video and DOOH advertising and related metrics is a plus

• Passion and curiosity for advertising technology and artificial intelligence; eagerness to learn new tools (e.g., HTML, Big Query, and Python, etc.)

• Proficiency in technologies: Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP’s, etc.) is required.

• Strong analytical skills and an affinity for numbers is key; experience with Google Analytics is a plus.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; the ability to clearly communicate your findings and solutions in both written and verbal.

• The ability to form strong relationships with internal/external teams.

• A self-starter attitude – not afraid to ask for help or volunteer with new ideas.

• Highly organized, including strong time management.

• Bachelor’s degree OR Associate's degree with at least 1 year of experience (including Internships) within the online advertising industry with a focus on trafficking and operations

jobs.title: Manager, Corporate Events

jobs.description:
Role Purpose

At NBCUniversal, the Corporate Events Department produces high-impact experiences for clients and C-suite executives across some of the most recognized brands in media and entertainment — from marquee tentpole events and corporate initiatives to brand activations and large-scale client programs.

The Corporate Events Manager is an experienced event lead who independently drives small to mid-sized programs from ideation through execution while also contributing to larger-scale events as part of a broader team. This individual brings 5–7 years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, or related industries, along with a proven ability to lead programs, navigate complex logistics, and collaborate effectively across stakeholders. The Manager serves as a key partner to internal teams, clients, vendors, and executives, balancing strategic thinking with flawless execution. This position may provide guidance and oversight to Coordinators, Associates, Pages, or project-based team members depending on event staffing and department structure.

Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. The position reports to a Vice President within the Corporate Events Department. At NBCUniversal, you’ll have opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact alongside some of the industry’s most talented professionals.

Job Duties

Event Leadership & Execution

• Lead small to mid-sized programs from initial planning through on-site execution and post-event reconciliation
• Contribute to larger-scale and high-profile events in partnership with senior team members, owning specific workstreams, logistics, vendors, or operational components within the broader program
• Oversee all aspects of assigned events, including venue sourcing, vendor coordination, run-of-show development, premium sourcing, guest experience, and on-site logistics
• Partner closely with internal stakeholders and clients throughout the planning and execution process, facilitating meetings and ensuring clear communication and follow-through
• Interface directly with clients and C-suite executives with professionalism and discretion
• Develop and track event budgets, process invoices, and support post-event reconciliation
• Negotiate contracts, track deliverables, and maintain detailed production timelines
• Coordinate event registration, attendee communications, and guest management to ensure a seamless experience
• Produce or oversee the creation of digital and printed event materials in collaboration with vendors and internal/external partners
• Travel domestically and internationally to execute and support events
• Provide on-site support across the department’s broader event portfolio as needed

Team Collaboration & Department Support

• Provide guidance and day-to-day direction to Associates, Coordinators, Pages, and project-based team members assigned to events
• Foster a collaborative and supportive working environment while helping junior team members strengthen their event management skills
• Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams on complex programs and department initiatives
• Contribute to operational improvements, internal processes, and shared departmental resources
• Maintain awareness of emerging trends across hospitality, food and beverage, entertainment, sports, venues, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Basic Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience
• 5+ years of experience in events, hospitality, entertainment, experiential marketing, production, client services, or related fields
• Demonstrated experience independently leading and executing events from concept through completion
• Experience working with executive-level stakeholders, clients, vendors, and cross-functional teams

Desired Characteristics

• Solid project management and organizational skills with the ability to balance multiple events and timelines simultaneously
• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
• Experience managing budgets, contracts, production schedules, and vendor relationships
• Ability to remain adaptable, resourceful, and solutions-oriented in high-pressure environments
• Collaborative team player who can effectively guide and support project teams
• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences
• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and event registration platforms
• Knowledge of current trends within hospitality, entertainment, food and beverage, sports, experiential marketing, and premium gifting

Additional Requirements

• Willing to work in New York, NY
• Able to travel up to 40%
• Work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the event schedule

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $75,000 - $90,000  (bonus eligible).

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Partner Sales
jobs.description:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

We are looking for an experienced, articulate, and passionate Solutions Engineer (SE), with the primary objective of helping guide prospective customers through their evaluation of Instructure products. This individual will work directly with regional sales representatives to both architect and sell the best possible solution for buyers.

 

Solutions Engineers are the primary knowledge resource for the sales team and are responsible for actively driving and managing the functional and technical evaluation stages of the sales process. SEs are key technical advisors and product advocates, thoughtfully considering all alternatives to arrive at the best recommendations. SEs must effectively communicate complex education and technology concepts and practices to a variety of stakeholders.

 

This SE position will partner with our Provider Sales Team to position Instructure solutions to fellow educational technology companies and providers. The location of this position is flexible, although candidates must be willing to travel up to 40%.

 

What you will be doing:

 

 - Present Instructure products and Instructure as a partner to a variety of education technology industry stakeholders.

 - Articulate how Instructure solutions can help fellow educational technology providers fulfill their mission to support K-12 and Higher Education markets.

 - Discover and analyze individual customer goals and challenges and map those back into the appropriate solution(s), including:
   
   - Canvas LMS and Canvas Career
   
   - Canvas Studio and Canvas Catalog
   
   - Impact by Instructure
   
   - Elevate Standards Alignment
   
   - Elevate DataSync
   
   - Mastery Connect and Mastery Item Bank

 - Identify or develop solutions to address unique technical or functional requirements.

 - Develop and deliver tailored product demonstrations that are simple but engaging.

 - Lead in-depth, technical discussions with various business stakeholder roles and align solutions with value propositions for those individuals.

 - Understand and document customer requirements to support a successful evaluation and implementation.

 - Assist proposal writers with responding to functional and technical elements of RFIs/RFPs.

 

What you will need to know/have:

 

 - Technical understanding of education technology, SaaS, systems integration and interoperability standards (e.g., LTI, QTI, APIs), business intelligence technologies, HRISs, CRMs, CMSs, digital publishing tools, SCORM, etc.

 - Applied understanding of K-12 and Higher Education needs and the importance of education technology to support those needs, including teaching and assessment best practices, standards alignment, and instructional design.

 - Articulate and compelling presentation skills.

 - Excellent communication skills in speech and writing, tailored for different roles and audiences.

 - Self-motivated, self-reliant, yet collaborative.

 - Organized and analytical, able to eliminate sales obstacles through creative and adaptive approaches.

 - Access to a nearby airport. Candidates must be willing to travel up to 40%.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

 - Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

jobs.title: Optical Technician
jobs.description:
Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart.

You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality.

If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

The Optical Technician provides hands-on technical support for the design, assembly, alignment, test, and integration of electro-optical and photonic systems within a fast-paced defense and aerospace environment. Working under the direction of senior optical engineers, this role is critical to meeting program milestones, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring the performance of precision optical instruments, laser systems, and imaging assemblies. The ideal candidate brings 6 years of demonstrated technician experience in an optics or photonics manufacturing or R&D environment, strong bench skills, and the discipline to operate within cleanroom and controlled environments.

The position reports to the Manufacturing Manager and is fully onsite, based in San Diego, CA.

Job responsibilities:

Assembly & Integration

• Assemble and align precision optical components including lenses, mirrors, beam splitters, prisms, and filters per engineering drawings and assembly procedures

• Integrate electro-optical subassemblies into larger sensor or imaging systems, ensuring mechanical and optical tolerances are maintained

• Perform fiber optic splicing, connector termination, and cable routing for photonic subsystems

• Support installation and integration of laser systems, detectors, and associated opto-mechanical hardware

Test & Verification

• Execute optical performance tests including wavefront error, MTF, transmittance, focal length, and centration measurements using interferometers, autocollimators, and profilometers

• Operate optical test equipment such as Zygo interferometers, Shack-Hartmann sensors, spectrophotometers, power meters, and optical spectrum analyzers

• Conduct functional and environmental testing (vibration, thermal, shock) in accordance with MIL-STD-810 and program test plans

• Document test results accurately in test travelers, data packages, and engineering notebooks; flag non-conformances and initiate corrective actions

Fabrication & Repair

• Perform optical surface cleaning, inspection, and minor fabrication tasks including polishing, cementing, and coating inspection

• Support rework and repair of returned assemblies, troubleshooting alignment and performance issues to root cause

• Fabricate and modify opto-mechanical fixtures, jigs, and tooling to support assembly and test processes

Quality & Documentation

• Maintain first-article inspection records and dimensional inspection reports using CMM, micrometers, and optical comparators

• Follow AS9100 and ISO 9001 quality management procedures; support internal audits and corrective action processes

• Ensure compliance with ESD, FOD, and cleanroom protocols (ISO Class 5–7)

• Complete work orders, assembly travelers, and material handling documentation accurately and on time

Collaboration & Support

• Collaborate closely with optical engineers, mechanical engineers, and program managers to support design verification and qualification activities

• Provide technical input during design reviews and producibility assessments from a technician's perspective

• Mentor junior technicians and support cross-training initiatives within the optical assembly team

• Support customer and government source inspections as required

If your experience aligns with our basic qualifications and you are inspired by our mission, we’d like to connect. If you don’t see the right role right now, Join Our Talent Community and stay connected as we continue to build what’s next.

• Associate degree in Electro-Optics, Photonics, Electronics Technology, or a related technical discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience

• Minimum 6 years of hands-on experience as an optical or electro-optical technician in a defense, aerospace, or precision optics manufacturing environment

• Demonstrated proficiency in optical alignment techniques, interferometric testing, and precision assembly of opto-mechanical systems

• Prior experience supporting MIL-SPEC programs or government-contracted programs

• Proficient with optical test instruments: interferometers (Zygo, ESDI), autocollimators, spectrophotometers, power meters, beam analyzers

• Skilled in reading and interpreting optical and mechanical engineering drawings, GD&T, and assembly procedures

• Experience with cleanroom operations at ISO Class 5–7 and associated contamination control practices

• Familiarity with ERP/MES systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) for work order tracking

• Basic proficiency with MS Office Suite; experience with data reduction tools (Excel, MATLAB, or LabVIEW a plus)

• Ability to obtain and maintain a US Government Security Clearance

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with LIDAR, electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor systems, or directed energy systems

• Familiarity with Zemax or Code V optical design software for review of optical models

• IPC-610 or J-STD-001 certification for soldering and electronics assembly

• Experience with laser safety protocols per ANSI Z136.1 and serving as a Laser Safety Officer (LSO) assistant

• Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent continuous improvement training

• Coursework or training in geometrical optics, laser principles, or optical instrumentation preferred

• Experience with fiber optic systems, free-space laser systems, or infrared imaging systems is strongly preferred

Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs unassisted

• Extended periods of standing, bending, and use of fine motor skills for precision assembly work

• Work performed in a combination of cleanroom, laboratory, and standard office environments

• Must be able to wear required PPE including ESD garments, cleanroom suits, and laser safety eyewear

• Occasional work outside standard business hours to meet program deadlines

The good faith base salary range for this role is $75,000 - $110,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

Voyager offers a highly competitive total compensation package designed to support the well-being, growth, and success of our employees. Employees benefit from a flexible and comprehensive rewards program that supports both professional and personal well-being.

• Flexible Time Off (FTO), empowering employees to take the time they need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance

jobs.description:
Our Why At Dotmatics

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

Ready to shape the future of pharmaceutical discovery, development and production? Let’s make it happen.

We’re looking for a high-energy, results-driven Global Account Executive (individual contributor) to help us power digital transformation across the Life Sciences industries. This is not your typical sales role—this is about building deep relationships across top global life sciences companies, understanding their complex challenges, and delivering cutting-edge solutions that accelerate groundbreaking discoveries.

• Strategic Account Management: Build trust and long-term partnerships by understanding your clients’ needs and ensuring our solutions align with their scientific and operational goals.

• Driving Process & Execution: Follow a best-in-class enterprise sales framework to create a repeatable, scalable success model.

• Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, product, customer success, external partners to deliver a seamless customer experience and drive sustained growth.

• ABC, Always Be Curious: Stay on top of industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies. You’re curious, ambitious, and always looking to level up your sales game.

We are looking for people with at least 10 years in the Life Sciences sales environment typically liaising/engaging with  CxOs, R&D teams, and IT leaders—influencing multi-dimensional decision-making. You can demonstrate  a strong track record in enterprise SaaS sales, ideally in data management, automation/orchestration, or AI that sells to R&D, IT, and business stakeholders and you’re comfortable selling solutions that aren’t pre-budgeted and can craft compelling business cases that justify investment.

• Collaborative - both external and internal

• Demonstrated sales performance

• Navigate and execute difficult/challenging contracts and relationships, multi-national, multi-agency

Life Sciences Knowledge: You understand the R&D and IT landscape in biotech or pharma (or you’re eager to learn!). Bonus points if you have a life sciences degree.
