Brand Design at Decagon shapes the visual identity of our company and helps define how we’re perceived by customers, partners, and the broader AI community. Our work turns sophisticated technology into clear, confident, and differentiated brand storytelling—across campaigns, content, web, and moments that shape perception.

We believe strong brands are built through taste, consistency, and conviction. We care deeply about craft, narrative, cohesion, and expanding the brand into new, exciting territories while building its core. Designers here grow by shipping work fast, operating with urgency, developing a strong point of view, and raising the bar together.

 

About the Role

This role sits at the heart of Decagon’s in-person brand expression. As an Experiential Designer, you’ll help shape how Decagon shows up in the real world—how we tell our story at our user conferences, how we stand apart at festival booths, and how our events evolves as the company scales.

You’ll work on marketing-led event initiatives that influence perception and drive growth, contributing to both foundational brand work and high-visibility moments. This role is ideal for a designer who is excited by storytelling, energized by momentum, and motivated by building a brand thoughtfully, not just executing individual assets.

You won’t be handed a perfectly defined box. Instead, you’ll help define the edges—learning where to push, where to refine, and how to maintain coherence as the brand expands.

 

In this role, you will

 - Design and art direct high-quality brand assets across event design - campaigns, web, sales materials, video, and social.

 - Contribute to brand strategy and messaging, and translate that thinking into clear and compelling visuals.

Even better if you have

 - Interest in technology and AI-driven companies (prior AI experience not required).

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM), established in 1969, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing the field of aviation maintenance through exceptional education and training. With 15 campuses nationwide, AIM is a cornerstone in the aviation industry, accounting for 20% of all students attending FAA-certified Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) schools across the country. jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT ATTICUS

At any given time, 16 million Americans are experiencing a crisis that requires urgent help from our legal system or government. The right assistance could transform their lives. But today, most never get it.

Atticus makes it easy for any sick or injured American to get life-changing aid. Our mission is to tear down barriers between people in crisis and the aid they deserve. In the last six years, we’ve become the leading platform connecting people with disabilities to government benefits.

We also help victims of accidents, misconduct, and violence get compensation from insurance. So far, we’ve helped hundreds of thousands of people access over $10 billion in life-changing aid —and earned over 20,000 five-star reviews. And we’re just getting started.

We've raised more than $100 million from top VC firms like Forerunner, Google Ventures, and True Ventures, and we’re on our way to creating a category defining business assisting  Americans in need.




THE JOB

In the next two years, we aim to help over 250,000 Americans get access to life-changing benefits. Behind that impact is a remarkable group of people — attorneys, engineers, client advocates, marketers, product managers, and more. The Atticus People team makes that work possible — we build the systems, policies and operations that enable us to do our best work.

We’re hiring a People Operations leader to uplevel the operational backbone of our People function: benefits, systems, payroll and multi-state compliance through our PEO, people policy, and our performance and merit cycles. You’ll manage the spend, the vendors, and decisions to uplevel our function and employee experience — when and how we leave our PEO, how to replace our HRIS, how our policies and benefits should evolve. As we grow, you’ll decide what we automate and set the standard for how this work gets done.

You’ll report to Amy Yu https://www.linkedin.com/in/amy-yu/, our Head of People, and join a small, high-ownership team that cares deeply about our mission and about having real impact. The ideal candidate has owned people programs and operations at a tech-driven company and is excited to build operations somewhere the work really matters. We’ve helped hundreds of thousands of people get the benefits they deserve, and the people doing that work are who you’d be building for.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years owning significant pieces of People Operations at a venture-backed Series C-D+ tech company, including benefits, systems, performance, compliance and policy

 - You’re equally comfortable presenting benefits analysis as you are having a tough leave conversation, and handle both situations with tact and clarity

 - You’ve owned HRIS systems end-to-end and implemented a new one seamlessly, and have chosen and managed People vendors and partners effectively

 - You’ve partnered with senior leaders on performance and merit cycles, and you can run a cross-functional group that includes people more senior than you

 - You operate with low ego but high ownership, and are comfortable both doing the work and directing it

 - You’re comfortable operating in the gray — we believe in low(er) process and high judgment, so we don't have rigid policies for every case. This role requires applying good judgment and care when the answer isn't obvious.


SALARY AND BENEFITS

The role is a rare opportunity to join a fast-growing Series C startup that doubles as a B-corp social enterprise. Our team is still small enough for you to have an outsized impact on how we operate and how our people experience unfolds.

We offer competitive pay — including equity — and generous benefits:

 - Medical and dental insurance with 100% of employee and family premiums covered

 - 15 vacation days & ~20 paid holidays each year (including two weeks at end-of-year)

 - Free membership to OneMedical

 - $600/year internet stipend

 - $1,000 reimbursable stipend for education and training outside of work

 - Up to $1,200/year student loan repayment assistance

 - 401(k) and optional HSA/FSA

 - Humble, thoughtful, smart, fun colleagues

We anticipate the base salary band for this role will be between $130,000 to $185,000 in addition to equity and benefits. The salary at offer will be determined by a number of factors such as candidate’s experience, knowledge, skills and abilities, as well as internal equity among our team.




LOCATION

This job is fully remote and we’re committed to empowering everyone with flexibility. Work remotely, and travel to LA (on the company dime) as needed to be with your colleagues – usually quarterly, plus offsites. We care a lot about building a great culture and we think some interactions need to happen in person, so we put a lot of thought into retreats, offsites, and other ways to gather.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.location: Denver, Colorado, United States; San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.description:
About Checkr
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.

We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.

About the team/role

We’re hiring an ML Engineer (P3) to build and ship the AI systems that power Checkr’s core products. This role sits on the ML team inside Checkr’s Data & ML organization within Engineering.

Checkr runs millions of background checks a year. The ML team builds the systems that make those checks faster, more accurate, and cheaper to operate: document processing, charge classification, entity resolution, and in-product intelligence. These are production services that Product Engineering depends on daily.

This is not a research role or a notebook role. You’ll own ML services end-to-end: design them, code them, deploy them, monitor them. We need someone who writes production software, builds with LLMs and APIs as first-class tools, and can tell the difference between working code and AI slop. If you’ve spent the last few years building AI-native software and you care deeply about engineering craft, we want to talk.

This role sits in the central Data & ML team within the Engineering organization. You will partner daily with Product Engineering, Product, and cross-functional teams. You’ll also contribute to Checkr’s broader AI strategy, including our initiative to deploy our agentic fleet and build scalable context with our semantic layer.

We are looking for someone based in San Francisco who has built ML systems in fast-moving, impact-first environments. Less process, more shipping. Less paperwork, more results.

What you’ll do

• Build and deploy ML/AI services. Design, develop, and ship ML models and AI systems that Product Engineering teams rely on. You write the model code, the API layer, the monitoring, and the tests. Not notebooks; production services.

• Design with LLMs and APIs. Use LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) as building blocks in production systems. You know when to call an LLM, when to fine-tune, when to use a classical model, and when to write a rule. You think about cost, latency, and quality together.

• Ship production software. Write clean, well-structured code with solid OOP, proper abstractions, error handling, and tests. Your code gets reviewed by SWEs and passes. CI/CD is how you work, not something you bolt on at the end.

• Partner with product and engineering. Translate business problems into ML solutions. Define API contracts with product engineers. Explain your approach clearly to non-ML partners and leave the room with alignment, not confusion.

• Evaluate and iterate fast. Build evaluation frameworks, run experiments, and make data-driven decisions about model and system performance. Ship and iterate; don’t wait for perfect.

• Ship AI-powered workflows. Put AI to work on your own processes: automate pipelines, build agentic workflows, and contribute reusable skills and context to Checkr’s agentic platform. The expectation is that our teams operate AI-first.

What you bring

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent depth from experience

• 6+ years building software professionally, with at least 2 of those building ML systems that run in production

• Strong Python fluency; you write clean, testable, well-structured code with solid OOP instincts. Hands-on experience using LLM APIs in production systems: prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, cost management, and evaluation

• You’ve built and maintained APIs, worked with CI/CD pipelines, and shipped code that other engineers depend on

• Comfort with and enthusiasm for AI-assisted workflows; experience using LLMs, code-generation tools, or agentic systems in production or operational contexts is a strong signal

• You use AI tools (Copilot, Claude, etc.) to move faster, but you understand every line they produce. You can spot AI slop and you don’t ship it

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

Nice to have

• Experience with MLOps platforms (MLflow, SageMaker, Vertex, or similar)

• Background in document processing, OCR, or information extraction

• Experience with PySpark or large-scale data processing

• Ruby experience (Checkr’s platform runs on Rails)

• Familiarity with compliance-sensitive domains (fintech, legal tech, HR tech)

• Working knowledge of dbt, Snowflake, or modern ELT/data transformation tools

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
THE VOICE AI WORKFORCE FOR HEALTHCARE

Healthcare runs on phone calls and loses $450B a year to the administration around them. Patients wait on hold, staff spend hours calling insurers, and revenue leaks at every handoff.

 

At Prosper, we're building the AI workforce that runs healthcare operations end to end. Our voice AI agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments directly in the EHR, verify insurance benefits, automate billing, and get payors on the phone when humans would otherwise wait on hold. We've grown revenue 5x in the last year, partnered with 100+ healthcare organizations covering more than 150,000 providers, and raised $35M, including a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz.


THE ROLE

We're hiring an Account Executive to own a named list of the largest provider organizations in the country: national MSOs, PE-backed platform groups, and multi-region specialty organizations.

 

This is the seat every enterprise seller says they want and rarely gets. The accounts are open, the whitespace is untouched, and the product wins in a bake-off. You're not inheriting a picked-over patch or a pipeline someone else already burned. You're picking the logos, building the plan, and running every cycle from first meeting to signature.

 

You'll have real air cover behind you. Founder-led sales that shows up on your calls, solutions and implementation teams that make pilots land, a product team that ships what your deals need, and a category with genuine urgency: every provider group in America is being asked what its AI strategy is, and most of them do not have an answer yet.

 

Revenue is up 5x on a lean team. This segment is our single largest expansion opportunity, and the person in this seat sets the ceiling on how fast we take it.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own a named account list end to end: account planning, prospecting, discovery, pilot, negotiation, close, and expansion

 - Run long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals across revenue cycle, finance, IT, security, compliance, clinical operations, and procurement, and hold every thread yourself

 - Build durable relationships with the people who decide. The best enterprise sellers are trusted before they're needed. You'll invest in multi-year relationships with CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and VPs of Revenue Cycle, arriving with a point of view on their business rather than a pitch

 - Author the ROI case. Every deal at Prosper is won on a quantified business case: cost-to-collect, denial rate, days in A/R, FTE hours redeployed, cash recovered. You'll build these models from the customer's own data and defend them in front of a CFO

 - Navigate the enterprise gauntlet of RFPs, security reviews, HIPAA and BAA diligence, legal negotiation, and phased multi-site rollouts without losing momentum

 - Convert pilots into platform commitments, designing land-and-expand paths from a single site or specialty to the full organization

 - Direct the resources around your deals: outbound, marketing, solutions engineering, and founders all work against the plan you set for your accounts

 - Codify what works into the battlecards, business-case templates, and qualification criteria the next five reps will run


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A track record of outperformance. You've consistently finished in the top tier of your team, and you can point to the numbers: quota attainment, President's Club, the year you closed the deal nobody thought was closable

 - 1-2 years of full-cycle closing experience

 - Command of a real methodology. MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger, whichever you run, you qualify hard, you know where every deal stands, and your forecast is accurate

 - Relationship-building as a core competency, not a byproduct. You build trust with senior operators over years, and people who've worked with you once seek you out again. You can win a room of C-suite executives and hold it

 - Entrepreneurial eagerness and drive. You're eager to get scrappy, comfortable with getting in the mud, while at the same time being able to take a 10,000 foot view and have an ongoing strategy that adapts fast to new market signals

 - Comfort with a technical product and the ability to translate AI capability into operational and financial outcomes


BONUS POINTS

 - Healthcare provider, payer, or RCM selling experience

 - Experience selling AI, automation, or voice technology into regulated industries

 - Fluency with EHR and practice management ecosystems (Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) and clearinghouse/RCM stacks

 - An existing network across provider group leadership or PE-backed provider platforms

 - Early-stage or hypergrowth startup background, especially as an early rep who helped build the motion


WHY PROSPER

 - A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

 - Greenfield named accounts with no legacy pipeline and no internal competition for logos

 - Direct access to founders, product, and engineering. Deals get unblocked in hours, not quarters

 - Backed by the best investors in the world. Andreessen Horowitz manages $90B and sits behind OpenAI, Databricks, and Coinbase

jobs.title: Strategy Associate
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Strategy Associate on Harvey's Transformation Office, you will be the analytical and content engine behind how we help the world's most sophisticated legal and professional services organizations adopt AI. Reporting to the Transformation Strategy Partner, you'll turn raw inputs — usage data, client context, and engagement learnings — into the playbooks, frameworks, analyses, and executive-ready materials that make transformation repeatable, scalable, and measurable.

This is a high-ownership, high-leverage role inside a function that is still being built from the ground up. You'll work across the full arc of transformation: helping size where Harvey can have the most impact, building the methodology that scales it, and supporting the strategic engagements that prove it out. You'll partner closely with Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success, and gain direct exposure to senior partners, General Counsel, and Harvey leadership. Strong performers will grow into owning engagements of their own.

This is a builder's role for someone early in their career who wants disproportionate ownership, range, and visibility.

Travel: up to ~25% of the time.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

Turn data into insight. Pull, structure, and analyze adoption and usage data across accounts to understand what drives transformation. Build the models, dashboards, and impact analyses that tell us what's working, where the gaps are, and where Harvey can create the most value. You make the numbers tell a clear story.

Build playbooks and frameworks that scale. Take what works in individual engagements and codify it into reusable playbooks, templates, and methodology. You're not producing one-off decks; you're building the operating system of the Transformation Office so every engagement gets faster, sharper, and more repeatable.

Capture best practices from strategic transformation engagements. Synthesize lessons learned from engagements into repeatable materials, stakeholder maps, workflow analyses, and tracking that keep engagements on plan. Sit close to live client work, own discrete workstreams, and take on more end-to-end responsibility as you grow.

Build executive-ready communications. Translate complex analysis into crisp narratives, decks, and one-pagers for senior partners, GCs, and internal leadership. You can hold a high bar on both rigor and polish, and you make complex things feel simple.

Drive cross-functional coordination. Act as connective tissue across Legal Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success — chasing down inputs, aligning teams, and making sure things actually move. You surface risk early and keep work on track without being asked.

Synthesize learnings and feed thought leadership. Capture patterns across engagements and turn them into internal knowledge and external thought leadership that sharpens how the market — and Harvey — thinks about AI transformation.

Travel required: up to 25% of the time.







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 2–3 years at a top-tier strategy consulting firm (MBB — McKinsey, BCG, Bain — or equivalent), where you owned analytically rigorous workstreams on real, complex client problems.

 - Exceptional quantitative and data analysis skills. You are deeply comfortable in Excel/Sheets, can structure messy data into clear insight, and build analyses leaders trust. Familiarity with BI tools (e.g. Omni, Looker, Tableau) or SQL is a plus, not a requirement.

 - A track record of building playbooks, frameworks, or repeatable methodology — not just polished one-off deliverables.

 - Exposure to transformation, change management, and strategy work, ideally in or adjacent to legal, financial services, or professional services.

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication. You make complex things simple, write with precision, and can hold your own in a room with senior stakeholders.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and a bias to action. You thrive where the playbook is still being written, and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for perfect information.

 - Genuine curiosity about AI and what it means for the future of professional work. You don't need to be a technologist, but you need to care deeply about the problem.







COMPENSATION

$116,000 - 159,500 USD

jobs.title: Principal Mixed Analog Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

Role Overview

Astera Labs is redefining the connectivity that powers rack-scale AI infrastructure, and analog design is at the heart of it. As a Principal Analog Design Engineer, you will architect and design the high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that anchor our SerDes, PHY, and high-speed I/O — the silicon building blocks that move data at the speed AI demands. Your work directly shapes the performance, power, and reliability of products deployed in the world's most advanced data centers.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role at a hyper-growth company purpose-built for AI connectivity. You will own designs from concept through silicon bring-up, set the technical bar for the analog team, and mentor engineers as we scale. If you want your circuits to enable the next generation of AI compute, this is where that happens.

Key Responsibilities

• Analog & Mixed-Signal Design Architect and design high-speed analog and mixed-signal circuits including PLLs, LDOs, references, high-speed SerDes building blocks, ADCs/DACs, and clocking. Drive circuit design from specification and architecture through schematic, layout supervision, and verification across PVT corners. Develop robust designs in advanced FinFET process nodes with attention to power, area, and performance trade-offs.

• Silicon Execution & Validation Lead silicon bring-up, characterization, and debug, partnering with validation and product engineering to root-cause and resolve issues. Define and execute test plans to correlate silicon performance against design targets.

• Technical Leadership Set analog design methodology, review standards, and best practices across the team. Partner cross-functionally with digital, physical design, systems, and architecture teams to deliver full-chip solutions. Mentor and guide junior engineers, elevating the technical capability of the analog organization.

Basic Qualifications

• MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience in analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design.

• Proven track record designing high-speed analog circuits such as PLLs, SerDes front-ends, data converters, references, or regulators in advanced CMOS/FinFET nodes.

• Strong understanding of physical-layer design principles, signal integrity, and high-speed I/O.

• Proficiency with industry-standard design and simulation tools (e.g., Cadence Virtuoso, Spectre) and solid layout/parasitic-aware design skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience taking multiple analog/mixed-signal designs through full production tape-out and high-volume manufacturing.

• Expertise in high-speed serial link design (PCIe, Ethernet, UALink, UCIe) and associated PHY architectures.

• Familiarity with silicon debug, ATE test development, and design-for-test techniques.

• Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical design reviews.

• Excellent communication skills and a collaborative, ownership-driven mindset.

Salary range is $170,000 to $210,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. This role may be eligible for discretionary bonus, incentives and benefits.

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Account Management
jobs.description:
CodaMetrix is revolutionizing Revenue Cycle Management with its AI-powered autonomous coding solution, a multi-specialty AI-platform that translates clinical information into accurate sets of medical codes. CodaMetrix’s  autonomous coding drives efficiency under fee-for-service and value-based care models and supports improved patient care. We are passionate about getting physicians and healthcare providers away from the keyboard and back to clinical care.


ABOUT THE ROLE

CodaMetrix is looking for a Director or Senior Director of Account Management to lead the people who own our relationships with large health systems and academic medical centers. You will run a team of senior account owners, set the bar for how we manage accounts, and be the first stop when something goes sideways. You sit between the executive team and the account owners, and the job exists so that no customer ever depends on a single person.

Our customers buy outcomes: high automation rates at a coding quality they trust. Those outcomes get earned after go-live, in the edge cases, with a coding director watching the numbers. So this is a high-touch model. Every account has a named owner who knows the coding and knows the data, and we do not run a hands-off tier for anyone. You will build that standard and hold it.

You will be a player-coach. You lead the team, and you also directly own a small number of accounts yourself. You will work daily with Sales, Product, Implementation, Integration, Support, and Quality, mostly without a reporting line into any of them. Level (Director or Senior Director) will be set based on the scope of team leadership and portfolio ownership you bring.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead and Develop the Account Team

•    Hire, manage, and coach Strategic Account Executives and Account Directors. You own their performance, development, and 1:1 rhythm.

•    Make autonomy explicit. Tell the team which decisions are theirs, then let them make those decisions. Seniority here should look like initiative: people who drive to an outcome without waiting for direction.

•    Build coverage depth. Every account has a named owner and a named backup, so one resignation or one reorg never leaves a customer without a point of contact.

•    Assign by risk and complexity, not by ARR alone, and revisit assignments as account health changes.

Set and Hold the Standard for Account Management

•    Define what great looks like and review account plans for strategic and active accounts. A good plan is outcome-driven, multi-threaded, and updated as risk, sentiment, and opportunity shift.

•    Pressure-test strategy before it reaches the customer. Hold the quality bar on QBRs, executive touchpoints, and renewal and expansion plans.

•    Own the portfolio narrative for executive leadership: where every account sits on the health and growth curve, what is changing, and what you need.

Run the Escalation and Decision Forum

•    Run a recurring executive escalation forum built for decisions, not status. You do the discovery before anyone sits down, so the room spends its time on blockers and resolution.

•    Be the first escalation point for account owners. Understand the question before you route it. Bring a recommendation up, never just a problem.

•    Surface material risk the moment it appears, with options, so leadership is never surprised by something your team already knew.

Drive Outcomes Across the Customer Lifecycle

•    Make the handoff from implementation to post-go-live optimization a plan, not a hope. Expansion and scaling are charted with the customer starting at kickoff.

•    Own the ramp. Track forecast against actuals for go-lives and for the gap between contracted and live revenue, and pull the right people in when an account falls behind.

•    Partner with Implementation, Integration, Support, Product, ML, and Quality to resolve issues at the root. Where the problem is in another team's lane, you drive it to resolution rather than tracking it.

•    Define the account health signals that matter (automation rate, eligibility, coding quality, ticket trends) and work with analytics partners so your team sees drift early.

Partner with Sales on Retention and Expansion

•    Be the bridge to Sales on renewal timelines, expansion plays, and signal flow, so neither team is surprised.

•    Share accountability for gross and net revenue retention, expansion pipeline, and go-live conversion across the portfolio.

•    Serve as executive sponsor on key accounts and co-present business reviews with Sales and CodaMetrix leadership.

Own Select Accounts Directly

•    Keep direct ownership of a small number of accounts, and run them the way you expect your team to run theirs. Stay credible with a coding director and a CRO in the same week.



THE STANDARD YOU WILL HOLD

We hold account owners to a strategic standard. You will hire for it, coach to it, and model it.

•    Ownership. Manage the trajectory, not the to-do list. Start every account issue with the outcome and work backward. Build the value story all year so renewal is a formality.

•    Orchestration. Assemble whoever the play requires, even outside your reporting line, and run internal syncs as working sessions that make decisions in the room.

•    Judgment. Know which risks to solve and which to escalate, and bring a recommendation either way. When the customer is not ready, treat readiness as something to manufacture. Push back with data when it protects the account.

•    Relationship depth. Map the full stakeholder landscape: coding leads, HIM, the CFO's office, IT, clinical leadership. No single departure should put an account at risk.

•    Impact. Measure success by account health, expansion pipeline, and reference-ability, not by the absence of complaints.



QUALIFICATIONS

•    12+ years in account management, customer success, revenue cycle management, health system operations, or healthcare consulting, including at least 5 years leading teams. Senior Director candidates will have managed senior account owners or managers and held retention and expansion accountability for a portfolio of enterprise accounts.

•    Working fluency in medical coding and revenue cycle: conversant in automation performance, denial trends, and coding accuracy, and credible with coding and HIM leaders. A credential such as RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC, or RN, or equivalent hands-on experience, is a strong plus.

•    Experience with large health systems, academic medical centers, or integrated delivery networks, on the customer side or as a vendor.

•    A record of developing senior individual contributors toward ownership and initiative, including holding a clear line when expectations are not met.

•    Executive presence with C-suite and VP-level health system stakeholders, and with CodaMetrix leadership.

•    Comfortable working directly in performance data and using AI-assisted tools to stay on top of a large portfolio.

•    Experience leading through a matrixed organization (Sales, Product, Implementation, Support, Engineering) without a direct reporting line into most of it.

•    A high-agency, roll-up-your-sleeves style. You build the plan rather than wait for one.

What CodaMetrix can offer you:

Learn more about our full-time employee benefits and how we take care of our team.

 - Health Insurance: We cover 80% of the cost of medical and dental insurance and offer vision insurance

 - Retirement: We offer a 401(k) plan that eligible employees can contribute to one month after their first day

 - Flexibility: We have a generous Paid Time Off policy, which is managed but not limited, so you can take the time you need to relax and rejuvenate

 - Development: We provide annual performance evaluations and prioritize working with employees on what their individual growth looks like

 - Recognition: We recognize the outstanding achievements of our team through annual company awards where employees have the opportunity to nominate their peers

 - Office Location: A modern open plan workspace located in the bustling Back Bay neighborhood of Boston

 - Additional Employer Paid Benefits: We offer employer-paid life insurance and short-term and long-term disability insurance

Background Check Notice

All candidates will be required to complete a background check upon acceptance of a job offer.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Our company, as well as our products, are made better because we embrace diverse skills, perspectives, and ideas. CodaMetrix is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Don’t meet every requirement? We invite you to apply anyway. Studies have shown that women, communities of color and historically underrepresented talent are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At CodaMetrix we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace and encourage you to consider joining us.

jobs.title: Strategic GTM, Manager
jobs.description:
STRATEGIC GTM, MANAGER

New York City · On-site


THE VOICE AI WORKFORCE FOR HEALTHCARE

Healthcare runs on phone calls and loses $450B a year to the administration around them. Patients wait on hold, staff spend hours calling insurers, and revenue leaks at every handoff.

 

At Prosper, we're building the AI workforce that runs healthcare operations end to end. Our voice AI agents answer patient calls, schedule appointments directly in the EHR, verify insurance benefits, automate billing, and get payors on the phone when humans would otherwise wait on hold. We've grown revenue 5x in the last year, partnered with 100+ healthcare organizations covering more than 150,000 providers, and raised $35M, including a $30M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz.


THE ROLE

We're hiring a Strategic GTM, Manager to own a segment of the largest provider organizations in the country: national MSOs, PE-backed platform groups, and multi-region specialty organizations.

 

Think of it as running a business rather than working a patch. You'll own the segment the way a GM would. You decide how it's defined, which organizations belong in it, what the thesis is for winning each one, and what Prosper has to build, say, and do to get there. Then you go make it happen: a named account list you built yourself, run from first touch to signature, with marketing, product, solutions, and the founders working against the plan you set.

 

Prosper is at an inflection point. Revenue is up 5x on a lean sales team. It's early enough that the strategy is yours to write, and consequential enough that writing it well changes the trajectory of the company.

 

If you've spent years building strategy for other people's businesses, this is the version where you own the thesis, run the execution, and see the number move. This is the best opportunity for someone who wants a path to be a founder or learn the entrepreneurial joruney


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own a segment of the market

 

 - Build the strategy from a blank page: market map, account segmentation, prioritization logic, and a defensible point of view on where Prosper wins and why

 - Construct the named account list, a finite and deliberately chosen set of organizations, along with the entry hypothesis for each one

 - Set the commercial architecture for the segment: pricing posture, pilot design, and land-and-expand paths from a single site or specialty to the full organization

 - Bring the rest of GTM with you. Marketing, outbound, solutions, and product should be executing against your plan, not adjacent to it. You'll define the campaigns, content, and product priorities the segment needs and drive them cross-functionally

 

Run the outcome of the deals

 

 - Own long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals end to end: account planning, prospecting, discovery, pilot, negotiation, and close

 - Build durable relationships with the people who decide. The best strategic sellers are trusted before they're needed. You'll invest in multi-year relationships with CFOs, COOs, CIOs, and VPs of Revenue Cycle, arriving with a point of view on their business rather than a pitch

 - Multi-thread across revenue cycle, finance, IT, security, compliance, clinical operations, and procurement, and hold every thread yourself

 - Author the ROI case. Every strategic deal at Prosper is won on a quantified business case: cost-to-collect, denial rate, days in A/R, FTE hours redeployed, cash recovered. You'll build these models from the customer's own data and defend them in front of a CFO

 - Navigate the enterprise gauntlet of RFPs, security reviews, HIPAA and BAA diligence, legal negotiation, and phased multi-site rollouts without losing momentum

 

Build the playbook

 

 - Codify what works into an outreach strategy, business-case templates, and qualification criteria the next five hires on this team will run

 - Feed the top of the market back into roadmap, and turn roadmap into commercial advantage


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - MBB or top-tier strategy consulting experience (McKinsey, Bain, BCG) is strongly preferred, specifically, 2-6 years of experience. You've demonstrated you can take an unstructured market, break it into a defensible framework, and turn that into a prioritized plan to execute, and iterate on

 - Relationship-building as a core competency. You build trust with senior operators over years, and people who've worked with you once seek you out again. You can win a room of C-suite executives and excel at building trust and product knowledge

 - Entrepreneurial eagerness. You're eager to build, comfortable getting in the mud, and just as comfortable stepping back to decide what actually deserves your time. If you want to find the ceiling of what you're capable of, or build a billion dollar company of your own one day, this is where you learn how
   
    


BONUS POINTS

 - Healthcare or PE/provider-services practice experience in consulting

 - Experience selling AI, automation, or voice technology into regulated industries

 - Fluency with EHR and practice management ecosystems (Epic, athenahealth, ModMed, eClinicalWorks) and clearinghouse/RCM stacks

 - An existing network across provider group leadership or PE-backed provider platforms

 - Early-stage or hypergrowth startup background


WHY PROSPER

 - A trillion-dollar problem, real customers, and revenue growing 5x

 - A segment you own outright: the strategy, the accounts, and the number

 - Direct access to founders, product, and engineering. Deals get unblocked in hours

 - Competitive base, commission, and meaningful equity

jobs.title: Sr. Accounts Payable Specialist - Battery Storage
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Plus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market-leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure.

Standalone energy storage is rapidly transforming the North American energy markets, because it is cheaper than new natural gas plants, faster to build than fossil peakers or transmission, and able to perform diverse energy services. Plus Power partners with electricity system operators, utilities, and investors to originate, develop, finance, own and operate standalone energy storage projects that provide critical services to the wholesale electric market. Plus Power’s team applies an intentional mindset to energy storage development by using a data-driven approach to development and operations.

At Plus Power, we are focused on solving hard climate problems, profitably.  We are growing fast, and value candidates who, like us, share a focus on setting high expectations, owning and learning from mistakes in the spirit of radical transparency, and are committed to internal partnering as a key element of our ideas meritocracy. About the Role

Plus Power recruits outstanding energy industry professionals who are driven to develop, build and operate assets safely and reliably while growing their careers. Our team looks for data-driven and fact-based mindsets, engaging and collaborative behaviors, and personal growth-focused professionals.

We are looking to hire a Senior Accounts Payable Specialist to join the company’s accounting team. The ideal candidate will have prior renewable, development, or construction experience and the ability to take the initiative in completing tasks in a time-sensitive and high-quality manner. This role includes significant responsibilities and room for growth within the company.

Key Responsibilities

• Process high volumes of A/P invoices through Stampli across multiple related legal entities, ensuring proper entity allocation, approvals, supporting documentation, general ledger coding, data entry, and payment processing; identify and resolve vendor account discrepancies

• Periodically compare vendor terms with activity to ensure the most cost- and time- effective payment methods and timing are being used

• Coordinate with vendors and internal teams to obtain and verify W-9s and payment instructions, including ACH, wire and BillPay information, and complete required phone verification of vendor banking details

• Set up and maintain new vendors in NetSuite and applicable banking platforms, ensuring accurate and complete vendor information

• Process company credit card transactions through Stampli, ensuring appropriate supporting documentation and general ledger coding

• Manage the annual 1099 reporting and filing process, ensuring accurate and timely completion.

• Assist with compliance issues related to accounts payable processes (W-9, sales and use tax, etc.)

• Serve as a liaison between Plus Power and more than 300 vendors, addressing billing, payment, and account-related inquiries and issues

• Review project-related expenses for appropriate approval and work closely with project management teams to process invoices and ensure timely payment

• Update, verify and maintain accounting journals, ledgers and other financial records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project contract accounting requirements and internal controls

• Assist with producing periodic financial reports and ensure reported results are accurate and comply with U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

• Support the management of external relationships, as requested, including accounting firms, banking partners, investors, insurance brokers and bonding agents

• Prepare accounts payable-journal entries, ensure accurate general ledger coding and support the monthly close process

• Reconcile the accounts payable ledger to ensure that all bills and payments are accounted for and properly posted

• Generate reports detailing accounts payables status

• Proactively work on initiatives to implement operational accounting efficiencies through process improvements and control enhancements

• Assist with supplying documentation for annual audits, loan draws, etc.

• Support investor reporting, budgeting and forecasting activities, as requested

• Develop, implement and effective and efficient internal controls, policies, procedures and workflows to safeguard company assets and promote accurate financial reporting

• Other projects as assigned

Skills & Qualifications

• BA/BS in Accounting or Finance

• 4+ years’ relevant work experience in an accounting department

• Current experience in renewable energy, power and utilities, or construction preferred

• Expert proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Microsoft Excel along with macro-writing capabilities, pivot tables, and data queries

• Working knowledge and experience with Stampli, NetSuite or similar software

• Strong organization and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail

• High degree of business acumen, discretion, and professionalism

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with vendors, colleagues and internal stakeholders

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively and effectively in a cross-functional environment with team members who are geographically dispersed

• Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining aligned with company and department objectives

• Proven ability to stay connected and maintain communication across distributed teams in hybrid or remote settings

• Strong desire and demonstrated ability to learn quickly, take initiative, and assume increasing responsibility

• Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver timely, high-quality results

Compensation, Location, and Benefits

Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America’s leading energy storage developers, owners, and operators, along with market-leading health benefits, 401(k) match, generous paid parental leave, flexible time off, work from home stipend, and other programs designed to support employees and their families.

Flexible work arrangements include work-from-home or hybrid options from Plus Power’s offices in The Woodlands, San Francisco, Chicago, Seattle, Brooklyn, Denver, Palm Beach Gardens, and Birmingham. jobs.title: Staff Workday HRIS Technical Analyst
jobs.description:

Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. About the team/role

We are seeking a highly experienced Workday specialist to own and advance our Workday platform end to end. This role sits at the center of our people systems landscape and is responsible for deep Workday configuration, business process design, integrations, reporting, and the adoption of Workday's AI and automation capabilities. The ideal candidate has deep, hands-on Workday expertise: they know its modules, security model, and release cadence intimately, and they can translate complex HR and business requirements into clean, scalable Workday solutions. We are looking for a proactive self-starter who can independently drive work forward without needing explicit direction.

What you’ll do

• Platform Ownership & Roadmap - Serve as the Workday subject matter expert across HR, IT, and Finance; own the platform roadmap, module adoption strategy, and alignment with Workday's twice-yearly release cycle.

• Configuration & Optimization - Lead configuration, testing, and deployment across HCM Core, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, Performance, Recruiting, Workday Adaptive Planning - including business processes, security models, calculated fields, and custom reporting.

• Release Management & Health - Conduct regression testing for each Workday release, perform regular audits, and drive performance tuning and configuration health checks to ensure platform stability.

• Integrations & Automation - Build and maintain integrations using Workday Studio, Core Connectors, EIB, and APIs to connect Workday with adjacent systems (Greenhouse, CultureAmp, Pave, payroll, finance, provisioning); identify and eliminate manual workflows through system-driven automation.

• Self-Service & Employee Experience - Optimize business processes, notifications, navigation, and the user interface to reduce administrative burden, increase adoption, and improve the employee and manager self-service experience.

• AI & Analytics - Evaluate and implement Workday AI, machine learning, skills intelligence, and Analytics capabilities; partner with data and IT teams to ensure scalability, data privacy, and ethical deployment.

• Cross-Functional Partnership - Translate stakeholder requirements into technical specifications, manage the Workday vendor and implementation partner relationships, and lead project delivery and adoption across the organization.

What you bring

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.

• 6+ years of progressive HR technology experience, with deep, hands-on expertise configuring and optimizing Workday.

• Demonstrated expertise across multiple Workday modules, such as HCM Core, Compensation, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, or Recruiting. Workday certification (Pro or equivalent) is a strong plus.

• Hands-on experience building Workday integrations using Studio, Core Connectors, EIB, and Workday APIs.

• Strong command of the Workday security model, business process framework, calculated fields, and advanced reporting.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning is a strong plus.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills. Self-starter with a proactive approach, capable of driving work independently and identifying opportunities for improvement without explicit direction.

• Proven experience with process automation and workflow design inside Workday.

• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex Workday concepts for non-technical audiences.

• An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE



Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.



We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.



Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.



Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!


ABOUT THIS ROLE



Yubo doesn't have a PR team yet, and that's exactly why this role exists: to build one from scratch and help Yubo become culturally relevant, resilient to reputational bumps, and a real driver of growth.



It's a rare chance to shape a PR function from day one inside a fast-moving global tech company. You'll design how it works, lead our agency partner, and craft the stories, moments and relationships that make people pay attention to Yubo. The role covers everyday consumer stories, corporate communications, and handling sensitive issues or crises when they arise. To start, you'll focus on the US, UK and France, with room to grow from there.



You'll report to the Director of Brand & Communications and work closely with teams across the business, especially Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal. You'll own the relationship with our PR agency, making sure they feel like a true extension of the team, and you'll help set up the habits and processes that make PR part of how Yubo works day to day.



This is a freelance role on a 6-month contract, with a target start in Q4 2026.






YOUR RESPONSIBILITES



Set up how PR works at Yubo

 - Build PR operations and onboard Yubo's PR agency, setting clear ways to spot stories, check facts, and turn insight into coverage.

 - Dig into Yubo's data to find trends and stories worth telling.

 - Build a simple way to report on PR performance, linking coverage and sentiment to awareness and growth.

 - Review and embed Yubo's Crisis Comms Playbook.

Plan and run the PR agenda

 - Build Yubo's 2027 PR calendar and strategy, balancing campaigns, cultural moments, and day-to-day press activity.

 - Lead proactive and reactive media relations so Yubo speaks with a clear, consistent voice.

 - Spot and activate cultural moments through PR, research, events, creator partnerships and other earned activity.

 - Team up with Product and Data to build proof points and stories that show what Yubo means to people.

Look after Yubo's reputation

 - Advise senior leaders on reputational opportunities and risks.

 - Support corporate communications and reactive issues management when needed.

 - Work with Trust & Safety and Legal so Yubo talks about sensitive topics responsibly.

 - Help rally the right people internally when a crisis hits.






WHO YOU ARE

You're a proactive PR lead with sharp cultural instincts and a track record of creating stories that genuinely earn attention, not just promote launches.

You'll bring:

 - Solid PR experience, with real results to show from leading a function or campaign.

 - A good read on Gen-Z culture and how 18 to 24 year-olds socialise and engage online.

 - Experience turning insight and data into media stories, including digging into data yourself to find the angle.

 - A track record of using different levers to earn attention: influencers, experts, events, activations, research, stunts.

 - Experience managing and getting the best out of an external PR agency.

 - Good judgement under pressure, with experience in issues or crisis communications.

 - Strong writing and speaking skills, comfortable with both consumer storytelling and sensitive corporate messaging.

 - The ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.

 - A self-starter mindset, with examples of building something from the ground up.

Nice to have, but don't let that stop you:

 - Experience in high-growth tech, consumer apps, youth culture, media, entertainment or lifestyle.

 - Experience in the US market, including relationships with US media and journalists.






WITHIN A MONTH, YOU WILL

 - Get familiar with Yubo's product, mission and community, and where our communications and reputation stand today.

 - Meet key people across Brand, Product, Data, Trust & Safety and Legal.

 - Start onboarding our PR agency and reviewing the Crisis Comms Playbook.






WITHIN 3 MONTHS, YOU WILL

 - Have set up solid working habits with the PR agency and cross-functional teams.

 - Be well into building the 2027 PR strategy, calendar and measurement framework.

 - Have embedded the Crisis Comms Playbook and be actively building relationships with consumer, culture, lifestyle, tech and business media.






WITHIN 6 MONTHS, YOU WILL

 - Have delivered Yubo's finished 2027 PR strategy and calendar.

 - Have landed our first standout data- and culture-led stories in top-tier media, backed by a working way to measure PR performance.

 - Have wrapped up the agency onboarding and defined the role of creators, experts, events and activations in Yubo's communications, leaving a solid foundation for what's next.






THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 - A first introductory call with Nicolas, Talent Acquisition

 - A case study with Alex, our Brand Director.






OUR APPROACH TO PRIVACY & SAFETY

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.



Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

 

Here’s how we live our mission every day:

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Be Bold & Resilient: Raise your head, break barriers, keep moving forward

One team, one mission: No egos, no passengers, just shared wins

 

Trust & Flexibility: Our hybrid model calls for only two office days a month; the rest is up to the rhythm that works best for you.

 

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

Culture is central at Yubo, hence the numerous benefits:

Cool Workplace: enjoy our amazing Parisian office and our many hybrid work options

Team Activities: participate in get-togethers, events, and team-building activities

Family-Friendly: we support parents with childcare options and family-friendly policies

Wellness Programs: benefit from comprehensive health insurance, wellness programs, sports classes, and mental well-being initiatives

jobs.description:
ABOUT RADIANT

Radiant is an El Segundo, CA-based startup building the world’s first mass-produced, portable nuclear microreactors. The company’s first reactor, Kaleidos, is a 1-megawatt, fail-safe microreactor that can be transported anywhere power is needed and run for up to 5 years without refueling. Portable nuclear power with rapid-deploy capability can replace similar-sized diesel generators and provide critical asset support for hospitals, data centers, remote sites, and military bases. Radiant’s unique, practical approach to nuclear development leverages modern software engineering to rapidly deliver safe, factory-built microreactors that use existing, well-qualified materials. Founded in 2020, Radiant is on track to test its first reactor at the Idaho National Laboratory this summer, with initial customer deliveries beginning in 2028.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a T&E (Travel & Expense) Specialist to manage the processing and review of employee T&E activity and credit card charges for our nuclear energy company. You will help ensure expenses are accurate, policy-compliant, and properly recorded, while providing responsive support to employees who travel to project sites, vendor facilities, and regulatory meetings.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Review and process employee expense reports for accuracy, policy compliance, and proper documentation

 - Process corporate card transactions and reconcile card statements to the general ledger

Affect is transforming behavioral health care by combining mobile technology with counseling and medical services, offering 100% virtual treatment. We break down barriers to care, making it more accessible and effective for our members.

As a FNP, you will lead member care alongside a team of counselors, therapists, peer support specialists, and case managers. You’ll provide evidence-based treatment for individuals with substance use disorders.

• Experience prescribing Suboxone and active DEA registration.

• Willingness to obtain multi-state licensure (cost covered by Affect).

• Empathy for members facing behavioral health challenges.

• Comfort using technology, including EHRs and mobile apps.

Additional Information:

You’ll need a quiet, private office with a reliable internet connection for HIPAA-compliant telehealth visits. The role may include periodic meetings with internal teams; reasonable accommodations are available as needed.

Come be a part of the Affect mission!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you’ll find your place here.  We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Accounting Manager who is passionate about navigating complex, non-routine transactions and implementing new accounting standards. As a Senior Technical Accounting Manager at DigitalOcean, you will join a dynamic team dedicated to revolutionizing cloud computing and AI. You’ll be part of a high-performing team that is responsible for all aspects of technical accounting, including researching complex transactions, providing strategic advice to partners, implementing accounting policies and process improvements and ensuring compliance with U.S. GAAP and SEC reporting standards. You’ll have high visibility, collaborating cross-functionally with Financial Reporting, Corporate Development, Legal, FP&A, Investor Relations, Tax and Accounting. This position reports to the Senior Director, Financial Reporting and Technical Accounting.

What You’ll Do:

• Draft high-quality accounting memos and analyses to support management’s conclusions and obtain concurrence from external auditors, on topics such as business combinations, financing transactions, consolidation and joint ventures, investments, segment reporting, goodwill and intangible assets, derivatives and hedging, leases, stock-based compensation and internal-use software.

• Evaluate and operationalize the accounting for complex, non-routine transactions, including equity offerings, convertible debt issuance and settlement, supplier financing and data center, GPU, power and colocation agreements, and provide timely, strategic guidance to business partners on the accounting impact of proposed transactions.

• Review the accounting for material lease transactions, such as large data center and GPU arrangements, in partnership with the Accounting team, which owns lease accounting.

• Review non-routine or unusual revenue arrangements as needed, in partnership with the Revenue Accounting team, which owns ASC 606 analyses.

• Lead the accounting and valuation of M&A transactions and strategic investments, partnering with third-party specialists on purchase price allocations and fair value measurements.

• Perform goodwill, long-lived asset and indefinite-lived intangible asset impairment analyses.

• Develop and maintain certain accounting policies, ensuring they reflect current standards and industry best practices.

• Monitor FASB and SEC rulemaking, proactively lead the implementation of new standards and regulations and partner with Accounting, Tax and FP&A to create SOX-compliant processes.

• Serve as a primary technical accounting contact for external auditors during quarterly reviews and annual audits, coordinating the information and documentation needed to resolve technical matters.

• Partner with Financial Reporting on technical accounting disclosures for quarterly and annual SEC filings, and support offering documents and related diligence for equity and debt financings as needed.

• Review the statement of cash flows and the earnings per share calculations, including the impact of convertible debt and equity transactions, and support their preparation as needed.

• Work with the Accounting team to ensure complex transactions are recorded accurately in the general ledger, reviewing key journal entries and supporting calculations.

• Prepare clear, concise, executive-level materials, including technical accounting updates for senior leadership.

• Design, document and execute management review controls over technical accounting areas, with clear evidence of review and support for significant inputs, while continuously strengthening controls and increasing automation.

• Mentor, coach and develop junior accounting staff, and support ad hoc technical accounting requests and special projects as they arise.

What You’ll Add to DigitalOcean:

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field and an active CPA license

• 8+ years of progressive technical accounting experience under U.S. GAAP, with significant exposure to financing arrangements (debt, equity and convertible instruments), consolidations, derivatives, stock-based compensation and business combinations; working knowledge of lease and revenue accounting sufficient to review material transactions

• Public company experience, including SEC reporting and SOX 404 internal controls

• Prior Big 4 audit or transaction advisory experience, or an equivalent in-house technical accounting role at a high-growth technology company; 4+ years at a Big 4 audit firm strongly preferred

• Experience leading the accounting for financing and M&A transactions of meaningful size and complexity

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to critically evaluate valuation methodologies and assess complex security structures

• Proven ability to build financial processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• Excellent communication and writing skills, with the ability to draft clear, well-supported technical memos and explain complex accounting topics to executives, external auditors and non-accounting partners

• Exceptional attention to detail, with developed self-review processes to produce error-free work products

• Proficiency in financial modeling and comfort working across Excel, ERP systems (Oracle Fusion), Workiva and collaboration tools such as Google Suite

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and drive projects to completion with minimal supervision

• Preferred: experience with cloud, data center or AI infrastructure accounting

Compensation Range:

• $140,800 - $176,000

*This is a remote role

#LI-Remote

You’ll be a part of a cutting-edge technology company with an upward trajectory, who are proud to simplify cloud and AI so builders can spend more time creating software that changes the world. As a member of the team, you will be a Shark who thinks big, bold, and scrappy, like an owner with a bias for action and a powerful sense of responsibility for customers, products, employees, and decisions.

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM), established in 1969, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing the field of aviation maintenance through exceptional education and training. The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM)—the largest aviation maintenance training school in the U.S.—is seeking experienced Aircraft Maintenance Technicians (AMTs), Aircraft Mechanics, and FAA-certified A&P Mechanics to join our team as instructors.

jobs.title: Director of Data & AI Products
jobs.description:
As Head of Data and AI Technical Product Management, this leader serves as the global Commercial Data & AI technical product leader accountable for the operating model, portfolio strategy, investment trade-offs, product lifecycle, adoption, and product talent buildout for a large, regulated, global commercial data and AI ecosystem. The role builds and scales AbbVie’s Technical Data Product Ownership practice, serving as the IT counterpart to Commercial Business Product Owners and defining how technical data and AI products are discovered, prioritized, funded, built, launched, adopted, supported, measured, modernized, and retired. This leader translates Commercial product roadmaps and data consumer needs into durable, measurable technical product roadmaps while partnering with architecture, engineering, security, privacy, governance, analytics, and business teams. The role establishes the standards, lifecycle discipline, decision rights, adoption practices, funding mechanisms, and performance scorecards needed to move Global Commercial Data and AI from project-based delivery to product-based ownership at enterprise scale.

Responsibilities:

• Role dimensions: Serve as the global Commercial Data & AI technical product leader, owning the product operating model, multi-year portfolio strategy, investment trade-offs, lifecycle discipline, adoption strategy, and product talent buildout for a large, regulated, global commercial data and AI ecosystem. Lead the technical product roadmap across data products, AI-enabling capabilities, platform services, and self-service experiences aligned to Commercial priorities and enterprise risk expectations.
• Role scale: Own a multi-million-dollar annual Commercial Data & AI technical product portfolio supporting 30 commercial data domains, 30+ AI products and platform capabilities, 40+ brands/business units, and 120 countries. Build and scale a direct team of Technical Product Managers and product leaders, with intended responsibility for 10–20 product professionals and influence across 50–100+ matrixed engineering, AI, architecture, governance, analytics, and vendor resources as the organization matures.
• Ownership & autonomy: Own the Technical Data Product Management strategy, operating model, and product lifecycle for Commercial Data and AI capabilities, with accountability from discovery and roadmap integration through launch, adoption, support, versioning, modernization, and retirement. Partner with enterprise architecture, engineering, security, privacy, and governance leaders to make product trade-offs and ensure technical decisions align to business value, risk posture, and platform strategy.
• Decision-making: Accountable for product strategy, prioritization, roadmap trade-offs, adoption goals, lifecycle decisions, and value/risk recommendations for technical data and AI products. Define decision rights and working models with Commercial Business Product Owners and partners with architecture, engineering, security, privacy, and governance leaders on technical standards, risk acceptance, and compliance-by-design.
• Scope: Drive Global Commercial Data & AI technical product strategy across 40+ brands/business units, 120 countries, and hundreds of businesses, analytics, technology, and governance stakeholders. Partner with adjacent enterprise functions where Commercial data and AI products intersect, while maintaining clear primary accountability for the Commercial technical product ecosystem.
• Budget & investment: Own the annual engineering and technical portfolio budget and investment model; develop technical business cases, allocate funding across engineering initiatives, manage compute/cost-to-serve, and ensure vendor/partner spend aligns to product outcomes, architectural direction, and risk posture.
• Product talent buildout: Build and scale the Technical Data Product Management organization and talent bench, including hiring, coaching, performance management, succession planning, role standards, playbooks, communities of practice, and product leadership capability across direct and matrixed teams.
• Impact & influence: Serve hundreds of business, analytics, technology, and governance stakeholders globally; accountable for measurable technology outcomes such as reduced data latency, system uptime, engineering productivity gains, and compliance posture through improved data/AI reliability, discoverability, and adoption; operates at executive level, chairing or co-chairing technical steering committees and governance forums and influencing VP/SVP stakeholders through technical narratives, investment cases, operating model design, and performance metrics.
• Leadership expectations: Operate with enterprise mindset; make transparent value, risk, and capacity trade-offs; build inclusive and high-performing teams; influence senior stakeholders through clear narratives and metrics; raise product management standards across teams; and balance strategic ambition with pragmatic delivery and operational excellence.

Required:

• Bachelor’s Degree plus 12+ years of progressive experience in technical product management, platform leadership, data and analytics, AI-enabled products, or a related discipline, including global portfolio ownership, operating model leadership, investment accountability, people leadership, and senior accountability for measurable outcomes in a complex enterprise environment.
• Demonstrated ability to define multi-year strategy, secure alignment with executive stakeholders, and translate business objectives into funded roadmaps and measurable value realization.
