jobs.title: Executive Director - Corporate Investigations
jobs.description:
The Executive Director of Corporate Investigations is responsible for leading the strategic direction, execution, and oversight of all corporate investigations across Wynn Las Vegas. This role protects the integrity, assets, reputation, guests, and team members of the organization by managing complex investigations involving employee misconduct, fraud, theft, regulatory violations, workplace incidents, financial crimes, cyber-related concerns, and other matters that present legal, operational, or reputational risk.

The Executive Director serves as a trusted adviser to executive leadership and works closely with Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Internal Audit, Surveillance, Security, Finance, and regulatory agencies to ensure investigative activities are conducted with professionalism, discretion, objectivity, and adherence to applicable laws and company policies.

Job Responsibilities

• Develop, implement, and maintain the overall corporate investigations strategy for Wynn Las Vegas.
• Lead, direct, and oversee investigations involving allegations of fraud, theft, embezzlement, conflicts of interest, policy violations, harassment, workplace misconduct, bribery, corruption, and other compliance-related matters.
• Provide leadership and guidance to investigative personnel, establishing investigative standards, procedures, and best practices.
• Ensure investigations are conducted thoroughly, objectively, confidentially, and in accordance with company policies and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.
• Direct the collection, preservation, and analysis of evidence, including digital, financial, documentary, and witness information.
• Partner with Human Resources and Employee Relations during investigations involving employee conduct and workplace concerns.
• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, Information Security, Surveillance, and Security departments on complex or high-risk matters.
• Prepare comprehensive investigative reports, executive briefings, and recommendations for senior leadership.
• Identify trends, emerging risks, and control weaknesses, developing proactive mitigation strategies to reduce organizational vulnerability.
• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with gaming regulators, law enforcement agencies, and other external partners.
• Serve as the primary investigative resource during significant incidents, crises, and matters involving potential legal or regulatory exposure.
• Support litigation, audits, regulatory reviews, and administrative proceedings by providing investigative expertise and documentation.
• Develop performance metrics and reporting tools to measure investigative effectiveness and organizational risk trends.
• Manage department budgets, staffing plans, and operational resources.
• Lead training and awareness programs related to fraud prevention, investigative reporting, compliance, ethics, and workplace integrity.
• Foster a culture of accountability, ethical conduct, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
• Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and exercise sound judgment when addressing complex business and personnel matters.
• Demonstrate a commitment to Forbes Five-Star service standards and Wynn's culture of excellence.

• Minimum of ten (10) years of progressive investigative experience, including leadership responsibilities in corporate investigations, law enforcement, regulatory enforcement, public integrity, intelligence, compliance, or related fields.
• Minimum of five (5) years of senior management experience leading investigative teams.
• Bachelor’s degree in criminal justice, Business Administration, Law, Security Management, Intelligence Studies, or related discipline is required. Extensive experience at a senior level in State, Local or Federal Law Enforcement can be supplemented for college degree.
• Extensive knowledge of investigative methodologies, evidence handling, interviewing techniques, and case management practices.
• Strong understanding of employment law, regulatory compliance, fraud detection, internal controls, and risk management principles.
• Experience conducting financial, operational, workplace, and compliance-related investigations within a large, complex organization.
• Ability to analyze complex information, identify key issues, and develop practical, risk-based solutions.
• Experience in counter terrorism and homeland security threats, investigations, and prevention.
• Understanding of Human Trafficking laws and prevention.
• Ability to lead complex teams of various backgrounds, skills, and abilities.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present findings to executive leadership and regulatory authorities.
• Proven ability to maintain confidentiality and manage highly sensitive matters with discretion and professionalism.
• Strong project management, leadership, and organizational skills.
• Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and investigative case management systems.
• Proficiency with modern AI tools such as Copilot, Gemini, Claude, and Chat GPT.
• Ability to obtain and maintain all licenses and work cards required by the Nevada Gaming Control Board and local regulatory authorities.
• Must be able to adapt to changing work environments and maintain excellent time management skills.
• Must be able to work evenings, weekends, holidays, and maintain availability for urgent investigations when business needs require.

jobs.title: Transportation Design Lead - TX
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Transportation Design Lead to support our Texas market. The position can be based in any of our TX offices in Houston, Austin or San Antonio.

The Impact You’ll Make

As the Transportation Design Lead for Texas, reporting to the U.S. South Central Regional Manager, you will lead the performance and growth of the Texas transportation design team. This role leads client service, business development, and project delivery in the Texas market, with a strong emphasis on building relationships and securing work with Texas agencies at the local, regional, and state levels (including TxDOT, MPOs, cities, counties, and regional authorities). You will oversee design staff, manage resources and budgets, provide technical and project oversight, support go/no-go decisions on pursuits, and support the region’s growth strategy by developing and implementing business plans.

Project Management, Design Oversight, and Staff Management

• Be capable of analyzing all technical aspects of roadway/highway engineering, identifying issues and applying suitable solutions, analyzing complex design problems requiring the development of new or improved techniques or procedures, and recommending major design changes.
• Review construction plans, design calculations, specifications, cost estimates to ensure completeness, accuracy, constructability, and conformity to local standards or best engineering practices.
• Have strong report writing skills and be responsible for preparing project reports and feasibility studies.
• Have the ability to lead meetings and interface with Egis’s clients.
• Have experience in developing project schedules, scope and budget, as well as have other fundamental project management capabilities.
• Be responsible for the quality assurance and quality control through the development and review of construction plans, specifications, and cost estimates.
• Have excellent leadership potential and soft skills, and the ability to work well with staff at all levels.

Marketing and Business Development

• Help develop the civil transportation vision and support business plans to drive the region's growth, leveraging a strong understanding of the Texas marketplace, competitive landscape, and opportunities with local, regional, and state agencies (TxDOT, MPOs, cities, counties, and regional authorities).
• Work closely with Marketing Manager on development and implementation of marketing and growth strategies focused on Texas agencies at the local, regional, and state levels. Enforce application of marketing best practices and ensure the office is actively working toward meeting business plan goals and objectives. Stay apprised of key / strategic opportunities, make go/no-go decisions on pursuits, and ensure pursuit team compliance with client management, pre-positioning, go/no-go, and pursuit strategy best practices and company guidelines.
• Represent the firm at client meetings, industry events, and other business functions with a priority on Texas agencies (TxDOT districts and divisions, metropolitan planning organizations, cities, counties, and regional transportation authorities). Develop relationships with key client decision-makers and leaders from teaming partner firms; take active leadership roles in professional organizations. Support the development of strategic teaming partnerships and subsequent agreements.
• Schedule and lead periodic meetings with key client personnel from Texas agencies (local, regional, and state) in coordination with PMs, staff, and other members of leadership as appropriate to strengthen relationships and identify new opportunities.

Business Strategy and Implementation

• Support the development of office-level action plans to support the regional business plan and encourage strong debate and analysis for growth in an area or discipline.
• Help with the compliance with company expectations for staff utilization and enforce corrective action plans when/where needed. Resolve high level operational concerns or problems as soon as practicable and take actionable steps to remediate impacts and enhance performance.
• Assess and anticipate talent needs to best understand current and future gaps and bench strength.
• Support team recruiting efforts to align with growth strategy.

Finance and Operations

• Help with the profitability of the Texas office(s) and associated projects.
• Measure and monitor budget and operational performance and communicate key metrics and information regularly to the leadership team.

Operational Responsibility

• Where possible and in agreement with regional leadership, maintain a defined level of chargeability.
• Work closely with other leaders in the Region and support teaming.
• Maintain client communication in coordination with other offices and assure satisfactory client experience, project production, and Quality Assurance / Quality Control procedures.
• Oversee succession plans and where appropriate, support development of defined successor(s) across the team. Perform honest and candid performance evaluations of direct reports. Recommend salary increases for subordinate staff for approval by leadership.
• Ensure office complies with applicable laws, regulations, and corporate policies / procedures.
• Ensure the flow of communication within the region, through regular meetings, written communications, and informal communication, to ensure the effective sharing or critical information, efficient decision-making, team engagement and collaboration.

Results

• Help drive the growth of the business regionally to support attainment of Egis’s nationwide growth strategies and plans.
• Leverage an entrepreneurial approach to refresh the local strategy and position the business for success. Contribute to long-term growth in the region by building the technical and civil transportation capabilities required to secure current business and penetrate new markets.
• Stabilize the business and reinvigorate the culture. Engage and inspire the team, with a focus on sustainable growth through recruitment, retention, and professional development.

The Expertise You’ll Bring

• Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering
• Professional Civil Engineering License in Texas required
• Minimum of 15 years of diversified experience in civil engineering, with specific expertise in transportation infrastructure
• Has led and delivered significant projects of scale through effective team and budget management.
• Experienced in relevant facets of planning, design and construction services for roads, highways and bridges.
• Strategic and growth minded leadership
• Demonstrated track record of positioning and scaling a business and team for growth. Ensures effective governance, at the project and business level.
• Demonstrated track record of building strong relationships.
• Ability to develop effective and trustworthy long-term relationships with clients, colleagues, and other stakeholders in the transportation industry. Ideally brings an established network with Texas agencies at the local, regional, and state levels, along with relevant partners.
• Strong written and verbal communications skills
• Adept at leveraging communications skills both externally (business development, writing proposals, community engagements, stakeholder and partnership development, leading client presentations/meetings) and internally, to drive the development and engagement of strong teams.

Demonstrated Leadership Capabilities

• Strategic thinking
• Driving results
• Leading change
• Leading people
• Collaborating and influencing
• Building people capability

Why You'll Thrive at Egis

At Egis, you'll do more than build your career—you'll help shape the future of infrastructure. As we continue to expand across the United States, we're looking for curious, collaborative professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and delivering projects that improve communities and create lasting impact.

Whether you're launching your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading experts, collaborate across disciplines and borders, and contribute to projects that transform the way people live, move, and connect. Here, you'll be empowered to take on meaningful work, develop new skills, and grow your career with the support of a global engineering leader.

What Sets Egis Apart

• Meaningful Projects – Contribute to complex infrastructure projects that strengthen communities and improve quality of life.
• Global Expertise, Local Impact – Collaborate with technical specialists across North America and around the world while delivering solutions that make a difference locally.
• Career Growth – Expand your skills through mentorship, professional development, technical training, and leadership opportunities.
• A Culture of Collaboration – Thrive in an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and teamwork drives success.
• Opportunity to Grow with Us – Join a rapidly expanding organization where your ideas, contributions, and career can grow alongside the business.

Total Rewards That Support You

We believe great work starts with supporting our people. That's why Egis offers a comprehensive Total Rewards program designed to promote your health, well-being, financial security, and professional growth, including:

• Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage

Position Summary:The Inventory Specialist plays a critical role in assisting the Stockroom Manager with maintaining inventory accuracy through meticulous cycle counting and the efficient resolution of inventory discrepancies. This position is essential to ensuring that physical inventory levels align precisely with recorded inventory data. The responsibilities encompass addressing inventory discrepancies, identifying potential areas of inventory inaccuracies, actively participating in root cause analysis processes, and proposing enhancements to existing procedures. Furthermore, this role provides support to the Stockroom and Receiving teams in their daily operations.

Key Duties / Responsibilities:

• Perform stocking and allocation duties for inventory and supplies.

• Conduct quality assurance inspections on orders.

• Provide assistance with material handling as required, including investigation of material problems and inventory control issues.

• Support incoming receiving, receipt inspection, and Stockroom activities as needed.

• Lead and execute daily cycle counting, often for specific sections or locations, comparing results with inventory records in the ERP system.

• Update inventory records based on cycle count results, ensuring the inventory system accurately reflects the physical stock on hand.

• Conduct frequent spot and partial audits of physical inventory.

• Perform other duties as requested, directed, or assigned.

• Critical success factors include accuracy, timely completion of tasks, and adherence to instructions.

Education / Experience:

• High school diploma or equivalent is required; formal technical training is preferred.

• A minimum of 1-2 years of experience in inventory control is necessary.

• Basic knowledge of inventory tracking and rotation methods is essential.

• Experience in cycle counting is required.

• Previous experience working in a manufacturing environment is preferred; understanding of ERP systems is a plus.

• Previous experience utilizing Microsoft Excel (V-Lookups, formulas, pivot tables) is a plus but not mandatory.

Job Knowledge / Requirements:

• Must develop a thorough knowledge of Stockroom fundamentals, including interpretation of packing lists, accurate order pulling, filling inventory kits, and use of the Material Requirements Planning (MRP) system.

• Demonstrate basic competency in computer skills: MS Office (MS Word, Excel), Google applications, and database systems

• Must develop knowledge of Cadwell products, and their parts and assemblies.

• Possess strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to receive, understand, and follow oral and written instructions, information, procedures, and schematics.

• Complete tasks as directed with minimal supervision, with precision and within defined schedules.

• Capable of working both independently and as an effective member of a team.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant SEC Reporting
jobs.description:
Collegium Pharmaceutical is building a leading, diversified biopharmaceutical company committed to improving the lives of people living with serious medical conditions. We have a leading portfolio of responsible pain management and neuropsychiatry medications.

Hybrid – Boston, MA: Collegium will relocate its headquarters to One Lincoln in downtown Boston in Q1 2027. Until the move, this role will be based at our current headquarters in Stoughton, MA. Employees are required to work onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday each week, both before and after the relocation.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Senior Accountant, SEC Reporting, position will play a key role in Collegium's external financial reporting, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, and equity administration and accounting. Reporting to the Assistant Controller, this role will own the end-to-end, day-to-day process for timely, accurate, and complete SEC reporting, including the Form 10-K, Form 10-Q, proxy statement, and other filings. The role will also be responsible for the timely and accurate processing of equity awards, ensuring proper process, accounting, and reporting. In addition, the Senior Accountant will serve as a key administrator for several financial systems, partnering with consultants, colleagues, and IT to ensure those systems operate effectively, remain SOX compliant, and continue to improve.

This position is ideal for a Big 4 auditor with public company experience who is ready to bring their audit skills into a growing public company. From day one, the Senior Accountant will help improve accuracy, drive deadlines, manage open items lists, and serve as a key point of contact for internal and external auditors. The 10-Q and 10-K feed directly into the earnings process and are approved by the Audit Committee, so this role has significant visibility to the executive team and Board of Directors. It requires a highly responsible, polished professional. In return, it offers the chance to learn how a public company operates from the inside, work alongside talented colleagues, and build a foundation for future career growth across Finance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Perform the day-to-day SEC reporting process, including managing the preparation of the 10-K, 10-Q, annual proxy statement, and other filings as needed

• Support the quarterly earnings process, preparing and reviewing financial information for management, the Audit Committee, and external communications

• Support the financial statement and SOX audit process, partnering with auditors to provide timely and accurate support, establish expectations and deadlines, and manage open items lists through resolution

• Support the SOX attestation process, including the design, implementation, and operating effectiveness of internal controls over financial reporting

• Work with internal teams and Legal to ensure all financial and compliance processes for the Company's equity plan, including W-2 and 1099 reporting impacts, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) enrollment, Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) processing, and overall administration of employee equity awards

• Develop and implement enhancements to the financial close and equity administration processes with support from consultants and colleagues

• Serve as a key administrator and reviewer for the Company's accounting and finance systems and related reports

• Work closely with the accounting team to identify opportunities to improve the accuracy, timeliness, and effectiveness of financial reporting

• Identify opportunities to develop and use analytics that turn data into actionable information

• Partner with other departments to ensure effective use of systems, Excel models and AI tools, reporting, and information sharing, as well as overall compliance with internal controls

• Build strong relationships with colleagues across functions, including Finance, Legal, HR, IT, R&D, Operations, and Sales & Marketing

• Communicate clearly, providing thoughtful explanations and asking clarifying questions

• Drive continuous improvement and proactively solve routine problems

REQUIRED LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS

At Collegium, how we achieve results is just as important as what we achieve. Our Leadership Behaviors define how we work, collaborate, and succeed as we continue to evolve as an organization.

We group these behaviors into three pillars:

• HEAD

• Think Entrepreneurially

• Take Decisive Action

• Drive Results

• HEART

• Communicate Effectively

• Enable High Performance

• Collaborate with Purpose

• GUTS

• Take Smart Risks

• Be Tenacious About Change

• Compete to Win

Successful candidates will demonstrate these behaviors through their ability to challenge the status quo, build strong relationships, drive results, embrace change, and contribute to a high-performance culture.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting required; CPA preferred

• 2–4 years of public accounting experience required; Big 4 audit experience strongly preferred

• Experience auditing public companies (SEC registrants) strongly preferred

• Strong understanding of SEC reporting requirements, including Forms 10-K and 10-Q, and U.S. GAAP

• Working knowledge of SOX and internal controls over financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines

• Polished, professional communication skills and comfort interacting with senior leadership

• Advanced, hands-on Microsoft Excel skills; experience using AI tools also preferred

Pay Range

$95,000—$115,000 USD

This role leads client service, business development, and project delivery in the PNW market, with a strong emphasis on building relationships and securing work with PNW agencies at the local, regional, and state levels (including DOT, MPOs, cities, counties, and regional authorities). Marketing and Business Development

Operational Responsibility

Results

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst - Finance
jobs.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our growing team. Data is a core competency of Engine, and the team’s mission is to leverage our data assets, advanced analytics, and machine learning to deliver product and business value across the organization. Our overarching company goals include revenue growth, enhancing member experience, and ensuring scalability.

What You'll Do

• Partner with stakeholders across product, engineering, and design to lead metrics definition, reporting, and analyses.

• Lead key analytics projects and derive actionable insights to drive better product and business performance.

• Design and build statistical analyses to answer specific business questions and power key product functionalities.

• Participate in product and growth experiments.

• Build and maintain data pipelines to generate and track relevant product and business metrics.

• Collaborate with data engineers to establish data assets and feature stores for process automation, advanced analytics, and machine learning models.

• Manage the company’s business intelligence reporting dashboards.

• Leverage advanced SQL skills to explore large, complex datasets and uncover key insights related to pricing and business performance.

• Independently investigate open-ended business questions; identify patterns, quantify opportunities, and deliver actionable recommendations that inform strategic pricing decisions.

• Translate complex and nuanced analytical findings into clear, concise insights for senior leadership, with a strong focus on aligning recommendations with business goals.

• Demonstrate ownership and depth in analysis — moving beyond surface-level metrics to uncover the "why" behind performance trends and deliver high-impact insights.

• Partner cross-functionally with product, pricing, and engineering teams to scope analytical needs and validate hypotheses with rigorous data-driven approaches.

What We're Looking For

• Bachelor’s degree in Data, Economics, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.

• 5+ years of relevant work experience as a Data or Business Analyst with a proven track record of manipulating and extracting value from datasets.

• Experience building complex SQL queries.

• Strong fundamentals in statistics and econometrics (e.g., regressions, hypothesis testing).

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to distill complex issues and analyses.

• Experience with Looker, Snowflake, and Amplitude is a plus.

• Inquisitive mindset with a desire to dig deeper to understand the "why" behind our data.

Why Join Us

• Be part of a data-driven culture that values innovation and continuous improvement.

• Work with cross-functional teams to shape the future of our product and business.

• Enjoy opportunities for growth, learning, and meaningful impact across the organization.

If this sounds like your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

Applications for this role will be accepted through 12/31/2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range

$131,500—$154,700 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM)—the largest aviation maintenance training school in the U.S.—is seeking experienced Aircraft Maintenance Technicians (AMTs), Aircraft Mechanics, and FAA-certified A&P Mechanics to join our team as instructors.

jobs.description:
Training Tomorrow's Technicians to Become Skilled, Employable and Essential.

About Us  - Big Changes, Better Benefits - Join us today!

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM), established in 1969, is a premier institution dedicated to advancing the field of aviation maintenance through exceptional education and training. With 15 campuses nationwide, AIM is a cornerstone in the aviation industry, accounting for 20% of all students attending FAA-certified Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) schools across the country. Each year, AIM proudly contributes to the graduation of nearly one in four certified aircraft technicians in America.

At AIM, you'll become part of a dynamic team of educators and leaders, all united by a shared commitment to delivering top-notch training and ensuring student success. We are passionate about equipping the next generation of aircraft technicians with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in the aviation industry. If you are eager to make a meaningful impact and help shape the future of aviation maintenance, AIM offers a rewarding environment where your contributions will truly matter.

Campus Location: 2025 Satellite Pointe Duluth, GA 30096

Compensation: Up to $36 per hour, based on experience, qualifications, and other relevant factors.

Employment: Part-Time

Are you an A&P Mechanic ready for a new chapter in your aviation career?

The Aviation Institute of Maintenance (AIM)—the largest aviation maintenance training school in the U.S.—is seeking experienced Aircraft Maintenance Technicians (AMTs), Aircraft Mechanics, and FAA-certified A&P Mechanics to join our team as instructors.

If you have hands-on experience in aircraft maintenance and enjoy mentoring others, this is your opportunity to step out of the hangar and into a role where you can shape the next generation of aviation professionals.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals exploring aviation mechanic jobs, aircraft maintenance careers, or instructor roles in aviation training.

No prior teaching experience required. We provide a 5-day paid instructor training program to help you successfully transition into the classroom.

Why Consider Teaching?

Many skilled A&P mechanics and aviation technicians don’t initially consider teaching—but those who do often find it to be one of the most rewarding paths in their career.

At AIM, you’ll:

• Share your real-world aircraft maintenance experience with future technicians

• Enjoy more predictable schedules compared to field work

• Make a lasting impact on students entering the aviation industry

• Continue growing your own knowledge while developing others

About the Role

As an Aircraft Maintenance Instructor (A&P Mechanic Instructor), you will deliver FAA Part 147-aligned aviation maintenance curriculum and provide hands-on instruction to students preparing for careers as aircraft maintenance technicians (AMTs).

This role is ideal for experienced A&P mechanics, aircraft mechanics, and aviation maintenance professionals who want to combine technical expertise with mentorship and training while delivering hands-on aviation maintenance instruction in classroom and active hangar environments.

Schedule Options

• Option 1: Monday - Thursday: 7:00am - 2:00pm

• Option 2: Monday - Thursday: 4:30pm - 11:00pm

• Option 3: Friday - Sunday: 7:00am - 4:30pm

Key Responsibilities

• Teach aircraft maintenance systems, procedures, and techniques in a hands-on environment

• Deliver FAA-aligned curriculum to prepare students for A&P certification

• Demonstrate practical skills used by A&P mechanics and aviation technicians

• Maintain accurate records of attendance, grades, and student progress

• Support curriculum updates and collaborate with program leadership

• Help create a structured, engaging, and safety-focused learning environment

• Maintain classroom, lab equipment, and training materials

Qualifications

Education

• High School Diploma or GED required

• Associate degree in aviation or related field preferred

Experience

• Minimum 3 years of aircraft maintenance experience

• Background as an A&P Mechanic, Aircraft Mechanic, or Aviation Maintenance Technician (AMT)

Licensure

• FAA Airframe & Powerplant (A&P) Mechanic Certificate required

Skills

• Strong knowledge of aircraft systems and aviation maintenance procedures

• Interest in mentoring, coaching, and developing others

• Ability to work in a structured, compliance-driven training environment

• Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint)

• Flexibility to support evening or weekend schedules as needed

Apply today to join the team at Aviation Institute of Maintenance and help train the next generation of A&P mechanics.

AIM is a proud equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe that a diverse workforce contributes to the success of our company and are dedicated to fostering a culture of respect, equity, and inclusion.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer, Electrical
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

Senior Project Engineer – Performs & plans commissioning of electrical systems. Must be a self-motivated & energetic professional. Must have understanding of building electrical systems design & construction. Must have experience with commissioning process of electrical systems ranging in size, rating and complexity. The ideal candidate shall possess theoretical and practical knowledge in the commissioning, testing and troubleshooting of electrical systems and related controls. Candidate will be responsible for reviewing project information; coordinating and executing daily field activities; maintaining project documentation; assisting the Project Manager with schedule and planning of resources; and providing guidance to Project Engineers. May perform as team lead on small to medium sized projects. Will be expected to assess and test at a high technical level. This role requires the candidate to have technical competency, organizational skills, good communication skills, and to work well in a team environment where leadership is necessary.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Commission electrical distribution equipment and related controls, primarily in data center environments, including high voltage and medium voltage systems.
• Review system designs for compliance with client facility goals.
• Prepare plans and procedures for execution of the commissioning process.
• Conduct commissioning activities from the design phase through the occupation phase, in accordance with client requirements and industry commissioning process best practices.
• Attend factory testing of equipment and document procedures and results.
• Conduct functional testing of equipment.
• Perform analysis of test results using instrumentation and prepare reports.
• Understand critical power quality requirements and test procedures.
• Perform thermographic surveys and analyze results.
• Fully document all field procedures including results, issues and observations either via company provided templates or online applications.
• Report on system performance and make technical recommendations on issues.
• Work with the Project Manager and project teams to coordinate and execute field activities.
• Prepare and provide input on commissioning project documentation and schedules.
• Draft comprehensive test procedures for a variety of equipment and systems.
• Attend relevant project coordination and schedule meetings as necessary.
• May be required to lead commissioning meetings or speak on technical topics.
• Assist with submitting and maintaining daily commissioning reports.
• Train and guide both Associate Project Engineers and Project Engineers on roles & responsibilities
• Respond to project team and client inquiries in a professional and timely manner.
• Comply with company, client, and project safety requirements.
• Be knowledgeable with building equipment, including, but not limited to:GeneratorGenerator Paralleling SwitchgearHigh / Medium / Low Voltage Transformer (XFMR)Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS Systems)Battery SystemsHigh / Medium / Low Voltage Switchgear (SWGR)Low Voltage Main Switchboards (MSB)PLC ControlAutomatic and Semi-Automatic Switching ControlsElectrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS)Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS)Static Transfer Switch (STS)Power Distribution Unit (PDU)BuswaysRemote Power Panel (RPP)Grounding SystemsLighting Control Systems

Education/Experience/Background:

• BSc/MSc in Electrical Engineering with 5 or more years with mission critical project experience, or relevant and applicable industry experience;

OR

• Minimum of 7 or more years of experience in commissioning with mission critical project experience, or relevant and applicable industry experience.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Experience in Mission Critical facility commissioning essential.
• Organized, detail-oriented, analytical, proactive, problem solver.
• Good communication and relationship skills.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, work with limited supervision and manage junior engineers on day to day tasks.
• Knowledge & experience with ASHRAE or BCxA commissioning guidelines preferred.
• Knowledge & experience with InterNational Electrical Testing Association (NETA) test specifications.
• Distributed control system experience a plus.
• Good understanding of building management systems (BMS) and/or electrical power monitoring system (EPMS).
• Deep understanding and application of test instrumentation.
• Team player and a “client-first” mentality.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Professional Engineers (PE) License and/or a commissioning certification a plus but not required.

Physical Requirements:

• Ability to walk up to 5 miles per day.
• Carry up to 50 lbs.
• Ability to wear required PPE daily.
• Travel nationwide 50% - 75% if not assigned locally; may have periods of higher travel expectation.

Pay Range: $115,000 to $130,000 Per Year.

Benefits: Veolia’s comprehensive benefits package includes paid time off policies, as well as health, dental, vision, life insurance, savings accounts, tuition reimbursement, paid volunteering and more. In addition, employees are also entitled to participate in an employer sponsored 401(k) plan, to save for retirement.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer! All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Technical Solution Consultant
jobs.description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

The Role:

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you’ll bring technical expertise to the sales process, helping customers understand how Bottomline’s banking solutions fit within their technology environment.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Program Management, and Implementation teams to understand customer requirements, guide technical conversations, define solution architecture and integrations, and help ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation.

This role supports opportunities across our Digital Banking, Cash & Fraud Risk Management, and Financial Messaging solutions. You’ll work with stakeholders ranging from CIOs and CTOs to developers and technical application teams, so we’re looking for someone who can go deep technically while also making complex concepts easy to understand.

You don’t necessarily need to come from a traditional Solutions Consulting background. If you have strong technical experience in areas like solution architecture, implementation, software development, or enterprise integrations and enjoy working with customers, this could be a great opportunity to bring that technical expertise into a more consultative, sales-focused role.

How You’ll Contribute

Technical Sales & Customer Engagement

• Serve as a technical resource throughout the sales process, joining opportunities after qualification and helping shape the technical strategy.

• Lead technical discovery conversations to understand customer requirements, architecture, integrations, and potential dependencies.

• Engage confidently with both technical and executive stakeholders, including developers, architects, technical application leads, CIOs, and CTOs.

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, meaningful information for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Deliver technical presentations, architecture reviews, solution demonstrations, and other technical discussions as needed.

• Identify technical risks, dependencies, and implementation considerations early in the sales cycle.

• Support opportunities with both prospective and existing customers.

Solution Architecture & Integration

• Understand and communicate the architecture behind Bottomline’s Digital Banking, Cash & Fraud Risk Management, and Financial Messaging solutions.

• Develop solution approaches that align with customer requirements and existing technology environments.

• Guide conversations around integrations, infrastructure, configuration, interfaces, and solution architecture.

• Create and maintain architecture and integration documentation to clearly capture the proposed solution and scope.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, Program Management, and Implementation teams to validate solution feasibility and support an effective handoff into implementation.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Work closely with Sales as part of deal pursuit teams across multiple opportunities.

• Partner with Product Management to deepen product knowledge and share customer insights.

• Collaborate with Engineering and Development to understand solution architecture and technical capabilities.

• Work closely with Program Management and Implementation to understand integration requirements and ensure continuity from sales through implementation.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Implementation, Software Development, or another technical role where you’ve worked with customers or cross-functional stakeholders.

• Strong understanding of software architecture, enterprise applications, and systems integration.

• Ability to understand and explain technical architecture, including infrastructure, databases, operating systems, interfaces, and integrations.

• Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for different audiences.

• Comfort engaging with developers, architects, IT leaders, and executive stakeholders.

• Ability to quickly learn new technologies, products, and architectures.

• A collaborative approach and comfort working across multiple opportunities and priorities.

Preferred Experience

• Experience within banking, fintech, or financial services technology.

• Experience with Digital Banking solutions is especially valuable.

• Exposure to fraud, risk management, payments, or Financial Messaging solutions.

• Experience working with banks and understanding how enterprise software solutions integrate within a bank’s technology ecosystem.

• Previous client-facing implementation, solution architecture, or technical pre-sales experience.

• Working knowledge of AI and its application within enterprise software and the ability to comfortably discuss AI-related concepts with customers.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll be successful in this role if you can:

• Build credibility with both technical and business stakeholders.

• Quickly become knowledgeable across multiple Bottomline banking solutions and their underlying architecture.

• Take complex technical information and make it understandable to the audience in front of you.

• Help customers understand how Bottomline solutions can successfully integrate within their environment.

• Identify technical considerations early and help create a clear path from evaluation through implementation.

• Balance multiple opportunities while knowing where and when your technical expertise can have the greatest impact.

The Ideal Candidate

You’re technically curious, a quick learner, and comfortable digging into the details of how software works and integrates. At the same time, you enjoy working with people and can explain technology without making it feel unnecessarily complicated.

You may already be a Sales Engineer or Technical Solutions Consultant, or you may come from solution architecture, implementation, or software development and be ready to take your technical experience into a more customer-facing role. Expected travel: up to approximately 25%.

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive (NYC)
jobs.description:
Artsy and Artnet are hiring a Senior Account Executive to grow and manage a portfolio of gallery partners across our full product suite. Business fluency in French is highly desirable, with German or Spanish language skills considered a plus.

You'll manage a book of 150+ galleries and report to your regional Sales Lead. You'll own retention and growth for your portfolio, renewing subscriptions, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring partners see meaningful value from the products they purchase. You'll sell across Artsy gallery subscriptions, the Artnet Gallery Network, advertising, the Artnet Price Database, and new products and initiatives as they launch.

This is a senior, commercially driven role that requires strong ownership, sound judgment, and operational excellence. You'll be expected to independently manage your revenue targets, navigate complex negotiations, and proactively identify opportunities to offset revenue risk through growth elsewhere in your portfolio.

Success requires balancing high-volume account management and administrative responsibilities with thoughtful, personalised customer engagement. You'll use Salesforce, Looker, AI, and automation tools to streamline workflows, maintain exceptional data hygiene, and create more capacity for meaningful, human-focused client relationships.

Beyond delivering your own results, you'll contribute to a collaborative, ego-free team culture by sharing your expertise, successes, and learnings to help those around you succeed.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own retention and revenue growth for a portfolio of 150+ gallery partners, independently managing renewals, upsells, and expansion opportunities to achieve quarterly targets.

 - Sell bundles and multi-product solutions across Artsy and Artnet, including new products and initiatives as they launch.

 - Build a deep understanding of each gallery's business, using consultative discovery to recommend solutions aligned with their needs, goals, and financial circumstances.

 - Lead complex commercial negotiations, confidently handling pricing objections, payment challenges, and renewal discussions while balancing customer relationships with revenue retention goals.

 - Proactively manage revenue risk, identifying opportunities to offset downgrades, churn, or other negative revenue changes through growth elsewhere in your portfolio.

 - Strategically segment and prioritise accounts based on revenue potential, customer needs, and growth opportunities, ensuring your time and attention are invested effectively.

 - Manage a high volume of customer requests, administrative tasks, and client deliverables, including advertising placements and other product commitments, with exceptional organisation and attention to detail.

 - Maintain accurate and up-to-date account records, pipeline activity, and revenue forecasts in Salesforce, ensuring consistently high standards of data hygiene.

 - Leverage Looker, AI, and automation tools to identify opportunities, improve efficiency, streamline repetitive tasks, and create more time for personalised, high-value customer interactions.

 - Plan several quarters ahead, anticipating renewal challenges, identifying risks early, and proactively developing strategies to protect and grow your book of business.

 - Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure seamless delivery of products and services and an excellent partner experience.

 - Actively support your peers by sharing best practices, successful strategies, and lessons learned, contributing to a collaborative and high-performing team.


WHO YOU ARE

We welcome you to apply even if you don't check every box below.

 - 5+ years of experience in B2B account management or sales, with a demonstrated track record of achieving retention, renewal, and expansion targets.

 - A commercially minded account owner who takes full accountability for their portfolio, proactively addressing revenue challenges and identifying growth opportunities without needing direction.

 - A confident, consultative negotiator who can navigate financial objections, distinguish genuine customer challenges from negotiation tactics, and find commercially sound solutions that protect revenue while maintaining strong client relationships.

 - Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a large portfolio, competing priorities, high-volume administrative responsibilities, and time-sensitive client deliverables.

 - Experienced in Salesforce or a comparable CRM, with a commitment to maintaining accurate customer records, reliable forecasting, and excellent data hygiene.

 - Proficient in using AI and automation tools to increase productivity and streamline workflows, while recognising that technology should enhance, not replace, authentic and personalised customer engagement.

 - Experienced in selling multiple products or solutions to existing customers, with the ability to identify opportunities for cross-selling, bundling, and account expansion.

 - Strategic and data-driven, with the ability to assess account potential, prioritise opportunities, and allocate time and resources effectively.

 - Comfortable engaging with senior, discerning clients, confidently advising them, challenging assumptions when appropriate, and building trusted, long-term relationships.

 - A collaborative, ego-free team player who actively shares knowledge, celebrates collective success, and contributes to the development of peers.

 - Based in London, with the ability to work from the office at least three days per week.

Nice to Have

 - Experience in the art market or another relationship-driven industry.

 - Experience selling SaaS subscriptions, advertising, data products, or other multi-product solutions.

 - Experience managing advertising placements, campaign deliverables, or other customer commitments requiring close operational coordination.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Opportunity to reimagine the art industry while working with a talented, diverse, international team.

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Flexible time off: our culture of trust and empowerment allows employees to take the time they need away from work while still excelling in their roles

 - We are a global hybrid team: most employees work from our NYC, London, or Berlin offices 2-3 days per week. (In-person expectations vary by role)

 - Comprehensive healthcare & benefit options, including: medical, dental, parental leave, short- and long-term disability, Employee Assistance Program featuring free mental health support, 401k, commuter benefits, flexible spending accounts (FSA), health savings accounts (HSA), financial wellness support & resources, and more

 - Professional development, including: mentoring, lunch & learns, regular training, 1:1 management, and an open feedback culture

jobs.title: Team Lead, Market Operations - Houston - Spring VM, TX
jobs.description:
About Carvana

At Carvana, we sell cars, but we are not salespeople. We have made it our mission to create a hassle-free way for people to buy and sell cars. We saw a huge problem with how much of a headache it is to buy a car the traditional way, so we committed ourselves to put customer satisfaction at the core of our business, we have built a no-pressure, no-haggle online car buying experience that saves our customers time and money. Customers can search through thousands of vehicles online, see full 360-degree views of both the interior and exterior of the vehicles before deciding to go through the purchasing process. Our Customer Advocates will then either deliver the purchased vehicle to our customer’s driveway using one of our kick-ass one car haulers, or they will meet our customers at one of our amazing coin-operated Vending Machines.

For more information on Carvana and our mission, sneak a peek at our company introduction video.

About the team and position

Carvana’s Market Operation department is known for its team-oriented, fast-paced environment. We hire bright people who are willing to roll up their sleeves, step in wherever needed, mentor and develop team members, and assume additional responsibilities as needed while juggling multiple projects. Don’t forget to bring your personality! We thrive from each unique perspective. Our strength is in our diversity of opinions.

Job Description

The Team Lead, in our Market Operations group, is responsible for running the local Carvana hub and everything that comes with it, including (but not limited to); market launch, operations, logistics, consumer branding, team engagement and effectiveness and, of course, the market’s ongoing success. We are looking for someone who is a big picture thinker with the ability to manage the employee and customer experience. A Team Lead not only crushes daily operations, but they have the savvy to assess business trends and proactively create solutions to potential roadblocks. We need a strong people leader, as a Team Lead works closely with a team of extremely talented Customer Advocates and is responsible for providing vision and development opportunities.

What you’ll be Doing

• Be a continuous positive force within the market and create strong morale and spirit throughout the team.

• Help interview, select, onboard and train a team of Customer Advocates and provide the tools, resources and guidance they need to be successful. Employee development is an essential part of this role.

• Actively develop a team of Customer Advocates by providing feedback, conducting performance check-ins, and setting goals to improve performance and skill set.

• Recognize and reinforce individual and team accomplishments by using existing organizational tools and programs as well as by finding new, creative and effective methods of recognition.

• Generate and monitor regular reports like a boss and presenting to upper management… also like a boss.

• Be the go to expert for your team. You’re always ready to jump in alongside an Advocate to wash cars or jump into our kick-ass single-car hauler and deliver cars to our customers while providing a stellar customer experience.

• Drive production in a fast-paced customer service environment and keep every detail of your market operating like a well oiled machine

• Actively look for ways to improve the overall customer and Advocate team experience.

• Address and effectively manage complex and sensitive customer-facing issues.

What you should have

• 5+ years work experience in a customer facing team environment

• 3+ years of management experience

• Proven history of developing and coaching employees

• Prior experience with strategic planning, process improvement, and guiding teams to exceed goals

• Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills

• Ability to diagnose and solve problems with varying complexity while maintaining focus on the customer experience

• Willingness to work on weekends

• Enthusiasm and energy to contribute to and thrive in a rapidly growing start-up atmosphere where roles continually adapt as the company evolves

It would be great if you also had

• Bachelor’s Degree

• Experience with Salesforce or Tableau

• An analytical mind

• Experience handling logistics

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time Salary Position

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• 401K with company match

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally

• Access to opportunities to expand your skillset and share your knowledge with others across the organization

• A company culture of promotions from within, with a start-up atmosphere allowing for varied and rapid career development

• A seat in one of the fastest-growing companies in the country

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

• The ability to walk/stand and sustain physical activity for extended periods of time (8+ hours).

• Requires high and low levels of movement with the ability to reach with arms, twist, kneel, crouch, climb, balance, and squat.

• Requires the grasping, carrying, lifting, pushing, and pulling of items up to 50lbs.

• Frequent driving requires excellent visual activity and manual dexterity.

• Requires to work in outdoor weather conditions.

• Must be able to stay in stationary positions for extended periods of time (when driving) up to 3 hours at a time.

• Frequently communicates with customers and must be able to exchange accurate information

* California, Colorado, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Nevada, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia and Wisconsin employees must apply for a Salesperson license within the first two weeks of employment (process sponsored by Carvana). Obtaining this license is a condition of employment; failure to secure it may impact continued employment in this role.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

Backed by leading investors (Goldman Sachs, Hedosophia, NEA, Valar, 8VC) and trusted by major carriers, Bestow is powered by a team that moves with precision, purpose, and heart. If you want to help reimagine a centuries-old industry with lasting impact, join us.

Bestow offers flexible remote/hybrid work, meaningful benefits, equity, and substantial growth opportunities.

Bestow uses E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit E-Verify.gov http://e-verify.gov.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Bestow is the leading platform for life and annuity carriers, and we're scaling fast.

The Director of Product Marketing sets platform positioning strategy and leads go-to-market for Bestow's most important launches, working closely with the CMO, executive team, and stakeholders across the business to shape how the company's innovation narrative evolves alongside the business. You'll build strong partnerships across Product, Sales, and Communications, bringing each function along early and turning competing priorities into a single, clear story the whole company can execute against.

You'll have real autonomy to set direction and real influence over how leadership thinks about market strategy. If you want to shape both the narrative and the cross-functional muscle behind it at a company in a high-growth phase, this is the role.

This role reports to the CMO and is open to hybrid in our Dallas office or Remote (US). #LIRemote




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Bestow's platform positioning and messaging strategy, and be the senior voice on how that story evolves as the product, market, and competitive landscape shift.

 - Lead go-to-market strategy and execution for major launches, making the final call on sequencing and priorities across Product, Sales, Communications, and Marketing.

 - Build proactive, trusted partnerships across Product, Sales, and Communications, aligning stakeholders early so launches and narratives move fast without last-minute scrambles.

 - Set the strategy and quality bar for sales enablement, pitch decks, battle cards, and competitive intelligence, and build the team and process to maintain it at scale.

 - Bring market, buyer, and competitive insight into executive conversations, influencing roadmap, positioning, and business strategy decisions.

 - Own the measurement framework connecting product marketing to pipeline and win rates, using it to guide investment and resourcing.

 - Grow the product marketing function over time, bringing on and developing team members as Bestow's needs scale.

 - Significant product marketing experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology at a senior/leadership level, with a track record of increasing scope.

 - A trusted strategic partner to executives and cross-functional stakeholders, comfortable shaping company-level narrative and GTM decisions, not just executing on them.

 - A compelling storyteller who can take a complex, technical platform and make it land clearly with a sophisticated enterprise audience.

 - Strong positioning and launch instincts, setting direction from ambiguity and driving it through execution with minimal oversight.

 - Experience building and scaling both sales enablement and a product marketing team.

 - Experience in fintech, insurtech, or a platform business is a strong plus.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, and fluency using AI tools to accelerate research, content, and GTM speed.

Job Title: Billing Tech Support Specialist 

Prompt is revolutionizing healthcare by delivering highly automated and modern software to rehab therapy businesses, the teams within, and the patients they serve. As the fastest growing company in the therapy EMR space and the new standard in healthcare technology, we’re looking to bring on a Billing Tech Support Specialist who will serve as a Prompt software expert to customers via our email support channel and will be an integral part of our Customer Experience Team.

This role is an unprecedented opportunity to have an immense impact on our industry leading Client Success Team that ranks 85 Net Promoter Score points higher than our competition (in other words, people love Prompt). We’re looking for someone scrappy, willing to bring new ideas, take on big challenges, and is into doubling down on what works.

We’re doing something special here and this role will be critical in taking Prompt to the next level.

Why work for Prompt?

 - BIG Challenges: Here at Prompt, we are solving complex and unique problems that have plagued the healthcare industry since the dawn of time.

 - Talented People: Prompt didn't happen by chance, it's a team of incredibly talented and proven individuals who all made their mark before joining forces to build the greatest software on the planet for rehab therapists.

 - Healthy Approach: This isn't an investment bank, we work long hours when it's needed, but at Prompt you own your workload and the entire organization takes a liking to smart work (over hard work).

 - Positive Impact: Prompt helps outpatient rehab organizations treat more patients and deliver better care with less environmental waste. That means less surgery and less narcotic-based pain treatment, all while turning a paper-heavy industry digital. We aren't enthralled with patting ourselves on the back everyday, but it does feel good :)

The Role:

Our expectation of this role is that you assist our clients via our email support channel and quickly establish yourself as a key contributor within 6 months.

Key Responsibilities:

 - Respond to customer questions and requests regarding RCM and billing software questions via email using our help desk platform to help them find solutions to their inquiries in an accurate and efficient manner

 - Triage tickets, perform escalations to appropriate teams, and provide all necessary details to ensure the teams are equipped to assist the customer

 - Support engineering ticket creation, review and prioritization

 - Develop and maintain a deep understanding of our product offerings to effectively respond to incoming customer inquiries across our single-channel support system

 - Promote customer satisfaction and loyalty by understanding each customer’s unique (and evolving) needs, delivering value, and exceeding expectations

 - Improve and advocate for customer experience by identifying opportunities to enhance our product and service features

Minimum Requirements:

 - 3+ years of relevant experience in customer-facing functions such as tech support or similar

 - Medical billing background required- Physical Therapy billing strongly preferred

 - Experience in any function of clinical development or medical billing operations (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, system management, information management, medical monitoring, RCM follow up, claim review and submission, etc.)

 - Must have a highly analytical mindset and with superior ability to troubleshoot/test use cases and issues in software

 - Proactive, self-motivated and self-directed, with the ability to learn quickly and autonomously

 - Ability to multitask, keep records, prepare reports, and follow specific instructions

 - Proficient in MS Excel

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

 - Eagerness to learn and adopt software

Preferred (Nice-to-have) Qualifications

 - Prior startup and/or B2B SaaS technology organization experience

 - Experience with Zendesk or similar customer support software

 - Preferred Excel experience

Perks - What you can expect:

 - Competitive salaries

 - Remote/hybrid environment

 - Potential equity compensation for outstanding performance

 - Flexible PTO

 - Company-wide sponsored lunches

 - Company paid disability and life insurance benefits

 - Company paid family and medical leave

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance benefits

 - Discounted pet insurance

jobs.title: Large Loss Adjuster
jobs.description:
Horace Mann is seeking an experienced and technically skilled Large Loss Adjuster to manage high-exposure homeowner property claims, including complex and litigated files. This role requires advanced investigative expertise, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to handle significant financial exposures while delivering exceptional service to policyholders and business partners.

The ideal candidate thrives in complex claim environments, demonstrates strong business acumen, and brings deep knowledge of policy interpretation, dwelling estimating, and litigation management.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Claims Handling

• Manage and investigate large loss and high-exposure homeowner claims, including litigation files and claims involving public adjusters and attorneys.

• Verify coverage, interpret policy language, and determine liability and scope of damages.

• Evaluate claim facts and damage estimates to move claims toward appropriate and timely resolution.

• Apply in-depth knowledge of homeowners policies and jurisdictional documents to assigned claims.

Investigation & Damage Assessment

• Conduct on-site inspections as needed to evaluate damages and determine loss exposure.

• Investigate origin and cause of high-exposure claims, coordinating with insureds, claimants, agents, attorneys, contractors, experts, Special Investigation Unit (SIU), public officials, and other adjusters.

• Identify prior losses and recognize potential environmental exposures.

• Reconcile contractor and mitigation estimates and collaborate with vendors to determine appropriate damage valuations.

• Demonstrate advanced proficiency in Xactimate, including preparation of large loss and total loss estimates (Level 3 certification encouraged).

Negotiation & Resolution

• Negotiate settlements with insureds, attorneys, and public adjusters in accordance with company best practices.

• Manage period of restoration for ALE (Additional Living Expense) and Loss of Rent claims.

• Interpret and apply policies, leases, by-laws, declarations, and contract coverages as they apply to all parties involved.

• Maintain transparent and timely communication with all stakeholders throughout the claim lifecycle.

Catastrophe & Collaboration

• Provide assistance during catastrophe events as needed.

• Participate in special projects and consult on process improvement initiatives.

• Actively engage in mentoring and training of other claims professionals.

Qualifications & Experience

• 5–7 years of dwelling estimating experience preferred, with demonstrated sustained technical performance.

• Proven experience handling homeowner property losses of $50,000 or greater.

• Strong claims and business acumen with litigation experience.

• Advanced knowledge of homeowner policy interpretation and coverage analysis.

• Demonstrated Xactimate expertise; encouraged to pursue Level 3 certification.

• Ability to work effectively with vendors regarding damage determination and estimate reconciliation.

• Ability to operate in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment using claims systems and telephony platforms.

• Maintain and obtain required state adjuster licenses; ability to comply with all jurisdictional regulatory requirements.

• Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and decision-making skills.

Additional Information

• Must obtain and maintain required state adjuster licenses.

• Periodic travel may be required for inspections or catastrophe support.

Salary Range:

$76,600.00 - $106,450.00 + bonus

Salary is commensurate to experience, location, etc.

Horace Mann was founded in 1945 by two Springfield, Illinois, teachers who saw a need for quality, affordable auto insurance for teachers. Since then, we’ve broadened our mission to helping all educators protect what they have today and prepare for a successful tomorrow.  And with our broadened mission has come corporate growth:  We serve more than 4,100 school districts nationwide, we’re publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (symbol: HMN) and we have more than $12 billion in assets.

We’re motivated by the fact that educators take care of our children’s future, and we believe they deserve someone to look after theirs.  We help educators identify their financial goals and develop plans to achieve them.  This includes insurance to protect what they have today and financial products to help them prepare for their future. jobs.title: Field Operator - Aurora, IL
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Field Operator, you will serve as Traba's in-market operational hands — focused on recruiting, onboarding, and preparing workers for placement across the market. Rather than being anchored to a single customer, you'll support the broader market and may interact with multiple customer sites as volume and coverage needs dictate.

You'll be the local face of Traba to our workforce: building community partnerships, running onboarding sessions, and making sure every worker is vetted, prepared, and ready to succeed on their first shift. This role requires professionalism, strong recruiting instincts, and the flexibility to flex across worker funnel needs in a fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Worker Relationship Management: Build strong relationships with workers across the market — owning the experience from recruiting through placement and providing timely updates, feedback, and support.

 - Community & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with workforce centers, community organizations, and local partners to drive worker pipeline and brand presence in the market.

 - Worker Vetting & Onboarding: Oversee worker vetting, drug testing, and onboarding end-to-end, including running large group onboarding sessions when volume calls for it.

 - Worker Funnel Management: Manage the full worker funnel — sourcing, screening, scheduling, and converting applicants into placement-ready workers.

 - New Start Scheduling: Coordinate interviews and start schedules for new hires across customer sites, ensuring workers are matched to the right opportunities at the right time.

 - PPE & On-Site Support: Distribute and manage PPE, and provide on-site presence at customer facilities as needed to support new starts, escalations, or peak coverage.

 - Communication & Reporting: Maintain consistent, proactive feedback loops with Traba HQ — flagging market trends, funnel issues, or coverage risks early.


REQUIREMENTS

 - High School Diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

 - English required.

 - 1–2+ years of experience in operations or customer-facing environments, including but not limited to: staffing, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, food service, teaching, or on-site coordination.

 - Strong recruiting instincts and the ability to source, screen, and convert candidates.

 - Comfortable running large group onboarding sessions and presenting in front of workers.

 - Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills (email and in-person).

 - Professional demeanor and ability to represent Traba with workers, partners, and client stakeholders.

 - Flexible and adaptable — able to shift priorities and locations as market needs evolve.

 - Organized, detail-oriented, and a proactive problem solver.

 - Comfortable working in fast-paced, dynamic warehouse and field environments.


COMPENSATION

Competitive hourly base pay plus performance-based incentives tied to worker onboarding and successful placements.
