jobs.title: Director of Operational & Quality Excellence
jobs.description:
ABOUT PHIL

Getting a prescription filled shouldn't be the hardest part of starting treatment. Yet for many patients, it is. PHIL is a Series D health-tech company building the platform that connects patients, prescribers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical manufacturers so patients can get their medication quickly and affordably.

Our digital hub and pharmacy platform handles everything from enrollment and benefits verification to prior authorization, copay support, and home delivery. For manufacturers, that means more patients start therapy and stay on it, plus the commercial insight to keep improving access.

We're a dedicated team of people from a wide range of backgrounds, united by a focus on the patient experience.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a Director of Operational & Quality Excellence to drive a best-in-class operational and technical platform, using automation and AI to . This is a build-and-lead role, not an audit-management or Six Sigma role. Our operations span patient support, pharmacists, and pharmacy technicians, and manual review no longer scales with that volume. This role is how we grow coverage without growing headcount in a straight line.

You'll report to the VP of Operational Excellence and work closely with Operations, Engineering, Product, and Client Success. You'll set the quality and process agenda and own the outcomes; Engineering and Product are your build partners for the systems you specify.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Quality strategy and AI-enabled monitoring: Define and run the roadmap that moves quality from manual, after-the-fact audits to automated, real-time controls, including AI monitoring that flags error signals before they reach a patient.

 - Software and operational quality: Own quality for our operational workflows and the platform behind them, including test automation and release validation, working side by side with Engineering and Product.

 - Process design at the point of work: Standardize workflows, documentation, and tooling across patient support, pharmacist, and pharmacy technician teams, and embed controls where the work happens.

 - Cross-functional accountability: Run an escalation framework in which every quality issue has an owner, a date, and a path forward, and hold partner leaders to it.

 - A tenured team and executive visibility: Lead the audit, analysis, and quality engineering team (about 10 people, mostly experienced subject-matter experts) through a change in how they work, and give leadership real-time visibility into error rates and their drivers.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

By 90 days: You've learned the core workflows firsthand, met every partner leader, and delivered a data-backed root cause review of our top error drivers with specific corrective actions. A live initiative tracker is in place, and you have a plan for the team that the team has helped shape.

By 6 months: Your first automated or AI-enabled control is running in production, the escalation framework is in regular use, and quality reporting is standardized and executive-ready.

By 12 months: Error rates across all operational and technical workflows are down 50% from baseline, quality coverage has expanded without adding audit headcount, and your team is operating on the new model with at least one emerging leader under you.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Our strongest candidates have led quality or operational improvement in a high-accuracy, high-volume environment and have personally built AI or automation into how the work gets done. Quality engineering, process excellence, and special-projects paths all work, as long as you've created leverage through teams and systems, not only through your own output.

 - 10+ years in operational quality, quality engineering, operational excellence, or process improvement in a complex, high-volume environment

 - 5+ years leading and building a team or function, not only running an existing one

 - Hands-on experience deploying AI, LLM, or automation tools to solve a real quality or operational problem, and you can name the tools and the results

 - Experience shifting work from manual, after-the-fact review to controls embedded in systems, including partnering with Engineering on test automation, release validation, or defect prevention

 - A record of driving results across teams without direct authority, including root cause analyses that led to documented fixes

 - You originate work, escalate early with a proposed path forward, and present data-driven narratives to senior leaders

Nice to have

 - Experience in a regulated, high-accuracy setting such as pharmacy, healthcare, or clinical operations

 - Experience leading tenured subject-matter experts through a change in how they work

 - Experience reporting quality performance to external clients

Travel: up to 20%.



WHY PHIL

 - Fully remote working environment available in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IA, ID, IL, IN, MA, MI, MO, NC, NH, NJ, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WV

jobs.description:
Lab Summary:

The Robot Intelligence Lab at Samsung Research America is a new facility dedicated to advancing the field of robotics through cutting-edge research and development. The lab’s mission is to develop advanced technologies to power intelligent robotic systems capable of manipulation, navigation, and complex reasoning for a variety of high-impact application areas. To achieve this mission, the lab collaborates closely with external entities such as universities, startups, and government labs, as well as with several Samsung Product and Advanced Research labs.

Position Summary:

Samsung Research America is looking for a Robotics Systems Architect to own the end-to-end software architecture for our robot platform, driving technical decisions that shape how hardware and software integrate at scale. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role: you won’t inherit a mature codebase—you’ll build the foundations that make it possible.

As an early team member, you’ll work directly across software teams (reasoning, dexterity, perception, simulation) to integrate their work into a cohesive platform. You’ll establish the architectural patterns, engineering practices, and infrastructure that allow rapid iteration today and maintainable growth tomorrow. This includes defining component interfaces, building CI/CD pipelines, containerizing environments, and implementing package management and deployment strategies—essentially, laying the technical groundwork for a production robotics system.

Samsung’s unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on AI and robotics will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience. By leveraging Samsung’s vast product ecosystem to deliver novel user experiences, your work will define Samsung’s future in robotics and significantly impact real-world users.

Position Responsibilities:

• Guide cross-platform robotics software architecture, including component interfaces, dependencies, and integration across software and hardware.

• Establish practical guidelines for maintaining the codebase, including repository organization, coding standards, code reviews, testing, and documentation.

• Develop and integrate Python and C++ software within ROS/ROS2-based systems.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated integration tests for simulation and physical robots.

• Maintain Docker-based development and runtime environments across x86-64 (Intel/AMD) and ARM platforms.

• Improve software deployment, logging, and troubleshooting workflows for robot computers and shared lab systems.

• Support reproducible AI development environments and cloud-based training workflows in collaboration with researchers.

Required Skills:

• MS degree in CS/EE/Robotics, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• 16+ years experience conducting state-of-the-art robotics R&D

• Proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing and maintaining Linux-based software.

• Experience with ROS/ROS2 and hands-on integration with robotics hardware.

• Experience designing software components and defining clear interfaces within complex systems.

• Practical experience with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and automated testing.

• Ability to establish maintainable engineering practices while supporting fast-moving research.

• Strong troubleshooting, collaboration, and documentation skills.

jobs.title: Senior Lead Consultant, Environmental Engineering
jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our New York or Pennsylvania offices.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you eager to develop your excellence in an inclusive, collaborative, and empowering community? Are you excited about joining a company that strives to make a difference – for its employees, clients, and society? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health team and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Senior Lead Consultant, Environmental Engineering, you will be part of an interdisciplinary team providing innovative and sustainable site solutions to an international client base.

Ramboll currently has an opportunity to support environmental investigation and remediation projects through design and engineering projects in our New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania offices. This is a growth position for the right candidate to develop skills for managing technical and financial aspects of progressively larger, complex projects with varying levels of direct supervision depending on the project size and complexity. In addition, a strong technical education, professional demeanor, and desire to learn is a necessity.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Execute engineering tasks in support of key projects/programs under RCRA and CERCLA programs, including Remedial Investigations, Feasibility Studies, Remedial Designs, Remedial Actions, and post-remediation operation, maintenance and monitoring.
• Provide engineering support for the remediation of contaminated soils, sediments, surface water and groundwater involving remedies such as excavation, capping, containment, in situ and ex situ treatment, and subsurface vapor mitigation.
• Coordinate the development and finalization of technical documents (e.g., regulatory reports, feasibility studies, work plans, remedial design plans and specifications, construction completion reports, permit applications, health and safety plans, etc.) pursuant to regulatory requirements.
• Provide project support with the development of scopes of work, planning, and implementation of routine tasks including, but not limited to, soil, groundwater, and vapor sampling efforts.
• Function as a task manager, providing assistance in the development of project execution strategies, and successfully track task/project activities related to scope, schedule, and budget, and effectively lead and/or mentor Early-Career Engineers.
• Interact with existing and prospective clients and integrate with collaborative project teams made up of Engineers, Geologists and Scientists.

About you

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil or Environmental Engineering or related field, with 6+ years of relevant experience.
• Possession, eligibility, or interest in obtaining a PE license and a valid driver’s license.
• Completion of OSHA 40-hour HAZWOPER course and current 8-hour refresher.
• Strong commitment to health and safety, with experience in conventional and innovative remediation technologies.
• Strong working knowledge of state (e.g., NYSDEC, PADEP) and federal regulations is a plus.

Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role

• Ability to work on and prioritize multiple projects with competing deadlines.
• Excellent interpersonal skills, client focus, and the ability to work effectively in teams.
• Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
• Solid technical writing and communication (written and verbal) skills.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $96,677 – $120,846 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Talent & People Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT DILIGENCESQUARED

DiligenceSquared is the AI-native consulting firm. We deliver investment-grade market research and commercial due diligence, powered by AI agents and led by experienced consultants. Our founding team brings deep experience from Blackstone and BCG, and we're backed by Y Combinator and Relentless. Our clients include 6 of the 10 largest private equity firms in the world and represent more than $4T in combined AUM.


THE ROLE

We're looking for a Talent & People Lead to help us hire exceptional people and build the foundations of our people function. You'll work directly with the founders to identify the talent we need, bring great candidates into the business and create an excellent experience from first conversation through onboarding and beyond.

Recruiting will be your primary focus. You'll personally source candidates, run hiring processes and help close hires across consulting, GTM, engineering and operations. Alongside that, you'll own the day-to-day people processes that help a growing team work well together.

This is a hands-on builder role with broad ownership. You'll need to be equally comfortable persuading a strong candidate to take a first meeting, helping a founder make a hiring decision and making sure a new teammate has everything they need on day one.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Own recruiting from start to finish: Partner with founders and hiring managers to define roles, source candidates, run interviews, coordinate feedback and move offers through to acceptance.

 - Find exceptional people: Build targeted candidate pipelines through thoughtful outreach, referrals and relationships. Develop a clear view of where to find strong talent for each function.

 - Make hiring more effective: Create clear role scorecards, practical assessments and consistent interview processes that help us make better decisions quickly.

 - Deliver a strong candidate experience: Keep candidates informed, prepare interviewers and ensure every interaction reflects the quality and ambition of the business.

 - Help close hires: Understand what matters to candidates, communicate the opportunity clearly and partner with founders on offers and negotiations.

 - Build excellent onboarding: Coordinate everything from signed offer to first weeks on the team, with clear ownership, thoughtful preparation and regular check-ins.

 - Own people operations: Manage day-to-day people administration in Rippling, including employee records, payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding, with support from Rippling's team and our external advisers. Keep our handbook and policies current and make sure employee questions and administrative tasks are resolved promptly.

 - Coordinate work authorization and immigration: Work with employees and external counsel to coordinate documentation, visa-related processes and important deadlines.

jobs.title: Deal Desk Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX | Seattle, WA | Denver, CO

About the Department

The Deal Desk team is a critical component of the Finance function, acting as a strategic partner to the global Sales organization. We are responsible for partnering with sales to structure, negotiate, and close complex deals. We ensure that deals meet the requirements of "good business" while also keeping our customers' best interest in mind. We are committed to building a data-centric and AI-augmented Deal Desk that leverages predictive analytics and automated workflows to optimize pricing in real-time and automate routine approvals, allowing for deeper strategic focus.

About the Role

As a Deal Desk Manager, you will be the architect of our AI-driven deal desk, transitioning our sales process from manual workflows to an intelligent, automated engine that spans from initial scoping to final execution. By leveraging agentic workflows and automated data layers, the focus shifts to high-judgment architecture for non-standard enterprise deals. The objective is to serve as a high-influence "Sales Co-pilot," using AI-driven insights to maximize deal velocity and Long-Term Value (LTV) while relentlessly reducing friction through iterative process automation.

Responsibilities

• Orchestrate Strategic Deal Architecture: Lead the structuring and execution of non-standard, high-value enterprise deals, providing high-judgment guidance that balances competitive differentiation with long-term business health.

• Sales Co-pilot & Strategic Influence: Serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership, utilizing AI-driven data to maximize deal velocity, improve LTV, and ensure discovery reflects true customer needs. Perform analysis on pricing and deal terms, leveraging AI insights to recommend "next best action" for deal structuring and margin optimization.

• Curate and Tune AI Agents: Manage the enterprise deal approval ecosystem by tuning automated agents and models to ensure compliance and accuracy at scale.

• Drive Process Iteration: Partner with cross-functional teams (Legal, Finance, Product) to build, streamline, and automate deal desk processes, architecting autonomous approval workflows and focusing on reducing field friction through relentless automation.

• Champion AI & Automation Integration: Champion the integration of LLMs and generative AI tools to automate deal desk workflows, significantly reducing deal cycle times. Identify bottlenecks and implement AI-powered productivity solutions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• 6-8+ years of Deal Desk, FP&A, Revenue Operations, or similar experience, with a proven track record of supporting large-scale enterprise sales motions; 3+ years of deal desk experience preferred.

• Financial & Sales Acumen: Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, pricing models, and financial concepts like ARR, Gross Margin, churn, and profitability. Experience with revenue recognition principles (e.g., ASC 606) is highly desirable. Experience selling software is a bonus.

• Contract & Pricing Knowledge: Experience drafting and interpreting commercial contracts, with a focus on terms that impact revenue recognition and financial risk. Ability to analyze and recommend the best course of action for complex pricing and licensing situations.

• Data & AI Literacy: Proficiency in leveraging agentic workflows and prompt engineering to scale influence, extract insights from large datasets, and automate repetitive operational tasks and internal documentation.

• Algorithmic Thinking: The ability to understand and audit automated pricing models to ensure alignment with long-term company goals.

• Strategic Influence: Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, cross-functional negotiations and make high-judgment decisions in fast-paced environments.

• Process Design Mindset: A relentless focus on iterative automation and the ability to translate complex business policies into streamlined, automated logic.

• Communication Excellence: Exceptional written and oral communication skills, capable of explaining complex deal structures and financial data to both technical and executive stakeholders.

Bonus Points

• Experience in software sales or sales operations, providing a "boots on the ground" perspective of the sales cycle.

• Deep knowledge of Cloud/SaaS infrastructure and the global cybersecurity competitive landscape.

If you're excited by fast-paced innovation, dedicated to driving global growth, and want to help build a better internet, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $147,000 - $202,000

• For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $134,000 - $184,000

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering, Thermal Control Systems (New Grad)
jobs.description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for Mechanical Engineer, Thermal Control Systems (New Grad), to help develop the systems behind our human-rated space stations. You'll use your engineering knowledge and creativity to design, build, and test novel solutions at the cutting edge of space technology.

This will be a full-time, exempt position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop thermal control system components for our artificial-gravity space station, such as heat exchangers, cold plates, heaters, and heat pipes, with guidance from senior engineers.

• Perform thermal and fluid analyses to size components and check that designs meet requirements.

• Contribute to design trades and support systems engineering tasks such as tracking requirements and interfaces.

• Help plan and run development tests, collect and interpret data, and use the results to improve designs and manufacturing processes.

• Work with avionics, software, and mission operations teams to make sure your components integrate with the rest of the station.

• Work hands-on with technicians and suppliers to build, test, and troubleshoot hardware.

• Design with manufacturability and reliability in mind.

Minimum Qualifications:

• B.S. in mechanical, aerospace, or civil engineering, physics, mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Coursework, project, or internship experience designing and developing mechanical components or systems.

• Familiarity with 3D CAD and FEA software through coursework, student project teams, or internships.

• Understanding of GD&T fundamentals (ASME Y14.5).

Preferred Skills & Experience:

• Participation in hands-on engineering teams such as Formula SAE, rocketry, CubeSat, or robotics.

• A portfolio or examples of designs you've taken from concept through build or test.

• Coursework, project, or internship experience designing structures or components for a high-performance vehicle or spacecraft.

• Familiarity with CAD tools, ideally NX, and exposure to PLM tools such as Teamcenter.

• Exposure to thermal or structural analysis using Ansys, Femap/Nastran, Abaqus, or similar tools.

• Working knowledge of GD&T fundamentals (ASME Y14.5).

• A curious, hands-on approach to problem solving, including interest in troubleshooting and root cause analysis.

• Hands-on experience building or testing hardware, whether through internships, co-ops, machine shops, or student project teams.

• Awareness of aerospace design and environmental test standards such as SMC-S-016, NASA-STD-5001, or MIL-STD-810.

Additional Requirements:

• Willingness to work evenings and/or weekends to support critical mission milestones.

Pay Ranges:

• Mechanical Engineer/ Level I: $86,100.00 - $122,220.00

We calibrate level and compensation to the selected candidate's experience and demonstrated capability. We welcome applicants across a range of experience levels to apply.

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Base salary will vary depending on job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, business needs, and market demand. Salary is just one component of our comprehensive compensation package. Full-time employees also receive company equity, as well as access to a full suite of compelling benefits and perks, including: medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents, generous paid time off; up to 20+ days of vacation for exempt staff and up to 10+ days of vacation for non-exempt staff with the ability to cash-out unused vacation annually, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, ClassPass credits, personalized mental healthcare through Spring Health, and other discounts and perks. We also take pride in offering exceptional food perks, with snacks, drip coffee & onsite barista, cold drinks, and dinner meals remaining free of charge, and lunch subsidized as part of Vast’s ongoing commitment to providing high-quality meals for employees.

U.S. EXPORT CONTROL COMPLIANCE STATUS

The person hired will have access to information and items subject to U.S. export controls, and therefore, must either be a “U.S. person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. § 120.62 or otherwise eligible for deemed export licensing. This status includes U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), and asylees and refugees with such status granted, not pending.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Tecovas was founded with the simple goal of making the world's best western boots, apparel and leather goods - and selling them at a fair price. We are a brand revolutionizing a category and welcoming first-time boot buyers and western enthusiasts alike.

Tecovas is looking for a Technical Project Manager to run the day-to-day sprint cadence for our Front End Engineering team, working closely with our Digital team. You’ll also lead select projects across the tech org. Reporting directly to the Director of Program Management, you will drive timely delivery, prioritization, and timeline management. You must love working across a range of technical disciplines and bring a friendly attitude to the role!

This role is required to be based in Austin, TX. Candidates must either be currently located in or willing to relocate to Austin, TX.

What you’ll do:

• Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of technical projects

• Own the day-to-day management of Front End Engineering sprint work, from planning through release

• Serve as the main link between Front End Engineering and the Digital teams, guiding Digital priorities into sprint-ready work

• Partner with internal stakeholders to define project goals, requirements, and strategies

• Document project requirements, user stories, and test plans clearly and comprehensively

• Communicate regularly with relevant stakeholders on project status, progress, risks, and changes in scope

• Follow a defined project management methodology to ensure that project steps and resources are well-planned and executed

• Facilitate daily standup meetings, sprint planning meetings, and backlog grooming sessions for assigned technology teams

• Own and manage sprint planning in project management software, including incorporating stakeholder prioritization

• Partner with engineering team on project estimates and prioritization

• Balance the ability to work independently and drive projects forward with the awareness to seek guidance or escalate issues when needed

• Resolve conflicts in a timely manner and escalate to senior management when appropriate

Experience we’re looking for:

• 3+ years of experience in technical project management, working directly with engineering teams, and/or experience in relevant work, fields, or related functions

• Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

• Excellent customer intuition; demonstrated success in identifying, prioritizing and delivering product capabilities to delight customers

• Strong data analysis skills; the ability to run data analysis and synthesize data to make on-point business decisions

• Experience running Agile sprints for a front end, web, or e-commerce engineering team.

• Bonus points for a Certified ScrumMaster Certification

What you bring to the table:

• You have the capacity to handle multiple tasks, set priorities, schedule and meet deadlines

• You have excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with an ability to influence at executive level

• You have a proven track record of earning trust with stakeholders who may possess disparate working styles

• You take pride in the quality and durability of your work

Full Time Benefits & Perks:

• We offer insurance plans that pay 79-90% of your health premium coverage and 100% of your dental & vision insurance coverage for your family/dependents

• 401(k) match

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible PTO policy

• Corporate wellness program

• Competitive salary - $95,000 - $105,000/commensurate with experience

• Eligibility to participate in Corporate Bonus Program

• Generous employee discounts!

About Us:

Based in Austin, TX, Tecovas brings the spirit of the West to the modern consumer. Handcrafting the best Western footwear, workwear, apparel, and accessories, Tecovas has grown rapidly since its founding as the first digitally native Western brand in 2015, serving customers through www.Tecovas.com, Tecovas Stores from coast to coast, and select wholesale partners. We’re certainly growing- and hiring passionate, humble, positive, and talented people determined to help us continue to grow!

Important note: We strive to hire values-aligned people because we believe it takes each and all of us to be successful, and lead with grit, speed and a clear vision of where we’re headed. In a remote setting, interviewing at Tecovas may include phone interviews, virtual “on-site” interviews, and on-the-job mock cases. We are committed to run a thorough process for candidates with whom we identify a potential match, and we will do our best to follow-up with each and every applicant! If you’re on the fence, just give it a try!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply! Information collected during the application process is subject to our privacy policy. Please note: Offers of employment may be conditional pending the completion of standard onboarding procedures.

jobs.title: Gestor de Cliente, Prestígio
jobs.description:
Prestar um serviço de qualidade e gerir as lacunas de serviço identificadas pelos clientes à medida que estes interagem através dos vários pontos de contacto do banco. Promover interações planeadas e proativas com os clientes, impulsionadas por análises holísticas centradas na obtenção de resultados contextuais para os clientes. Aprofundar as relações entre o banco e os clientes, com foco principal na prestação de soluções interdisciplinares, trabalhando em conjunto com os especialistas em produtos de apoio para garantir um envolvimento holístico e orientação nas decisões financeiras dos clientes.

Funções Essenciais

Proporcionar valor ao cliente e atingir os orçamentos de crescimento atribuídos para a carteira principal,  centrando-se principalmente no crescimento do balanço e da taxa de contribuição dos clientes, bem como na adoção de soluções de produtos especializados (por exemplo: Planeamento Sucessório, soluções do pilar de produtos de seguros, etc.).

Analisar oportunidades da carteira e implementar um envolvimento proativo com os clientes (análises holísticas dos clientes) no âmbito da estratégia definida de envolvimento com os clientes para a Carteira Principal – defendendo e prestando um serviço holístico aos clientes em colaboração com o planeador Financeiro da SBFC a quem estão associados.

Analisar o comportamento financeiro dos clientes, os produtos que detêm atualmente e as necessidades financeiras a curto e longo prazo, a fim de identificar oportunidades de vendas que sejam mutuamente benéficas para o banco e para o cliente.

Analisar, identificar e recomendar a adoção de procedimentos operacionais para minimizar o risco.

Agir com discrição ao cumprir as instruções do cliente dentro do mandato definido e escalar a questão quando aplicável (por exemplo, se um cliente solicitar que seja efetuada uma transferência eletrónica, o titular do cargo pode dar seguimento ao pedido se estiver dentro do mandato atribuído).

Com base no perfil de crédito do cliente, fazer recomendações sobre como estruturar futuras linhas de crédito para os clientes.

Executar atempadamente os requisitos de gestão da carteira e de desenvolvimento pessoal, tais como análises de due diligence do cliente e de combate ao branqueamento de capitais, atividades de gestão precoce de atrasos, formação em conformidade, requisitos de conformidade regulamentar, gestão de excedentes não autorizados, etc.

Tipo de qualificação: Licenciatura

Área de estudo: Gestão e Comércio

Licenças e certificações: Representante FAIS

Experiência exigida

Atendimento a clientes

Banca pessoal e privada

3-4 anos

Experiência em vendas, atendimento, gestão de relações, pedidos de crédito e perspicácia financeira (ou seja, histórico comprovado de vendas no setor dos serviços financeiros). Trabalho com clientes de banca privada, com pelo menos 1 ano de experiência na gestão de uma carteira.

Competências Comportamentais:

• Articular informação
• Questionar ideias
• Transmitir autoconfiança
• Convencer pessoas
• Desenvolver conhecimentos especializados
• Estabelecer rapport
• Analisar informação
• Explorar possibilidades
• Impressionar as pessoas
• Interagir com as pessoas
• Interpretar dados
• Tomar decisões
• Cumprir prazos
• Fornecer perspetivas
• Perseguir objetivos
• Aproveitar oportunidades
• Mostrar serenidade
• Tomar medidas
• Trabalho em equipa
• Compreender as pessoas

Competências Técnicas:

• Processos e procedimentos bancários
• Conhecimento do cliente
• Retenção de clientes
• Atendimento ao cliente
• Compreensão do cliente (banca de retalho)
• Consciência do risco
• Identificação de riscos

jobs.title: Assistant Manager (02819) - 1002 Shooting Park Rd
jobs.description:
Domino's in Peru, United States is seeking an enthusiastic and detail-oriented Assistant Manager to join our dynamic team at 1002 Shooting Park Rd. In this pivotal role, you will partner with the Store Manager to drive operational excellence, foster a positive team environment, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. As an Assistant Manager, you will demonstrate leadership, analytical thinking, and a commitment to achieving our organizational goals while maintaining the highest standards of service and quality.

• Oversee daily store operations and manage shifts with efficiency and transparency, ensuring smooth workflow and adherence to company standards
• Lead, train, and motivate team members with a supportive and inclusive approach, fostering professional development and growth opportunities
• Interact positively and empathetically with employees and customers, building strong relationships and resolving concerns promptly
• Manage cash handling, financial transactions, and reconciliation with accuracy and attention to detail
• Maintain store cleanliness, organization, and visual standards to create an inviting environment for customers
• Answer phones, process customer orders accurately, and provide responsive customer service
• Ensure strict compliance with food safety regulations, quality standards, and company policies
• Assist in inventory management, stock control, and ordering processes to optimize operational efficiency
• Analyze performance metrics and contribute to data-driven decision-making to support sales targets and operational goals
• Participate actively in team meetings, share innovative ideas, and collaborate on process improvements
• Support the Store Manager in implementing strategic initiatives and achieving organizational objectives
• Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness when handling challenging situations and customer complaints

• Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate, inspire, and develop team members in a collaborative environment
• Excellent customer service orientation with a friendly, approachable, and empathetic demeanor
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail
• Proficient time management and multitasking skills to thrive in a fast-paced environment
• Demonstrated ability to handle pressure, remain organized, and maintain composure under demanding circumstances
• Proficiency in cash handling, financial management, and basic accounting principles
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work inclusively with diverse teams
• Physical capability to lift up to 25 pounds regularly and stand for extended periods
• High school diploma or equivalent
• Food service industry experience preferred
• Knowledge of food safety standards, quality assurance, and inventory management preferred
• Flexibility to work various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
• Conflict resolution and performance management experience preferred
• Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to professional growth within the organization

What are we looking for?

The good news is we can teach you how to answer the phone and make a perfect pizza. But here are a few skills you should have to be a successful Assistant Manager:

•Experience leading a team; during your shift, you will manage a staff of anywhere from 3 to 15 people. You will need to use your stellar attitude and motivational skills to get them in the right place, at the right time and doing the right thing all while creating a great place to work.

•A clean driving record and the ability to pass a Motor Vehicle Record check. Safety is a priority for us and we want to make sure anyone we put on the road is safe to be there. You will also need access to reliable vehicle that is insured and have a valid driver's license

•A great role model - you're the person everyone will look to. From being on time for your shift, to having a great attitude to customers and co-workers and even how you dress - you have to have high standards for yourself and the rest of the team.

•Our stores are open 365 days a week. Yes, that's right even on the weekends and the holidays; that's when we are busiest! While you schedule is pretty flexible, you have to be willing to work when the team needs you the most.

•You have to be at least 18 years old.

You'll be working for a company that is fun and flexible. Not to mention, its work experience you will rely on for a long time to come. You've had our pizza delivered to you, now it's time to help up be the pizza delivery company in the world. Go on, boss, show us what you've got. Apply now!

We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

IT SUPPORT SPECIALIST

As an IT Support Specialist based onsite at Rocket Lab’s Head Quarters you will have the opportunity to support our global teams by ensuring seamless access to information and smooth operation of our computer systems, networks, and devices. In this role, you will provide day-to-day IT support, interact positively with staff, and play a key role in onboarding new hires to ensure productivity from day one.  This role is ideal for someone seeking fast-tracked career progression, exposure to multiple technologies, and the opportunity to be a valued member of a vibrant, collaborative IT team.  A natural curiosity and a drive to continuously learn are essential to be successful in this role.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

• Carry out the day-to-day functions required to provide quality IT support and service by interacting positively with our staff, answering inquiries, and effectively handling complaints

• Track and update support desk Incident, Request, Problem, and Change, Project tickets, and other documentation

• You will be the point of contact for any onboarding of new hires to ensure they are setup and productive from day one

• Participate in the Continuous Improvement Process; the ongoing effort to improve our service, IT Systems, and processes

• This position may require flexibility to work various shifts, including evenings, weekends, and participation in an on-call rotation as needed

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

• 2+ years’ experience in IT support and high school diploma or GED

• Exposure with most and solid operational experience in at least two of the following: Windows or Linux desktop operating systems (including imaging, maintenance, troubleshooting) PC hardware (including assembly and disassembly of desktop PCs) Understanding of networking infrastructure and basic troubleshooting (TCP/IP/DNS) A scripting language Active Directory and Group Policy

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

• Certifications in CompTIAA+ or ITIL

• Experience with cloud-based technologies (Azure, AWS, O365)

• Familiarity with virtualization technologies and public/private cloud environments

• Familiarity with common AI platforms and the ability to write effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve service delivery and operational efficiency

• Experience with Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible and Terraform

• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, able to see the big picture and make connections

• Experience participating in and supporting a medium to complex, end‑to‑end IT project, in all phases from initial requirements gathering and planning through implementation, testing, stakeholder coordination, and ongoing operational support

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

Level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one component of our total rewards package at Rocket Lab. Our comprehensive benefits package includes our industry-leading Employee Stock Purchase Program (with a 15% discount on company stock), top-tier medical plans (HMO, PPO, and a zero cost HDHP option with a significant HSA company contribution), dental and vision coverage, paid vacation and sick time, 11 paid holidays, flexible spending and dependent care accounts, paid parental leave, disability and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

Additional perks include subsidized EV charging, onsite fitness centers (where available), discounted gym memberships, complimentary snacks and beverages, 50% employee discount on our popular merch store, and a variety of other employee discounts.

Eligibility for benefits may vary based on employment status, please check with your recruiter for a comprehensive list of the benefits available for this role. Benefit programs are subject to change at the company’s discretion.

Hourly Pay Range (CA Only)

$23.08—$28.25 USD

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated and results-driven Commercial Account Manager to join our dynamic sales team. In this role, you will be responsible for contacting existing customers to renew their contracts through primarily inside sales techniques while also occasionally engaging in face-to-face sales interactions when necessary.

Are you a fit?

Ideal candidates will possess exceptional communication skills, a firm grasp of sales strategies, and efficient and organized workflows.

Additional Responsibilities

• Decision-maker Engagement:

• Initiate outbound calls, emails, and other communication methods to engage decision makers to close renewal contracts.

• Proactively find new decision makers as contacts change.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to align outreach efforts with ongoing campaigns.

• Sales Presentations:

• Conduct compelling sales presentations or rate/cost comparisons over the phone, in-person, and via online platforms to educate and close customers on our natural gas services.

• Tailor presentations to meet the needs and preferences of existing clients.

• Relationship Building:

• Develop & maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their energy needs and aligning our energy products to meet their needs.

• Provide exceptional post-sale support to foster long-term customer loyalty

• Consultant Channel Selling:

• Develop & maintain strong relationships and foster ease of business with consultant channel partners.

• Learn best practices on how to engage with and meet the needs of the various consultants

• Keep feedback and information sharing strong with internal acquisition consultant reps to facilitate strong Gas South brand in consultant channel.

• Consultative Selling:

• Listen actively to customers to understand their requirements and tailor solutions accordingly.

• Provide expert product knowledge and advice to guide customers in making informed purchasing decisions.

• Leverage customer feedback to fine-tune your consultative approach.

• Sales Goals Achievement:

• Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly sales, annual sales goals.

• Develop strong margin management skills to leverage knowledge of the customer and market prices/costs to drive improvements to profitability.

• Continuously seek opportunities for upselling and cross-selling to existing customers.

• CRM Utilization:

• Keep customer information and interactions up to date in the CRM system.

• Use Salesforce CRM data to analyze sales KPI trends and identify areas for improvement.

• Help streamline CRM processes by providing feedback on usability and functionality.

• Team Collaboration:

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders, and partners at all levels.

• Work with cross-functional teams, including marketing and customer care, to ensure a seamless customer experience.

• Share insights and feedback from customer interactions to contribute to product and service enhancements as well as process improvements.

• Participate in regular team meetings to foster a culture of open communication and shared insights.

• Face-to-Face Sales:

• Conduct in-person sales meetings no more than 15% of the time.

Experience

• Proven experience in sales, preferably within a related industry.

• Proficiency in using CRM software to manage leads and track sales activities.

• High school diploma or equivalent is required.

• Willingness to travel occasionally for face-to-face meetings.

Preferred Experience

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport quickly.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and target-driven environment.

• Self-motivated and able to work independently while contributing to team goals.

Location Requirements

Atlanta, GA or Gainesville, FL

Physical Requirements

Sitting: Ability to sit for extended periods at a desk or workstation while performing computer-based tasks, conducting meetings, and collaborating with colleagues.

Standing and Walking: Ability to stand and walk within the office environment, such as when attending meetings, interacting with colleagues or external stakeholders, or visiting different departments.

Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry material, files, or equipment weighing up to 20 pounds, such as when organizing documents or setting up for meetings .

Pay range is commensurate with education, experience, specialized skills or certifications, etc.

Gas South Base Pay Range

$26.22—$29.31 USD

Our Purpose and Culture

At Gas South, we approach each day knowing we have an opportunity to make a difference in people’s lives. That means helping our customers save money with everyday low rates and treating them with dignity, honesty and respect. It means supporting our employees in their personal and professional lives, and it means we want to make sure our success directly benefits the communities we serve by giving back 5% of profits to support children in need. Through partnerships with non-profits like United Way, Salvation Army, Junior Achievement, Bert’s Big Adventure and many others, we’re proud to help make a difference.  At Gas South our employees bring their boldest ideas and most authentic selves to work, no matter their title, position or background.  We understand that our people are our most valuable assets. So, we treat them that way, with competitive benefits, flexible schedule options, and a fun, casual atmosphere.

Gas South affirms that it is an Equal Opportunity Employer whose actions and practices are consistent with fair employment.  In this regard, Gas South will not discriminate against any employee or applicant with regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.  This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment including recruiting, hiring, placement, training, promotion, lay-offs, transfers, leave of absence, compensation and termination.

Benefits for full-time employees include:

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage

• Employer-paid life and disability coverage

• Annual employer contributions of up to 12.5% to your 401k

• Remote work options available based on business needs

• Annual performance incentive is a % of annual benchmark based on position level

jobs.title: Partner Account Manager
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

A small number of Apollo's partners account for the majority of partner-driven revenue — and how well Apollo manages those relationships has an outsized effect on the business. Apollo has thousands of partners who've raised their hand, and a named-partner motion that's still being built to actually activate and grow the best of them into that tier. As Partner Account Manager (PAM), you'll own a focused, named book of Apollo's highest-value partners (roughly 20–30) once they've proven sustained activity and strategic importance.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not inheriting a mature program, you're helping define what high-touch partner management looks like at Apollo. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping the program's future, not just running an existing playbook.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into durable growth for our most important partners.

This isn't a maintenance role — it's a growth lever. You'll build joint business plans with each partner, run the operating cadence that keeps both sides accountable, grow managed ARR and customer outcomes alongside Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps, and make the call on when a partner is ready to progress, needs support, or should step back from named coverage.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Named Partner Book

• Maintain a live account plan for every partner in your book — segment, tier, health status, IPP score, and next milestone

• Flag at-risk accounts before they become escalations

• Serve as the system of record for who's in the book and why

Build Joint Business Plans

• Co-create mutual goals with each partner: target segments, pipeline objectives, managed-customer growth targets

• Build certification and enablement plans directly into the joint business plan, not as a side conversation

• Set the co-marketing and executive-alignment agenda for the period

Grow Managed ARR and Customer Outcomes

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and RevOps to find expansion opportunities inside partner-managed accounts

• Monitor adoption and usage signals closely enough to catch churn or delivery risk before it shows up in retention

• Bring data — not anecdotes — to internal reviews of what's working across the managed book

Run the Operating Cadence

• Run regular 1:1 check-ins and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with every named partner

• For top-tier partners, lead a deeper annual strategic review with a standing recommendation prepared in advance

• Come to every touchpoint with the latest scorecard pulled and open items tracked

Maintain Standing and Progression

• Track certification coverage, customer quality, and routing eligibility on an ongoing basis, not just at review time

• Build promotion, remediation, or downgrade recommendations on consistent criteria, not gut feel

• Own accountability internally whenever a partner's standing is in question

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in partner/channel account management, customer success, or strategic account management, ideally in B2B SaaS

• Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of external relationships against mutual growth goals (joint business plans, QBRs, or equivalent)

• Comfortable owning revenue-adjacent outcomes (managed ARR, NRR, retention) in partnership with Sales, CS, and RevOps

• Strong executive presence — able to run a quarterly business review and represent Apollo credibly to partner leadership

• Organized and data-driven, with experience maintaining account plans, scorecards, and health tracking across a named book

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems

• Experience managing a tiered partner book (e.g., strategic/named tiers with differentiated cadence and service levels)

• Familiarity with partner/channel platforms (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)

• Background working alongside Partner Marketing on co-marketing, case studies, or joint events

• Experience in a GTM, sales-engagement, or RevOps ecosystem

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$140,000—$175,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$120,000—$150,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

jobs.title: Regional Business Manager (Northeast)
jobs.description:
At Alamar, we are passionate about enabling our customers to make scientific discoveries that translate into clinical outcomes and benefit patients. Our team is growing quickly as we develop innovative approaches to measure critical protein biomarkers from liquid samples that can enable the earliest possible detection of disease. We believe the next frontier in biology is enabled by measuring proteins at higher sensitivity in highly multiplexed assays at the push of a button, which is something only Alamar can do. As we build our team, we seek collaborative, driven, intellectually curious people committed to solving complex challenges. Our culture rewards accountability and cross functional teamwork because we believe this enables the kind of breakthrough thinking that will accelerate our mission.

We are looking for a collaborative, self-driven sales leader to join our team. You will be responsible for developing, driving and executing the commercial strategy within the Boston/Cambridge territory and supporting our global expansion. In this sales role you will develop deep customer relationships within Academic, Biotech, Pharma and Government accounts, establish the Alamar technology as the market leader, support the build out of Alamar’s commercial organization and meet or exceed the commercial targets set for the company. This role will be field and home-office based.

Primary responsibilities include:

• Develop a territory and account-based sales plan for the territory

• Execute the plan for the territory to meet or exceed company goals

• Deliver presentations on the Alamar technology to customers in seminars and smaller meetings.

• Consult customers on the value of Alamar technology for precision proteomics to ensure the delivery of an exceptional customer experience.

• Partner across the company to communicate the needs of customers to drive future product developments and market expansion

• Manage and drive the sales process within a complex sales environment

• Utilize, update and manage the CRM system

• Effectively manage and deliver an accurate forecast for the sales territory

• Drive prospecting and develop new leads in the region to expand the customer base and open up new markets

• Support the expansion of the commercial organization as needed to meet the company goals

Requirements include:

• Bachelor’s degree in the Life Sciences or related field, MBA or similar degree desired

• 5+ years or equivalent of proven life science capital sales experience and success

• Deep knowledge of biomarker discovery and life science markets

• Highly adaptable and independent professional

• Strong desire to build customer relationships for long term engagement

The base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000 - $160,000 + commission + equity + benefits. jobs.title: Contract Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Mob Entertainment is a startup multimedia studio that is best known for our hit indie horror game "Poppy Playtime".  This franchise is one of the hottest new properties in gaming, and our team is naturally expanding as our ambition expands.  To give a taste of our brand's popularity, more than 100 billion YouTube views of Poppy Playtime related content have occurred since the game's launch 4 years ago.

Mob Entertainment is seeking a Senior Level Designer to help craft engaging and innovative levels that integrate gameplay mechanics with narrative elements for the future of the Poppy Playtime franchise, starting with our upcoming release. You’ll be responsible for collaborating with directors across disciplines, and ensuring our levels are tense, well-paced, and deeply atmospheric — true to what makes Poppy Playtime special.

This is a hands-on Senior role, greyboxing, iterating, and polishing through to final implementation.You’ll help shape structure and vision, mentor designers, and build compelling spaces using Unreal Engine 5 that serve both gameplay mechanics and narrative delivery. We’re looking for someone who combines strong execution, clear communication, and an intuitive grasp of player experience — especially in horror, puzzle, or exploration-based games.

Responsibilities:

• Collaborate on the level design pipeline, ensuring alignment with gameplay mechanics, narrative pacing, and technical constraints.

• Partner with the Game Director, Design Director, and Art Director to define the experience, goals, and the spacing of each level.

• Prototype, build, and iterate on levels in Unreal Engine, blocking out layouts and refining through to final implementation to deliver on the project’s creative goals

• Work cross-discipline with system Designers, Writers, Engineers, and Environment Artists to ensure all elements of the level support the desired experience.

• Maintain strong documentation, workflow clarity, and visibility of progress for the team and stakeholders.

• Lead regular playtests and design reviews, collecting feedback and driving iteration to improve player experience.

• Balance level aesthetics, readability, and performance, ensuring tight collaboration with environment art and tech design.

• Help shape the level design culture at Mob, identifying opportunities to raise team capability and creative ambition.

• Mentor and serve as a key collaborator and creative leader across the broader design team, sharing feedback and practical solutions to help the team work through design challenges.

• Contribute to level design workflows and reviews, identifying ways to improve iteration and delivery.

Minimum Requirements:

• 8+ years of professional game design experience, with a strong emphasis on level design.

• Proficiency in Unreal Engine 5, with experience using Blueprints for gameplay interaction and scripting.

• A portfolio demonstrating authored or lead level work, ideally in first-person, puzzle, or horror-based games.

• Strong grasp of spatial pacing, gameplay readability, environmental storytelling, and encounter flow.

• Experience collaborating with narrative teams, ensuring levels support and enhance story moments.

• Strong communication and organizational skills; able to clearly define tasks and communicate direction.

• Familiarity with source control (Perforce), task management tools (Jira, Confluence), and level design documentation best practices.

Bonus Points:

• Experience shipping narrative-focused or horror adventure games.

• Familiarity with modular environment workflows and LD/Art pipeline coordination.

• Experience working with procedural elements or systemic game spaces.

• Strong instincts for emotional pacing, building tension, and delivering impactful moments through level layout.

Salary

jobs.title: Electrical Foreman
jobs.description:
As the Electrical Foreman, this role supports the Electric division by leading on-site crews, managing job site execution, and serving as the single point of contact for assigned construction projects. As Electrical Foreman you’ll be responsible for coordinating labor, materials, subcontractors, safety efforts, and customer expectations while ensuring projects are completed accurately and on schedule. Success in this role means delivering high-quality installations while mentoring team members and driving job site performance—all while upholding KE’s commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in doing things the right way and thrives in a fast-moving environment, this position is built for you.

What You’ll Do

As Electrical Foreman you’ll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

• Lead field crews and subcontractors on large commercial and industrial electrical projects
• Represent KE in customer walk-throughs and site meetings
• Coordinate project materials, deliveries, and crew assignments
• Ensure work is completed in compliance with code, contract specs, and schedule
• Enforce safety standards and lead daily tailgate meetings
• Track and report job progress, site conditions, and crew hours
• Support and enforce project budgets, timelines, and quality control standards
• Mentor field team members and foster a culture of accountability and collaboration
• Assist with documentation, change orders, and site logistics
• Partner with the Construction Manager and project team to solve issues and adjust plans as needed
• Serve as on-site point of contact for inspectors, landowners, subcontractors, and customers

What You'll Bring

As Electrical Foreman you’re someone who shows up ready to work hard, learn fast, and contribute to a team that takes pride in doing things right. Successful candidates typically bring:

• Journeyman License with 5+ years of experience in an Electrical Foreman or Project Lead role
• Strong knowledge of industrial electrical construction or Data Center construction and best practices
• Ability to manage crews, schedules, and jobsite communication independently
• Experience interpreting drawings, specs, and installation standards
• Understanding of budget control, documentation, and quality assurance
• Excellent communication and leadership skills; team-first mindset
• Willingness to travel up to 100% regionally with overnight stays as needed
