jobs.title: Partnerships & Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

Main challenge

As part of the Strategic Partnership team in Seattle, you will help strengthen relationships with key distribution partners while identifying opportunities to grow our business. You will work at the intersection of external partners and internal teams to support publishing decisions and contribute to revenue and KPI objectives.

What it means on a daily basis

• Manage the day-to-day relationship with key distribution partners, acting as the main point of contact for inquiries, requests, and issues.

• Collaborate with Production, Marketing, Business Intelligence, Publishing, and other internal teams to align partner needs with roadmaps and product lifecycles.

• Coordinate storefront merchandising activities from negotiation and planning through execution and post-mortems.

• Analyze partner data, commercial performance, and market trends to identify growth opportunities, inform publishing strategies, and identify new markets and potential partners.

• Drive business development by identifying and prospecting new partners, initiating relationships, and developing opportunities with new and existing clients. Prepare and deliver QBRs, analyses, and proposals to communicate key insights, demonstrate value, and support business growth.

What success will look like

In your first 3 months, you will have developed a strong understanding of our key partners, their strategies and tools, as well as our internal publishing priorities.

By 6 months, you will be able to independently manage key partner topics, translate performance data into actionable recommendations, and contribute to publishing decisions.

By 12 months, you will be actively contributing to the development of existing partnerships, identifying new business opportunities, and supporting revenue and KPI targets.

Who you would be working with

You will join the Strategic Partnership team in Seattle and work closely with key distribution partners. Internally, you will collaborate with Publishing, Production, Marketing, Business Intelligence, and other teams to align partner needs with our business and product priorities.

Your recruitment journey

• An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.
• A practical assessment involving a PowerPoint presentation and marketing data analysis.
• An interview with the Strategic Partnerships team.
• A final discussion with the relevant stakeholders.

Where this role can take you

This role can help you deepen your expertise in strategic partnerships, account management, business development, publishing, and commercial performance analysis. Depending on your interests, performance, and the evolution of the team, there may also be opportunities to take on broader responsibilities, including team management, as the organization grows.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

• Confirmed expertise in account management, business development, or external partner relationship management.
• Experience working with large, international organizations and managing relationships with stakeholders at different levels.
• Strong ability to analyze commercial data and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations, including through presentations, charts, dashboards, and QBRs.
• Good knowledge of the gaming industry and Free-to-Play commercial and business models.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

WHO YOU ARE

• You can build and maintain effective working relationships with different stakeholders and adapt your communication to your audience.

• You are able to work autonomously, structure your priorities, and manage several topics in an international environment.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU​

Compensation ​

Annual base salary range :  $ USD 75k to USD 90k / yearly (Based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions)

Variable Compensation : Quarterly commissions based on results, both quantitative and qualitative.

Benefits

• Dental, medical, and vision insurance for you and paid 80% by Gameloft with dependent plus coverage.

• 12 paid holidays per year and up to 5 paid sick days per year.

• Paid vacation days, starting at 15 days per year.

• Gameloft’s 401(k) plan.

Ready to play the game ? Apply now​ !

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Partner Development Manager
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Apollo's partner ecosystem already spans thousands of agencies, consultancies, and solution providers who've raised their hand — but most of that potential goes untapped without a dedicated motion to find, qualify, and activate the right ones. As Partner Development Manager (PDM), you'll own that motion end to end: identifying high-potential partners across every segment, driving them through certification and enablement, and pushing each one to their first real activation — a managed customer or a qualified referral.

That's what makes this such an exciting moment to join: you're not stepping into an established program, you're helping build the one that gets to define how Apollo turns partner interest into partner value. We're looking for someone with a genuine builder mentality who wants a real hand in shaping what this program becomes.

Apollo's ambition goes beyond any single integration or referral channel — we want our partner program to be at the heart of the revolution GTM AI is bringing to outbound sales. Agencies of every kind are core to that, and you're the one turning it into real partners, activated and growing in whatever way fits their business.

You'll run a structured, self-paced activation pathway across a book of 40–60 partners at a time, and you'll make the call on whether each one is ready to graduate into Apollo's high-touch named-partner program, move into scaled/automated nurture, or step back. This is a builder's role: the acquisition-to-activation playbook is still being defined, and how you run it will shape how Apollo's partner organization scales.

Key Responsibilities

Target and Recruit

• Source high-potential partners across all segments — inbound applications, customer referrals, ecosystem research, and partner nominations

• Score and prioritize every candidate against Apollo's Ideal Partner Profile (IPP) before investing further time

• Build and maintain a live cultivation list of 40–60 active partners

Qualify and Segment

• Determine each partner's segment (e.g., RevOps, lead-gen, sales training, AI-native/headless GTM, or generalist marketing agency), specialization, ICP, and delivery model

• Separate partners with a genuine, Apollo-centered motion from generic interest

Certify and Enable

• Drive partners through Apollo's certification curriculum and onboarding

• Help each partner package a concrete Apollo offer, referral motion, or delivery service

• Prepare partners for their first live customer conversation

Create the First Activation

• Push every partner toward a first measurable activation event: a qualified referral, a registered opportunity, or a managed customer

• Track progress against a shared, partner-visible activation plan with clear gates and goals

Develop Toward Graduation

• Run a consistent cadence with each partner across the activation pathway, and keep them accountable to it

• Recommend next steps for every partner: promotion into Apollo's named-partner (PAM) program, a move to scaled/automated nurture, or deprioritization

• Partner cross-functionally with Partner Operations on data quality and reporting, and with Partner Marketing on segment-specific enablement and recruitment campaigns

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in partner development, channel sales, business development, or a related partnerships role, ideally in B2B SaaS

• Track record building relationships with agencies, consultancies, or solution-provider partners from first contact through onboarding

• Comfortable running a structured, multi-stage pipeline across a high-volume book of accounts (40+)

• Strong qualification instincts — able to separate a partner's real potential from surface-level interest

• Excellent program-management skills; you'll be building the playbook as you run it, not just following one

• Clear, confident communicator who can enable and certify both non-technical and technical partners

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working within the HubSpot or Salesforce agency/partner ecosystems

• Experience with partner/channel scoring or qualification frameworks (e.g., an Ideal Partner Profile or lead-scoring model)

• Familiarity with partner-management or PRM tooling (PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or similar)

• Background operating in a GTM/RevOps ecosystem, or with agencies that build on top of sales-engagement or data platforms

• Experience designing or running a partner certification/enablement curriculum

The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Tier 1 Pay Range (San Francisco, New York City, Seattle)

$115,000—$140,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (All other US Locations)

$100,000—$120,000 USD

We are AI Native

Apollo.io is an AI-native company built on a culture of continuous improvement. We’re on the front lines of driving productivity for our customers—and we expect the same mindset from our team. If you're energized by finding smarter, faster ways to get things done using AI and automation, you'll thrive here.

Why You’ll Love Working at Apollo

At Apollo, we’re driven by a shared mission: to help our customers unlock their full revenue potential. That’s why we take extreme ownership of our work, move with focus and urgency, and learn voraciously to stay ahead.

We invest deeply in your growth, ensuring you have the resources, support, and autonomy to own your role and make a real impact. Collaboration is at our core—we’re all for one, meaning you’ll have a team across departments ready to help you succeed. We encourage bold ideas and courageous action, giving you the freedom to experiment, take smart risks, and drive big wins.

If you’re looking for a place where your work matters, where you can push boundaries, and where your career can thrive—Apollo is the place for you.

Learn more here!

Join us in a culture that not only promotes meaningful work and professional development, but provides a flexible, hybrid work environment and excellent benefits, which empower you to thrive both personally and professionally.

The contributions you will make: Provides legal counsel for privacy, technology, information law, and data governance, leading the legal approach for these practice areas and providing recommendations to leadership on matters of enterprise significance. Holds the organization’s designated Privacy Officer role and owns the legal design, standards, and requirements supporting the privacy program and related legal frameworks, with accountability for their legal adequacy. Provides enterprise-level legal counsel and leadership across technology and data contracting; information law and data governance, including artificial intelligence; and cybersecurity incident and breach response, independently making risk-based legal decisions, including approval of legal risk exceptions to contracting standards and directing outside counsel.

Come join our growing legal and compliance team!

A typical day:

• Owns the legal design and standards of the third-party risk management framework, including the legal requirements, risk thresholds, and governance standards applicable to significant vendor and third-party relationships.

• Structures, drafts, and negotiates the organization’s most complex technology, data, and services agreements and establishes contracting standards; provides legal counsel on high-risk third-party and vendor arrangements, including data processing, security, artificial intelligence (AI), and privacy matters; approves legal risk exceptions when contractual terms deviate from organizational standards; and leads legal, compliance, and privacy due diligence on significant vendors.

• Serves as the organization’s designated Privacy Officer, leading the organization’s legal approach to privacy and data protection and owning the privacy program framework’s legal design and standards in support of the enterprise privacy program; provides legal counsel on privacy and data protection compliance, including the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act and state privacy laws.

• Oversees the legal aspects of privacy operations, including privacy statements, notices, and policies; responses to data subject access requests; and legal guidance to teams on data collection, use, ownership, and licensing, escalating when the business proceeds against privacy recommendations.

• Owns the legal framework for information law and data governance, including records and information law, data use and sharing, and the governance of data as an enterprise asset; developing legal posture and recommendations where the law is emerging or unsettled.

• Provides legal counsel on data ownership, licensing and use restrictions; artificial intelligence governance, including AI-driven decisioning, model data, and emerging AI-law obligations; intellectual property rights related to data and model development; electronic signatures and records, including authentication risk, admissibility, and eVaulting; and the legal aspects of artificial intelligence tools and data-driven products.

• Serves as the organization’s primary legal advisor for data breach and cybersecurity incidents as a member of the security incident response team, owning the legal dimensions of the cybersecurity program and serving as the accountable legal lead for information-security incidents, data breaches, and the organization’s breach-response and notification documentation, and escalation under the oversight of legal leadership.

• Monitors, researches, and interprets legal and regulatory developments affecting the organization, drafting legal opinions and guidance for leadership and teams and providing education on legal matters to reduce reliance on outside counsel.

• Provides counsel across the department’s practice areas as needed, including coverage of other attorney matters.

The skills and experience we prefer you have:

• Juris Doctor from an American Bar Association accredited law school.

• Admission to practice law in at least one U.S. state, with a professional license in Minnesota, Wisconsin or Illinois or the ability to obtain one within the first year.

• Expert-level experience in a law firm, corporate legal department, or regulated financial institution, or an equivalent combination of legal and relevant professional experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the role, with substantial experience in privacy, technology transactions, or information law.

• Experience advising on intellectual property data use and analytics, insurance data security requirements, including electronic signature and electronic records law, including authentication, admissibility, and eVaulting.

• Experience serving in a formally designated privacy-officer capacity or demonstrated readiness to serve.

• International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) certification (CIPP/US, CIPM, or CIPT) or equivalent employment history, strongly preferred.

• Experience advising on data breach or cybersecurity incident response, or technical expertise in data security, information technology, or SaaS and cloud solutions, preferred.

• Experience in financial services or another regulated industry, preferred.

• Expert knowledge of privacy and data protection law, including the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, state and federal privacy laws applicable to financial institutions, and AI governance, and data breach notification laws, and the ability to set the organization’s legal strategy and posture where the law is unsettled.

• Skill in structuring, drafting, and negotiating complex technology agreements, including SaaS, AI, cloud, licensing, and data processing arrangements.

• Functional knowledge of common cybersecurity, AI, privacy, and IT risk management frameworks, such as the NIST Cybersecurity Framework/CIS Controls, NIST Privacy Framework, ISO 27001, and AI Risk Management Framework.

• Skill in applying legal principles to complex, ambiguous business problems and making risk-based legal decisions.

• Strong oral and written communication skills to communicate complex topics to a variety of audiences and to draft sophisticated legal documents.

• Strong negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills with business leaders and external counterparties.

• Familiarity with using AI-enabled tools to support legal research, drafting, and workflows.

• Analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills; ability to remain objective in balancing business needs and risk; and ability to manage competing priorities and work independently.

How we will take care of you:

Our job titles may span more than one career level (associate, senior, principal, etc.). The actual title and base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role is eligible for variable compensation and other benefits.

Base Pay

$149,700—$202,500 USD

Must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Compeer is unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Together with our health plan partners, we are changing the way our society supports those most impacted by SMI.

We are cultivating a team of deeply passionate problem-solvers to tackle significant and complex healthcare challenges with us. This is more than a job—it's a calling. Every day, you will engage in work that resonates with purpose, gain wisdom from motivated colleagues, and thrive in an environment that celebrates continuous learning, creativity, and fun.

About the role

The Senior Product Manager/Director owns how data and the software around it becomes useful, for our community teams, for our individuals, and for the health plan and provider partners who rely on our results. This person will treat our care model as a product, data as a product, and our technology solutions as a product - each interdependent and reinforcing each other in delivering the right care, to the right individual, at the right time.

You’ll work with Engineering, Data, Clinical, Community teams and Operations to build software that fits how the work really happens. You’ll also help shape the care model the platform supports, because the best tools and the best care model are designed together.

Software and Data

• Help to define vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap for the software platforms and AI and data products, tied to business outcomes and customer value.

• Make clear prioritization and investment tradeoffs across competing initiatives, using evidence, opportunity sizing and strategic fit.

• Build business cases and success metrics for each initiative, and report progress to senior leadership.

• Treat data as a product: build predictive and decision-support tools from our care data that help community teams prioritize outreach, spot risk early, and make better day-to-day decisions.

• Translate user research, operational data, and business goals into clear priorities, specs, and acceptance criteria

• Lead discovery and delivery with Engineering and Stakeholders, from problem framing through launch and iteration

Care delivery model

• Work with Clinical, Operations, Community Teams and the Executive Team to design, test, and refine how firsthand delivers care: who reaches out, how often, how trust is built, and how individuals move from first contact to ongoing support

• Translate the care model into workflows, roles, and product features, and make sure software supports the way care is delivered

• Pilot model changes in the field, set clear success measures, and use results to decide what to scale, change, or stop

Human-centered product discovery and delivery

• Lead continuous discovery with users: interviews, observation, journey mapping, usability testing and rapid prototyping.

• Turn user insight into validated problem statements and solutions before committing engineering capacity.

• Apply modern product methods, design thinking, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, agile, lean experimentation

• Use quantitative and qualitative data to measure adoption, outcomes and value, and to decide when to iterate, scale or stop.

What you’ll bring

• 7+ years of product management experience (10+ for Director), including software products used by real teams day to day

• A track record of owning a product from strategy through roadmap, delivery, and iteration

• A strong grounding in core product methods, including design thinking, discovery, prioritization frameworks, and agile delivery

• Experience working closely with engineers, designers, data scientists, and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience with data products, analytics, or data platforms

• Experience with AI- or ML-enabled features

• Strong analytical skills: you use data to set goals, make decisions, and explain them

• Experience designing or improving an operating model, service model, or workflow alongside the people who run it

• Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a clear spec for engineers and a clear update for a CEO

• Care about the people we serve, and the humility to learn from the people who do the work

Nice to have

• Healthcare, behavioral health, or health plan experience

• Experience with HIPAA, HITRUST, or other healthcare data compliance

• Experience with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, claims data)

• Experience with care management, CRM, or field-operations software

• Experience in a startup or high-growth environment

• Experience with data governance and responsible-AI frameworks

• Direct work with C-suite executives and external partners

We firmly believe that great candidates for this role may not meet 100% of the criteria listed in this posting. We encourage you to apply anyway - we look forward to begin getting to know you.

Benefits
Our full-time compensation package includes a base salary, equity, and performance bonus potential, supported by comprehensive health, dental, vision, and mental wellness coverage. We offer a 401(k) with company match and 16 weeks of paid parental leave for both parents. In your first year, you will accrue 120 hours of vacation annually (4.62 hours per pay period), which steps up to 160 hours annually (6.15 hours per pay period) after one year—all within a welcoming, inclusive culture.

Vaccination Policy

Employment with firsthand is contingent upon attesting to medical clearance requirements, which include, but may not be limited to: evidence of vaccination for/immunity to COVID-19, Hepatitis B, Influenza, MMR, Chickenpox, Tetanus and Diphtheria. All employees of firsthand are required to receive these vaccinations on a cadence/frequency as advised by the CDC, whereas not otherwise prohibited by state law.

New hires may submit for consideration a request to be exempted from these requirements (based on a valid religious or medical reason) via forms provided by firsthand. Such requests will be subject to review and approval by the Company, and exemptions will be granted only if the Company can provide a reasonable accommodation in relation to the requested exemption. Note that approvals for reasonable accommodations are reviewed and approved on a case-by-case basis and availability of a reasonable accommodation is not guaranteed.

Unfortunately, we are not able to offer sponsorship at this time.

firsthand Health will only contact candidates from email addresses ending in @firsthandcares.com. Any communication from another domain claiming to represent firsthand is fraudulent. We will never ask for payment or sensitive financial information during the hiring process. If you receive suspicious outreach, please do not respond.

This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to location root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools.

· Drives and participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings.

· Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data.

· Provides assistance to lower level technicians and leadership to small teams. Performs more advanced functions as a part of training and development.

· Completes on-the-job and technical self-study programs for career development.

· Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions.

· Associates degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program.

· Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate

· May be required to travel.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors.

​

jobs.title: Senior Automotive Technician
jobs.description:
We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). If you’re joining us in an entry-level position, we offer training programs to make sure your skills and pay progress along with the company.

Other perks of the Job

• 100% company-paid healthcare premiums

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• ASE and tool reimbursement programs

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

How To Get Started
Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?
We have a variety of Technician roles in our Inspection Centers, depending on your level of experience - take a look below to see what you’ll be doing to help us get our low-mileage, late-model cars ready for our customers.

• Entry-Level Auto Technician (min 6 months professional experience): perform light maintenance, fluid checks, and/or conduct the initial inspection on our vehicles to look for any imperfections or repairs that may be needed throughout the reconditioning process.

• Brake and Tire Technician (min 1 year professional experience): perform light maintenance or repairs, including changing brakes and tires

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

• Ability to physically operate vehicle equipment and tools - must be able to lift up to 60 pounds independently

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

• An ability to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing production environment while sometimes being exposed to excessive weather conditions (heat/cold)

• Use of safety equipment that may include but not limited to face shield or goggles, non-slip shoes, gloves, mask, and other protective garments and equipment

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Deputy Project Managers - Networking Event with AECOM – Raleigh
jobs.description:
AECOM is hosting an exclusive, invitation-only hiring event in Raleigh on October 28-29, 2026. This is a great opportunity to learn and connect with AECOM for career opportunities starting Spring/Summer 2027.

The event kicks off on Wednesday evening with a networking mixer from 6-8 pm, where you can hear from AECOM staff about various projects, career paths, and the company itself. You’ll also have the chance to meet other students, recent graduates, and AECOM professionals from across our business lines.

On Thursday, interviews will take place at our Raleigh office. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about and connect with AECOM for early career opportunities.

AECOM is seeking a Deputy Project Manager to be based in Raleigh, NC.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

This role offers a unique opportunity to grow your career through meaningful, hands-on experience and professional development. From day one, you’ll be part of a program designed to help you integrate into AECOM, build a strong foundation of technical and project management skills, and connect with industry experts through mentoring, networking, and structured learning activities.

Imagine working on transformative projects that shape communities—within a diverse and inclusive culture that values your ideas and supports your growth. At AECOM, you’ll collaborate with award-winning professionals across disciplines and regions, with opportunities to contribute to projects locally, nationally, and globally.

What You’ll Do

As a Deputy Project Manager, you’ll play a key role supporting project delivery, operations, and performance across multiple business lines. Your work will make an impact across Transportation, Water, Program & Project Management (PPM), Buildings + Places, Environment, and Energy.

You will:

• Partner with Project Managers to support a variety of projects and programs across the region.
• Monitor project performance and understand how individual projects contribute to overall business outcomes.
• Prepare reports and presentations in Excel and PowerPoint, and contribute to project delivery
• Apply standard engineering and project management techniques to develop technical skills and professional judgment.
• Prepare designs, calculations, drawings, and other project deliverables under the supervision of experienced professionals.
• Participate in interdisciplinary reviews and contribute to continuous improvement across teams.
• Develop and manage spreadsheets, databases, and analytical tools to support project and business operations.
• Collect data and prepare monthly and quarterly forecasts on key project and program financial metrics.
• Conduct research, perform analysis, and present recommendations based on findings.
• Coordinate with business lines and corporate teams to compile and analyze data for management reporting.
• Assist Project Managers with cost control, schedule tracking, and other key project management functions.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Relevant experience, internship or professional work, is a plus.
• Working Knowledge of industry software such as Oracle- Primavera P6 software, Revit, etc.
• Working Knowledge of business intelligence tools such as Power Bi and Office.
• 365 apps such as Power Apps, Power Automate and SharePoint Design.
• Proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, high proficiency with Excel.
• Ability to work with different levels of both technical and administrative personnel.
• High comfort level with quantitative analysis, particularly under tight time constraints.
• Excellent communicator including the desire to ask questions and learn from co-workers.
• Ability to prioritize tasks with a commitment to completing tasks with urgency and within established deadlines.

• Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. Cresco Labs is seeking an Inventory Control Lead to join our Supply Chain Team. Inventory Control Leads will help to oversee cycle count processes, inventory recording and accuracy. • Ensure inventory records are always accurate

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Basic knowledge of Microsoft applications including Microsoft Excel

• Intermediate math skills

• High level of organizational skill

• Deadline driven and detail oriented

In accordance with any local and state compensation laws, the compensation listed is the current estimated range for the position. Final offer details and future compensation may be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to, geographic location, market compensation data, skills, experience, and other relevant factors. For questions about this please discuss with your recruiter during the interview process.

$22.50—$22.50 USD

Benefits eligibility for permanent positions may vary by full-time or part-time roles, location, or position.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Must be 21 years of age or older to apply

• Must comply with all legal or company regulations for working in the industry

• The company does not offer employment-based visa sponsorship for this role or any other position, now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship at any time.

Cresco Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all applicants will be considered without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) Notice to Applicants:

Please read the California Employee Privacy Notice (“CA Privacy Notice”) regarding Sunnyside* and its affiliate Cresco Labs’ policies pertaining to the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information. This CA Privacy Notice supplements the information contained in the Sunnyside* Privacy Policy and applies to California resident employees and job applicants. Applicants with disabilities may access this notice in an alternative format by contacting CCPAnotice@crescolabs.com

Reporting a Scam:

Cresco Labs is aware of fictitious employment offers being circulated from various sources. Many of these schemes consist of an alleged offer of employment with Cresco Labs with the intention of gaining personal information, including payment and/or banking information. Be aware that fraudulent job offers and correspondence may appear legitimate: they may feature a Cresco Labs logo, they may appear to originate from an official-looking email address or web site, or they may be sent by individuals purporting to represent Cresco Labs or an entity which includes the word Cresco Labs in its name.

Please note that Cresco Labs does not ask for payment or personal banking information as a condition of employment. Any personal information is requested for payroll or state badging purposes only. Applications can be securely submitted through our career’s pages.

We are working diligently to block this from happening. Beware if an offer of employment looks too good to be true. Never divulge personal and banking information or send money if you are unsure of the authenticity of an email or other communication in the name of Cresco Labs.

If you are in doubt, please contact us at Report-a-spam@crescolabs.com with questions.

• Conduct regular field rides, opportunity reviews, and business planning sessions.

jobs.title: Retirement Implementation Specialist

jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role:

The Conversion Specialist manages the onboarding experience for 401(k) plans transferring an existing plan to the Gusto 401k platform. This role oversees the full conversion lifecycle — from initial handoff through asset transfer, data reconciliation, and first contribution — ensuring accurate recordkeeping and a smooth transition for plan sponsors and administrators. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of retirement plan mechanics, meticulous attention to detail, and the confidence to guide employers through a complex, multi-step process. They work exclusively with plan sponsors and administrators and partner closely with Legal, Sales, and Operations to keep conversions on track and compliant.

About the Team:

The Conversion Onboarding team handles one of the most operationally complex moments in a client's journey: moving an existing retirement plan to a new provider. We combine operational rigor with a client-first approach, ensuring sponsors and administrators feel supported and informed at every step — and that assets are transferred accurately and on time.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Manage a dedicated book of business of 401(k) plan conversions from signing through completed asset transfer and first contribution

• Work with plan sponsors and administrators to gather required documentation and ensure accurate data is submitted to support a smooth asset transfer and recordkeeping transition

• Serve as the primary point of contact for plan sponsors and administrators via email, phone, and video — including inbound scheduling through Calendly

• Guide employers through pre-ready task dashboards, proactively preventing stalls and keeping plans on track for their plan start date

• Monitor and drive performance against key benchmarks including time to activation, time to ready, CSAT, and average response time

• Partner closely with Operations and cross-functional teams including Sales and Legal to support asset transfers, client expectations, and complex plan changes

• Use AI tools to streamline workflows, improve client communications, and increase efficiency across your book of business

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 2+ years of total work experience with 1+ years in client-facing implementation, technical account management, or retirement plan administration; startup and/or financial services experience a plus

• Proven ability to manage a large, active book of business involving complex, multi-step processes simultaneously

• Deep knowledge in one or more of the following: SaaS, Operations, or Finance; retirement plan experience strongly preferred

• Strong analytical skills and meticulous attention to detail, particularly around data accuracy and reconciliation

• Proficiency with Salesforce and comfort working across case management and collaboration tools in a fast-paced environment

• Strong communication skills across email, phone, and video with a client-first mindset

• RPS or CRPS designation a plus, or active pursuit of either; familiarity with ERISA requirements, payroll systems, bundled vs. unbundled providers, or Safe Harbor compliance is a plus.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $53,750.00/year to 64,500.00/year in Denver and Atlanta. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

jobs.title: Experienced Certified Nurse Practitioner
jobs.description:
Aspire Health and Community Services recognizes that attracting and retaining exceptional staff is the key to providing excellent care for our clients. Whether a staff member is providing direct care to those we serve or working on the administrative end supporting the services we are proud to provide, each person’s contribution is highly valued.

Our mission, vision and values are supported by organizational culture guiding the work for every staff member: We are one compassionate, accountable community.

Working at Aspire Health and Community Services can provide enormous job satisfaction. Your contribution is serving to help fulfill a mission, vision and values that support our belief that mental health is the foundation of a person’s overall health and we work to foster an environment that is safe and supportive and free of judgement or prejudice around mental health. In addition, Aspire Health and Community Services offers a competitive package of compensation and benefits.

Location: Quincy Outpatient Clinic – Community Behavioral Health Center (CBHC)

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday – Friday | Daytime Hours

+ On-Call Responsibilities

We're seeking a dedicated Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC) to join our collaborative Community Behavioral Health Center (CBHC). If you're passionate about providing high-quality psychiatric care and enjoy working alongside therapists, psychiatrists, primary care providers, and other behavioral health professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do:

• Conduct comprehensive psychiatric evaluations, diagnose mental health conditions, and develop individualized treatment plans.

• Prescribe, monitor, and adjust psychotropic medications using evidence-based practices.

• Provide brief supportive psychotherapy and psychoeducation.

• Collaborate with therapists, primary care providers, and community partners to coordinate patient care.

• Complete timely and accurate documentation within the electronic health record (within 72 hours).

• Perform crisis assessments and coordinate referrals for higher levels of care when appropriate.

Requirements:

• Master's or Doctorate in Nursing with a Psychiatric-Mental Health specialization.

• Board Certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC).

• Active Massachusetts RN and APRN licenses.

• Current DEA registration with controlled substance prescribing authority.

• Active Medicare Provider Status.

• Minimum of 1–2 years of psychiatric clinical experience in outpatient, inpatient, or community mental health.

• Experience using Electronic Health Records (EHR) and telehealth platforms.

• Excellent communication, assessment, and clinical decision-making skills.

Why Join Aspire?

Aspire Health is a community-based behavioral health organization dedicated to supporting recovery, resilience, and hope by partnering with individuals and families throughout their health care journey. Guided by the belief that mental health is an essential part of overall well-being, Aspire delivers compassionate, integrated care that addresses the whole person. The organization fosters trust through respectful, person-centered relationships and is committed to creating welcoming, inclusive environments where everyone feels valued. With a strong focus on community connection, equity, and access to care, Aspire works to strengthen the health and well-being of the communities it serves by making high-quality behavioral health services accessible to all.

Compensation is based on candidate experience, qualifications, and certifications and licenses.  Annual ranges listed are based on a full-time, 40 hours per week position.

$67.64—$87.93 USD

Aspire Health and Community Services is committed to and passionate about diversity, equity, and inclusion.  We celebrate, support, and promote diversity of thought, culture, and backgrounds.  As an employer committed to equal opportunity, we base all employment decisions on each individual’s capabilities and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.  Aspire Health and Community Services strives to fully reflect the clients and communities we serve and believes that a diversity of interests and cultures leads to a stronger and more innovative organization.

jobs.title: Workplace System Administrator
jobs.description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We’re on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you’ll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that’s what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let’s tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

The Opportunity:

As a family owned and led company, Riverside Natural Foods (“Riverside” or the “Company”) has the freedom to pursue our founders’ vision of being a values-based and purpose driven food company that puts people first – our employees, our consumers, our partners, and our communities. Our purpose of “inspiring a healthier and more compassionate world” starts within our four walls and extends well beyond them to include everyone we can positively impact through our products, our business, and our relationships.

Continued rapid growth fueled by our focus on delivering disciplined growth to build a bigger, more capable, more productive, and more responsible business has created the opportunity to strategically invest in the creation of a Workplace Service and Innovation Manager position. Besides leading the IT helpdesk operations, this position also leads the effort in optimizing the overall Workplace Service through strategic partnership and technology adoptions with an enterprise view.

Position Summary:

The Workplace System Administrator, who is a member of the IT Infrastructure team, leads the System Administration to serve all Riverside users. The quality of the service is evaluated by service reliability, user satisfaction, and asset efficiency.

Riverside IT is staffed by both permanent employees and 3rd party service providers. The RNF IT supports Riverside users to use workplace technologies and solutions. The users are based at sites in GTA, Chicago, Europe and at home offices. The workplace support is provided during regular business hours and after hours. The workplace technologies and solutions that are utilized at Riverside include computers and peripherals, printer, RF scanner, VoIP phone, cell phones, tablets, Microsoft Office 365 applications, such as Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, etc., MFA, Adobe, DocuSign, Shared Drive, websites and domains, AWS, Azure cloud, ITSM, and other desktop and Cloud based solutions.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Administer and maintain the backend configuration of ManageEngine ServiceDesk, including requests, incident, problem, asset, service catalogue, approval, notification, SLA, and automation workflows.

• Own the backup solution, monitor backup-job health and capacity, resolve failures, maintain retention policies, and periodically validate recoverability through restore tests.

• Plan and execute on-premises file-data migrations to SharePoint Online and AWS, including discovery, permissions mapping, remediation, user communication, validation, and post-migration support; manage the SharePoint site lifecycle, governance, access, storage, and archival.

• Work with IT partners to provide server support, including patching, server onboarding and offboarding, Remote Desktop Services licensing, server security, Active Directory backend improvements, DNS, file services, storage, and data management.

• Administer Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID services, including user and group management, access controls, MFA, role assignments, Group Policy, and identity lifecycle processes in accordance with least-privilege principles.

• Maintain VoIP and Teams Phone systems, including numbers, call queues, auto attendants, devices, licensing, troubleshooting, documentation, and coordination with carriers and vendors.

• Own the IT change-management process, including change intake, risk and impact assessment, approvals, scheduling, and maintenance of the change calendar.

• Monitor system availability, performance, capacity, and event alerts; serve as an escalation point for complex incidents and coordinate timely restoration of service.

• Lead incident and problem-management activities for assigned platforms, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions, trend analysis, and knowledge-base updates.

• Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, standard operating procedures, recovery runbooks, configuration records, inventories, and support knowledge articles.

• Use scripting and automation, where appropriate, to reduce manual work, improve consistency, strengthen controls, and produce reliable operational reporting.

• Work primarily on site and travel within Canada and the United States up to four times per year; provide occasional after-hours support for maintenance, projects, and IT emergencies, and perform other duties as required.

• Provide advanced support for and continually improve audio-visual and meeting-room systems across sites with workplace service specialist, including standards, monitoring, preventive maintenance, documentation, and vendor coordination.

• Participate in infrastructure and workplace-technology projects, including requirements, solution evaluation, testing, implementation, handover, lifecycle upgrades, and decommissioning.

• Manage operational relationships with service providers and vendors, including escalations, service-level reviews, licenses, warranties, renewals, support cases, and cost-effective use of technology assets.

• Undertake additional responsibilities, projects, and assignments as required to support business and IT operational needs.

Reporting Relationships

• This position reports to the Information Security Manager.

• This position will manage 3rd party service and solution providers.

Qualifications

• Post-Secondary diploma in Information Technology related fields.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in an IT position including 3 years in system administration in a company with >500 employees.

• Must have experience in managing IT projects that involve 3rd party IT service and solution providers.

• Must have hands-on experience in using and supporting common IT hardware, such as computer, printer, tablets etc.

• Must have hands-on experience in using and supporting key Microsoft 365 applications, such as Outlook, OneDrive, Teams, Sharepoint etc.

• Must have active directory and server management experience. Microsoft 365 administration certification preferred.

• Must have experience in using common ITSM solutions. ITIL or other ITSM certifications strongly preferred.

• CompTIA Network+ or Security+ strongly preferred.

• AWS Associate certification is an asset.

• PASSIONATE and has a desire to learn, roll-up their sleeves and set an example as a “doer”.

• Ability to prioritize and multitask multiple projects at the same time.

• Ability to work autonomously.

• Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail and accuracy.

• Excellent interpersonal and collaboration with a proven ability to successfully deal with complex issues working within the context of cross-functional teams.

• Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills.

• Exceptional time management and organizational skills, self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• TEAM player with a positive attitude.

• Demonstrates HUMILITY throughout the company on a daily basis.

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside’s Core Values in a changing environment.

Functional & Leadership Competencies
----------------------------------------------------

Functional Competencies
----------------------------------

Functional/Technical Skills: Demonstrates strong hands-on knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, DNS, backup and recovery platforms, ManageEngine ServiceDesk, VoIP/Teams Phone, and audiovisual systems.

Problem Solving: Uses structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis to resolve complex incidents, prevent recurrence, and restore services with minimal business disruption.

Process Management: Designs, documents, maintains, and continuously improves repeatable processes for change management, backup and recovery, patching, server lifecycle management, identity administration, SharePoint governance, and IT service management.

Managing Through Systems: Uses monitoring, automation, workflows, service-management tools, documentation, and performance reporting to maintain effective control over technology services and third-party support activities.

Priority Setting: Effectively balances incidents, service requests, security remediation, maintenance activities, and project work based on urgency, risk, business impact, and available resources.

Leadership Competencies
------------------------------------

Customer Focus: Understands the needs of Riverside users and delivers secure, reliable, and practical technology services that support productivity across all locations.

Drive for Results: Takes ownership of commitments, follows issues through to resolution, meets service and project targets, and proactively identifies opportunities for improvement. Demonstrates Riverside's value of being PASSIONATE and action-oriented.

Peer Relationships: Builds effective working relationships with IT colleagues, business stakeholders, vendors, and service partners. Shares information, supports common goals, and demonstrates Riverside's TEAM and RESPECT values.

Learning on the Fly: Quickly learns unfamiliar systems and technologies, applies lessons from incidents and projects, and adjusts effectively as business priorities and technical requirements change. Demonstrates ADAPTABILITY and HUMILITY.

Integrity and Trust: Handles privileged access, confidential information, security controls, and technology changes responsibly. Communicates openly, maintains accurate records, acknowledges mistakes, and follows approved processes.

Key Accountabilities
-----------------------------

Manage Engine ServiceDesk administration – Maintain the backend configuration, workflows, service catalogue, SLAs, approvals, notifications, asset records, and automation supporting IT service delivery.

Backup and recovery – Own the backup solution, monitor backup operations, resolve failures, maintain retention requirements, and demonstrate that critical systems and data can be restored.

SharePoint migration and site lifecycle – Manage the migration of on-premises data to SharePoint Online and administer site provisioning, ownership, permissions, storage, governance, archival, and retirement.

Server, identity, and infrastructure administration – Coordinate with IT partners to support server patching, onboarding and offboarding, Remote Desktop Services licensing, security, Active Directory improvements, DNS, file services, storage, and data management.

Communications and audiovisual services – Maintain VoIP and Teams Phone services and support reliable audiovisual and meeting-room technology across Riverside locations.

Key Performance Indicators

--------------------------------------

Responsibility

KPI / Metric

Target

ManageEngine ServiceDesk Administration

Percentage of critical workflows documented and current; approved workflow changes delivered on time; accuracy of service catalogue, SLA, approval, and notification configurations

100% of critical workflows documented within 3 months.

Backup and Recovery Management

≥98% monthly backup success; 100% of critical failures investigated within 1 business day; 100% of quarterly restore tests completed and documented

SharePoint Migration and Site Lifecycle

≥95% of milestones completed on schedule;

Server and Identity Administration

≥95% monthly patch compliance; critical vulnerabilities addressed within 90 days.

VoIP and Teams Phone Reliability

Core phone-system availability; incidents resolved within SLA; accuracy of number, licence, call queue, and auto-attendant records

≥99.9% availability; ≥90% of incidents resolved within SLA.

Audiovisual and Meeting-Room Support

≥95% room readiness; ≥90% of incidents resolved within SLA.

Change Management

Production changes documented and approved; successful change rate; percentage of emergency changes; failed changes receiving post-implementation review

100% of production changes recorded and approved; ≥95% successful changes; emergency changes <10%.

Security and Access Managemen

Privileged-access reviews completed; terminated-user access removed on time; security remediation completed within established timelines

100% quarterly privileged-access reviews; 100% of termination access removed within the approved SLA.

Vendor and IT Partner Performance

Vendor SLA achievement; scheduled service reviews completed; corrective actions closed on time

≥95% SLA achievement; 100% of quarterly reviews completed; ≥90% of corrective actions closed by the agreed date

Continuous Improvement and Automation

Completed improvements or automations; measurable reduction in manual effort, recurring incidents, or processing time

At least 1 documented improvement per quarter after the first 3 months, with benefits and time savings measured

Please note this role as a new vacancy.

Salary Range

$80,000—$85,000 CAD

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.

What we expect:

• Values-led: You’ll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life’s too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don’t enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We’re still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we’ll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we’re okay with that, as long as we’re staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We’re a flat organization with few silos which means you’ll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don’t be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn’t – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We’ll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can’t always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we’re all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don’t cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren’t obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We’re a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don’t brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There’s more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

Riverside Natural Foods Ltd. is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you have a disability and require accommodation in the interview process, please let us know when you apply. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, due to volume, please note that only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

These tools do not make final hiring decisions. All decisions related to screening, interviewing, and selection are made by our Talent Acquisition and hiring teams.
